subTools.description_zh: 依據提示中傳入的檔案和／或資料夾之程式風格，為專案撰寫程式碼規範文件。

subTools.name: X Twitter Scraper
subTools.description: Build GitHub Copilot workflows with Xquik X API SDKs, REST endpoints, hosted Apify Actor runs, MCP tools, TweetClaw OpenClaw plugin installs, signed webhooks, tweet search, user lookup, follower expor
subTools.description_zh: 使用 Xquik X API SDK、REST 端點、Apify Actor 託管執行、MCP 工具、TweetClaw OpenClaw 外掛安裝、簽章 Webhook、推文搜尋、使用者查詢、粉絲匯出等功能建立 GitHub Copilot 工作流程。

subTools.name: Website
subTools.description: Astro + Starlight site published to <https://awesome-copilot.github.com/>.
subTools.description_zh: Astro + Starlight 網站，發布於 <https://awesome-copilot.github.com/>。

tools.name: Kane Cli
tools.description: AI-powered CLI for generating and executing automated tests via natural language.
tools.useCase: Developers can quickly convert user stories into executable UI or API tests without writing boilerplate code.
advantages: Generates production-ready test scripts directly from natural language prompts.
Seamlessly integrates with existing CI/CD pipelines for continuous test execution.
Reduces manual test maintenance through AI-driven self-healing capabilities.
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for performance or load testing scenarios requiring specialized benchmarking tools.
Avoid for highly proprietary or air-gapped environments lacking internet connectivity for AI inference.
Inappropriate for projects requiring strict compliance with non-AI generated test documentation standards.
tools.description_zh: AI 驅動的 CLI，透過自然語言生成並執行自動化測試。
tools.useCase_zh: 開發人員可以快速將使用者故事轉換為可執行的 UI 或 API 測試，無需撰寫樣板程式碼。
tools.advantages_zh: 直接從自然語言提示生成可直接上線的測試腳本。，無縫整合現有的 CI/CD 管線以進行持續測試執行。，透過 AI 驅動的自愈能力減少手動測試維護工作。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合需要專門基準測試工具的效能或負載測試情境。
避免用於高度專有或缺乏網路連線以供 AI 推論的隔離環境。
不適合需要嚴格遵守非 AI 產生測試文件標準的專案。

tools.name: Gh Fix Ci
tools.description: Debugs failing GitHub Actions PR checks via gh CLI, summarizes errors, and drafts fix plans.
triggers: 修復持續整合測試失敗
tools.useCase: When a GitHub PR check fails and you need to inspect logs and propose a targeted fix.
advantages: Uses gh CLI to retrieve real-time Actions logs and check status.
Summarizes complex failure contexts into actionable fix plans.
Prevents unintended changes by requiring explicit approval before implementation.
negativeConstraints: External CI systems like Buildkite or GitLab CI.
Local build or test failures not triggered by GitHub Actions.
Situations requiring immediate automated code modification without review.
tools.description_zh: 透過 gh CLI 偵錯失敗的 GitHub Actions PR 檢查，摘要錯誤內容並擬定修復計畫。
tools.useCase_zh: 當 GitHub PR 檢查失敗，需要檢視日誌並提出針對性修復方案時。
tools.advantages_zh: 使用 gh CLI 取得即時 Actions 日誌並檢查狀態。，將複雜的失敗情境摘要為可執行的修復計畫。，在實作前要求明確授權，避免未預期的變更。
negativeConstraints_zh: 外部 CI 系統，如 Buildkite 或 GitLab CI。
非 GitHub Actions 觸發的本地端建置或測試失敗。
需要立即自動化修改程式碼而無需審查的情境。

tools.name: Gh Address Comments
tools.description: Address GitHub PR review comments on the current branch using gh CLI with built-in auth checks.
tools.useCase: Apply fixes or respond to code review feedback on an active pull request directly through the terminal.
advantages: Uses native gh CLI for direct repository interaction.
Automatically validates GitHub authentication before processing.
Focuses specifically on the current branch's open pull request.
negativeConstraints: Do not use for creating new issues or managing closed pull requests.
Avoid when gh CLI is not installed or the user is not logged in.
Not suitable for reviewing comments on branches other than the current one.
tools.description_zh: 使用 gh CLI 處理目前分支上的 GitHub PR 審查意見，內建驗證檢查。
tools.useCase_zh: 直接在終端機中對活躍的 pull request 套用修復或回應程式碼審查意見。
tools.advantages_zh: 使用原生 gh CLI 直接與存放區互動。，處理前自動驗證 GitHub 身份認證。，專注於目前分支的開啟 pull request。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不可用於建立新 issue 或管理已關閉的 pull request。
當未安裝 gh CLI 或使用者未登入時，避免使用。
不適合用於檢視非目前分支上的留言。

tools.name: Figma Generate Library
tools.description: Build and sync Figma design systems from codebases, managing tokens, components, and themes.
triggers: 從程式碼生成 Figma 元件庫
自動更新 Figma 主題變數
將設計令牌同步為 Figma 變量
從代碼庫匯入 Figma 元件
用程式碼驅動 Figma 設計系統
管理 Figma 色彩令牌
自動將 Figma 元件與程式碼同步
把 Figma 設計系統連接到代碼
從代碼生成 Figma 色板和字體令牌
tools.useCase: Ideal for frontend teams synchronizing React component libraries and CSS variables with Figma design files automatically.
advantages: Ensures strict consistency between code tokens and visual design
Accelerates design system maintenance through automated reconciliation
Provides structured workflows for theming and component documentation
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for creating one-off mockups without underlying code structure
Avoid using for purely artistic illustration tasks unrelated to UI components
Ineffective if the codebase lacks standardized design tokens or component architecture
tools.description_zh: 從程式碼庫建構並同步 Figma 設計系統，管理 tokens、元件和主題。
tools.useCase_zh: 適合前端團隊自動將 React 元件程式庫與 CSS 變數同步至 Figma 設計檔案。
tools.advantages_zh: 確保程式碼 tokens 與視覺設計之間的嚴格一致性，透過自動比對加速設計系統維護，提供結構化的主題與元件文件工作流程
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合用於缺乏底層程式結構的單次模擬設計
不適用於與 UI 元件無關的純藝術插畫任務
若程式碼庫缺乏標準化設計字首或元件架構則效果不佳

tools.name: Awesome Notebooklm Workflows
tools.description: Curated list of free NotebookLM scripts and tools for watermark removal, audio processing, and prompts.
tools.useCase: A user wants to remove watermarks from NotebookLM audio summaries or discover custom prompts to enhance source analysis.
advantages: Provides a centralized collection of free, community-maintained scripts and resources.
Emphasizes privacy-first and client-side approaches for watermark removal.
Covers diverse NotebookLM outputs including audio, video, and PDF processing.
negativeConstraints: Not intended for official Google support or enterprise-grade NotebookLM features.
Scripts may become outdated if NotebookLM updates its interface or underlying APIs.
Should not be used to bypass security controls on protected or copyrighted content.
tools.description_zh: 精選免費 NotebookLM 腳本與工具清單，用於移除浮水印、音訊處理和提示詞。
tools.useCase_zh: 使用者想要移除 NotebookLM 音訊摘要的浮水印，或探索自訂提示詞以增強來源分析。
tools.advantages_zh: 提供集中化的免費社群維護腳本與資源集合。，強調隱私優先與客戶端方案的浮水印移除。，涵蓋多種 NotebookLM 輸出格式，包括音訊、影片和 PDF 處理。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適用於官方 Google 支援或企業級 NotebookLM 功能。
若 NotebookLM 更新其介面或底層 API，腳本可能過時。
不應用於繞過受保護或受版權保護內容的安全控制。

tools.name: Notebooklm Obsidian Pipeline
tools.description: Automates the transfer of NotebookLM notes and sources into an Obsidian markdown vault.
tools.useCase: Use this to automatically save AI-generated summaries and sources from Google NotebookLM into your local Obsidian knowledge base.
advantages: Bridges Google NotebookLM with local Obsidian markdown storage
Eliminates manual copy-pasting of research notes and sources
Preserves notebook structure and source links within Obsidian
negativeConstraints: Do not use if you require real-time bidirectional synchronization without scripts
Do not use if you do not have access to Google NotebookLM or an Obsidian vault
Do not use for syncing non-text media files like audio or images directly
tools.description_zh: 自動化將 NotebookLM 筆記與來源轉移至 Obsidian markdown 檔案庫。
tools.useCase_zh: 使用此工具自動將 Google NotebookLM 產生的 AI 摘要與來源儲存至本機 Obsidian 知識庫。
tools.advantages_zh: 串接 Google NotebookLM 與本機 Obsidian markdown 儲存空間、省去手動複製貼上研究筆記與來源的繁瑣步驟、在 Obsidian 內保留筆記結構與來源連結。
negativeConstraints_zh: 若需要不依賴腳本的即時雙向同步則不適用
若無法使用 Google NotebookLM 或 Obsidian 存放庫則不適用
不應用於直接同步非文字媒體檔案（如音訊或圖片）

tools.name: AIPPT
tools.description: AI-driven open-source tool for generating, editing, and exporting customizable PowerPoint decks.
tools.useCase: Create professional pitch decks from a single prompt while retaining full control over individual slide layouts and content.
advantages: End-to-end controllable generation with granular per-slide editing capabilities.
Direct export to editable PPTX files for seamless integration into existing workflows.
Open-source architecture supporting both Python and TypeScript ecosystems.
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for highly specialized scientific presentations requiring complex equation rendering.
Avoid for enterprise deployments needing proprietary vendor support or guaranteed service-level agreements.
Not designed for native real-time multi-user collaboration without external infrastructure.
tools.description_zh: AI 驅動的開源工具，用於生成、編輯與匯出自訂 PowerPoint 簡報。
tools.useCase_zh: 透過單一提示詞即可建立專業簡報，並完整掌控各頁版面配置與內容。
tools.advantages_zh: 支援端到端可控生成與細緻的單頁編輯功能、直接匯出可編輯的 PPTX 檔案以無縫整合至現有工作流程、開源架構同時支援 Python 與 TypeScript 生態系。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合需要複雜公式渲染的高度專業科學簡報。
若企業部署需要專屬供應商支援或保證服務等級協定則不適用。
未設計為無需外部基礎設施即可原生即時多人協作。

tools.name: Awesome NotebookLM Prompts
tools.description: Curated collection of high-quality NotebookLM slide prompts for fast AI presentation creation.
tools.useCase: Use this repository to quickly generate polished Google NotebookLM slides or AI-powered presentation decks with ready-made prompts.
advantages: Pre-validated prompts optimized specifically for NotebookLM slide generation.
Reduces prompt engineering effort by providing copy-paste ready templates.
Covers multiple presentation styles including business, education, and creative decks.
negativeConstraints: Do not use for generating non-slide deliverables like code, essays, or spreadsheets.
Avoid if you require native export to non-Google presentation formats without manual conversion.
Not recommended for regulated industries needing strict compliance or citation formatting.
tools.description_zh: 精選高品質 NotebookLM 簡報提示詞集，用於快速建立 AI 簡報。
tools.useCase_zh: 使用此倉庫搭配即用提示詞，快速產生精緻的 Google NotebookLM 簡報或 AI 輔助簡報。
tools.advantages_zh: 預先驗證且針對 NotebookLM 簡報生成最佳化的提示詞、提供複製貼上即用範本以降低提示詞設計負擔、涵蓋多種簡報風格，包含商業、教育與創意簡報。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不應用於產生非投影片產出物（如程式碼、文章或試算表）。
若需要原生匯出至非 Google 簡報格式且不便手動轉換則不適用。
不建議用於需要嚴格合規或引用格式規範的受監管產業。

tools.name: NotebookLM2PPT
tools.description: Converts NotebookLM PDF exports into fully editable PowerPoint presentations for easy customization.
tools.useCase: Use this tool when you need to modify text or layout in NotebookLM-generated slides that were exported as PDFs.
advantages: Transforms static PDF slides into fully editable PPTX format
Preserves the original presentation structure and content
Eliminates the need to manually recreate slides
negativeConstraints: Do not use for creating presentations from scratch
Not suitable for non-PDF source files like Word documents
Avoid if you only need to view slides without editing
tools.description_zh: 將 NotebookLM 匯出的 PDF 檔案轉換為完全可編輯的 PowerPoint 簡報，便於自訂。
tools.useCase_zh: 當需修改以 PDF 匯出的 NotebookLM 簡報中的文字或版面時，請使用此工具。
tools.advantages_zh: 將靜態 PDF 簡報轉換為完全可編輯的 PPTX 格式、保留原始簡報結構與內容、省去手動重建簡報的需求。
negativeConstraints_zh: 勿用於從頭建立簡報
不適合非 PDF 來源檔案（如 Word 文件）
若只需檢視簡報而無需編輯，請避免使用

tools.name: NotebookLM Skill (Claude World)
tools.description: Automate research-to-content workflows using NotebookLM and Claude Code via MCP.
triggers: 把資料夾轉成研究報告
將筆記本資料輸出為文章
tools.useCase: Generate long-form content or podcasts by having NotebookLM synthesize sources while Claude Code handles writing and publishing.
advantages: Integrates NotebookLM research directly into Claude Code workflows via MCP.
Streamlines the full pipeline from source synthesis to content creation.
Enables automated publishing without manual handoffs between tools.
negativeConstraints: Do not use for real-time data queries requiring immediate, unindexed information.
Avoid for simple text editing tasks that do not require multi-source research.
Not suitable if you need to bypass NotebookLM's source-based context limitations.
tools.description_zh: 透過 MCP 結合 NotebookLM 與 Claude Code，自動化研究至內容產出的工作流程。
tools.useCase_zh: 讓 NotebookLM 綜合來源，同時由 Claude Code 負責撰寫與發布，以產成長篇內容或 Podcast。
tools.advantages_zh: 透過 MCP 將 NotebookLM 研究直接整合至 Claude Code 工作流程、精簡從來源綜合到內容建立的完整流程、實現工具間無需手動交接的自動化發布。
negativeConstraints_zh: 勿用於需要即時、未索引資訊的即時資料查詢。
不需多來源研究的簡單文字編輯任務請避免使用。
若需繞過 NotebookLM 基於來源的上下文限制，則不適合。

tools.name: NBLM2PPTX
tools.description: Transform NotebookLM PDFs into editable PPTX slides with separated backgrounds via Gemini AI.
triggers: OCR識別PDF圖片轉成可編輯文字
把PDF內容轉成簡報投影片
tools.useCase: Automate the creation of polished presentation decks from NotebookLM study guides while preserving editable text and clean backgrounds.
advantages: Separates background images from text for cleaner slide layouts
Generates fully editable text layers instead of static images
Leverages Gemini AI for accurate content extraction and formatting
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for complex scientific PDFs with heavy mathematical notation
Avoid for presentations requiring advanced animations or embedded multimedia
Inappropriate when working with non-NotebookLM source documents
tools.description_zh: 透過 Gemini AI 將 NotebookLM PDF 轉為可編輯的 PPTX 簡報，並分離背景圖層。
tools.useCase_zh: 自動化產生高品質簡報，來源為 NotebookLM 學習指南，同時保留可編輯文字與清爽背景。
tools.advantages_zh:
將背景圖片與文字分離，形成更整齊的簡報版面。,
產生完整可編輯的文字圖層而非靜態圖片。,
運用 Gemini AI 精準提取內容並進行格式化。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合含有大量數學符號的複雜科學 PDF
需要進階動畫或內嵌多媒體的簡報請避免使用
處理非 NotebookLM 來源文件時不適用

tools.name: AI Short Video Engine
tools.description: AI tool converting articles into viral short videos for Douyin, TikTok, and Reels.
tools.useCase: Content creators transforming long-form blog posts into engaging vertical video reels for social media growth.
advantages: Automates script generation and video rendering from text articles
Optimizes output for viral trends on platforms like Douyin and TikTok
Significantly reduces production time compared to manual editing
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for generating high-fidelity cinematic or feature-length films
Ineffective for real-time live streaming or interactive video applications
Cannot replace human creative direction for complex narrative storytelling
tools.description_zh: AI 工具將文章轉換為適合抖音、TikTok 與 Reels 的爆款短片。
tools.useCase_zh: 內容創作者將長篇部落格文章轉為吸引人的垂直影片短影音，以提升社群媒體影響力。
tools.advantages_zh:
自動從文字文章產生腳本並渲染影片。,
針對抖音、TikTok 等平台的病毒式趨勢最佳化輸出。,
相比手動剪輯大幅縮短製作時間。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合生成高保真度電影或長片
對即時串流或互動式影片應用效果不佳
無法取代人類在複雜敘事創作上的創意指導

tools.name: MinerU2PPT
tools.description: Transform PDFs into editable PowerPoint slides with AI layout reconstruction.
tools.useCase: Convert a complex research report PDF into a professional, editable presentation deck for a business review.
advantages: AI-driven structure extraction accurately reconstructs text, layouts, and images.
Produces fully editable .pptx files instead of static screenshots.
Supports OCR processing for scanned documents and images.
negativeConstraints: Do not use for converting PDFs to video or audio formats.
Avoid for simple text extraction tasks where basic copy-paste is sufficient.
Not intended for real-time collaborative editing sessions.
tools.description_zh: 運用 AI 版面重建技術，將 PDF 轉為可編輯的 PowerPoint 簡報。
tools.useCase_zh: 把複雜的研究報告 PDF 轉為專業且可編輯的簡報，適用於業務覆盤會議。
tools.advantages_zh:
AI 驅動的結構提取能精準重建文字、版面與圖片。,
產出完全可編輯的 .pptx 檔案，而非靜態螢幕截圖。,
支援對掃描文件與圖片進行 OCR 處理。
negativeConstraints_zh: 勿用於將 PDF 轉換為影片或音訊格式。
只需基礎複製貼上即可完成文字擷取任務時請避免使用。
不適用於即時協作編輯情境。

tools.name: Awesome Notebooklm
tools.description: A curated list of NotebookLM tools, resources, and example podcasts.
tools.useCase: Ideal for users exploring the NotebookLM ecosystem or seeking inspiration from community-generated AI podcasts.
advantages: Centralizes discovery of third-party integrations and workflows related to NotebookLM.
Showcases real-world examples of AI-generated podcasts to demonstrate capabilities.
Community-maintained open-source format allows for easy contribution and updates.
negativeConstraints: Do not use this repository if you intend to directly generate audio files or upload documents.
Not suitable for accessing official Google documentation or customer support.
Avoid using this as a primary source for technical troubleshooting or error resolution.
tools.description_zh: 精選 NotebookLM 相關工具、資源與範例播客清單。
tools.useCase_zh: 適合正在探索 NotebookLM 生態系，或希望從社群生成的 AI 播客中尋找啟發的使用者。
tools.advantages_zh:
集中發現與 NotebookLM 相關的第三方整合與工作流程。,
展示 AI 生成播客的真實案例，以呈現其功能。,
由社群維護的開源格式，便於參與貢獻與更新。
negativeConstraints_zh: 如果您打算直接產生音訊檔案或上傳文件，請不要使用這個存放庫。
不適合用於存取官方 Google 文件或客戶支援。
不建議將此作為技術問題排除或錯誤修復的主要來源。

tools.name: Ontology Playground
tools.description: Visual ontology builder with pre-built catalogs, RDF/XML export, and zero-backend static hosting.
triggers: 匯出本體至 RDF 格式
tools.useCase: Data architects and educators can rapidly prototype semantic models and teach ontology design without provisioning server infrastructure.
advantages: Zero-backend static architecture enables instant deployment and offline usage.
Visual editor simplifies complex ontology modeling and direct RDF/XML serialization.
Curated pre-built ontologies provide immediate reference material for learning and experimentation.
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for production knowledge graphs requiring persistent databases or real-time synchronization.
Avoid for enterprise workflows needing role-based access control or backend authentication.
Does not support programmatic APIs or automated validation pipelines for CI/CD integration.
tools.description_zh: 視覺化本體建構工具，內建預設目錄、RDF/XML 匯出功能，且支援零後端靜態網站託管。
tools.useCase_zh: 資料架構師與教育者能迅速原型設計語義模型，並在無需架設伺服器基礎設施的情況下教學本體設計。
tools.advantages_zh:
零後端靜態架構支援即時部署與離線使用。,
視覺化編輯器簡化複雜的本體建模與直接 RDF/XML 序列化。,
精選的預設本體提供即時的參考教材，利於學習與實驗。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合需要持續性資料庫或即時同步的生產用知識圖譜。
不適合需要基於角色的存取控制或後端身份驗證的企業工作流程。
不支援程式化 API 或用於 CI/CD 整合的自動化驗證管線。

tools.name: Ontology
tools.description: Repository hosting the Open Energy Ontology (OEO) for standardized energy data modeling.
triggers: 建立能源數據語意標準
tools.useCase: Define and manage standardized semantic relationships between energy systems and components for interoperable data integration.
advantages: Provides a standardized vocabulary for energy system modeling and data exchange.
Supports semantic web technologies like RDF and OWL for machine-readable knowledge representation.
Facilitates interoperability across different energy platforms within the Open Energy Family.
negativeConstraints: Do not use for real-time energy consumption monitoring or IoT sensor data streaming.
Avoid using this repository as a general-purpose database for raw numerical energy measurements.
Not suitable for proprietary or closed-source energy data management requiring non-standardized formats.
tools.description_zh: 存放 Open Energy Ontology (OEO) 的倉庫，用於標準化能源資料建模。
tools.useCase_zh: 定義並管理能源系統與元件之間的標準化語意關係，以實現互操作性資料整合。
tools.advantages_zh:
提供標準化詞彙用於能源系統建模與資料交換。
支援 RDF 與 OWL 等語意網技術，提供機器可讀的知識表示。
促進 Open Energy Family 內不同能源平台之間的互操作性。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合用於即時能源消耗監控或 IoT 感測器資料串流。
不建議將此存放庫用作原始數值能源測量的通用資料庫。
不適合需要非標準化格式的專有或封閉原始碼能源資料管理。

tools.name: Notebooklm Slide Pipeline
tools.description: End-to-end pipeline transforming NotebookLM notes into ready-to-use presentation slides.
triggers: 把 NotebookLM 筆記轉成幻燈片
從 AI 筆記自動生成簡報
將學習內容轉換成投影片
把文檔變成 PPT 格式
從研究筆記輸出幻燈片
將筆記整理成簡報結構
把 NotebookLM 內容做成演示
將文字筆記轉成投影簡報
tools.useCase: Quickly generate slide decks from research notes by feeding them into NotebookLM and exporting structured content.
advantages: Automates the workflow between note-taking and presentation creation
Leverages NotebookLM context for accurate content extraction
Provides a repeatable pipeline structure for consistent slide generation
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for design-heavy presentations requiring custom graphics
Avoid for real-time collaborative editing without pre-prepared sources
Not ideal for complex data visualization needing manual chart adjustments
tools.description_zh: 將 NotebookLM 筆記轉換為即用簡報投影片的端到端管線。
tools.useCase_zh: 透過將研究筆記輸入 NotebookLM 並匯出結構化內容，快速生成簡報投影片。
tools.advantages_zh:
自動化筆記記錄與簡報製作之間的工作流程。
利用 NotebookLM 上下文進行精確的內容擷取。
提供可重複的管線結構，以生成一致的簡報投影片。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合需要客製化圖形的高度設計簡報。
避免在沒有預先準備來源的情況下用於即時協作編輯。
對於需要手動調整圖表的複雜資料視覺化，並非理想選擇。

tools.name: Animejs V4 Ai Guidelines
tools.description: AI guidelines and GSAP-to-Anime.js v4 migration reference for developers.
tools.useCase: Use this to guide AI coding assistants in refactoring GSAP animations to Anime.js v4 syntax.
advantages: Provides structured prompts ensuring accurate Anime.js v4 API usage.
Simplifies migration by mapping GSAP patterns to the v4 library.
Covers modern v4 features including timelines and easing updates.
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for Anime.js v3 or older versions due to API differences.
Do not use for pure CSS animations without JavaScript logic.
Not intended for non-animation web development tasks.
tools.description_zh: 提供給開發者的 AI 指南以及從 GSAP 遷移至 Anime.js v4 的參考資料。
tools.useCase_zh: 用於引導 AI 編碼助手將 GSAP 動畫重構為 Anime.js v4 語法。
tools.advantages_zh:
提供結構化提示，確保準確使用 Anime.js v4 API。
透過將 GSAP 模式映射至 v4 函式庫，簡化遷移過程。
涵蓋現代 v4 功能，包括時間軸與緩動更新。
negativeConstraints_zh: 由於 API 差異，不適合 Anime.js v3 或更早版本。
不適合沒有 JavaScript 邏輯的純 CSS 動畫。
不適用於非動畫網頁開發任務。

tools.name: Book To Skill (Virgilio)
tools.description: Converts technical PDF books into Claude Code skills for instant study and workflow integration.
triggers: 將技術書籍轉成Claude Code技能
把電子書轉成技能文件
把技術PDF轉成可直接使用
將技術文檔轉成Claude Code助手
tools.useCase: Developers can quickly convert a newly published software architecture book into an interactive skill to reference best practices during coding sessions.
advantages: Instantly transforms static PDF documentation into interactive, queryable AI skills.
Seamlessly integrates with Claude Code workflows for real-time reference during development.
Preserves technical accuracy while enabling fast knowledge retrieval without manual parsing.
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for non-technical or heavily illustrated books lacking structured text.
Avoid using for copyrighted material without proper licensing or distribution rights.
Ineffective for PDFs with poor OCR quality or complex multi-column layouts that break parsing.
tools.description_zh: 將技術性 PDF 書籍轉換為 Claude Code 技能，以便即時學習與工作流程整合。
tools.useCase_zh: 開發者可以快速將新出版的軟體架構書籍轉換為互動式技能，以便在編碼期間參考最佳實踐。
tools.advantages_zh:
將靜態 PDF 文件瞬間轉換為互動式、可查詢的 AI 技能。
無縫整合進 Claude Code 工作流程，便於開發期間即時參考。
在保持技術準確性的同時，實現快速知識檢索，無需手動解析。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合缺乏結構化文字的非技術性或高度插圖書籍。
避免用於未具備適當授權或發行權的版權著作。
對於 OCR 品質不佳或複雜多欄排版會破壞解析的 PDF 無效。

tools.name: Book2skills
tools.description: Converts top books into actionable AI skills for investing and stock analysis.
triggers: 從書籍提取股票分析策略
將經典投資書籍轉成可執行指令
將股票書轉成分析腳本
從投資書籍擷取實戰技巧
將書籍內容轉成可運作技能
從股票分析書提取交易策略
tools.useCase: Transform investment literature into structured prompts for Claude-based stock analysis agents.
advantages: Converts unstructured book knowledge into reusable AI agent skills.
Specializes in extracting domain-specific insights for investing and stock analysis.
Leverages Anthropic Claude for high-quality reasoning and skill generation.
negativeConstraints: Do not use for real-time market data feeds or automated trading execution.
Avoid for generating skills unrelated to investing or book-based knowledge extraction.
Not suitable for users lacking access to source books or the Anthropic API.
tools.description_zh: 將優質書籍轉換為投資與股票分析的可用 AI 技能。
tools.useCase_zh: 將投資文獻轉換為基於 Claude 的股票分析代理的結構化提示詞。
tools.advantages_zh:
將非結構化書籍知識轉換為可重複使用的 AI 代理技能。
專門擷取投資與股票分析領域的特定見解。
運用 Anthropic Claude 進行高品質推理與技能生成。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適用於即時市場資料串流或自動化交易執行。
避免用於生成與投資無關的技能或基於書籍的知識萃取。
不適合無法取得原始書籍或 Anthropic API 的使用者。

tools.name: Book Skill Generator
tools.description: Extracts core methodologies from book content and automatically generates executable Agent Skills.
triggers: 把書籍方法論轉成可執行流程
將專業內容轉成agent工作流
把書中的方法提取成工具
從文章生成人工智慧技能
把閱讀內容轉換成agent流程
將書籍知識轉成自動化技能
把理論方法轉成可運作工具
tools.useCase: Transform professional books into directly callable Agent skills, such as generating behavior-building assistants based on 'Atomic Habits'.
advantages: Automatically extracts actionable methodologies from unstructured book texts
Converts static knowledge into dynamic Agent workflows
Significantly lowers the threshold and cost of creating domain-specific skills
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for real-time data queries or dynamic news retrieval
Not applicable for scenarios requiring creative writing or art generation
Less effective when source materials lack structured methodologies
tools.description_zh: 從書籍內容中提取核心方法論，並自動生成可執行的 Agent 技能。
tools.useCase_zh: 將專業書籍轉換為可直接呼叫的 Agent 技能，例如根據《Atomic Habits》生成行為建構助手。
tools.advantages_zh: 自動從未結構化書籍文本中提取可操作方法論；將靜態知識轉換為動態 Agent 工作流；大幅降低建立領域專用技能的門檻和成本。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適用於即時資料查詢或動態新聞搜尋。
不適用於需要創意寫作或藝術生成的情境。
當原始材料缺乏結構化方法時效果較差。

tools.name: Markitdown
tools.description: Converts PDFs, Office docs, and web pages to Markdown for LLM ingestion.
tools.useCase: Convert complex Word or PDF documents into clean Markdown text for AI analysis pipelines.
advantages: Supports diverse formats including PDF, DOCX, PPTX, and HTML.
Preserves document structure, tables, and images during conversion.
Seamlessly integrates with OpenAI and LangChain for RAG workflows.
negativeConstraints: Do not use for real-time streaming video or audio processing.
Avoid for generating binary executables or non-text assets.
Not suitable for editing original source files in place.
tools.description_zh: 將 PDF、Office 文件和網頁轉換為 Markdown，供 LLM 使用。
tools.useCase_zh: 將複雜的 Word 或 PDF 文件轉換為乾淨的 Markdown 文本，用於 AI 分析流程。
tools.advantages_zh: 支援多種格式，包括 PDF、DOCX、PPTX 和 HTML；轉換過程中保留文件結構、表格和圖片；與 OpenAI 和 LangChain 無縫整合，支援 RAG 工作流。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適用於即時串流影片或音訊處理。
避免用於生成二元可執行檔或非文字資產。
不適合就地編輯原始來源檔案。

tools.name: Markitdown Website
tools.description: Convert PDFs, Office docs, and web pages to Markdown locally in your browser.
tools.useCase: Quickly transform Word or PDF reports into clean Markdown for documentation without uploading sensitive files to external servers.
advantages: Client-side browser processing keeps files private and secure.
Fully functional offline after initial WebAssembly initialization.
Supports diverse formats including PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, HTML, CSV, and EPUB.
negativeConstraints: Avoid for high-volume batch processing due to browser memory limitations.
Not ideal for complex PDFs with intricate layouts or proprietary fonts.
Do not use when server-side Python packages or custom ML pipelines are required.
tools.description_zh: 在瀏覽器本機將 PDF、Office 文件和網頁轉換為 Markdown。
tools.useCase_zh: 快速將 Word 或 PDF 報告轉換為乾淨的 Markdown，用於文件編寫，無需將敏感文件上傳至外部伺服器。
tools.advantages_zh: 客戶端瀏覽器處理確保文件隱私和安全；初次 WebAssembly 初始化後完全離線可用；支援多種格式，包括 PDF、DOCX、XLSX、PPTX、HTML、CSV 和 EPUB。
negativeConstraints_zh: 因瀏覽器記憶體限制，避免用於大量批次處理。
不適用於具有複雜排版或專有字型的複雜 PDF。
需要伺服器端 Python 套件或自訂 ML 管線時請勿使用。

tools.name: Anthropic Claude Skills
tools.description: Anthropic's public repository for discovering and implementing AI agent skills.
tools.useCase: Developers can leverage these pre-built templates to rapidly extend AI agent capabilities in production workflows.
advantages: Official Anthropic source ensures compatibility and reliability for Claude-based agents.
Provides reusable, standardized skill structures to accelerate development cycles.
Open-source format encourages community contributions and continuous updates.
negativeConstraints: Do not use for non-AI agent tasks such as database administration or system operations.
Not suitable if you require proprietary, closed-source skill implementations.
Avoid using directly without developer integration, as it is a resource repository rather than an executable tool.

subTools.name: Algorithmic Art
subTools.description: Creating algorithmic art using p5.js with seeded randomness and interactive parameter exploration. Use this when users request creating art using code, generative art, algorithmic art, flow fields, or particle systems. Create original algorithmic art rather than copying existing artists' work to avoid copyright violations.
subTools.description_zh: 使用 p5.js 建立演算法藝術，包含種子隨機性與互動式參數探索。當使用者要求用程式碼、生成式藝術、演算法藝術、流場或粒子系統創作藝術時使用。建立原創演算法藝術，避免複製現有藝術家作品。

subTools.name: Brand Guidelines
subTools.description: Applies Anthropic's official brand colors and typography to any sort of artifact that may benefit from having Anthropic's look-and-feel. Use it when brand colors or style guidelines, visual formatting, or company design standards apply.
subTools.description_zh: 將 Anthropic 官方品牌色彩與字體套用於可能受益的各種產物。當涉及品牌色彩、樣式指南、視覺格式或公司設計標準時使用。

subTools.name: Canvas Design
subTools.description: Create beautiful visual art in .png and .pdf documents using design philosophy. You should use this skill when the user asks to create a poster, piece of art, design, or other static piece. Create original visual designs, never copying existing artists' work to avoid copyright violations.
subTools.description_zh: 運用設計哲學在 .png 與 .pdf 文件中創造精美視覺藝術。當使用者要求建立海報、藝術作品、設計或其他靜態作品時使用。建立原創視覺設計，避免複製現有藝術家作品。

subTools.name: Doc Coauthoring
subTools.description: Guide users through a structured workflow for co-authoring documentation. Use when user wants to write documentation, proposals, technical specs, decision docs, or similar structured content. This workflow helps users efficiently transfer context, refine content through iteration, and verify the doc works for readers. Trigger when user mentions writing docs, creating proposals, drafting specs, or similar documentation tasks.
subTools.description_zh: 引導使用者透過結構化工作流程共同撰寫文件。當使用者想撰寫文件、提案、技術規格、決策文件等結構化內容時使用。協助有效率地轉移脈絡、透過迭代精煉內容。

subTools.name: Docx
subTools.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to create, read, edit, or manipulate Word documents (.docx files) or Word templates (.dotx files). Triggers include: any mention of 'Word doc', 'word document', '.docx', '.dotx', or requests to produce professional documents with formatting like tables of contents, headings, page numbers, or letterheads. Also use when extracting or reorganizing content from .docx or .dotx files, inserting or replacing images in documents, performing find-and-replace in Word files, working with tracked changes or comments, or converting content into a polished Word document. If the user asks for a 'report', 'memo', 'letter', 'template', or similar deliverable as a Word or .docx file, use this skill. Do NOT use for PDFs, spreadsheets, Google Docs, or general coding tasks unrelated to document generation.
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者想建立、讀取、編輯或操作 Word 文件（.docx）或 Word 範本（.dotx）時使用。觸發條件包含提及「Word 文件」、產生具目錄、標題、頁碼、信頭等專業格式的文件，或從文件中萃取與重組內容。

subTools.name: Frontend Design
subTools.description: Guidance for distinctive, intentional visual design when building new UI or reshaping an existing one. Helps with aesthetic direction, typography, and making choices that don't read as templated defaults.
subTools.description_zh: 建立新 UI 或改造現有 UI 時，提供獨特且有意的視覺設計指導。協助美學方向、字體選擇，以及做出非模板預設的設計決策。

subTools.name: Internal Comms
subTools.description: A set of resources to help me write all kinds of internal communications, using the formats that my company likes to use. Claude should use this skill whenever asked to write some sort of internal communications (status reports, leadership updates, 3P updates, company newsletters, FAQs, incident reports, project updates, etc.).
subTools.description_zh: 一套資源，協助以公司偏好的格式撰寫各種內部溝通內容。當被要求撰寫狀況報告、領導層更新、3P 更新、公司通訊、FAQ、事件報告、專案更新等內部溝通時使用。

subTools.name: Mcp Builder
subTools.description: Guide for creating high-quality MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers that enable LLMs to interact with external services through well-designed tools. Use when building MCP servers to integrate external APIs or services, whether in Python (FastMCP) or Node/TypeScript (MCP SDK).
subTools.description_zh: 建立高品質 MCP（模型上下文協定）伺服器的指南，使 LLM 能透過設計完善的工具與外部服務互動。當建構 MCP 伺服器以整合外部 API 或服務時使用，適用於 Python (FastMCP) 或 Node/TypeScript (MCP SDK)。

subTools.name: Pdf
subTools.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to do anything with PDF files. This includes reading or extracting text/tables from PDFs, combining or merging multiple PDFs into one, splitting PDFs apart, rotating pages, adding watermarks, creating new PDFs, filling PDF forms, encrypting/decrypting PDFs, extracting images, and OCR on scanned PDFs to make them searchable. If the user mentions a .pdf file or asks to produce one, use this skill.
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者處理 PDF 檔案時使用，包含讀取或提取文字與表格、合併或拆分 PDF、旋轉頁面、加入浮水印、建立新 PDF、填寫表單、加解密 PDF、提取圖片，以及對掃描 PDF 進行 OCR 使其可搜尋。

subTools.name: Pptx
subTools.description: Use this skill any time a .pptx or .potx file is involved in any way — as input, output, or both. This includes: creating slide decks, pitch decks, or presentations; reading, parsing, or extracting text from any .pptx or .potx file (even if the extracted content will be used elsewhere, like in an email or summary); editing, modifying, or updating existing presentations; combining or splitting slide files; working with templates (.potx), layouts, speaker notes, or comments. Trigger whenever the user mentions \"deck,\" \"slides,\" \"presentation,\" or references a .pptx or .potx filename, regardless of what they plan to do with the content afterward. If a .pptx or .potx file needs to be opened, created, or touched, use this skill.
subTools.description_zh: 任何涉及 .pptx 或 .potx 檔案時使用，包含建立投影片或簡報、讀取解析或提取文字、編輯修改現有簡報、合併或拆分投影片。

subTools.name: Skill Creator
subTools.description: Create new skills, modify and improve existing skills, and measure skill performance. Use when users want to create a skill from scratch, edit, or optimize an existing skill, run evals to test a skill, benchmark skill performance with variance analysis, or optimize a skill's description for better triggering accuracy.
subTools.description_zh: 建立新技能、修改與改進現有技能，並評估技能效能。當使用者要從頭建立技能、編輯或最佳化現有技能、執行評估測試技能、以變異分析基準測試技能效能，或最佳化技能描述以提高觸發準確性時使用。

subTools.name: Slack Gif Creator
subTools.description: Knowledge and utilities for creating animated GIFs optimized for Slack. Provides constraints, validation tools, and animation concepts. Use when users request animated GIFs for Slack like "make me a GIF of X doing Y for Slack.
subTools.description_zh: 建立適合 Slack 的動態 GIF 的知識與工具，提供限制、驗證工具和動畫概念。當使用者要求為 Slack 建立動態 GIF 時使用，例如「幫我製作一個 X 做 Y 的 GIF」。

subTools.name: Theme Factory
subTools.description: Toolkit for styling artifacts with a theme. These artifacts can be slides, docs, reportings, HTML landing pages, etc. There are 10 pre-set themes with colors/fonts that you can apply to any artifact that has been creating, or can generate a new theme on-the-fly.
subTools.description_zh: 用於為產物套用主題樣式的工具包，這些產物可以是簡報、文件、報告、HTML 落地頁等。提供 10 種預設主題，包含色彩與字型，可套用到任何已建立的產物，或即時產生新主題。

subTools.name: Web Artifacts Builder
subTools.description: Suite of tools for creating elaborate, multi-component claude.ai HTML artifacts using modern frontend web technologies (React, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui). Use for complex artifacts requiring state management, routing, or shadcn/ui components - not for simple single-file HTML/JSX artifacts.
subTools.description_zh: 用於使用現代前端網頁技術（React、Tailwind CSS、shadcn/ui）建立複雜多組件 claude.ai HTML 產物的工具套件。適用於需要狀態管理、路由或 shadcn/ui 組件的複雜產物，不適用於簡單單檔 HTML/JSX 產物。

subTools.name: Webapp Testing
subTools.description: Toolkit for interacting with and testing local web applications using Playwright. Supports verifying frontend functionality, debugging UI behavior, capturing browser screenshots, and viewing browser logs.
subTools.description_zh: 使用 Playwright 與本機網頁應用程式互動及測試的工具包。支援驗證前端功能、除錯 UI 行為、捕獲瀏覽器截圖，以及查看瀏覽器日誌。

subTools.name: Xlsx
subTools.description: Use this skill any time a spreadsheet file is the primary input or output. This means any task where the user wants to: open, read, edit, or fix an existing .xlsx, .xlsm, .xltx, .csv, or .tsv file (e.g., adding columns, computing formulas, formatting, charting, cleaning messy data); create a new spreadsheet from scratch or from other data sources; or convert between tabular file formats. Trigger especially when the user references a spreadsheet file by name or path — even casually (like \"the xlsx in my downloads\") — and wants something done to it or produced from it. Also trigger for cleaning or restructuring messy tabular data files (malformed rows, misplaced headers, junk data) into proper spreadsheets. The deliverable must be a spreadsheet file. Do NOT trigger when the primary deliverable is a Word document, HTML report, standalone Python script, database pipeline, or Google Sheets API integration, even if tabular data is involved.
subTools.description_zh: 當試算表檔案為主要輸入或輸出時使用。支援開啟、編輯、修復 .xlsx/.csv 等檔案，或建立新試算表、轉換表格格式。

subTools.name: Template
subTools.description: Replace with description of the skill and when Claude should use it.
subTools.description_zh: 替換為技能的描述以及 Claude 應使用的時機。

tools.description_zh: Anthropic 的公開儲存庫，用於發現和實現 AI 代理技能。
tools.useCase_zh: 開發者可以利用這些預建模板，快速擴展生產工作流中 AI 代理的能力。
tools.advantages_zh: 官方 Anthropic 資源確保與 Claude 代理的相容性和可靠性；提供可重複使用的標準化技能結構，加速開發週期；開源格式鼓勵社群貢獻和持續更新。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不可用於非 AI 代理任務（如資料庫管理或系統操作）。
若需專有、封閉原始碼的技能實作，則不適合。
不應直接使用，因為它是資源庫而非可執行工具，需經開發者整合。

tools.name: SKILL.Md (OpenAI Figma Implement)
tools.description: Codex skill guiding implementation of Figma designs into production code.
triggers: 把 Figma 轉成 HTML 和 CSS
設計稿轉換成前端代碼
Figma 轉成 React 元件
Figma 轉成 Vue 專案

tools.name: Browserbase Agent Skills
tools.description: Reusable agent skills for reliable web automation and browser interaction via Browserbase.

subTools.name: Agent Experience
subTools.description: Audit the developer experience of a product, SDK, docs site, or SKILL.md by dropping multiple Claude subagents at it with only a tiny task prompt and real tools (WebFetch, Bash, Write). Agents must discover the docs themselves, install deps, ask for credentials if needed, and attempt real execution. The skill captures each agent's trace — tool calls, retries, wall time, errors — and scores on Setup Friction, Speed, Efficiency, Error Recovery, and Doc Quality, then emits an HTML report with an A–F grade and concrete fixes. Use when the user asks to audit agent experience, test a skill, audit docs for agents, check if a SDK is agent-friendly, validate a SKILL.md, measure agent DX, or benchmark how painful onboarding is for an AI agent. Triggers: 'audit agent experience', 'test this skill', 'audit docs for agents', 'is my SDK agent-friendly', 'run a DX audit', 'agent experience test', 'test my docs', 'how do agents do with my product'.
subTools.description_zh: 審核產品的開發者體驗：透過 SKILL.md 或文件網站，投放多個 Claude 子代理，以最小任務提示與真實工具（WebFetch、Bash、Write）執行驗證。代理需自行發現文件、安裝依賴，並在需要時請求憑證。記錄每代理的工具呼叫、重試次數、耗時與錯誤，由 Setu 評分。

subTools.name: Autobrowse
subTools.description: Self-improving browser automation via the auto-research loop. Iteratively runs a browsing task, reads the trace, and improves the navigation skill (strategy.md) until it reliably passes. Supports parallel runs across multiple tasks using sub-agents. Use when you want to build or improve browser automation skills for specific website tasks.
subTools.description_zh: 透過自我改進的回溯自動瀏覽。反覆執行瀏覽任務，讀取執行軌跡，並持續優化導航策略（strategy.md），直到能可靠通過測試。支援透過子代理並行執行多個任務。適合用於建構或改進特定網站的瀏覽器自動化能力。

subTools.name: Browser
subTools.description: Automate web browser interactions using natural language via CLI commands. Use when the user asks to browse websites, navigate web pages, extract data from websites, take screenshots, fill forms, click buttons, or interact with web applications. Supports remote Browserbase sessions with Browserbase Identity, Verified browsers, automatic CAPTCHA solving, and residential proxies — ideal for protected websites and JavaScript-heavy pages.
subTools.description_zh: 使用自然語言透過 CLI 命令自動化網頁瀏覽器操作。適用情境包括：瀏覽網站、導航頁面、擷取資料、截圖、填寫表單、點擊按鈕等。支援 Browserbase 遠端會話，具備身份驗證、經認證的瀏覽器、自動解答 CAPTCHA 與住宅代理 IP，適合保護機制較嚴的網站。

subTools.name: Browser To Api
subTools.description: Turn a website's observable HTTP traffic into a best-effort OpenAPI 3.1 spec by analyzing a `browser-trace` capture. Use when the user wants to discover/extract API endpoints from a browser session, build an OpenAPI doc from network traffic, or document a third-party site's XHR/fetch surface for client integration.
subTools.description_zh: 分析 `browser-trace` 紀錄，將網站可觀察到的 HTTP 流量轉為最佳努力版本的 OpenAPI 3.1 規格。適用情境包括：從瀏覽器會話中發現或擷取 API 端點、從網路流量建立 OpenAPI 文件，或為第三方站點的 XHR/fetch 介面建立文件以供整合。

subTools.name: Browser Trace
subTools.description: Capture a full DevTools-protocol trace of any browser automation — CDP firehose, screenshots, and DOM dumps — then bisect the stream into per-page searchable buckets. Use when the user wants to debug a failed run, audit network/console/DOM activity, attach a trace to an in-progress session, or feed structured per-page summaries back into an agent loop so its next iteration learns from the last one.
subTools.description_zh: 擷取任何瀏覽器自動化操作的完整 DevTools 協定軌跡（CDP 流量、截圖、DOM 轉儲），並將串流拆解為每頁可搜尋的儲存區。適用於除錯失敗執行、審計網路/控制台/DOM 活動、附加軌跡至進行中的工作階段，或將結構化的每頁摘要回傳至代理程式迴圈。

subTools.name: Browser Use To Stagehand
subTools.description: Migrate browser-use (Python) browser-automation scripts to Stagehand v3 (TypeScript) on Browserbase. Use when the user wants to convert, port, rewrite, or migrate a browser-use Agent script to Stagehand, map browser-use features/APIs to Stagehand primitives (act/extract/observe/agent), or move agentic browser automation onto Browserbase with more determinism. Triggers on "browser-use", "browser_use", or "Agent(task=...)".
subTools.description_zh: 將 browser-use（Python）瀏覽器自動化腳本遷移至 Browserbase 上的 Stagehand v3（TypeScript）。適用於轉換、移植、重寫或遷移 browser-use Agent 腳本、將 browser-use 功能／API 對應至 Stagehand 操作原語，或將代理式瀏覽器自動化移至具有更高確定性的 Browserbase。觸發詞：browser-use、browser_us。

subTools.name: Cookie Sync
subTools.description: Sync cookies from local Chrome to a Browserbase persistent context so the browse CLI can access authenticated sites. Use when the user wants to browse as themselves, sync cookies, or log into sites via Browserbase.
subTools.description_zh: 將本機 Chrome 的 cookie 同步至 Browserbase 的持續性工作階段，讓 browse CLI 能存取需認證的網站。當使用者想以自身身份瀏覽、同步 cookie，或透過 Browserbase 登入網站時使用。

subTools.name: Fetch
subTools.description: Use this skill when the user wants to retrieve a URL without a full browser session: fetch HTML or JSON from static pages, inspect status codes or headers, follow redirects, or get page source for simple scraping. Prefer it over a browser when JavaScript rendering and page interaction are not needed. Supports proxies and redirect control.
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者不需要完整瀏覽器工作階段即可擷取 URL 時使用此技能：從靜態頁面取得 HTML 或 JSON、檢查狀態碼或標頭、追蹤重新導向，或抓取網頁原始碼。若無需 JavaScript 渲染與頁面互動，優先使用此方案。支援代理伺服器與重新導向控制。

subTools.name: Functions
subTools.description: Deploy serverless browser automation as cloud functions using Browserbase. Use when the user wants to deploy browser automation to run on a schedule or cron, create a webhook endpoint for browser tasks, run automation in the cloud instead of locally, or asks about Browserbase Functions.
subTools.description_zh: 使用 Browserbase 將無伺服器瀏覽器自動化部署為雲端函式。當使用者想部署定時或 cron 執行、建立 webhook 端點、在雲端而非本機執行自動化，或詢問 Browserbase Functions 時使用。

subTools.name: Safe Browser
subTools.description: Build local constrained-browser agents with a safe_browser tool that owns CDP, enforces a domain allowlist with Fetch interception, and lets a runtime Claude Agent SDK agent complete browsing tasks without raw browser, shell, or CDP access. Use when the user wants an agent to browse or scrape while staying on approved domains, demo blocked off-domain navigation, or generate a safe browser client.
subTools.description_zh: 使用 safe_browser 工具建立本地受限瀏覽器代理，擁有 CDP、執行網域白名單與 Fetch 攔截，讓 Claude Agent SDK 代理完成瀏覽任務而無需直接存取瀏覽器、shell 或 CDP。適合在核准網域內瀏覽或爬蟲、示範擋下非授權網域導航，或產生安全瀏覽器客戶端。

subTools.name: Search
subTools.description: Use this skill when the user wants to search the web without a full browser session: find URLs, titles, and metadata for a query. Prefer it over a browser when you just need search results, not page content. Returns structured results with titles, URLs, authors, and dates.
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者想搜尋網頁但不需要完整瀏覽器工作階段時使用，可找到查詢的 URL、標題與 metadata。在只需要搜尋結果而非網頁內容時優先使用，回傳包含標題、URL、作者與日期的結構化結果。

subTools.name: Ui Test
subTools.description: AI-powered adversarial UI testing via the browse CLI. Analyzes git diffs to test only what changed, or explores the full app to find bugs. Tests functional correctness, accessibility, responsive layout, and UX heuristics. Use when the user asks to test UI changes, QA a pull request, audit accessibility, or run exploratory testing. Supports local browser (localhost) and remote Browserbase (deployed sites).
subTools.description_zh: 透過 browse CLI 進行 AI 驅動的對抗式 UI 測試，分析 git diff 僅測試變更處，或探索完整應用程式尋找 bug。測試功能正確性、無障礙、響應式版面與 UX 啟發規則，適合測試 UI 變更、QA pull request、稽核無障礙或執行探索性測試，支援本地瀏覽器與遠端 Browserbase。

subTools.name: Webmcp Gen
subTools.description: Create, compile, and validate site-specific WebMCP init scripts from a target URL and desired tool capability. Use when the user wants to author WebMCP tools for a website, produce a webmcp.init.js artifact, or test WebMCP registration and invocation through Stagehand.
subTools.description_zh: 從目標 URL 與期望的工具能力建立、編譯與驗證網站特定的 WebMCP init 腳本，適合想為網站撰寫 WebMCP 工具、產出 webmcp.init.js 檔案，或透過 Stagehand 測試 WebMCP 註冊與呼叫時使用。

tools.useCase: Use this when an AI agent needs to navigate websites, fill forms, or extract data through a managed browser session.
advantages: Provides standardized, tested code patterns for common browser actions.
Integrates seamlessly with Browserbase infrastructure for scalable headless browsing.
Reduces development time by offering ready-to-use agent capabilities.
negativeConstraints: Do not use for non-browser-based tasks like direct database queries or pure API calls.
Avoid for simple static page scraping where lightweight HTTP requests are sufficient.
Not suitable for local desktop application automation outside the browser context.
tools.description_zh: 透過 Browserbase 進行可靠網頁自動化與瀏覽器互動的可重用 agent 技能。
tools.useCase_zh: 當 AI agent 需要導覽網站、填寫表單或透過受管理的瀏覽器工作階段擷取資料時使用此功能。
tools.advantages_zh: 提供常見瀏覽器操作的標準化、已測試程式碼模式。與 Browserbase 基礎設施無縫整合，支援可擴展的無頭瀏覽器瀏覽。提供即用型 agent 功能，減少開發時間。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不要用於非瀏覽器任務，如直接資料庫查詢或純 API 呼叫。
若輕量 HTTP 請求即可滿足的簡單靜態網頁爬蟲，請避免使用。
不適合用於瀏覽器環境外的本機桌面應用程式自動化。

tools.name: Autogen
tools.description: Microsoft framework for building and orchestrating multi-agent LLM applications.
triggers: 讓多個 AI 代理協作完成任務
編排多步驟 LLM 對話流程
自動讓 AI 分角色討論問題
構建多智能體編程助手
讓 ChatGPT 群聊解決複雜任務
自動化 AI 代理工作流編排
設計多 LLM 協作對話系統
用多代理框架實現任務自動化
讓 AI 團隊分工處理編程任務
搭建可自主協作的 AI 系統
tools.useCase: Automating complex research or coding workflows by coordinating multiple specialized AI agents that collaborate through structured conversations.
advantages: Enables customizable multi-agent conversation patterns and dynamic group chats.
Natively supports human-in-the-loop oversight and tool/code execution integration.
Seamlessly connects with major LLM providers including OpenAI and Azure.
negativeConstraints: Avoid for simple single-turn chatbots where lightweight API calls are sufficient.
Not ideal for latency-critical real-time systems requiring fully deterministic outputs.
Unnecessary for workflows that do not require collaborative AI agent orchestration.
tools.description_zh: 用於建置和協調多 agent LLM 應用程式的 Microsoft 框架。
tools.useCase_zh: 透過協調多個透過結構化對話協作的專業 AI agent，自動化複雜的研究或程式設計工作流程。
tools.advantages_zh: 支援自訂的多 agent 對話模式與動態群組聊天。內建支援人類在迴路監督，以及工具/程式執行整合。與 OpenAI 和 Azure 等主要 LLM 提供者無縫連接。
negativeConstraints_zh: 簡單的單輪對話機器人若輕量 API 呼叫即可滿足時，請避免使用。
對於需要完全決定性輸出的延遲關鍵即時系統，非理想選擇。
不需要協作 AI 代理協調的工作流程則無需使用。

tools.name: Metagpt
tools.description: Multi-agent framework automating software engineering workflows using LLM-powered roles.
tools.useCase: Transform a one-line business requirement into a complete project structure with generated code and documentation.
advantages: Assigns specialized roles like Product Manager and Architect to simulate a real development team.
Generates structured engineering artifacts such as PRDs and design documents before coding.
Enables end-to-end automation of software creation from natural language prompts.
negativeConstraints: Avoid for simple scripts or trivial tasks where agent orchestration is unnecessary overhead.
Not suitable for projects requiring strict manual control at every development step.
Inappropriate for non-software tasks like data analysis or creative writing without modification.
tools.description_zh: 使用 LLM 驅動角色自動化軟體工程工作流程的多 agent 框架。
tools.useCase_zh: 將一行業務需求轉換為包含產生程式碼和文件的完整專案結構。
tools.advantages_zh: 指派產品經理和架構師等專業角色，模擬真實開發團隊。在編碼前產生 PRD 和設計文件等結構化工程工件。從自然語言提示實現軟體創建的端到端自動化。
negativeConstraints_zh: 簡單的腳本或瑣碎任務若代理協調為不必要負擔時，請避免使用。
不適合需要在每個開發步驟嚴格手動控制的專案。
未經修改，不適合用於資料分析或創意寫作等非軟體任務。

tools.name: Lobehub
tools.description: Orchestrate, schedule, and monitor autonomous AI agents for continuous 24/7 workflow operations.
triggers: 設定定時任務讓AI自動執行
tools.useCase: Automating the deployment, scheduling, and monitoring of multiple AI agents for continuous workflow execution.
advantages: Centralized dashboard for multi-agent coordination and lifecycle management
Automated scheduling and 24/7 operational monitoring capabilities
Native support for MCP protocols and modular skill frameworks
negativeConstraints: Single-purpose scripting tasks requiring minimal system overhead
Real-time latency-critical applications needing sub-millisecond responses
Strictly air-gapped environments without external network dependencies
tools.description_zh: 協調、排程和監控自主 AI agent，以支援持續 24/7 工作流程運作。
tools.useCase_zh: 自動化多個 AI agent 的部署、排程和監控，以進行持續工作流程執行。
tools.advantages_zh: 多 agent 協調和生命週期管理的中央化儀表板。自動化排程和 24/7 運作監控能力。原生支援 MCP 協議和模組化技能框架。
negativeConstraints_zh: 單一用途的腳本任務，需將系統資源消耗降至最低
需即時低延遲的應用程式（要求反應時間低於1毫秒）
嚴格隔離網路的環境，無法依賴外部網路資源

tools.name: Transformers
tools.description: Open-source library for state-of-the-art NLP, vision, and audio model training and inference.
tools.useCase: Fine-tune pre-trained language models like BERT or GPT for tasks such as text classification or named entity recognition.
advantages: Unified API for tokenizers, pipelines, and trainers streamlines development.
Supports PyTorch, TensorFlow, and JAX backends for flexible deployment.
Access to thousands of pre-trained models covering text, vision, and audio tasks.
negativeConstraints: Avoid using it for simple text manipulation tasks that do not require machine learning.
Do not use it when building low-level custom neural network architectures without leveraging existing model classes.
Not suitable for real-time embedded systems with strict memory constraints due to heavy dependencies.
tools.description_zh: 用於尖端 NLP、視覺和音訊模型訓練與推論的開源函式庫。
tools.useCase_zh: 針對文本分類或命名實體識別等任務，微調 BERT 或 GPT 等預訓練語言模型。
tools.advantages_zh: 統合的 tokenizer、pipeline 和 trainer API 簡化開發流程。支援 PyTorch、TensorFlow 和 JAX 後端，提供彈性的部署選項。可存取數千個涵蓋文本、視覺和音訊任務的預訓練模型。
negativeConstraints_zh: 避免用於簡單的「文字處理任務」，且這類任務不需要依賴機器學習。
當建構底層的自訂神經網路架構，且未使用現有模型類別時，不應依賴此套件。
由於依賴函式庫龐大，不適合用於記憶體限制嚴格的即時嵌入式系統。

tools.name: Cocoindex
tools.description: Incremental indexing engine for maintaining persistent context in long-horizon AI agents.
triggers: 維護 AI 長期記憶
自動索引 ETL 流程
長任務 AI 記憶延續
tools.useCase: Ideal for AI agents that require continuous, low-latency updates to their knowledge base as new data arrives.
advantages: Performs incremental updates instead of full re-indexing, significantly reducing compute overhead.
Combines Rust performance with Python accessibility for seamless integration into existing pipelines.
Optimized for long-horizon state management and persistent memory in autonomous agents.
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for static, one-time batch analytics where real-time updates are unnecessary.
Avoid for simple keyword search tasks that do not require complex incremental state tracking.
Not designed for general-purpose relational database management or ad-hoc SQL querying.
tools.description_zh: 用於在長期 AI 智能體中維持持久上下文的增量索引引擎。
tools.useCase_zh: 適合需要在新資料到達時持續、低延遲更新知識庫的 AI 智能體。
tools.advantages_zh: 執行增量更新而非全量重新索引，大幅降低運算開銷。結合 Rust 的效能與 Python 的易用性，可無縫整合至現有管線。針對自主智能體的長期狀態管理與持久記憶進行優化。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適用於靜態且僅執行一次的批次分析，而這類分析也不需要即時更新的特性。
遇到簡單的關鍵字搜尋任務時，應避免使用，因為這不需複雜的增量狀態追蹤機制。
此工具的設計目的並非作為一般用途的關聯式資料庫管理系統，也不適合用來執行即席的 SQL 查詢。

tools.name: Stable Diffusion WebUI
tools.description: Feature-rich Gradio web interface for Stable Diffusion supporting txt2img, img2img, inpainting, ControlNet, LoRA, and a vast ecosystem of extensions.
tools.useCase: 適用於在本機或伺服器透過直覺完整的網頁 GUI 介面進行高畫質 AI 影像生成、細節重繪 (Inpainting)、風格 LoRA 應用與 ControlNet 精確控制的視覺設計場景。
advantages: 全球最具統治力的開源擴散模型 Web GUI，支援幾乎所有主流擴展與 LoRA/Checkpoint 模型
內建強大的 ControlNet、Tile Upscale、Prompt Matrix、X/Y Plot 與批量生成工作流
一鍵開箱腳本支援 Windows / Linux / macOS，並支援豐富的社群 Extension
negativeConstraints: 不適用於無獨立 GPU（NVIDIA/AMD/Apple Silicon）或 VRAM 極小（<4GB）的運算環境
不適合作為高並發、無頭（Headless）微服務 API 部署（建議使用 ComfyUI 或 SD API 專用伺服器）
初次安裝需下載數 GB 模型與 PyTorch 權重，需要充裕硬碟空間與網路頻寬
tools.description_zh: 功能豐富的 Gradio 網頁介面，用於 Stable Diffusion，支援 txt2img、img2img、inpainting、ControlNet、LoRA 及龐大的擴展生態系統。
tools.useCase_zh: 適用於在本機或伺服器透過直覺完整的網頁 GUI 介面進行高畫質 AI 影像生成、細節重繪 (Inpainting)、風格 LoRA 應用與 ControlNet 精確控制的視覺設計場景。
tools.advantages_zh: 全球最具統治力的開源擴散模型 Web GUI，支援幾乎所有主流擴展與 LoRA/Checkpoint 模型,內建強大的 ControlNet、Tile Upscale、Prompt Matrix、X/Y Plot 與批量生成工作流,一鍵開箱腳本支援 Windows / Linux / macOS，並支援豐富的社群 Extension
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適用於無獨立顯卡（NVIDIA/AMD/Apple Silicon）或 VRAM 極小（<4GB）的運算環境
不適合作為高併發、無頭（Headless）微服務 API 部署（建議使用 ComfyUI 或 SD API 專用伺服器）
初次安裝需下載數 GB 的模型與 PyTorch 權重，需要充裕的磁碟空間與網路頻寬

tools.name: Stable Diffusion Webui Localization Zh_TW
tools.description: Traditional Chinese localization extension for AUTOMATIC1111's Stable Diffusion WebUI.
triggers: 把 SD WebUI 改成中文顯示
安裝 AUTOMATIC1111 繁中語系
把 SD WebUI 介面繁中化
把 AUTOMATIC1111 網頁改成中文
安裝 SD WebUI 中文版擴充功能
tools.useCase: Translate the AUTOMATIC1111 Stable Diffusion WebUI interface to Traditional Chinese for local users.
advantages: Full Traditional Chinese interface translation
Seamless compatibility with AUTOMATIC1111's Stable Diffusion WebUI
Open-source community maintenance via GitHub
negativeConstraints: Do not use for Simplified Chinese; use the zh_CN extension instead
Not designed for ComfyUI or other Stable Diffusion interfaces
Does not auto-translate user prompts or generated images
tools.description_zh: AUTOMATIC1111 的 Stable Diffusion WebUI 之繁體中文本地化擴展。
tools.useCase_zh: 將 AUTOMATIC1111 Stable Diffusion WebUI 介面翻譯為繁體中文，供本地用戶使用。
tools.advantages_zh: 完整繁體中文介面翻譯；與 AUTOMATIC1111 的 Stable Diffusion WebUI 無縫相容；透過 GitHub 由開源社群維護。
negativeConstraints_zh: 若需支援簡體中文，請改用 zh_CN 擴充功能
此擴充功能並非為 ComfyUI 或其他 Stable Diffusion 介面所設計
不會自動翻譯使用者輸入的提示（prompt）或生成的圖像

tools.name: Langflow
tools.description: Visual platform for building and deploying LLM-powered agents and workflows.
triggers: 視覺化串接大語言模型
tools.useCase: Build complex RAG pipelines or multi-agent systems visually without writing boilerplate code.
advantages: Drag-and-drop interface accelerates prototyping of AI workflows.
Native integrations with major LLM providers and vector databases.
Deployable as a standalone API or embedded into existing applications.
negativeConstraints: Avoid for low-latency edge deployments due to resource overhead.
Not suitable for simple scripts where workflow orchestration is unnecessary.
May not fit strict closed-source compliance requirements.
tools.description_zh: 用於建構和部署 LLM 驅動智能體與工作流程的視覺化平台。
tools.useCase_zh: 視覺化建構複雜的 RAG 管線或多智能體系統，無需編寫模板程式碼。
tools.advantages_zh: 拖曳式介面加速 AI 工作流程的原型製作。原生整合主要 LLM 供應商與向量資料庫。可部署為獨立 API 或嵌入現有應用程式。
negativeConstraints_zh: 因資源開銷，不適合低延遲邊緣部署。
對於不需要工作流編排的簡單腳本來說並不適合。
可能不符合嚴格的閉源合規需求。

tools.name: Mem0
tools.description: Open-source memory layer enabling AI agents to learn and remember across sessions.
tools.useCase: Empower a customer support bot to recall user history and preferences across separate conversations.
advantages: Enables persistent memory across sessions without manual prompt engineering.
Supports vector and graph-based memory for flexible context retrieval.
Integrates seamlessly with frameworks like LangChain and LlamaIndex.
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for stateless applications that do not require historical context.
Avoid for simple CRUD tasks unrelated to AI agent memory management.
tools.description_zh: 開源記憶體層，使 AI 智能體能在會話之間學習與記憶。
tools.useCase_zh: 賦予客服機器人能在不同對話之間記憶使用者歷史與偏好。
tools.advantages_zh: 實現跨會話的持久記憶，無需手動提示工程。支援基於向量與圖形的記憶體，提供靈活的上下文檢索。可與 LangChain、LlamaIndex 等框架無縫整合。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合不需要歷史上下文（historical context）的 stateless 應用程式。
避免用於與 AI 代理記憶管理無關的簡單 CRUD 任務。

tools.name: Ruflo
tools.description: Agent meta-harness for deploying multi-player agent swarms, coordinating autonomous workflows, and building conversational AI systems with adaptive memory, self-learning intelligence, RAG, and native Claude Code / Codex / Hermes integration.
triggers: 建立對話式 AI 系統
整合 Claude 與 Codex 工具
搭建 RAG 搜尋引擎
自動化 Agent 團隊任務
建構具記憶力的 AI 對話系統
tools.useCase: Deploy a coordinated swarm of specialized agents (researcher, coder, reviewer) that share memory and adapt workflows across long-running autonomous tasks.
advantages: Native integration with multiple LLM providers including Claude Code, Codex, and Hermes.
Built-in adaptive memory and self-learning intelligence for evolving workflows.
Supports RAG integration for context-aware agent interactions.
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for simple single-task scripts that do not require multi-agent coordination.
Avoid for projects needing a lightweight standalone CLI without orchestration overhead.
May be overkill for basic conversational bots that do not need swarm capabilities.
tools.description_zh: Agent 中樞框架，用於部署多玩家 agent 群，協調自主工作流程，並建構具備自適應記憶、自學習智慧、RAG 及原生 Claude Code / Codex / Hermes 整合的對話式 AI 系統。
tools.useCase_zh: 部署協調的特殊 agent 群（研究員、程式設計師、審查員），共享記憶並在長時間自主任務中調整工作流程。
tools.advantages_zh: 原生整合多個 LLM 供應商，包括 Claude Code、Codex 與 Hermes。內建自適應記憶與自學習智慧，支援工作流程持續演進。支援 RAG 整合，實現具情境感知能力的 agent 互動。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合不需要多代理協調的簡單單任務腳本。
避免用於不需要編排開銷的輕量獨立 CLI 專案。
對於不需要蜂群能力的基礎對話機器人而言可能過於複雜。

tools.name: Crewai
tools.description: Framework for orchestrating role-playing AI agents to tackle complex tasks.
triggers: 讓多個LLM分工完成複雜任務
用多Agent架構執行串聯任務
設計AI代理角色扮演工作流
實現多步驟AI任務自動化
整合多個AI代理完成端到端流程
搭建分工明確的多Agent平台
tools.useCase: Build a multi-agent workflow where specialized agents handle research, analysis, and report generation autonomously.
advantages: Enables flexible role-based agent collaboration with customizable goals.
Supports multiple LLM providers and memory types for persistent context.
Simplifies complex workflows through sequential or hierarchical task execution.
negativeConstraints: Avoid for simple, single-step automation tasks that do not require multi-agent coordination.
Not suitable for real-time, low-latency applications needing immediate single-model inference.
Do not use for non-AI related backend services or standard CRUD operations.
tools.description_zh: 用於協調角色扮演 AI agent 以處理複雜任務的框架。
tools.useCase_zh: 建立多 agent 工作流程，讓專門的 agent 自主處理研究、分析與報告生成。
tools.advantages_zh: 支援靈活的基於角色的 agent 協作，目標可自訂。相容多種 LLM 供應商與記憶類型，維持持久情境。透過序列或階層式任務執行簡化複雜工作流程。
negativeConstraints_zh: 避免用於不需要多代理協調的簡單單步驟自動化任務。
不適合需要即時單一模型推論的低延遲即時應用程式。
不要用於非 AI 相關的後端服務或標準 CRUD 操作。

tools.name: Hermes Agent (Nous Research Coding)
tools.description: Open-source AI coding agent by Nous Research for intelligent software development automation.
tools.useCase: A software engineer automating complex refactoring and debugging workflows directly within their IDE using natural language.
advantages: Supports multiple LLM backends including OpenAI, Anthropic, and local models.
Provides autonomous agentic capabilities with memory and tool integration.
Fully open-source and customizable for specific development environments.
negativeConstraints: Not designed for general-purpose chat or non-technical queries.
Requires external LLM API access or local model configuration to function.
May incur token costs depending on the selected model provider.
tools.description_zh: Nous Research 開發的開源 AI 編碼 agent，用於智慧軟體開發自動化。
tools.useCase_zh: 軟體工程師直接在 IDE 中以自然語言自動化複雜的重構與除錯工作流程。
tools.advantages_zh: 支援多個 LLM 後端，包括 OpenAI、Anthropic 與本地模型。提供具備記憶與工具整合的自主 agent 能力。完全開源且可依特定開發環境客製化。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適用於通用聊天或非技術性查詢。
需要外部 LLM API 存取或本地模型配置才能運作。
可能會產生 token 成本，視所選模型供應商而定。

tools.name: Maigret
tools.description: OSINT tool for gathering public data on usernames across thousands of websites.
triggers: 查某個使用者名稱在哪些網站有註冊
搜尋某個帳號的公開資訊
透過使用者名稱找帳號在哪裡存在
查詢使用者的社交媒體帳號
檢查某個名稱是否被註冊
搜尋用戶名在不同平台的資料
利用使用者名稱做 OSINT 調查
查詢某個帳號的線上存在
搜尋網路上的使用者帳號
tools.useCase: Security researchers can quickly map a target's online footprint to identify exposed accounts or phishing risks.
advantages: Scans over 3,000 websites simultaneously for username availability.
Extracts detailed profile links and associated metadata automatically.
Lightweight CLI interface with cross-platform support and active updates.
negativeConstraints: Do not use for unauthorized surveillance or targeted harassment.
Avoid relying on results as standalone legal evidence without corroboration.
Ineffective against platforms requiring authentication or blocking automated requests.
tools.description_zh: OSINT 工具，用於在數千個網站上搜集使用者名稱的公開資料。
tools.useCase_zh: 安全研究人員能快速掌握目標的網路足跡，識別洩露帳號或網路釣魚風險。
tools.advantages_zh: 同時掃描超過 3,000 個網站的使用者名稱可用性。自動提取詳細個人檔案連結與相關元資料。輕量 CLI 介面，跨平台支援並持續更新。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不應用於未經授權的監視或目標騷擾。
避免在無佐證情況下將結果作為獨立法律證據依賴。
對需要身份驗證或阻擋自動化請求的平台上無效。

tools.name: Open Webui
tools.description: Self-hosted web interface for managing and interacting with multiple AI models and LLM providers.
triggers: 管理多個 AI 模型
整合多個 LLM 供應商
統一介面操作不同模型
建立 AI 模型儀表板
切換比對多個語言模型
連接多個 AI 服務 API
管理混合 AI 系統介面
tools.useCase: Teams can deploy it locally to centrally manage, test, and switch between multiple LLM providers like Ollama and OpenAI.
advantages: Native multi-provider routing for Ollama, OpenAI, and custom endpoints
Built-in RAG pipeline with document ingestion and vector search
Extensible plugin system supporting MCP and OpenAPI integrations
negativeConstraints: Production environments requiring out-of-the-box enterprise SSO and audit logs
Resource-constrained edge devices with less than 4GB RAM
Projects needing strict HIPAA or financial compliance without heavy customization
tools.description_zh: 自建式網頁介面，用於管理和與多個 AI 模型及 LLM 供應商互動。
tools.useCase_zh: 團隊可本地部署以集中管理、測試並切換多個 LLM 供應商（如 Ollama 與 OpenAI）。
tools.advantages_zh: 原生支援 Ollama、OpenAI 與自訂端點的 Multi-provider 路由。內建 RAG 管線，含文件 ingestion 與向量搜尋。可擴展的插件系統，支援 MCP 與 OpenAPI 整合。
negativeConstraints_zh: 需要開箱即用企業 SSO 和稽核日誌的生產環境
記憶體少於 4GB 且資源受限的邊緣裝置
需要嚴格 HIPAA 或金融合規但不進行重度自定義的專案

tools.name: Aider
tools.description: AI-powered CLI tool for pair programming with LLMs directly in your terminal.
tools.useCase: Edit code files and fix bugs in an existing Git repository by chatting with an LLM in the terminal.
advantages: Directly modifies local files and manages changes through Git integration.
Supports multiple LLM providers including OpenAI, Gemini, and local models.
Maintains project context to suggest accurate edits across multiple files.
negativeConstraints: Do not use for non-code tasks such as writing articles or generating images.
Avoid for users who require a graphical IDE interface instead of a command line.
Not suitable for real-time collaborative editing with other humans.
tools.description_zh: 可直接在終端機中與 LLM 進行配對程式設計的 AI 驅動 CLI 工具。
tools.useCase_zh: 透過在終端機中與 LLM 交談，編輯程式碼檔案並修復現有 Git 倉儲中的錯誤。
tools.advantages_zh: 直接修改本機檔案並透過 Git 整合管理變更。支援多個 LLM 供應商，包括 OpenAI、Gemini 和本地模型。維持專案脈絡以在多檔案間提出準確的編輯建議。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不應用於撰寫文章或生成影像等非程式碼任務。
需要圖形化 IDE 介面而非命令列的使用者應避免使用。
不適合與其他使用者進行即時協作編輯。

tools.name: Tech Interview Handbook (Yang Shun)
tools.description: Curated coding interview prep for engineers covering algorithms and system design.
tools.useCase: A software engineer preparing for FAANG interviews uses this handbook to review data structures and practice LeetCode-style problems efficiently.
advantages: Comprehensive coverage of algorithms, data structures, and system design topics
Curated resources optimized for busy professionals seeking structured learning
Includes practical interview questions and tips from experienced engineers
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for beginners needing basic programming syntax tutorials
Do not use for non-coding job interviews like product management or sales
Not a substitute for hands-on coding practice or mock interviews
tools.description_zh: 為工程師精選的程式設計面試準備，涵蓋演算法和系統設計。
tools.useCase_zh: 正在準備 FAANG 面試的軟體工程師使用此手冊來複習資料結構並有效率地練習 LeetCode 類型的問題。
tools.advantages_zh: 全面涵蓋演算法、資料結構和系統設計主題。為尋求結構化學習的忙碌專業人士精選優化資源。包含實用面試題目和來自經驗豐富工程師的技巧。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合需要基礎程式語法教學的新手
不應用於產品管理或業務等非程式設計職務的面試準備
無法取代實作編程練習或模擬面試

tools.name: Tech Interview Handbook
tools.description: Curated resource hub for mastering technical interviews, coding challenges, and system design.
tools.useCase: Ideal for software engineers preparing for FAANG or startup technical interviews who need structured study plans and practice problems.
advantages: Comprehensive coverage of coding, system design, and behavioral question types.
Structured learning paths with curated resources and practice exercises.
Regularly updated community contributions ensuring relevance to current industry standards.
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for non-technical roles like marketing or HR interview preparation.
Avoid using as a substitute for hands-on coding practice or real-world project experience.
Inappropriate for advanced research or academic paper writing guidance.
tools.description_zh: 精通技術面試、程式設計挑戰和系統設計的精選資源中心。
tools.useCase_zh: 適合需要結構化學習計劃和練習題目的軟體工程師，為 FAANG 或新創公司技術面試做準備。
tools.advantages_zh: 全面涵蓋程式設計、系統設計和行為問題類型。透過精選資源和練習提供結構化學習路徑。定期更新社群貢獻以確保與當前產業標準相關。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合用於行銷或人力資源等非技術職務的面試準備。
避免將其取代實作編程練習或真實世界專案經驗。
不適合用於進階研究或學術論文撰寫指導。

tools.name: Awesome Selfhosted
tools.description: Curated list of free software alternatives to proprietary SaaS for self-hosting.
triggers: 尋找可自建的Google Drive替代方案
用開源工具替換付費雲端服務
搭建隱私保護的文件存儲服務
尋找開源項目管理工具推薦
把業務遷移到自有服務器
適合開發者的開源協作平台
企業級私有雲解決方案推薦
tools.useCase: A user wants to replace proprietary cloud services with open-source tools they can run on their own infrastructure.
advantages: Curated collection of verified self-hostable projects
Promotes data sovereignty and privacy by replacing proprietary SaaS
Provides Docker-ready deployment options for many listed services
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for finding commercial managed hosting providers
Does not provide direct installation support or customer service
Inappropriate for users seeking proprietary software solutions
tools.description_zh: 自有託管替代專有 SaaS 的免費軟體精選清單。
tools.useCase_zh: 使用者希望用可在自身基礎設施上執行的開源工具，取代專有雲端服務。
tools.advantages_zh: 經過驗證可自行託管專案的精選收藏。透過取代專有 SaaS 促進資料主權和隱私。為多個所列服務提供 Docker 預先就緒的部署選項。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合尋找商業托管服務提供商
不提供直接安裝支援或客戶服務
不適合尋求專有軟體解決方案的使用者

tools.name: Javascript Algorithms
tools.description: JavaScript algorithms and data structures reference with explanations for learning and interviews.
tools.useCase: Use this repository to study sorting and graph algorithms in JavaScript before a technical interview.
advantages: Provides clear explanations and visualizations for complex data structures and algorithms.
Includes links to further readings and academic resources for deeper understanding.
Implements solutions purely in JavaScript, making it easy to copy and adapt code.
negativeConstraints: Do not use for production-ready performance optimization benchmarks or low-level system programming.
Avoid using as a primary resource for non-JavaScript languages like Python or C++.
Not suitable for finding ready-made npm packages or libraries for immediate application deployment.
tools.description_zh: 包含解說的學習和麪試用的 JavaScript 演算法和資料結構參考。
tools.useCase_zh: 在技術面試前使用此儲存庫來研究 JavaScript 中的排序和圖演算法。
tools.advantages_zh: 為複雜的資料結構和演算法提供清晰的解說和視覺化。包含延伸閱讀連結和學術資源以利深入理解。純粹以 JavaScript 實作解決方案，方便複製和調整程式碼。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適用於生產環境的效能優化基準測試或低層級系統程式設計
避免作為 Python 或 C++ 等非 JavaScript 語言的主要學習資源
不適合尋找可直接部署應用程式的現成 npm 套件或函式庫

tools.name: 30 Seconds Of Code
tools.description: Curated collection of concise coding articles and snippets for web and backend developers.
tools.useCase: Ideal for developers seeking quick reference guides and practical code examples while debugging or learning new web technologies.
advantages: Provides concise, ready-to-use code snippets that save research time.
Covers a broad range of modern web and backend technologies in one place.
Open-source and regularly updated with community contributions.
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for production-ready, enterprise-grade documentation or API references.
Unsuitable for beginners needing step-by-step tutorials or video courses.
Does not replace comprehensive framework-specific guides or official documentation.
tools.description_zh: 為網頁與後端開發者精心策劃的精簡程式文章與程式碼片段合集。
tools.useCase_zh: 適合在除錯或學習新網頁技術時，尋找快速參考指南與實用程式碼範例的開發者。
tools.advantages_zh: 提供精簡且即用的程式碼片段，節省研究時間。涵蓋廣泛的現代網頁與後端技術於單一平台。開源並定期透過社群貢獻更新。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適用於生產環境、企業級的說明文件或 API 參考文件
不適合需要逐步教學或影片課程的初學者
無法取代框架專用的完整指南或官方說明文件

tools.name: Gitignore
tools.description: Official GitHub .gitignore templates for various languages and environments.
triggers: 排除不需 git 追蹤的檔案
為各種語言生成 ignore 模板
遮蔽敏感金鑰與憑證檔案
tools.useCase: Quickly apply standard ignore rules when initializing a new project for a specific language or OS.
advantages: Maintained by GitHub for broad compatibility across popular languages and tools.
Saves time by providing pre-configured patterns instead of manual configuration.
Covers diverse environments including IDEs, OS files, and build artifacts.
negativeConstraints: Do not use for managing repository access permissions or authentication secrets.
Avoid using as a substitute for dedicated credential management systems.
Not suitable for enforcing code quality standards or linting rules.
tools.description_zh: 適用於各種語言與環境的官方 GitHub .gitignore 範本。
tools.useCase_zh: 當為特定語言或作業系統初始化新專案時，快速套用標準的忽略規則。
tools.advantages_zh: 由 GitHub 維護，確保在熱門語言與工具間的廣泛相容性。省去手動設定的時間，直接提供已配置好的模式。涵蓋多樣環境，包括 IDE、作業系統檔案及建構產物。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適用於管理倉庫存取權限或認證金鑰
避免作為專用憑證管理系統的替代品
不適合用於執行程式碼品質標準或 linting 規則

tools.name: LangChain
tools.description: Comprehensive framework for developing context-aware, reasoning-driven LLM applications, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and composable agent workflows.
triggers: 呼叫大語言模型生成文本
查詢向量資料庫找相似內容
自動化執行多步驟任務
建立自動回覆的聊天機器人
tools.useCase: 適用於快速構建整合多種大型語言模型、向量資料庫、文檔檢索器 (RAG) 與外部 API 工具鏈的複雜企業級 AI 應用與 Chatbot 系統。
advantages: 擁有業界最廣泛的模型適配器、向量儲存庫與第三方工具生態（LangChain Community 700+ 整合）
提供宣告式 LCEL (LangChain Expression Language)，支援自動串流、非同步與重試
模組化分層架構（Core / Community / Text Splitters），支援極致靈活的管線組合
negativeConstraints: 不適用於完全不需要 LLM 介入的純規則型確定性業務邏輯
對於僅呼叫單一 OpenAI/Anthropic API 的極簡腳本可能引入過多抽象封裝
不推薦在微秒級超低延遲系統中使用深層嵌套的 Chain 結構

subTools.name: LangChain Core
subTools.description: Base abstractions, LCEL runtime, interfaces for LLMs, vectorstores, and prompt templates.
subTools.description_zh: 基礎抽象、LCEL 執行階段、LLM、向量資料庫與提示模板的介面。

subTools.name: LangChain Community
subTools.description: Third-party integrations with 700+ LLM providers, vector databases, and tools.
subTools.description_zh: 與 700 多家 LLM 供應商、向量資料庫和工具的第三方整合。

subTools.name: LangChain Text Splitters
subTools.description: Specialized tokenizers and text chunking strategies for optimized RAG ingestion.
subTools.description_zh: 專用編碼器與文字分塊策略，用於優化 RAG 資料攝取。

tools.description_zh: 用於開發具情境感知、推理驅動的 LLM 應用程式、檢索增強生成（RAG）及可組合的代理人工作流的全面框架。
tools.useCase_zh: 適用於快速構建整合多種大型語言模型、向量資料庫、文檔檢索器 (RAG) 與外部 API 工具鏈的複雜企業級 AI 應用與 Chatbot 系統。
tools.advantages_zh: 擁有業界最廣泛的模型適配器、向量儲存庫與第三方工具生態（LangChain Community 700+ 整合）,提供宣告式 LCEL (LangChain Expression Language)，支援自動串流、非同步與重試,模組化分層架構（Core / Community / Text Splitters），支援極致靈活的管線組合
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適用於完全不需要 LLM 介入的純規則型確定性業務邏輯
對於僅呼叫單一 OpenAI/Anthropic API 的極簡腳本可能引入過多抽象封裝
不推薦在微秒級超低延遲系統中使用深層嵌套的 Chain 結構

tools.name: N8n
tools.description: Fair-code workflow automation platform with native AI, 400+ integrations, and hybrid deployment.
tools.useCase: Automate cross-platform data synchronization between SaaS apps and internal databases using visual node-based workflows.
advantages: Native AI agent integration for autonomous task execution
Hybrid deployment supports both self-hosting and managed cloud
Extensive library of 400+ pre-built connectors for rapid API integration
negativeConstraints: High-frequency real-time trading systems requiring microsecond latency
Strictly open-source compliance projects due to fair-code licensing
Simple single-task scripts better handled by lightweight cron jobs
tools.description_zh: 具備原生 AI、400 多種整合與混合部署的公平授權工作流自動化平台。
tools.useCase_zh: 利用視覺化的節點式工作流，自動化 SaaS 應用程式與內部資料庫之間的跨平台資料同步。
tools.advantages_zh: 原生 AI 代理人整合，支援自主任務執行。混合部署同時支援自建與托管雲端。擁有 400 多種預先建立的連接器，實現快速的 API 整合。
negativeConstraints_zh: 需要微秒級延遲的高頻即時交易系統
因公平程式碼授權而需嚴格遵循開源合規的專案
簡單單一任務腳本，以輕量排程工作處理更為合適

tools.name: Openclaw
tools.description: Self-hosted personal AI assistant for any OS and platform.
tools.useCase: A developer can run Openclaw locally to manage daily tasks, automate workflows, and access AI features without relying on cloud services.
advantages: Cross-platform support across Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Local-first architecture ensures full data privacy and offline capability.
Modular design allows easy integration with custom AI models and tools.
negativeConstraints: Enterprise environments requiring centralized team management and role-based access control.
Users needing managed cloud infrastructure or guaranteed SLA uptime.
Highly regulated industries requiring certified compliance audits out of the box.
tools.description_zh: 適用於任何作業系統與平台的自架個人 AI 助理。
tools.useCase_zh: 開發者可以在本地執行 Openclaw，無需依賴雲端服務即可管理日常任務、自動化工作流並存取 AI 功能。
tools.advantages_zh: 跨平台支援 Windows、macOS 與 Linux。Local-first 架構確保完整資料隱私與離線能力。模組化設計便於與客製化 AI 模型和工具整合。
negativeConstraints_zh: 需要集中式團隊管理與角色權限管控的企業環境。
需要托管雲端基礎設施或保證 SLA 可用率的用戶。
需要內建認證合規審計的高度監管產業。

tools.name: Dify
tools.description: Open-source platform for building AI agents, workflows, and LLM apps with visual orchestration.
triggers: 可視化編排 LLM 應用
tools.useCase: Build and deploy a customer support chatbot with RAG retrieval and multi-step agent reasoning without writing backend code from scratch.
advantages: Visual workflow editor simplifies complex LLM chain and agent orchestration.
Built-in RAG pipeline and prompt management for rapid prototyping.
Self-hostable architecture ensures data privacy and production scalability.
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for simple static websites or non-AI CRUD applications.
Avoid if you require a fully managed SaaS without self-hosting overhead.
Not ideal for low-level system programming or embedded device control.
tools.description_zh: 開放原始碼平台，透過視覺化編排建構 AI 智能體、工作流程與 LLM 應用程式。
tools.useCase_zh: 建構並部署具備 RAG 檢索與多步驟智能體推理能力的客戶支援聊天機器人，無需從頭開始編寫後端程式。
tools.advantages_zh: 視覺化工作流程編輯器簡化複雜的 LLM 鏈與智能體編排。內建 RAG 管線與 prompt 管理，快速建立原型。自托管架構確保資料隱私與生產環境擴展性。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合簡單的靜態網站或非 AI 的 CRUD 應用。
若需要完全托管的 SaaS 且不希望自行架設時請避免使用。
不適合用於底層系統程式設計或嵌入式裝置控制。

tools.name: Public APIs

subTools.name: Business Growth Skills
subTools.description: Router/index for the 4 business & growth skills bundled in this plugin: customer-success-manager (health scoring, churn risk, expansion), sales-engineer (RFP analysis, competitive matrices, PoC planning), revenue-operations (pipeline, forecast accuracy, GTM efficiency), and contract-and-proposal-writer. Use when a growth/revenue request doesn't obviously match one skill and you need to pick the right one (e.g., 'which accounts are at risk', 'should we bid on this RFP').
subTools.description_zh: 本外掛整合 4 個商業與成長技能：客戶成功經理、銷售工程師、營收作業、契約與提案撰寫。當需求不明確歸屬單一技能時，用來快速挑選最適合的技能。

subTools.name: Contract And Proposal Writer
subTools.description: Generate professional, jurisdiction-aware business documents: freelance contracts, project proposals, SOWs, NDAs, and MSAs. Structured Markdown output with docx conversion instructions. Covers US (Delaware), EU (GDPR), UK, and DACH (German law) jurisdictions. Not a substitute for legal counsel — use as strong starting points. Use when drafting a freelance contract, preparing a client proposal, writing an SOW for a new engagement, or producing an NDA before sharing sensitive material.
subTools.description_zh: 生成專業且符合管轄法律的事務文件：自營契約、專案提案、SOW、NDA、MSA。支援美國（Delaware）、歐盟（GDPR）、英國及 DACH（德國法）司法管轄區。輸出為結構化 Markdown，並附 docx 轉換指引。請作為起點，不取代法律諮詢。

subTools.name: Customer Success Manager
subTools.description: Monitors customer health, predicts churn risk, and identifies expansion opportunities using weighted scoring models for SaaS customer success. Use when analyzing customer accounts, reviewing retention metrics, scoring at-risk customers, or when the user mentions churn, customer health scores, upsell opportunities, expansion revenue, retention analysis, or customer analytics. Runs three Python CLI tools to produce deterministic health scores, churn risk tiers, and prioritized expansion recommendations across Enterprise, Mid-Market, and SMB segments.
subTools.description_zh: 監控 SaaS 客戶健康度、預測流失風險、識別擴展機會，使用加權評分模型。適用於分析客戶帳戶、檢視留存指標、評估高風險客戶，或涉及 churn、客戶健康分數、upsell、擴展營收、留存分析等情境。執行 3 個 Python CLI 指令完成分析。

subTools.name: Revenue Operations
subTools.description: Analyzes sales pipeline health, revenue forecasting accuracy, and go-to-market efficiency metrics for SaaS revenue optimization. Use when analyzing sales pipeline coverage, forecasting revenue, evaluating go-to-market performance, reviewing sales metrics, assessing pipeline analysis, tracking forecast accuracy with MAPE, calculating GTM efficiency, or measuring sales efficiency and unit economics for SaaS teams.
subTools.description_zh: 分析銷售漏斗健康度、營收預測準確度及 GTM 效率指標，優化 SaaS 營收表現。適用情境包括：檢視銷售漏斗覆蓋率、預測營收、評估 GTM 績效、審查銷售指標、計算 MAPE、衡量 GTM 效率與單位經濟。

subTools.name: Sales Engineer
subTools.description: Analyzes RFP/RFI responses for coverage gaps, builds competitive feature comparison matrices, and plans proof-of-concept (POC) engagements for pre-sales engineering. Use when responding to RFPs, bids, or proposal requests; comparing product features against competitors; planning or scoring a customer POC or sales demo; preparing a technical proposal; or performing win/loss competitor analysis. Handles tasks described as 'RFP response', 'bid response', 'proposal response', 'competitor comparison', 'feature matrix', 'POC planning', 'sales demo prep', or 'pre-sales engineering'.
subTools.description_zh: 分析 RFP/RFI 回覆的涵蓋缺口、建立競爭功能比對矩陣、規劃 POC 專案。適用情境包括：回應 RFP、比對產品功能、規劃或評分手頭 POC、準備技術提案、進行 win/loss 競爭分析。能處理英文與多語言文件。

subTools.name: Business Operations Skills
subTools.description: Use when running, diagnosing, or designing internal business operations — process documentation, vendor SLAs, capacity planning, internal comms, SOP/runbook authoring, procurement spend. Triggers on "BizOps review", "where's the bottleneck", "vendor health", "internal SOP", "all-hands deck", "spend categorization", "capacity for Q3", "process mapping". Forks context to route to one of six BizOps sub-skills (process-mapper, vendor-management, capacity-planner, internal-comms, knowledge-ops, procurement-optimizer) and returns a digest. Distinct from business-growth (external sales motion) and c-level-advisor (strategic, not operational).
subTools.description_zh: 用於執行、診斷或設計內部商業營運——流程文件、供應商 SLA、產能規劃、內部溝通、SOP/runbook 撰寫、採購支出。觸發條件包含「BizOps 檢視」、「瓶頸在哪裡」、「供應商健康度」、「內部 SOP」、「全員大會簡報」、「支出分類」、「Q3 產能」、「流程映射」等。將情境導向六個 BizOps 子…

subTools.name: Capacity Planner
subTools.description: Use when an ops leader (Director of CX, Head of Support, VP Ops, Head of BizOps, Head of IT ops, Head of Finance ops) is sizing ops capacity, building a headcount plan, modeling utilization risk, planning Q3 capacity or annual support capacity, or designing CS coverage — and needs Erlang-C queueing math, P90 demand sizing, shrinkage-adjusted FTE, manager-trigger thresholds, and a quarterly hiring sequence with ramp + attrition. Apply when sustained team utilization is above 80% or when the team is growing >50% in 12 months. Run before committing the headcount budget. This is NOT engineering capacity (see vpe-advisor for DORA + cycle time) and NOT strategic 3-year workforce planning (see chro-advisor).
subTools.description_zh: 適用於營運主管（CX 總監、客服主管、營運副總、BizOps 主管、IT 營運主管、財務營運主管）評估產能規模、制定員額計畫、建模利用風險、規劃 Q3 或年度客服產能、或設計客服覆蓋——需要 Erlang-C 排隊數學、P90 需求規模、修正縮水率的 FTE、管理者觸發閾值與季度招募方案時使用。

subTools.name: Internal Comms
