subTools.description: Use when a Head of People Ops, BizOps lead, or Internal Communications owner needs to draft and sequence an internal-only change-management communication — a re-org announcement, a tool rollout, a policy change, a leadership transition, a layoff, an acquisition close, or an internal product launch — and the audience is employees (not customers). Pairs Prosci ADKAR and Kotter's 8-step change model with deterministic stdlib-only Python tools to produce a sequenced touchpoint calendar, a Kotter-compliant primary announcement, an audience-segmented FAQ, and manager cascade talking points; industry-tuned via --profile {tech-startup, scaleup, enterprise, public-company, non-profit}. Triggers on "all-hands announcement", "change comms", "rollout comms", "re-org announcement", "manager talking points", "layoff comms".
subTools.description_zh: 適用於人力資源營運主管、BizOps 負責人或內部溝通負責人需撰寫與排程僅限內部使用的變革管理溝通文案——例如組織調整公告、工具推出、政策變更、領導交接、裁員、併購完成或內部產品發布，且對象為員工而非客戶。搭配 Prosci ADKAR 與 Kotter 八步驟變革模型使用。

subTools.name: Knowledge Ops
subTools.description: Use when a Head of Ops, Knowledge Manager, or TPM-Internal needs to author, validate, or clean up company SOPs and internal runbooks (procurement intake, vendor offboarding, incident-comms cascade, employee onboarding) — including 5W2H completeness checks (Who-What-When-Where-Why-How-HowMuch), cross-link and orphan-page validation across a sprawling Notion/Confluence/Obsidian wiki, KB ingestion + hygiene reporting, and runbook step verification (named owner, expected duration, observable success signal, rollback path, escalation contact). Pairs Ishikawa's 5W2H method, Gawande's *The Checklist Manifesto*, ISO 9001, ITIL v4, and Google SRE Workbook runbook discipline with deterministic stdlib-only Python tools that score completeness, detect anti-patterns, and emit prioritized cleanup lists (e.g., "validate this runbook before it goes into rotation", "audit our Confluence wiki for stale and orphaned SOPs").
subTools.description_zh: 適用於營運主管、知識經理或 TPM-Internal 撰寫、驗證或清理公司 SOP 與內部 runbook（採購收案、供應商離廠、事件溝通Cascade、員工入職）——包含 5W2H 完整性檢查（Who-What-When-Where-Why-How-HowMuch）、 sprawling Notion/Confluence/Obsidian wiki 的跨連結與孤立頁面驗證、KB 匯入，及…

subTools.name: Process Mapper
subTools.description: Use when a BizOps lead, COO, or process-improvement owner needs to document an end-to-end business process (procurement, employee onboarding, incident handoff, customer-onboarding, claims adjudication) in BPMN-style notation, measure cycle times by stage, surface where work spends most of its time waiting vs. being worked, and quantify the gap between processing time and total elapsed time. Pairs Lean / Six Sigma / Theory-of-Constraints canon with deterministic stdlib-only Python tools to produce a process map, a ranked bottleneck list (with severity + root-cause hypothesis), and a cycle-time analysis (P50, P90, value-add ratio, Little's-Law throughput). Distinct from sales-pipeline, system-reliability (SLO), and strategic-OKR work — this is tactical process documentation for internal operations.
subTools.description_zh: 當業務運營主管、執行長或流程改善負責人需要以BPMN風格記錄端到端商業流程（採購、員工入職、事件交接、客戶入職、理賠裁決），並按階段測量週期時間、呈現等待與處理時間分布、量化處理時間與總耗時差距時使用。

subTools.name: Procurement Optimizer
subTools.description: Use when running an annual SaaS audit, doing category-level spend review, or rationalizing the supplier base — when the user needs a spend audit, spend categorization (UNSPSC-aligned with Pareto breakdown and industry profiles), purchasing-cycle analysis (bottleneck categories per Goldratt's Theory of Constraints), or risk-balanced supplier consolidation that refuses single-source recommendations for tier-1 categories without a documented break-glass plan. Triggers on "spend audit", "SaaS audit", "spend categorization", "supplier rationalization", "supplier consolidation", "category strategy", "duplicate SaaS", "renewal cluster".
subTools.description_zh: 當進行年度SaaS稽核、類別層級支出檢視，或整合供應商基礎時使用——提供支出稽核、UNSPSC對齊的支出分類（含帕累托分解與產業概況）、採購週期分析（基於高德拉特約束理論的瓶頸類別），以及拒絕單一來源建議的風險平衡供應商整合。

subTools.name: Vendor Management
subTools.description: Use when reviewing, scoring, or auditing third-party SaaS / vendor relationships — running a vendor scorecard with industry tuning, tracking SLA compliance with credit-claim flags, classifying third-party risk across 4 risk vectors, preparing a tier-1 vendor review, or auditing the SaaS portfolio. Forks context so large vendor catalogs (50-500 line items) and SLA logs don't pollute the parent thread. Triggers on "vendor SLA", "vendor scorecard", "third-party risk", "TPRM", "vendor review", "supplier performance", "vendor health check", "renewal review".
subTools.description_zh: 當檢視、評分或稽核第三方SaaS供應商關係時使用——執行帶有產業調整的供應商評分卡、追蹤具有信用聲明標記的SLA合規性、跨4個風險向量分類第三方風險、準備一線供應商檢視，或稽核SaaS組合。分離大型供應商目錄（50-500項目）與SLA日誌以免污染父執行緒。

subTools.name: Arquiteto De Empresa
subTools.description: Company Architect: builds a business from scratch as an OKF (Open Knowledge Format) bundle — a tree of version-controllable .md files with frontmatter type, links forming a graph, and reserved index.md/log.md, readable by humans and agents. Guides the founder through a 12-phase interview (foundation, strategy, market, financial, sales, marketing, product, operations, tech, people, legal, governance), one phase at a time, few questions per block, and generates the concepts as conformant markdown. Trigger when the user wants to create, structure, or document an entire company in folders and .md files; when they mention build my company from scratch, company as code, company knowledge base for AI to read, company wiki for agents, OKF, or knowledge bundle. In English.
subTools.description_zh: 企業架構師：以OKF（開放知識格式）套件形式從零建構企業——可版本控制的.md檔案樹，包含frontmatter型別、連結形成圖結構，並預留index.md/log.md，供人與代理讀取。引導創辦人完成12階段訪談（基礎、策略、市場、財務、銷售、行銷、產品、運營、技術、人力、法律、治理）。

subTools.name: Boardroom
subTools.description: /cs:boardroom <brief> — 6-phase multi-role deliberation across the C-suite with Phase 2 isolation, critic pre-screen, and synthesis. Outputs a board memo. Use when a decision spans multiple executive domains — e.g. a pricing change touching finance, positioning, and product, or a raise-vs-cut runway call.
subTools.description_zh: /cs:boardroom <簡述> — 跨 C-level 多角色六階段 deliberation，含 Phase 2 隔離、critic 預篩與綜合。輸出董事會備忘錄。當決策跨越多個高管領域時使用，例如影響財務、定位與產品的定價變更，或延長 vs 縮減機率的選擇。

subTools.name: Brief
subTools.description: /cs:brief <topic> — Generate a one-page strategy brief from an office-hours intake. First step in the strategic sprint pipeline. Use when a strategic question needs to be framed before boardroom deliberation — e.g. locking options, assumptions, and success criteria for a pricing change or a market-entry decision.
subTools.description_zh: /cs:brief <主題> — 從 office-hours 問卷產生一頁策略摘要。策略 sprint 流水線的第一步。當戰略問題需在 boardroom deliberation 前先被界定時使用，例如鎖定定價變更或市場進入決策的選項、假設與成功標準。

subTools.name: C Level Agents
subTools.description: Founder-mode executive team. 13 cs-* C-suite agents (CFO, CMO, CRO, CPO, COO, CHRO, CISO, GC, CDO, CAIO, CCO, VPE, Chief of Staff) and 21 /cs:* slash commands for forcing-question office hours, multi-role boardroom deliberation, strategic sprint pipeline, and meta routing. Use when the founder needs a virtual executive team, when invoking /cs:* commands, or when orchestrating multi-role decisions.
subTools.description_zh: 創辦人模式的執行團隊。包含 13 位 cs-* C-level 代理（CFO、CMO、CRO、CPO、COO、CHRO、CISO、GC、CDO、CAIO、CCO、VPE、首席幕僚長）及 21 個 /cs:* 指令，用於強制提問 office-hours、多角色董事會 deliberation、策略 sprint 流水線與 meta routing。當創辦人需要虛擬執行團隊、呼叫 /cs:* 指令或協調多角色決策時使用。

subTools.name: Caio Review
subTools.description: /cs:caio-review <plan> — Eval-demanding Chief AI Officer interrogation of any plan that involves AI: model selection, risk classification, cost economics, or AI hiring. Use when shipping an AI feature without an eval set, choosing between API, fine-tune, and self-hosted, or classifying a use case under the EU AI Act.
subTools.description_zh: /cs:caio-review <計畫> — 對任何涉及 AI 的計畫進行嚴格的 Chief AI Officer 審問：模型選擇、風險分級、成本經濟或 AI 用人。當未附 eval set 就要上線 AI 功能、在 API、微調與自託管之間選擇，或根據歐盟 AI Act 對用例分級時使用。

subTools.name: Cco Review
subTools.description: /cs:cco-review <plan> — Retention-obsessed Chief Customer Officer interrogation of any plan that touches customer retention, segmentation, CS team sizing, or CS team hiring. Use when gross retention is slipping, before approving CSM headcount, or when deciding which customer segments to keep or fire.
subTools.description_zh: /cs:cco-review <plan> — 以客戶保留為核心的首席客戶官審查，檢視任何涉及客戶保留、客戶區隔、客服團隊規模或招聘的計畫。適用情境：客戶留存率下滑、核准客戶成功經理編制前、決定保留或淘汰客戶區隔時。

subTools.name: Cdo Review
subTools.description: /cs:cdo-review <plan> — Decision-driven Chief Data Officer interrogation of any plan that touches training data, data architecture, data productization, or data team hiring. Use when validating training-data rights before model work, choosing warehouse vs lakehouse vs mesh, or valuing data assets for productization or M&A.
subTools.description_zh: /cs:cdo-review <plan> — 以決策為導向的首席數據長審查，檢視任何涉及訓練資料、資料架構、資料產品化或資料團隊招聘的計畫。適用情境：模型工作前驗證訓練資料權限、選擇資料倉儲 vs 資料湖 vs 資料網格、為產品化或併購評估資料資產價值時。

subTools.name: Cfo Review
subTools.description: /cs:cfo-review <plan> — Numerate-skeptic interrogation of any plan that touches money. Unit economics, runway, dilution, capital allocation. Use when a plan commits meaningful spend — e.g. a hiring wave, a fundraise decision, or a new channel budget.
subTools.description_zh: /cs:cfo-review <plan> — 用數字說服的懷疑者審查，檢視任何涉及資金的計畫，包含單位經濟效益、現金跑道、股權稀釋、資本配置。適用情境：計畫涉及重大支出，例如招募浪潮、募資決策、或新頻道預算。

subTools.name: Ciso Review
subTools.description: /cs:ciso-review <plan> — Risk-paranoid interrogation of any plan that touches data, compliance, or production access. Use when launching features that handle customer data, before a SOC 2 / ISO audit, or after any incident or near-miss.
subTools.description_zh: /cs:ciso-review <plan> — 風險敏感的首席資訊安全長審查，檢視任何涉及資料、合規或生產環境存取的計畫。適用情境：推出處理客戶資料的功能前、SOC 2 / ISO 稽核前、發生資安事件或意外後。

subTools.name: Cmo Review
subTools.description: /cs:cmo-review <plan> — Narrative-first interrogation of positioning, ICP, message house, and channel mix. Use when launching a campaign or repositioning, or when CAC is rising and the one-sentence positioning test fails.
subTools.description_zh: /cs:cmo-review <plan> — 從敘事出發，深入檢視定位、ICP、message house 與 channel mix。適合用於新活動上線、重新定位，或 CAC 上升且一句話定位測試失敗時。

subTools.name: Cpo Review
subTools.description: /cs:cpo-review <plan> — JTBD-driven interrogation of product roadmap, PMF signal, and portfolio focus. Use when committing a quarter's roadmap, deciding whether to kill a feature, or claiming PMF without a retention curve.
subTools.description_zh: /cs:cpo-review <plan> — 基於 JTBD 檢視產品路線圖、PMF 訊號與產品組合聚焦。適合用於敲定季路線圖、決定砍功能，或宣稱已達 PMF 但缺乏留存曲線時。

subTools.name: Cro Review
subTools.description: /cs:cro-review <plan> — Pipeline-paranoid interrogation of revenue, win rate, NRR, and ramp time. Use when the forecast misses pipeline coverage, win rates drop, or before scaling the sales team.
subTools.description_zh: /cs:cro-review <plan> — 對 Pipeline 保持高度警覺，深入檢視營收、win rate、NRR 與 ramp time。適合用於預測未達 Pipeline 覆蓋標準、win rate 下滑，或準備擴大銷售團隊前。

subTools.name: Cross Eval
subTools.description: /cs:cross-eval <memo> — Multi-model consensus on a board memo or strategy brief. Claude + Codex + Gemini cross-review with graceful degradation. Use when a high-stakes memo needs an independent sanity check before the boardroom — e.g. a bet-the-company pivot or fundraise terms.
subTools.description_zh: /cs:cross-eval <memo> — 透過 Claude、Codex、Gemini 多模型交叉審查，為董事會簡報或策略備忘錄提供共識檢視，並具備優雅降級機制。適合在高風險備忘錄提交董事會前，需要獨立把關時，例如全押轉型或募資條款。

subTools.name: Cto Review
subTools.description: /cs:cto-review <plan> — Architecture and scaling interrogation. Tech debt, scaling cliffs, team scaling, build-vs-buy. Use when committing to an architecture, planning for 10x load, or weighing a rebuild against a vendor.
subTools.description_zh: /cs:cto-review <plan> — 深入檢視架構與擴展。涵蓋技術債、擴展瓶頸、團隊擴編與自製 vs 採購決策。適合用於敲定架構、規劃 10 倍流量負載，或評估重構與採購方案時。

subTools.name: Decide
subTools.description: /cs:decide <memo> — Log a decision to two-layer memory via decision-logger. Approved memo becomes durable; raw transcripts kept for reference. Use when the founder has approved a boardroom memo and the decision must become durable company memory — e.g. right after /cs:boardroom concludes.
subTools.description_zh: /cs:decide <memo> — 透過 decision-logger 將決策寫入兩層記憶。核准的 memo 成為持久記憶；原始會議記錄保留供參。適合創辦人核准董事會 memo 後，需要將決策轉為公司長期記憶時，例如 /cs:boardroom 結束後。

subTools.name: Execute
subTools.description: /cs:execute <decision> — Generate a 90-day execution plan with weekly milestones, DRIs, and check-in cadence from an approved decision. Use when a logged decision needs to become an operating plan — e.g. turning an approved market-entry call into weekly milestones with DRIs.
subTools.description_zh: /cs:execute <decision> — 根據已核准決策，產生 90 天執行計畫，包含每週里程碑、DRIs 與追蹤頻率。適合已記錄決策需轉為營運計畫時，例如將核准的市場進入決策化為帶有 DRIs 的每週里程碑。

subTools.name: Founder Mode
subTools.description: /cs:founder-mode <question> — Auto-routes any founder question to the right C-role advisor or to /cs:boardroom for multi-role topics. The single-command entry point. Use when a founder asks any strategic question without knowing which advisor or command fits — e.g. 'runway pressure' routes to the CFO, 'gross retention dropped' routes to the CCO.
subTools.description_zh: /cs:founder-mode <question> — 自動將創辦人問題轉介至對應的 C-level 顧問或 /cs:boardroom（多角色議題）。單一指令入口。適合創辦人提出策略問題但不確定該找哪位顧問或指令時，例如「現金流壓力」轉介 CFO、「毛續留下降」轉介 CCO。

subTools.name: Freeze
subTools.description: /cs:freeze <decision> <days> — Lock a strategic decision for a cooldown period to prevent impulse reversal. Mirrors gstack's safety primitives for the business layer. Use when an irreversible decision was made under pressure — e.g. a layoff plan or multi-year contract — and deserves a cooling-off lock before execution.
subTools.description_zh: /cs:freeze <決策> <天數> — 冷卻期內鎖定戰略決策，避免衝動反悔，對應 gstack 的安全機制於商業層。高壓下做出的不可逆決策（如裁員計畫、多年合約）執行前，需冷靜期鎖定時使用。

subTools.name: Gc Review
subTools.description: /cs:gc-review <plan> — General Counsel interrogation of contracts, IP, regulatory, term sheets, and employment-law surface. Use when reviewing a term sheet before signing, redlining a customer MSA, or checking IP assignment and regulatory exposure on a new product.
subTools.description_zh: /cs:gc-review <計畫> — 法務長對合約、智慧財產權、監管、條款清單與勞動法的深度檢視。簽署條款清單前、修訂客戶 MSA 時，或檢查新產品 IP 歸屬與監管曝險時使用。

subTools.name: Office Hours
subTools.description: /cs:office-hours <topic> — YC-style 6-question founder interrogation before any advice. Forces clarity on problem, customer, distribution, defensibility, capital, and founder fit. Use when a founder question is too vague to route — e.g. 'should we grow faster?' — or before drafting a strategy brief.
subTools.description_zh: /cs:office-hours <主題> — YC 風格 6 問創辦人面詢，任何建議前先釐清問題。強制釐清問題、客戶、分發、護城河、資金與創辦人適配度。創辦人提問過於模糊（如『該加速成長嗎？』），或撰寫策略備忘錄前使用。

subTools.name: Onboard
subTools.description: /cs:onboard — Founder interview that populates ~/.claude/company-context.md using the canonical 7-dimension cs-onboard schema. The first command to run when starting with c-level-agents. Use when setting up the virtual C-suite for a new company, or when advisors lack company context — e.g. before a first /cs:boardroom or after a fundraise changes the numbers.
subTools.description_zh: /cs:onboard — 創辦人訪談，以標準 7 維度架構填充 ~/.claude/company-context.md。開始使用 c-level-agents 時第一個指令。為新公司 setup 虛擬 C-Level 團隊，或顧問缺乏公司脈絡時使用。

subTools.name: Post Mortem
subTools.description: /cs:post-mortem <decision> — Honest retrospective on an executed decision, scored against original assumptions and dissent. Closes the strategic sprint loop. Use when a decision hits its 90-day review checkpoint or its kill criteria trigger — e.g. scoring last quarter's pricing change against its pre-committed success metrics.
subTools.description_zh: /cs:post-mortem <決策> — 對已執行決策的誠實回顧，以原始假設與異見評分，閉合戰略衝刺循環。決策達到 90 天檢視節點或觸發終止條件時使用，如以預先承諾指標評估上季定價調整。

subTools.name: Vpe Review
subTools.description: /cs:vpe-review <plan> — Throughput-first VP of Engineering interrogation of any plan that touches delivery, eng hiring, team structure, or production discipline. Use when cycle time balloons, DORA metrics slide, or before committing to an eng hiring wave or a reorg.
subTools.description_zh: /cs:vpe-review <計畫> — 以產能為優先的工程副總裁對任何涉及交付、工程招募、團隊結構或生產紀律的計畫進行嚴格檢視。週轉時間暴增、DORA 指標下滑，或準備 commit 招募與組織調整前使用。

subTools.name: Chief Ai Officer Advisor
subTools.description: Chief AI Officer advisory for startups: model build-vs-buy decisions (API vs fine-tune vs in-house), AI risk classification under EU AI Act + US state patchwork, AI cost economics (API-to-self-hosted breakeven), and AI team org evolution. Use when deciding whether to call an API or fine-tune, classifying AI use cases for regulatory risk, calculating when self-hosting pays off, sequencing AI hires, or when user mentions CAIO, AI strategy, model selection, foundation model, fine-tuning, EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, AI governance, model risk, or AI economics. Strategic only — does not duplicate engineering AI/ML skills.
subTools.description_zh: 初創公司 AI 長顧問：模型自製或外購決策（API vs 微調 vs 自建）、EU AI Act 與美國各州法規下的 AI 風險分類、AI 成本經濟學（API 與自建成本平衡點），以及 AI 團隊組織演進。決定呼叫 API 或微調、為監管風險對 AI 應用分類、計算自建划算時機時使用。

subTools.name: Chief Customer Officer Advisor
subTools.description: Chief Customer Officer advisory for startups: retention decomposition (gross retention vs NRR honesty, churn root-cause taxonomy), customer segmentation strategy (differential investment across tiers + ICP fit scoring), CS team coverage model (pooled vs named CSM thresholds + ratio math), and CS team org evolution (CS vs Support vs AM distinctions). Use when designing retention strategy, segmenting customers for differential investment, sizing CS team, or sequencing CS hires. Strategic only — does not duplicate engineering/business-growth tactical skills.
subTools.description_zh: 初創公司客戶長顧問：留存率分解（大額留存與 NRR 真實差距、流失根因分類）、客戶分群策略（各層級差異化投資 + ICP 符合度評分）、CS 團隊覆蓋模式（pooled vs named CSM 門檻與比率計算），以及 CS 團隊組織演進。設計留存策略、客戶分群時使用。

subTools.name: Chief Data Officer Advisor
subTools.description: Chief Data Officer advisory for startups: AI training data rights and consent provenance, data product strategy (warehouse vs lakehouse vs mesh, build-vs-buy), B2B customer-data-as-asset valuation and M&A readiness, data team org evolution. Use when deciding whether to train models on customer data, choosing data architecture, valuing data for fundraising or M&A, sequencing data hires, or when user mentions CDO, chief data officer, data strategy, data mesh, lakehouse, training data, data product, data monetization, or customer data asset. NOT a tactical data engineering skill — strategic decisions only.
subTools.description_zh: 為新創提供資料長級諮詢：AI 訓練資料權利與同意溯源、資料產品策略（倉儲vs湖倉vs mesh、自建vs外購）、B2B 客戶資料資產估值與 M&A 準備、資料團隊組織演進。適用於決策是否用客戶資料訓練模型、選擇資料架構、為募資或併購評估資料價值、排定資料招募時程。

subTools.name: Board Prep
subTools.description: Board meeting preparation for the adversarial scenario, not the friendly one. Forces numbers-cold mastery, anticipates hard questions, builds a narrative that acknowledges weakness without losing the room. Use when preparing for a board meeting, an investor update, fundraising presentation, or any high-stakes adversarial review where every number must live in your head not just on a slide.
subTools.description_zh: 針對對抗性場景的董事會會議準備，非友好場合。強制掌握資料細節，預先 anticipate 尖銳問題，建立承認弱點但不失場的話題。適用於準備董事會會議、投資人更新、募資簡報或任何高風險對抗性審查，每個數字都必須熟記於心而非只靠在投影片上。

subTools.name: Challenge
subTools.description: Pre-mortem plan analysis. Imagine the plan failed 12 months from now and work backwards to find the weaknesses. Surfaces assumptions, dependencies, and execution risks before committing resources. Use when before significant resource commitment, before presenting to a board or investors, when feedback has been one-sidedly positive, or when there is pressure to move fast and figure it out later.
subTools.description_zh: 前測計畫分析。想像 12 個月後計畫失敗，倒推找出弱點。在投入資源前凸顯假設、依賴關係與執行風險。適用於重大資源投入前、向董事會或投資人簡報前、回饋一面倒地正面時，或有壓力要求快速推進。

subTools.name: Executive Mentor
subTools.description: Adversarial thinking partner for founders and executives. Stress-tests plans, prepares for brutal board meetings, dissects decisions with no good options, and forces honest post-mortems. Use when you need someone to find the holes before the board does, make a decision you've been avoiding, or understand what actually went wrong.
subTools.description_zh: 為創投與高管提供對抗性思考夥伴。壓力測試計畫、準備殘酷董事會會議、剖析無好選項的決策、強制誠實事後檢討。適用於需要有人在董事會發現漏洞前找出問題、做出一直避免的決策、或釐清真正失誤原因時。

subTools.name: Hard Call
subTools.description: /em:hard-call — Framework for decisions with no good options. Use when every option is painful and a structured 10/10/10 + regret-minimization pass is needed — e.g. choosing between a layoff and a down round, or killing a beloved product line.
subTools.description_zh: 無好選項的決策框架。適用所有選項皆痛苦的場景，需結構化 10/10/10 分析與遺憾最小化檢視，例如在裁員與降值融資間抉擇，或砍掉心愛的產品線。

subTools.name: Postmortem
subTools.description: /em:postmortem — Honest analysis of what went wrong. Use after a failed launch, missed quarter, or bad hire to run a blameless 5-Whys retrospective with a change register — e.g. dissecting why the Q3 release slipped six weeks.
subTools.description_zh: 誠實分析失敗原因。適用於產品發布失敗、季報未達標、錯誤僱用後，執行無責的 5 Why 回顧並建立變更清單，例如剖析為何 Q3 版本延期六週。

subTools.name: Stress Test
subTools.description: /em:stress-test — Business assumption stress testing. Use before betting on a plan whose core assumptions are unvalidated — e.g. stress-testing 'enterprise buyers will tolerate a 6-month pilot' or a hockey-stick revenue model.
subTools.description_zh: 商業假設壓力測試。適用於核心假設未驗證時押注計畫，例如測試「企業客戶會容忍 6 個月測試期」或曲棍球棒營收模型。

subTools.name: General Counsel Advisor
subTools.description: General Counsel advisory for startups: contract review (MSA, SaaS, NDA, DPA, employment), IP strategy, term sheet decoding, and regulatory landscape mapping. Use when reviewing any contract or term sheet, deciding when to engage outside counsel, defining IP strategy, evaluating regulatory exposure (HIPAA, GDPR, FDA, fintech), or when user mentions general counsel, GC, legal review, contract risk, term sheet, IP assignment, or regulatory exposure. NOT a substitute for licensed counsel — surfaces questions to bring to qualified attorneys.
subTools.description_zh: 為新創提供總顧問級諮詢：合約審查（MSA、SaaS、NDA、DPA、僱傭）、智慧財產策略、條款解讀、法規景觀Mapping。適用於審查合約或條款、決定何時聘請外部律師、制定 IP 策略、評估法規曝險（HIPAA、GDPR、FDA、金融科技），或提及總顧問、GC、法律審查時。

subTools.name: Agent Protocol
subTools.description: Inter-agent communication protocol for C-suite agent teams. Defines invocation syntax, loop prevention, isolation rules, and response formats. Use when C-suite agents need to query each other, coordinate cross-functional analysis, or run board meetings with multiple agent roles.
subTools.description_zh: C-suite 多 Agent 團隊的通訊協定，定義呼叫語法、迴圈防範、隔離規則與回應格式。當 Agent 需跨角色查詢、協調跨部門分析或舉行董事會時使用。

subTools.name: Arquiteto De Empresa
subTools.description: Company Architect: builds a business from scratch as an OKF (Open Knowledge Format) bundle — a tree of version-controllable .md files with frontmatter type, links forming a graph, and reserved index.md/log.md, readable by humans and agents. Guides the founder through a 12-phase interview (foundation, strategy, market, financial, sales, marketing, product, operations, tech, people, legal, governance), one phase at a time, few questions per block, and generates the concepts as conformant markdown. Trigger when the user wants to create, structure, or document an entire company in folders and .md files; when they mention build my company from scratch, company as code, company knowledge base for AI to read, company wiki for agents, OKF, or knowledge bundle. In English.
subTools.description_zh: 從零開始建立企業，以 OKF 套件形式產出可版本控制的 .md 檔案樹，透過 12 階段訪談引導創業者，涵蓋基礎、策略、市場、財務、銷售、行銷、產品、營運、技術、人事、法律與治理。

subTools.name: Board Deck Builder
subTools.description: Assembles comprehensive board and investor update decks by pulling perspectives from all C-suite roles. Use when preparing board meetings, investor updates, quarterly business reviews, or fundraising narratives. Covers structure, narrative framework, bad news delivery, and common mistakes.
subTools.description_zh: 整合各 C-suite 角色觀點，建構董事會與投資人簡報。適用董事會準備、投資人更新、季報檢閱或募資敘事，涵蓋結構、敘事框架、壞消息呈現與常見錯誤。

subTools.name: Board Meeting
subTools.description: Multi-agent board meeting protocol for strategic decisions. Runs a structured 6-phase deliberation: context loading, independent C-suite contributions (isolated, no cross-pollination), critic analysis, synthesis, founder review, and decision extraction. Use when the user invokes /cs:boardroom, calls a board meeting, or wants structured multi-perspective executive deliberation on a strategic question.
subTools.description_zh: 多 Agent 董事會協議，執行策略決策。進行 6 階段結構化 deliberation：情境載入、獨立 C-suite 貢獻、評論者分析、綜合、創業者檢視與決策萃取。

subTools.name: C Level Skills
subTools.description: Index and router for the C-level advisory bundle: 33 skills covering 14 C-suite roles, orchestration, cross-cutting capabilities, and culture. Use when exploring what the c-level-advisor bundle contains, deciding which advisor skill fits a question, or finding the entry points (cs-onboard interview, chief-of-staff routing, board-meeting protocol).
subTools.description_zh: c-level-advisor 套件的索引與路由，涵蓋 14 個 C-suite 角色的 33 項技能。用於瀏覽套件內容、選擇合適顧問技能，或尋找入口點。

subTools.name: Ceo Advisor
subTools.description: Executive leadership guidance for strategic decision-making, organizational development, and stakeholder management. Use when planning strategy, preparing board presentations, managing investors, developing organizational culture, making executive decisions, fundraising, or when user mentions CEO, strategic planning, board meetings, investor updates, organizational leadership, or executive strategy.
subTools.description_zh: 提供高管領導指導，協助策略決策、組織發展與利害關係人管理。用於規劃策略、準備董事會簡報、管理投資人、募資，或當使用者提到 CEO、策略規劃等關鍵字。

subTools.name: Cfo Advisor
subTools.description: Financial leadership for startups and scaling companies. Financial modeling, unit economics, fundraising strategy, cash management, and board financial packages. Use when building financial models, analyzing unit economics, planning fundraising, managing cash runway, preparing board materials, or when user mentions CFO, burn rate, runway, fundraising, unit economics, LTV, CAC, term sheets, or financial strategy.
subTools.description_zh: 新創與成長期企業的財務領導，涵蓋財務模型、單位經濟學、募資策略、現金管理與董事會財務報告。當使用者提到 CFO、burn rate、runway、募資等關鍵字時使用。

subTools.name: Change Management
subTools.description: Framework for rolling out organizational changes without chaos. Covers the ADKAR model adapted for startups, communication templates, resistance patterns, and change fatigue management. Handles process changes, org restructures, strategy pivots, and culture changes. Use when announcing a reorg, switching tools, pivoting strategy, killing a product, changing leadership, or when user mentions change management, change rollout, managing resistance, org change, reorg, or pivot communication.
subTools.description_zh: 組織變革推動框架，涵蓋 ADKAR 模型、溝通模板、抵抗模式與變革疲勞管理。適用於流程變更、組織重整、策略轉向與文化變革情境。

subTools.name: Chief Ai Officer Advisor
subTools.description: Chief AI Officer advisory for startups: model build-vs-buy decisions (API vs fine-tune vs in-house), AI risk classification under EU AI Act + US state patchwork, AI cost economics (API-to-self-hosted breakeven), and AI team org evolution. Use when deciding whether to call an API or fine-tune, classifying AI use cases for regulatory risk, calculating when self-hosting pays off, sequencing AI hires, or when user mentions CAIO, AI strategy, model selection, foundation model, fine-tuning, EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, AI governance, model risk, or AI economics. Strategic only — does not duplicate engineering AI/ML skills.
subTools.description_zh: 為初創公司提供首席AI官顧問：模型自製或外購決策（API vs 微調 vs 自建）、EU AI Act及美國各州法規下的AI風險分級、AI成本經濟學（API與自建主機損益平衡），以及AI團隊組織演進。適合在決定呼叫API或微調、為法規風險對AI用例分級，以及安排AI人才招募時使用。

subTools.name: Chief Customer Officer Advisor
subTools.description: Chief Customer Officer advisory for startups: retention decomposition (gross retention vs NRR honesty, churn root-cause taxonomy), customer segmentation strategy (differential investment across tiers + ICP fit scoring), CS team coverage model (pooled vs named CSM thresholds + ratio math), and CS team org evolution (CS vs Support vs AM distinctions). Use when designing retention strategy, segmenting customers for differential investment, sizing CS team, or sequencing CS hires. Strategic only — does not duplicate engineering/business-growth tactical skills.
subTools.description_zh: 為初創公司提供首席客戶官顧問：留存率拆解（總留存率與淨變更率、流失根本原因分類）、客戶細分策略（不同層級差異化投資與ICP匹配評分）、客戶服務團隊覆蓋模式（pooled vs named CSM閾值與比例計算），以及CS團隊組織演進。適合在設計留存策略、細分客戶時使用。

subTools.name: Chief Data Officer Advisor
subTools.description: Chief Data Officer advisory for startups: AI training data rights and consent provenance, data product strategy (warehouse vs lakehouse vs mesh, build-vs-buy), B2B customer-data-as-asset valuation and M&A readiness, data team org evolution. Use when deciding whether to train models on customer data, choosing data architecture, valuing data for fundraising or M&A, sequencing data hires, or when user mentions CDO, chief data officer, data strategy, data mesh, lakehouse, training data, data product, data monetization, or customer data asset. NOT a tactical data engineering skill — strategic decisions only.
subTools.description_zh: 為初創公司提供首席資料官顧問：AI訓練資料權利與同意來源、資料產品策略（warehouse vs lakehouse vs mesh、自建vs外購）、B2B客戶資料資產估值與M&A準備度、資料團隊組織演進。適合在決定是否用客戶資料訓練模型、選擇資料架構，以及為募資或併購評估資料價值時使用。

subTools.name: Chief Of Staff
subTools.description: C-suite orchestration layer. Routes founder questions to the right advisor role(s), triggers multi-role board meetings for complex decisions, synthesizes outputs, and tracks decisions. Every C-suite interaction starts here. Loads company context automatically. Use when a founder question needs routing to the right advisor — e.g. 'should we raise now or cut burn?' — or when a multi-domain decision needs a board meeting convened.
subTools.description_zh: C層級協調層。將創辦人問題轉介至合適的顧問角色、為複雜決策觸發多角色董事會會議、綜合輸出結果，並追蹤決策。每項C層級互動皆由此開始，自動載入公司背景。適合在創辦人問題需轉介合適顧問，或涉及跨領域決策時使用。

subTools.name: Chro Advisor
subTools.description: People leadership for scaling companies. Hiring strategy, compensation design, org structure, culture, and retention. Use when building hiring plans, designing comp frameworks, restructuring teams, managing performance, building culture, or when user mentions CHRO, HR, people strategy, talent, headcount, compensation, org design, retention, or performance management.
subTools.description_zh: 成長期公司的人力資源領導。包含招募策略、薪酬設計、組織架構、文化與留任。適合在制定招募計畫、設計薪酬框架、重組團隊、管理績效、建立文化，或使用者提到CHRO、HR、人才策略、編制、薪酬、組織設計、留任、績效管理時使用。

subTools.name: Ciso Advisor
subTools.description: Security leadership for growth-stage companies. Risk quantification in dollars, compliance roadmap (SOC 2/ISO 27001/HIPAA/GDPR), security architecture strategy, incident response leadership, and board-level security reporting. Use when building security programs, justifying security budget, selecting compliance frameworks, managing incidents, assessing vendor risk, or when user mentions CISO, security strategy, compliance roadmap, zero trust, or board security reporting.
subTools.description_zh: 成長期公司的資訊安全領導。包含美元計量的風險量化、合規路線圖（SOC 2/ISO 27001/HIPAA/GDPR）、安全架構策略、事件應變領導，以及董事層級的安全報告。適合在建立安全計畫、為安全預算背書、選擇合規框架、管理事件，或使用者提到CISO、安全時使用。

subTools.name: Cmo Advisor
subTools.description: Marketing leadership for scaling companies. Brand positioning, growth model design, marketing budget allocation, and marketing org design. Use when designing brand strategy, selecting growth models (PLG vs sales-led vs community-led), allocating marketing budgets, building marketing teams, or when user mentions CMO, brand strategy, growth model, CAC, LTV, channel mix, or marketing ROI.
subTools.description_zh: 成長期公司的行銷領導。包含品牌定位、成長模式設計、行銷預算配置與行銷組織設計。適合在設計品牌策略、選擇成長模式（PLG vs 銷售驅動 vs 社群驅動）、配置行銷預算、建立行銷團隊，或使用者提到CMO、品牌策略、成長模式、CAC、LTV、管道組合、行銷ROI時使用。

subTools.name: Company Os
subTools.description: The meta-framework for how a company runs — the connective tissue between all C-suite roles. Covers operating system selection (EOS, Scaling Up, OKR-native, hybrid), accountability charts, scorecards, meeting pulse, issue resolution, and 90-day rocks. Use when setting up company operations, selecting a management framework, designing meeting rhythms, building accountability systems, implementing OKRs, or when user mentions EOS, Scaling Up, operating system, L10 meetings, rocks, scorecard, accountability chart, or quarterly planning.
subTools.description_zh: 公司如何運作的元框架，串連所有C層級角色。涵蓋作業系統選擇（EOS、Scaling Up、OKR原生、混合式）、職責分配圖、指標看板、會議節奏、問題解決機制，以及90天重點任務。適合在設定公司營運、選擇管理框架、設計會議節奏，或建立問責系統時使用。

subTools.name: Competitive Intel
subTools.description: Systematic competitor tracking that feeds CMO positioning, CRO battlecards, and CPO roadmap decisions. Use when analyzing competitors, building sales battlecards, tracking market moves, positioning against alternatives, or when user mentions competitive intelligence, competitive analysis, competitor research, battlecards, win/loss, or market positioning.
subTools.description_zh: 系統化追蹤競爭對手，輔助 CMO 定位、CRO 戰術卡和 CPO 路線圖決策。用於分析競爭對手、製作銷售戰術卡、追蹤市場動態、與替代品定位，或當使用者提及競爭情報、競爭分析、競品研究、戰術卡、成敗分析或市場定位時。

subTools.name: Context Engine
subTools.description: Loads and manages company context for all C-suite advisor skills. Reads ~/.claude/company-context.md, detects stale context (>90 days), enriches context during conversations, and enforces privacy/anonymization rules before external API calls. Use when starting any C-suite advisor session, when context looks stale or missing, or before sending company data to an external service.
subTools.description_zh: 載入並管理所有高管顧問技能的公司情境。讀取 ~/.claude/company-context.md，偵測過時情境（超過 90 天），在對話中豐富情境，並在外部 API 呼叫前強制執行隱私／匿名化規則。用於啟動任何高管顧問工作階段、情境過時或缺失時，或在將公司資料傳送至外部服務前。

subTools.name: Coo Advisor
subTools.description: Operations leadership for scaling companies. Process design, OKR execution, operational cadence, and scaling playbooks. Use when designing operations, setting up OKRs, building processes, scaling teams, analyzing bottlenecks, planning operational cadence, or when user mentions COO, operations, process improvement, OKRs, scaling, operational efficiency, or execution.
subTools.description_zh: 為成長期公司提供營運領導。包含流程設計、OKR 執行、營運節奏和擴展戰術。用於設計營運、設定 OKR、建立流程、擴展團隊、分析瓶頸、規劃營運節奏，或當使用者提及 COO、營運、流程改進、OKR、擴展、營運效率或執行時。

subTools.name: Cpo Advisor
subTools.description: Product leadership for scaling companies. Product vision, portfolio strategy, product-market fit, and product org design. Use when setting product vision, managing a product portfolio, measuring PMF, designing product teams, prioritizing at the portfolio level, reporting to the board on product, or when user mentions CPO, product strategy, product-market fit, product organization, portfolio prioritization, or roadmap strategy.
subTools.description_zh: 為成長期公司提供產品領導。包含產品願景、產品線策略、產品市場契合度和產品組織設計。用於設定產品願景、管理產品組合、測量 PMF、設計產品團隊、在產品線層級優先排序、向董事會報告產品，或當使用者提及 CPO、產品策略、產品市場契合度、產品組織、產品組合優先時。

subTools.name: Cro Advisor
subTools.description: Revenue leadership for B2B SaaS companies. Revenue forecasting, sales model design, pricing strategy, net revenue retention, and sales team scaling. Use when designing the revenue engine, setting quotas, modeling NRR, evaluating pricing, building board forecasts, or when user mentions CRO, chief revenue officer, revenue strategy, sales model, ARR growth, NRR, expansion revenue, churn, pricing strategy, or sales capacity.
subTools.description_zh: 為 B2B SaaS 公司提供營收領導。包含營收預測、銷售模式設計、定價策略、淨營收留存和銷售團隊擴展。用於設計營收引擎、設定目標、建模 NRR、評估定價、建立董事會預測，或當使用者提及 CRO、首席營收官、營收策略、銷售模式、ARR 成長、NRR、擴張營收、流失率、定價策略時。

subTools.name: Cs Onboard
subTools.description: Founder onboarding interview that captures company context across 7 dimensions. Invoke with /cs:setup for initial interview or /cs:update for quarterly refresh. Generates ~/.claude/company-context.md used by all C-suite advisor skills. Use when setting up the C-suite advisors for the first time, or when company context is missing or more than 90 days old — e.g. after a fundraise or pivot.
subTools.description_zh: 創辦人導入訪談，涵蓋 7 個維度的公司情境。使用 /cs:setup 進行初始訪談或 /cs:update 進行季度更新。產生 ~/.claude/company-context.md，供所有高管顧問技能使用。用於首次設定高管顧問，或當公司情境缺失或超過 90 天未更新時——例如融資後或轉型後。

subTools.name: Cto Advisor
subTools.description: Technical leadership guidance for engineering teams, architecture decisions, and technology strategy. Use when assessing technical debt, scaling engineering teams, evaluating technologies, making architecture decisions, establishing engineering metrics, or when user mentions CTO, tech debt, technical debt, team scaling, architecture decisions, technology evaluation, engineering metrics, DORA metrics, or technology strategy.
subTools.description_zh: 為工程團隊、架構決策和技術策略提供技術領導指導。用於評估技術債、擴展工程團隊、評估技術、進行架構決策、建立工程指標，或當使用者提及 CTO、技術債、團隊擴展、架構決策、技術評估、工程指標、DORA 指標時。

subTools.name: Culture Architect
subTools.description: Build, measure, and evolve company culture as operational behavior — not wall posters. Covers mission/vision/values workshops, values-to-behaviors translation, culture code creation, culture health assessment, and cultural rituals by stage. Use when building company values, assessing culture health, designing cultural rituals, creating culture codes, handling culture clashes, or when user mentions culture, values, culture debt, founder culture, or culture code.
subTools.description_zh: 將公司文化作為實際營執行為來建立、衡量和演進——而非牆上貼紙。涵蓋使命／願景／價值觀工作坊、價值觀轉化為行為、文化憲章建立、文化健康評估和階段性文化儀式。用於建立公司價值觀、評估文化健康、設計文化儀式、制定文化憲章、處理文化衝突，或當使用者提及文化相關議題時。

subTools.name: Decision Logger
subTools.description: Two-layer memory architecture for board meeting decisions. Manages raw transcripts (Layer 1) and approved decisions (Layer 2). Use when logging decisions after a board meeting, reviewing past decisions with /cs:decisions, or checking overdue action items with /cs:review. Invoked automatically by the board-meeting skill after Phase 5 founder approval.
subTools.description_zh: 董事會決策的兩層記憶架構。管理原始會議記錄（第一層）與核可決策（第二層）。董事會後記錄決策、使用/cs:decisions檢視過往決策，或透過/cs:review檢查逾期項目時使用。由董事會技能於第五階段創辦人核准後自動觸發。

subTools.name: Founder Coach
subTools.description: Personal leadership development for founders and first-time CEOs. Covers founder archetype identification, delegation frameworks, energy management, CEO calendar audits, leadership style evolution, blind spot identification, imposter syndrome, founder mental health, and succession planning. Use when a founder feels like the bottleneck, struggles to delegate, is burning out, transitioning from IC to executive, managing a board, or when user mentions founder mode, CEO growth, leadership development, delegation, burnout, or imposter syndrome.
subTools.description_zh: 針對創辦人與初任CEO的個人領導發展。涵蓋創辦人原型識別、授權框架、精力管理、CEO行事曆審查、領導風格演變、盲點識別、冒牌者症候群、創辦人心理健康及繼任規劃。當創辦人自認是瓶頸、不擅長授權、面臨倦怠，或從個別貢獻者轉型領導角色時使用。

subTools.name: General Counsel Advisor
subTools.description: General Counsel advisory for startups: contract review (MSA, SaaS, NDA, DPA, employment), IP strategy, term sheet decoding, and regulatory landscape mapping. Use when reviewing any contract or term sheet, deciding when to engage outside counsel, defining IP strategy, evaluating regulatory exposure (HIPAA, GDPR, FDA, fintech), or when user mentions general counsel, GC, legal review, contract risk, term sheet, IP assignment, or regulatory exposure. NOT a substitute for licensed counsel — surfaces questions to bring to qualified attorneys.
subTools.description_zh: 針對新創公司的法務顧問服務，包含合約審查（MSA、SaaS、NDA、DPA、僱用）、知識產權策略、條款單解讀與法規現狀映射。當需審查合約或條款單、決定何時委請外部律師、制定知識產權策略，或評估法規風險（HIPAA、GDPR、FDA、金融科技）時使用。使用者提及法務顧問、GC、法律審查或合約風險時亦適用。

subTools.name: Internal Narrative
subTools.description: Build and maintain one coherent company story across all audiences — employees, investors, customers, candidates, and partners. Detects narrative contradictions and ensures the same truth is framed for each audience's needs. Use when preparing investor updates, all-hands presentations, board communications, recruiting narratives, crisis communications, or when user mentions company narrative, messaging consistency, storytelling, all-hands, investor update, or crisis communication.
subTools.description_zh: 為所有受眾——員工、投資者、客戶、候選人和合作夥伴——建構並維持一致的公司敘事。偵測敘事矛盾，確保對各受眾需求呈現相同的事實。當準備投資者報告、全員會議簡報、董事會溝通、招募敘事或危機溝通時使用。使用者提及公司敘事、訊息架構時適用。

subTools.name: Intl Expansion
subTools.description: International market expansion strategy. Market selection, entry modes, localization, regulatory compliance, and go-to-market by region. Use when expanding to new countries, evaluating international markets, planning localization, or building regional teams.
subTools.description_zh: 國際市場擴展策略，涵蓋市場選擇、進入模式、在地化、法規遵循及各區域市場推出。用於擴展新國家、評估國際市場或規劃區域團隊。

subTools.name: Ma Playbook
subTools.description: M&A strategy for acquiring companies or being acquired. Due diligence, valuation, integration, and deal structure. Use when evaluating acquisitions, preparing for acquisition, M&A due diligence, integration planning, or deal negotiation.
subTools.description_zh: 併購策略，含收購或被收購的盡職調查、估值、整合及交易結構。用於評估收購案、準備被收購、盡職調查或交易談判。

subTools.name: Org Health Diagnostic
subTools.description: Cross-functional organizational health check combining signals from all C-suite roles. Scores 8 dimensions on a traffic-light scale with drill-down recommendations. Use when assessing overall company health, preparing for board reviews, identifying at-risk functions, or when user mentions org health, health check, or health dashboard.
subTools.description_zh: 跨部門組織健康檢查，整合各主管資訊，以紅黃綠燈評分八面向並提供深入建議。用於評估公司健康、準備董事會報告或識別風險部門。

subTools.name: Scenario War Room
subTools.description: Cross-functional what-if modeling for cascading multi-variable scenarios. Unlike single-assumption stress testing, this models compound adversity across all business functions simultaneously. Use when facing complex risk scenarios, strategic decisions with major downside, or when the user asks 'what if X AND Y both happen?'
subTools.description_zh: 跨部門情境模擬，分析多變數連鎖影響。能同時建模所有業務面的複合衝擊，適用於複雜風險情境、具重大下行風險的戰略決策，或當X與Y同時發生的情境分析。

subTools.name: Strategic Alignment
subTools.description: Cascades strategy from boardroom to individual contributor. Detects and fixes misalignment between company goals and team execution. Covers strategy articulation, cascade mapping, orphan goal detection, silo identification, communication gap analysis, and realignment protocols. Use when teams are pulling in different directions, OKRs don't connect, departments optimize locally at company expense, or when user mentions alignment, strategy cascade, silo, conflicting OKRs, or strategy communication.
subTools.description_zh: 將戰略從管理層逐層傳導至基層員工。檢測和修復公司目標與團隊執行間的不對齊。涵蓋戰略闡述、戰略分層映射、孤立目標檢測、部門孤島識別、溝通差距分析和重新對齊協議。適用於團隊方向分歧、OKR脫節、部門局部優化損害整體利益時使用。

subTools.name: Vpe Advisor
subTools.description: VP of Engineering advisory for startups: delivery throughput (DORA 4 metrics + bottleneck identification), engineering hiring funnel (sourcing → screen → onsite → offer conversion + time-to-fill + pipeline gap), engineering team structure (squad/tribe/chapter design + tech-lead manager-trigger thresholds), and production discipline (on-call, deployment cadence, postmortem culture). Use when sprint velocity is dropping, eng hiring is broken, team structure is unclear, or deciding when to add a tech-lead manager. NOT a CTO skill (which owns architecture) — VPE owns delivery operations and how the team ships.
subTools.description_zh: 創業公司工程副總裁顧問：交付吞吐量（DORA四指標+瓶頸識別）、工程招聘漏斗（尋源→篩選→現場→錄用轉化+填補週期+漏斗缺口）、工程團隊架構（小隊/部落/章節設計+技術負責人/經理觸發閾值）及生產紀律（待命值班、部署節奏、復盤文化）。適用於衝刺階段...

subTools.name: Vpe Advisor
subTools.description: VP of Engineering advisory for startups: delivery throughput (DORA 4 metrics + bottleneck identification), engineering hiring funnel (sourcing → screen → onsite → offer conversion + time-to-fill + pipeline gap), engineering team structure (squad/tribe/chapter design + tech-lead manager-trigger thresholds), and production discipline (on-call, deployment cadence, postmortem culture). Use when sprint velocity is dropping, eng hiring is broken, team structure is unclear, or deciding when to add a tech-lead manager. NOT a CTO skill (which owns architecture) — VPE owns delivery operations and how the team ships.
subTools.description_zh: 創業公司工程副總裁顧問：交付吞吐量（DORA四指標+瓶頸識別）、工程招聘漏斗（尋源→篩選→現場→錄用轉化+填補週期+漏斗缺口）、工程團隊架構（小隊/部落/章節設計+技術負責人/經理觸發閾值）及生產紀律（待命值班、部署節奏、復盤文化）。適用於衝刺階段...

subTools.name: Channel Economics
subTools.description: Use when reviewing or rebalancing direct vs. partner-led channel economics — computing fully-loaded cost-to-serve per channel, channel ROI with cash / LTV / marginal lenses, and optimal channel mix subject to constraints. For Head of Commercial, RevOps, and VP Sales doing quarterly channel review when pipeline is mixed (e.g., 60% direct + 40% partner-led) and nobody actually knows which channel makes money after CAC, support load, partner discount, deal-velocity differences, retention differential, and overhead allocation are all loaded in. Outputs cost to serve, channel ROI verdicts (DOUBLE-DOWN / MAINTAIN / DEFUND / EXIT), a sensitivity-tested channel-mix recommendation, and the diminishing-returns inflection (e.g., 'which channel actually makes money — direct or partner?').
subTools.description_zh: 評估或調整直銷與夥伴主導渠道的經濟模型——計算各渠道全成本服務佔比、結合現金流/LTV/邊際視角的渠道投資回報率，以及在約束條件下的最優渠道組合。適用於商業負責人、營收運營及銷售副總進行季度渠道審查，尤其當管道混合（如60%直銷+40%夥伴主導）且各渠道實際表現不清時

subTools.name: Commercial Forecaster
subTools.description: Use when building a quarterly bookings forecast, ARR projection, pipeline forecast, NRR projection, or commit/best-case/pipe-only board number — especially when the CRO needs to walk the board through funnel math + cohort ARR + per-stage conversion assumptions without the theatre of a single undefended number. Decomposes pipeline into commit, best-case, and pipe-only tiers; projects cohort-level NRR/GRR to surface leaky cohorts before they show up in the consolidated number; scores per-stage funnel confidence so soft-floor stages get treated differently from high-confidence ones. Every output explicitly names the conversion rate used, the data window, and the weighting choice. For Head of Commercial, RevOps, VP Sales, and CRO at quarterly forecast or board prep. NOT financial close (see finance/financial-analysis). NOT strategic CRO hiring/territory (see c-level-advisor/cro-advisor). NOT pricing (see sibling pricing-strategist).
subTools.description_zh: 用於建構季預約預測、ARR 預估、管道預測、NRR 預估，或_commit/best-case/only pipe_的董事會數字——特別是在 CRO 需要 walkthrough 漏斗計算、cohort ARR 及分階段轉換假設時，而非僅憑一個未受質疑的數字。將管道拆分為 commit、best-case 與 pipe-only 層級，預測 cohort 等級的 N

subTools.name: Commercial Policy
subTools.description: Use when designing or revising a company's commercial policy — the rules of engagement governing discounts off list price, approver thresholds, exception flows, and the deal framework that Deal Desk and AEs operate under. Covers discount matrix design (ARR band x term length x payment terms x strategic value), commercial policy design, exception policy, discount governance, approval thresholds, deal framework structure, and policy linting (contradictions, gaps, cliff edges, gaming surfaces). For Head of Commercial, Head of Deal Desk, VP Sales, or RevOps at the policy-design moment — NOT per-deal application (that is deal-desk) and NOT pricing model selection (that is pricing-strategist).
subTools.description_zh: 用於設計或修訂公司的商業政策——規範折扣、審批門檻、例外流程，以及 Deal Desk 與 AE 營運的交易框架。涵蓋折扣矩陣設計（ARR 區段 x 合約期 x 付款方式 x 戰略價值）、商業政策設計、例外政策、折扣治理、審批門檻、解約

subTools.name: Commercial Skills
subTools.description: Use when reviewing, approving, or designing commercial motion — pricing models, deal review, discount approval, partnership economics, channel mix, commercial policy, RFP/RFI response, bookings forecast. Triggers on "review this deal", "should we discount", "pricing model", "partner economics", "RFP response", "bookings forecast", "channel mix". Forks context to route to one of seven Commercial sub-skills (pricing-strategist, deal-desk, partnerships-architect, channel-economics, commercial-policy, rfp-responder, commercial-forecaster) and returns a digest. Distinct from business-growth (sales execution) and c-level-advisor/cro-advisor (strategic CRO judgment).
subTools.description_zh: 用於審查、核准或設計商業動線——定價模型、交易審查、折扣核准、合作夥伴經濟效益、管道組合、商業政策、RFP/RFI 回覆、預約預測。觸發條件包含「審查此交易」「是否該折扣」「定價模型」「合作夥伴經濟效益」「RFP 回覆」「預約預測」「管道組合」。依情境分流至七種商業子

subTools.name: Deal Desk
subTools.description: Use when reviewing a specific inbound deal before close — when sales has asked for a discount that exceeds AE authority, when the customer has redlined the MSA, when per-deal economics (margin after discount, multi-year payment shape, indemnity exposure) need to be quantified, or when discount approval needs to be routed to a named human approver (Sales Director, VP Sales, CFO, CRO, General Counsel). Covers deal review, discount approval routing, per-deal margin scoring, deal exception handling, MSA redline triage, contract landmine detection (uncapped indemnity, MFN, perpetual license-back, missing DPA), and named-approver chain assembly. NEVER auto-approves — every output is a numeric scorecard plus a routing recommendation to a named human.
subTools.description_zh: 用於關單前審查 incoming 交易——當銷售要求超出 AE 權限的折扣、客戶 redline 了 MSA、需量化 per-deal 經濟效益（折扣後毛利、多年付款方式結構、賠償風險），或需將折扣核准路由至指定人類審批者（銷售總監、VP 銷售、CFO、CRO、法

subTools.name: Partnerships Architect
subTools.description: Use when a startup is approached by a prospective partner and someone has to decide should we sign this partner, at what partner tier (referral / reseller / OEM / SI-consulting / strategic alliance), with what joint GTM commitment, and at what revshare. Classifies partner tier from independent-demand evidence vs. preferential-terms hunting, designs a 90-day joint GTM plan, models revshare against direct-sale margin, and surfaces kill criteria for unwinding under-performing partnerships. For Head of Partnerships, Head of BD, and Founder-CEOs doing reseller agreement, OEM deal, or strategic alliance review — not technical sale enablement, not channel cost economics, not M&A.
subTools.description_zh: 當新創收到潛在合作夥伴來電，需決定是否簽約、選擇夥伴等級（推薦／經銷／OEM／SI 顧問／戰略聯盟）、共同 GTM 承諾與營收分潤時使用。根據獨立需求證據與優惠條件偏好進行等級分類，設計 90 天共同 GTM 計畫，並建立營收分潤模型。

subTools.name: Pricing Strategist
subTools.description: Use when designing or revisiting product pricing — selecting a pricing model (subscription seat-based, usage-based, value-based, freemium, or hybrid), running Van Westendorp Price Sensitivity Meter analysis on WTP survey data, or designing Good/Better/Best packaging tiers. Recommends a model and a price range with trade-offs, never a single number. For Commercial leads, Product Marketing, and CMOs at the pricing-design moment — not deal-by-deal discounting, not brand positioning.
subTools.description_zh: 設計或重新檢視產品定價時使用，包含選擇定價模式（訂閱席位、用量計費、價值導向、免費增值或混合）、對 WTP 調查資料執行 Van Westendorp 價格敏感度分析，或設計 Good/Better/Best 包裝分層。提供定價模式與區間建議並說明取捨，而非單一數字。適用於商業主管、產品行銷與 CMO。

subTools.name: Rfp Responder
subTools.description: Use when an RFP, RFI, RFQ, security questionnaire, vendor questionnaire, or proposal request arrives and the team needs a structured response — parsing multi-section buyer-dictated requirements (MANDATORY vs WEIGHTED vs NICE-TO-HAVE), building a Shipley-method proof-point matrix mapping each requirement to a verifiable proof point, articulating 3-5 win-themes that ladder up across requirements, and producing a Shipley-derived winrate estimate that informs a bid / no-bid / partner-bid recommendation. For Bid Managers, Proposal Leads, Directors of Sales, and Sales Engineers at the response-strategy moment. Surfaces GAP requirements explicitly — never invents claims. NOT free-form proposal narrative authoring, NOT contract redline, NOT marketing collateral.
subTools.description_zh: 收到 RFP、RFI、RFQ、安全問卷、廠商問卷或提案請求，需結構化回應時使用。解析買家指定的多段需求（強制／權重／選配），建立 Shipley 方法論的論證矩陣，將各項需求對應至可驗證的論據，並勾勒 3 至 5 個跨越需求的贏面主題。

subTools.name: Ai Act Readiness
subTools.description: /cs:ai-act-readiness <system> — EU AI Act 6-question forcing interrogation. Use during AI-system intake, before EU deployment, or during annual compliance refresh as Article 113 obligations phase in (2025-02-02 / 2025-08-02 / 2026-08-02 / 2027-08-02).
subTools.description_zh: ／cs:ai-act-readiness <system>——歐盟 AI 法案六題強制性質詢。適用於 AI 系統導入階段、歐盟部署前，或年度合規刷新時，於 Article 113 義務依序生效（2025-02-02／2025-08-02／2026-08-02／2027-08-02）期間使用。

subTools.name: Aims Audit
subTools.description: /cs:aims-audit <scope> — ISO/IEC 42001 AIMS internal-audit 6-question forcing interrogation. Use before certification stage 1, before annual internal audit cycles, or when onboarding a new AI system into an existing AIMS.
subTools.description_zh: /cs:aims-audit <範圍> — ISO/IEC 42001 AIMS 內部審核六問強制檢視。用於認證階段一前、年度內部審核週期前，或將新 AI 系統導入現有 AIMS 時。

subTools.name: Compliance Os
subTools.description: Compliance OS — meta-orchestrator that lets compliance teams CONFIGURE which frameworks apply, COMPUTE cross-framework control overlap, SIMULATE internal audits, and CONSOLIDATE evidence across multiple frameworks. Four decisions: (1) Given a company profile, which of the 12 supported frameworks apply (ISO 27001/13485/42001/14971, EU AI Act, MDR 745, GDPR, SOC 2, FDA QSR, NIST CSF 2.0, NIS2, HIPAA)? (2) Across selected frameworks, which controls overlap and how much evidence reuses? (3) For a given framework + scope, what does a realistic mock audit produce — drawing from the 205-scenario library? (4) Across selected frameworks, what's the unified evidence checklist with reuse map? Use when standing up a multi-framework program, planning the annual audit calendar, or preparing for certification stage 1. Does NOT replace per-framework skills (it orchestrates them).
subTools.description_zh: Compliance OS — 讓合規團隊可設定適用框架、計算跨框架控制重疊、模擬內部審核，並整合多框架證據的元協調器。四大決策：(1) 依公司資料判斷適用框架（ISO 27001/13485/42001/14971、EU AI Act、MDR 745、GDPR、SOC 2、FDA QSR、NIST CSF 2.0、NIS2、HIPAA）

subTools.name: Compliance Readiness
subTools.description: /cs:compliance-readiness <program> — Multi-framework compliance officer 6-question forcing interrogation of any compliance program. Use before starting a new framework, planning the annual audit calendar, or preparing for certification stage 1.
subTools.description_zh: /cs:compliance-readiness <計畫> — 針對任何合規計畫的六問強制檢視。用於啟動新框架前、規劃年度審核時程表前，或準備認證階段一時。

subTools.name: Fda Qsr Audit Prep
subTools.description: /cs:fda-qsr-audit-prep <scope> — FDA 21 CFR 820 (QSR / QMSR) audit 6-question forcing interrogation. Post-Feb 2026 substantially harmonized with ISO 13485. Use before annual internal QSR audit, pre-FDA-inspection readiness, or Form 483 response.
subTools.description_zh: /cs:fda-qsr-audit-prep <範圍> — FDA 21 CFR 820（QSR / QMSR）審核六問強制檢視。2026 年 2 月後已與 ISO 13485 大幅調和。用於年度內部 QSR 審核前、FDA 檢查準備，或 Form 483 回覆時。

subTools.name: Gdpr Audit Prep
subTools.description: /cs:gdpr-audit-prep <scope> — GDPR audit 6-question Article-cited forcing interrogation. Use before annual internal GDPR review, post-breach internal audit, DPA investigation readiness, or acquisition due diligence.
subTools.description_zh: /cs:gdpr-audit-prep <範圍> — 依 GDPR 條文提問的 6 題強制式檢查。適用於年度內部 GDPR 審查、資安事件後內部稽核，或 DPA 調查準備。

subTools.name: Iso13485 Audit Prep
subTools.description: /cs:iso13485-audit-prep <scope> — ISO 13485 QMS audit 6-question forcing interrogation. Design controls + CAPA + post-market focused. Use before Clause 8.2.4 internal audit, MDR / FDA QSR alignment review, or product-launch DHF closure audit.
subTools.description_zh: /cs:iso13485-audit-prep <範圍> — ISO 13485 醫檢 QMS 6 題強制式檢查，著重設計控制與 CAPA。適用於 Clause 8.2.4 內部稽核或 MDR/FDA QSR 對齊審查。

subTools.name: Iso27001 Audit Prep
subTools.description: /cs:iso27001-audit-prep <scope> — ISO 27001 ISMS audit readiness 6-question forcing interrogation. Use before annual Clause 9.2 internal audit, surveillance audit prep, or stage 1 certification readiness.
subTools.description_zh: /cs:iso27001-audit-prep <範圍> — ISO 27001 ISMS 稽核準備 6 題強制式檢查。適用於年度 Clause 9.2 內部稽核、監督稽核或 Stage 1 認證準備。

subTools.name: Soc2 Audit Prep
subTools.description: /cs:soc2-audit-prep <scope> — SOC 2 Type II readiness 6-question forcing interrogation. Observation-period focused. Use before Type II observation begins, mid-period checkpoint, or pre-field-test month-10 readiness.
subTools.description_zh: /cs:soc2-audit-prep <範圍> — SOC 2 Type II 6 題強制式檢查，著重觀察期間。適用於 Type II 觀察期開始前、期中檢查點或前置測試月第 10 月。

subTools.name: Agents
subTools.description: Persona-Based Agents — agent-native AI orchestrator for Personas. Works with Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and OpenClaw.
subTools.description_zh: 角色導向 Agent — 針對 Personas 設計的 Agent-Native AI 協調器，支援 Claude Code、Codex CLI、Gemini CLI 與 OpenClaw。

subTools.name: Agent Harness
subTools.description: Turn any domain folder of skills into a bounded agentic loop: compile a goal into a verifiable task plan, execute tasks with the domain's own tools, verify every task with machine-run checks, retry with caps, escalate to a human when budgets exhaust, and refuse to close until everything is verified or explicitly waived. Use when you want an agent or subagent to pick up a goal and drive it to a verified close across one of this repo's 18 domains ('run this goal through the engineering harness', 'set up an agentic loop for marketing work', 'make the finance domain self-verifying'). NOT for authoring Claude Code Workflow-tool .js scripts (workflow-builder), N-agent tournaments on one task (agenthub), single-file metric optimization (autoresearch-agent), or discovering published loop recipes (loop-library).
subTools.description_zh: 將任何領域技能資料夾轉為受限式 Agentic 循環：編譯目標為可驗證任務計畫，使用領域自有工具執行，以機器檢查驗證每項任務，預算耗盡時 escalating 至人類，驗證通過前不關閉。

subTools.name: Agenthub
subTools.description: Multi-agent collaboration plugin that spawns N parallel subagents competing on the same task via git worktree isolation. Agents work independently, results are evaluated by metric or LLM judge, and the best branch is merged. Use when: user wants multiple approaches tried in parallel — code optimization, content variation, research exploration, or any task that benefits from parallel competition. Requires: a git repo.
subTools.description_zh: 多 Agent 協作插件，透過 git worktree 隔離spawn N 個平行子 Agent 競爭同一任務。結果由指標或 LLM Judge 評核，最佳分支合併。適用於需並行嘗試多方案的情境。

subTools.name: Board
subTools.description: Read, write, and browse the AgentHub message board for agent coordination. Use when the user runs /hub:board or asks to post, read, or inspect coordination messages between competing AgentHub agents.
subTools.description_zh: 讀取、撰寫與瀏覽 AgentHub 訊息看板，用於 Agent 協作。適用情境為使用者執行 /hub:board 或查詢競爭中 AgentHub Agent 間的協調訊息。

subTools.name: Eval
subTools.description: Evaluate and rank agent results by metric or LLM judge for an AgentHub session. Use when the user runs /hub:eval or asks to score, compare, or pick a winner among completed AgentHub agents.
subTools.description_zh: 針對 AgentHub 會話中的代理執行結果，依據指標或 LLM 裁判進行評估與排名。適用於使用者執行 /hub:eval 指令，或要求評分、比較、選出勝出者時。

subTools.name: Init
subTools.description: Create a new AgentHub collaboration session with task, agent count, and evaluation criteria. Use when the user runs /hub:init or asks to start a multi-agent competition on a task.
subTools.description_zh: 為新任務建立 AgentHub 合作會話，設定代理數量與評估標準。適用於使用者執行 /hub:init 指令，或啟動多代理任務競賽時。

subTools.name: Merge
subTools.description: Merge the winning agent's branch into base, archive losers, and clean up worktrees. Use when the user runs /hub:merge or asks to land the winning AgentHub result and tidy the session.
subTools.description_zh: 將獲勝 agent 的分支合併到 base，歸檔失敗分支並清理 worktree。當使用者執行 /hub:merge，或要求合入獲勝的 AgentHub 結果並整理工作階段時使用。

subTools.name: Run
subTools.description: One-shot lifecycle command that chains init → baseline → spawn → eval → merge in a single invocation. Use when the user runs /hub:run or asks to execute a full AgentHub competition end-to-end.
subTools.description_zh: 一次性生命周期指令，透過單次呼叫串聯 init → baseline → spawn → eval → merge。當使用者執行 /hub:run，或要求端到端執行完整的 AgentHub 競賽時使用。

subTools.name: Spawn
subTools.description: Launch N parallel subagents in isolated git worktrees to compete on the session task. Use when the user runs /hub:spawn or asks to start the competing agents for an initialized AgentHub session.
subTools.description_zh: 啟動 N 個平行子 agent，在隔離的 git worktrees 中競爭會話任務。當使用者執行 /hub:spawn 或要求為已初始化的 AgentHub 會話啟動競爭 agent 時使用。

subTools.name: Status
subTools.description: Show DAG state, agent progress, and branch status for an AgentHub session. Use when the user runs /hub:status or asks how the AgentHub agents are doing.
subTools.description_zh: 顯示 AgentHub 會話的 DAG 狀態、agent 進展與分支狀態。當使用者執行 /hub:status 或詢問 AgentHub agent 進度時使用。

subTools.name: Autoresearch Agent
subTools.description: Autonomous experiment loop that optimizes any file by a measurable metric. Inspired by Karpathy's autoresearch. The agent edits a target file, runs a fixed evaluation, keeps improvements (git commit), discards failures (git reset), and loops indefinitely. Use when: user wants to optimize code speed, reduce bundle/image size, improve test pass rate, optimize prompts, improve content quality (headlines, copy, CTR), or run any measurable improvement loop. Requires: a target file, an evaluation command that outputs a metric, and a git repo.
subTools.description_zh: 自治實驗循環，依據可度量指標最佳化檔案。透過編輯目標檔案、執行固定評估、保留改進（git commit）並捨棄失敗（git reset）來不斷循環。用於最佳化程式碼速度、減少套件/映像檔大小、提升測試通過率、最佳化提示詞或改善內容品質。

subTools.name: Loop
subTools.description: Start an autonomous experiment loop with user-selected interval (10min, 1h, daily, weekly, monthly). Uses CronCreate for scheduling. Use when the user runs /ar:loop or asks to run an autoresearch experiment continuously on a schedule.
subTools.description_zh: 啟動具有使用者選定間隔（10 分鐘、1 小時、每日、每週、每月）的自治實驗循環。使用 CronCreate 進行排程。當使用者執行 /ar:loop 或要求在排程上持續執行 autoresearch 實驗時使用。

subTools.name: Resume
subTools.description: Resume a paused experiment. Checkout the experiment branch, read results history, continue iterating. Use when the user runs /ar:resume or asks to pick up a previously started autoresearch experiment.
subTools.description_zh: 恢復暫停中的實驗。切換到實驗分支、檢視結果歷史，並繼續迭代。當使用者執行 /ar:resume 或要求接手先前啟動的自動研究實驗時使用。

subTools.name: Run
subTools.description: Run a single experiment iteration. Edit the target file, evaluate, keep or discard. Use when the user runs /ar:run or asks for one manual autoresearch iteration.
subTools.description_zh: 執行單次實驗迭代。編輯目標檔案、評估結果，並保留或捨棄。當使用者執行 /ar:run 或要求進行單次手動自動研究迭代時使用。

subTools.name: Setup
subTools.description: Set up a new autoresearch experiment interactively. Collects domain, target file, eval command, metric, direction, and evaluator. Use when the user runs /ar:setup or asks to start optimizing a file with the autoresearch loop.
subTools.description_zh: 互動式設定新的 autoresearch 實驗，收集領域、目標檔案、評估指令、指標、方向與評測器。使用者執行 /ar:setup 或要求以 autoresearch 循環最佳化檔案時使用。

subTools.name: Status
subTools.description: Show experiment dashboard with results, active loops, and progress. Use when the user runs /ar:status or asks how an autoresearch experiment is going.
subTools.description_zh: 顯示實驗儀表板，包含結果、作用中循環與進度。使用者執行 /ar:status 或詢問 autoresearch 實驗狀況時使用。

subTools.name: Behuman
subTools.description: Use when the user wants more human-like AI responses — less robotic, less listy, more authentic. Triggers: 'behuman', 'be real', 'like a human', 'more human', 'less AI', 'talk like a person', 'mirror mode', 'stop being so AI', or when conversations are emotionally charged (grief, job loss, relationship advice, fear). NOT for technical questions, code generation, or factual lookups.
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者希望 AI 回應更擬人化、減少機械感與條列式、更真誠時使用。觸發詞：「behuman」、「像真人」、「少一點 AI 味」等，或對話涉及情感議題（悲傷、失業、感情建議、恐懼）。不適用於技術問題、程式碼產生或事實查詢。

subTools.name: Chaos Engineering
subTools.description: Use when planning, running, or learning from chaos engineering experiments. Triggers on "chaos experiment", "fault injection", "gameday", "resilience test", "blast radius", "steady state", "abort criteria", "Chaos Toolkit", "Chaos Mesh", "Litmus", "Gremlin", "AWS FIS", or any deliberate failure-injection question. Ships experiment designer, blast-radius calculator, and postmortem generator (all stdlib Python), 4 references on chaos principles + experiment design + attack taxonomy + tooling landscape, and a /chaos-experiment slash command. Composes with feature-flags-architect (kill switches as abort triggers) and kubernetes-operator (common chaos targets).
subTools.description_zh: 用於規劃、執行或學習故障注入實驗。觸發詞：「chaos experiment」、「fault injection」、「gameday」、「resilience test」、「blast radius」、「steady state」、「abort criteria」、「Chaos Toolkit」、「Chaos Mesh」、「Litmus」、「Gremlin」、「AWS FIS」或任何刻意引入失敗的提問。提供實驗設計器、blast radius 計算器與事後回顧生成器。

subTools.name: Claude Coach
subTools.description: Personal coach that teaches users to become Claude power users. Use this skill the FIRST time a user asks to "learn Claude", "be a power user", "coach me", "teach me Claude tricks", "what can Claude do", "make me better at prompting", or any variation. After activation, also use it on EVERY subsequent turn to detect missed optimization opportunities (vague prompts, ignored capabilities, manual work Claude could automate) and surface a single power-user tip. Trigger generously — most users do not know what they do not know, so err on the side of coaching.
subTools.description_zh: 私人教練，教導使用者成為 Claude 高效使用者。首次出現「learn Claude」、「be a power user」、「coach me」、「teach me Claude tricks」、「what can Claude do」、「make me better at prompting」等時使用。啟用後，在後續每個回合持續偵測未善用之優化機會（模糊提示、忽略功能、手動作業）。

subTools.name: Code Tour
subTools.description: Use when the user asks to create a CodeTour .tour file — persona-targeted, step-by-step walkthroughs that link to real files and line numbers. Trigger for: create a tour, onboarding tour, architecture tour, PR review tour, explain how X works, vibe check, RCA tour, contributor guide, or any structured code walkthrough request.
subTools.description_zh: 用於建立 CodeTour .tour 檔案時，提供針對不同角色的逐步導覽，並連結到實際的程式檔案與行號。適用情境：建立導覽、新人導引導覽、架構導覽、PR 審查導覽、說明 X 如何運作、氛圍檢查、RCA 導覽、貢獻者指南、或其他結構化的程式碼導覽請求。

subTools.name: Collab Proof
subTools.description: Use when you want to understand what Claude contributed vs what you drove in a session. Triggers on: /collab-proof, session retrospective, ai contribution analysis, collaboration evidence, what did claude do.
subTools.description_zh: 用於了解某個會話中 Claude 的貢獻 vs 你主導的部分。觸發情境：/collab-proof、會話回顧、AI 貢獻分析、協作證明、Claude 做了什麼。

subTools.name: Data Quality Auditor
subTools.description: Audit datasets for completeness, consistency, accuracy, and validity. Profile data distributions, detect anomalies and outliers, surface structural issues, and produce an actionable remediation plan. Use when the user asks to check data quality, profile a dataset, hunt outliers or missing values, or validate data before analysis or model training.
subTools.description_zh: 稽核資料集的完整性、一致性、準確性與有效性。分析資料分佈、偵測異常與離群值、揭示結構性問題，並產生具體的改善計畫。適用情境：檢查資料品質、分析資料集、尋找異常值或缺失值、或在分析或模型訓練前驗證資料時。

subTools.name: Demo Video
subTools.description: Use when the user asks to create a demo video, product walkthrough, feature showcase, animated presentation, marketing video, or GIF from screenshots or scene descriptions. Orchestrates playwright, ffmpeg, and edge-tts MCPs to produce polished video content.
subTools.description_zh: 用於建立產品說明影片、功能展示、動畫簡報、行銷影片或從截圖／場景描述製作 GIF。協調 Playwright、ffmpeg 和 edge-tts MCP 來生成高品質影片內容。

subTools.name: Docker Development
subTools.description: Docker and container development agent skill and plugin for Dockerfile optimization, docker-compose orchestration, multi-stage builds, and container security hardening. Use when: user wants to optimize a Dockerfile, create or improve docker-compose configurations, implement multi-stage builds, audit container security, reduce image size, or follow container best practices. Covers build performance, layer caching, secret management, and production-ready container patterns.
subTools.description_zh: Docker 與容器開發的代理技能與插件，用於 Dockerfile 最佳化、docker-compose 編排、多階段建構及容器安全強化。當使用者想要最佳化 Dockerfile、建立或改進 docker-compose 設定、實作多階段建構、審計容器安全、減少映像檔大小，或遵循容器最佳實踐時使用。涵蓋建構效能

subTools.name: Feature Flags Architect
subTools.description: Use when adding, retiring, or auditing feature flags. Triggers on "add a flag", "ship behind a flag", "rollout plan", "kill switch", "stale flags", "flag debt", "LaunchDarkly", "GrowthBook", "Statsig", "Unleash", "Flipt", or any progressive-delivery question. Ships flag debt scanner, rollout planner, and kill-switch auditor (all stdlib Python), 4 references on flag taxonomy + provider trade-offs + rollout strategies + lifecycle, plus a /flag-cleanup slash command.
subTools.description_zh: 當新增、退役或審計功能標誌時使用。觸發條件包括『新增標誌』、『透過標誌發布』、『推出計畫』、『緊急停用開關』、『過時標誌』、『標誌債務』、LaunchDarkly、GrowthBook、Statsig、Unleash、Flipt，或任何漸進式交付相關問題。提供標誌債務掃描器、推出計畫工具和緊急停用開關審計器（均為標準 Python 函式庫），以及 4 份關於標誌分類與提供者權衡的參考資料

subTools.name: Grill Me
subTools.description: Interview the user relentlessly about a plan or design until reaching shared understanding, resolving each branch of the decision tree. Use when user wants to stress-test a plan, get grilled on their design, or mentions "grill me".
subTools.description_zh: 不斷向使用者提問，直至對計畫或設計達成共識，解決決策樹的每個分支。當使用者希望壓力測試計畫、接受設計挑戰，或提到『grill me』時使用

subTools.name: Grill With Docs
subTools.description: Docs-anchored grilling session — challenges a plan against the project's existing language (CONTEXT.md) and recorded decisions (docs/adr/), and updates those files inline as terminology and decisions crystallise. Use when user wants to stress-test a plan against documented domain language, or mentions "grill with docs".
subTools.description_zh: 以文件為基礎的討論會——針對專案現有語言（CONTEXT.md）和記錄決策（docs/adr/）挑戰計畫，並隨術語和決策明確而即時更新這些檔案。當使用者希望基於文件化領域語言壓力測試計畫，或提到『grill with docs』時使用

subTools.name: Handoff
subTools.description: Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent to pick up. References existing artifacts (PRDs, plans, ADRs, issues, commits, diffs) by path or URL instead of duplicating them. Use when user wants to hand off the conversation to a fresh agent or starts a new session that picks up prior work.
subTools.description_zh: 將目前對話精簡成交接文件，供其他代理接續使用。透過路徑或 URL 引用現有成果物（PRD、計劃、ADR、問題、提交、差異），避免重複。當使用者希望將對話交接給新代理，或啟動承接前序工作的新工作階段時使用。

subTools.name: Helm Chart Builder
subTools.description: Helm chart development agent skill and plugin for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, OpenClaw — chart scaffolding, values design, template patterns, dependency management, security hardening, and chart testing. Use when: user wants to create or improve Helm charts, design values.yaml files, implement template helpers, audit chart security (RBAC, network policies, pod security), manage subcharts, or run helm lint/test.
subTools.description_zh: Helm chart 開發代理技能與插件，適用於 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、Cursor、OpenClaw。提供 chart 骨架建立、values 設計、範本模式、依賴管理、安全強化與 chart 測試。當使用者要建立或改進 Helm chart、設計 values.yaml、實作範本輔助函數、審查 chart 安全（RBAC、網路策略、pod 安全）、管理子 chart 時使用。

subTools.name: Karpathy Coder
subTools.description: Use when writing, reviewing, or committing code to enforce Karpathy's 4 coding principles — surface assumptions before coding, keep it simple, make surgical changes, define verifiable goals. Triggers on "review my diff", "check complexity", "am I overcomplicating this", "karpathy check", "before I commit", or any code quality concern where the LLM might be overcoding.
subTools.description_zh: 用於撰寫、審查或提交程式碼時，強制執行 Karpathy 的 4 項程式撰寫原則——編碼前先明示假設、保持簡潔、進行精確修改、定義可驗證目標。觸發條件包括「審查我的差異」、「檢查複雜度」、「我是否過度複雜化」、「karpathy 檢查」、「提交前」，或任何 LLM 可能過度編碼的程式品質疑慮。

subTools.name: Kubernetes Operator
subTools.description: Use when building a Kubernetes Operator — custom controllers that reconcile CRD state. Triggers on "build an operator", "CRD design", "reconcile loop", "controller-runtime", "kubebuilder", "operator-sdk", "metacontroller", "KOPF", "operator capability levels", or "custom resource". Ships CRD validator, reconcile-loop linter, and OperatorHub capability auditor (all stdlib Python), 4 references on the operator pattern + CRD design + reconcile patterns + tooling landscape, and a /operator-audit slash command. NOT a generic k8s skill — specifically the Operator pattern.
subTools.description_zh: 用於建立 Kubernetes Operator——自訂控制器用以調和 CRD 狀態。觸發條件包括「建立 operator」、「CRD 設計」、「reconcile 迴圈」、「controller-runtime」、「kubebuilder」、「operator-sdk」、「metacontroller」、「KOPF」、「operator 能力層級」或「自訂資源」。內含 CRD 驗證器、reconcile 迴圈偵錯器與 OperatorHub 能力稽核工具（均為標庫 Python），附 4 個參考。

subTools.name: Llm Cost Optimizer
subTools.description: Use proactively whenever LLM API costs come up -- or should. Triggers include: 'my AI costs are too high', 'optimize token usage', 'which model should I use', 'LLM spend is out of control', 'implement prompt caching', 'we're about to launch an AI feature', 'build me an AI endpoint'. Don't wait for an explicit cost complaint -- if someone is building an AI feature, designing an LLM endpoint, or choosing between models, cost architecture belongs in the conversation. Apply immediately when any of these are true: a system prompt appears that exceeds a few hundred tokens, all requests are hitting the same model, max_tokens is not set, or no per-feature cost logging exists. NOT for RAG pipeline design (use rag-architect). NOT for improving prompt quality or effectiveness (use senior-prompt-engineer).
subTools.description_zh: Whenever LLM API 成本相關問題出現時主動使用。觸發條件包括：『我的 AI 成本太高』、『最佳化 token 使用量』、『該用哪個模型』、『LLM 開銷失控』、『實作提示快取』、『即將推出 AI 功能』、『幫我建置 AI 端點』。不要等到明確抱怨成本才行動——若有人正在建置 AI 功能、設計 LLM 端點，或選擇模型時，就該介入

subTools.name: Llm Wiki
subTools.description: Use when building or maintaining a persistent personal knowledge base (second brain) in Obsidian where an LLM incrementally ingests sources, updates entity/concept pages, maintains cross-references, and keeps a synthesis current. Triggers include "second brain", "Obsidian wiki", "personal knowledge management", "ingest this paper/article/book", "build a research wiki", "compound knowledge", "Memex", or whenever the user wants knowledge to accumulate across sessions instead of being re-derived by RAG on every query.
subTools.description_zh: 用於在 Obsidian 中建立或維護持久性個人知識庫（第二大腦）時，LLM 會逐步消化來源、更新實體／概念頁面、維護交叉參考，並保持綜述最新。觸發條件包括「第二大腦」、「Obsidian 維基」、「個人知識管理」、「消化這篇論文／文章／書籍」、「建立研究維基」、「複利知識」、「Memex」。

subTools.name: Minimalist
subTools.description: Use when the user asks to write code efficiently, avoid over-engineering, reduce dependencies, or prevent unnecessary abstractions. Enforces a strict efficiency ladder: YAGNI, reuse, stdlib, native platform, existing deps — before writing any new code.
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者要求有效率的程式撰寫、避免過度設計、減少依賴或防止不必要抽象時使用。強制執行嚴格的效率階梯：YAGNI、重用、stdlib、原生平台、現有依賴——在撰寫任何新程式碼之前。

subTools.name: Prompt Governance
subTools.description: Use when managing prompts in production at scale: versioning prompts, running A/B tests on prompts, building prompt registries, preventing prompt regressions, or creating eval pipelines for production AI features. Triggers: 'manage prompts in production', 'prompt versioning', 'prompt regression', 'prompt A/B test', 'prompt registry', 'eval pipeline'. NOT for writing or improving individual prompts (use senior-prompt-engineer). NOT for RAG pipeline design (use rag-architect). NOT for LLM cost reduction (use llm-cost-optimizer).
subTools.description_zh: 用於大規模生產環境中的提示管理：提示版本控制、執行提示 A/B 測試、建立提示註冊表、防止提示退化，或為生產 AI 功能建立評估管線。觸發條件：「在生產環境中管理提示」、「提示版本控制」、「提示退化」、「提示 A/B 測試」、「提示註冊表」、「評估管線」。不適用於撰寫或改進單一提示。

subTools.name: Security Guidance
subTools.description: PreToolUse security-anti-pattern hook for Claude Code. Catches 12 common security risks (command injection, XSS, SQL injection, unsafe deserialization, GitHub Actions workflow injection, eval/new Function code injection) BEFORE the Edit/Write/MultiEdit operation completes. Session-state caching prevents duplicate warnings on the same file+rule combo. Stdlib only — no dependencies. Use when you want a safety net during Claude Code sessions that touch security-sensitive code (auth, payments, user input handling, IaC). Disable with ENABLE_SECURITY_REMINDER=0 if you need to perform a verified-safe operation that would otherwise trip a pattern. Triggers — "add security hook", "block unsafe code", "detect command injection before write", "prevent SQL injection patterns", "security warning hook".
subTools.description_zh: Claude Code 的 PreToolUse 安全反模式勾點，在編輯/寫入/多編輯完成前偵測 12 種常見安全風險（命令注入、XSS、SQL 注入、不安全的解序列化、GitHub Actions 工作流注入、eval/new Function 程式碼注入）。使用會話狀態快取避免相同檔案與規則組合重複警告。僅依賴 stdlib，無需額外套件。當你希望…時使用。

subTools.name: Skillopt Sleep
subTools.description: Use when the user wants their Claude agent to self-improve from past usage, asks about a nightly/offline 'sleep' or 'dream' cycle, memory/skill consolidation, or says things like 'make my agent better the more I use it', 'review my past sessions', 'learn my preferences', 'consolidate what you learned', 'run the sleep cycle', or wants to schedule offline self-optimization. Drives the skillopt_sleep engine: harvest past sessions -> mine recurring tasks -> replay offline -> consolidate validated CLAUDE.md and SKILL.md behind a held-out gate.
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者希望 Claude agent 從過去使用中自我改進、詢問夜間/離線「睡眠」或「夢境」週期、記憶與技能整合，或說「讓我越用越好用」「回顧過往工作階段」「學習我的偏好」「整合所學」「執行睡眠週期」，或想排程離線自我最佳化時使用。驅動 skillopt_sleep。

subTools.name: Agent Designer
subTools.description: Use when the user asks to design a multi-agent system, pick an orchestration pattern (supervisor/swarm/pipeline), generate tool schemas for agents, or evaluate agent execution logs for cost, latency, and failure bottlenecks. Examples: 'design an agent architecture for research automation', 'generate Anthropic tool schemas from these tool descriptions', 'analyze these agent run logs for bottlenecks'. NOT for Claude Code workflow files (use workflow-builder) or single-agent prompt design (use agent-workflow-designer).
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者要求設計多代理系統時使用，可選擇協調模式（監督者/群聚/管線）、為代理生成工具方案，或評估代理執行記錄的成本、延遲和失敗瓶頸。範例：『為研究自動化設計代理架構』、『根據這些工具描述生成 Anthropic 工具方案』、『分析這些代理執行記錄以找出瓶頸'

subTools.name: Agent Workflow Designer
subTools.description: Design production-grade multi-agent workflows with clear pattern choice (sequential, parallel, hierarchical), handoff contracts, failure handling, and cost/context controls. Use when architecting a multi-step agent pipeline, choosing between single-agent vs multi-agent approaches, or refactoring an LLM workflow that suffers from context bloat or unreliable handoffs.
subTools.description_zh: 設計生產等級的多代理工作流，包含明確的模式選擇（序列、平行、階層式）、交接合約、錯誤處理與成本/上下文控制。當架構多步驟代理管線、在單一代理與多代理方法之間選擇，或重構受上下文膨脹或不可靠交接影響的 LLM 工作流時使用。

subTools.name: Api Design Reviewer
subTools.description: Comprehensive REST API design review with automated linting, breaking-change detection, and design scorecards. Catches inconsistent conventions, missing versioning, and design smells before APIs ship. Use when reviewing a PR that adds or changes API endpoints, auditing an existing API for v2 migration, or establishing API standards for a team.
subTools.description_zh: 提供 REST API 設計的全面審查，包含自動 linting、breaking-change 偵測與設計評分卡。在 API 上線前捕捉不一致的慣例、缺少版本控管與設計問題。適合用於審查新增或變更 API 端點的 PR、審計現有 API 以進行 v2 遷移，或為團隊建立 API 標準。

subTools.name: Api Test Suite Builder
subTools.description: Use when the user asks to generate API tests, create integration test suites, test REST endpoints, or build contract tests.
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者要求產生 API 測試、建立整合測試套件、測試 REST 端點，或建構契約測試（contract tests）時使用。

subTools.name: Browser Automation
subTools.description: Use when the user asks to automate browser tasks, scrape websites, fill forms, capture screenshots, extract structured data from web pages, or build web automation workflows. NOT for testing — use playwright-pro for that.
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者要求自動化瀏覽器任務、爬取網站、填寫表單、擷取截圖、從網頁提取結構化資料，或建立網頁自動化工作流程時使用。不適用於測試，請改用 playwright-pro。

subTools.name: Changelog Generator
subTools.description: Produce consistent, auditable release notes from Conventional Commits.
