Separates commit parsing, semantic-bump logic, and changelog rendering for automated releases with editorial control. Use when cutting a release, generating CHANGELOG.md from git history, computing the next semantic version from commits, automating release notes in CI, or planning a hotfix/rollback. Examples: 'generate the changelog for v1.4.0', 'what version bump do these commits require', 'we need an emergency hotfix process'.
subTools.description_zh: 根據 Conventional Commits 產生一致且可追溯的發行說明。分離 commit 解析、語義版本提升邏輯與變更日誌渲染，以實現具備編輯控制的自動化發行。適合用於發布版本、從 git 歷史產生 CHANGELOG.md、從 commits 計算下一個語義版本、在 CI 中自動化發行說明，或規劃熱修復／回滾。

subTools.name: Chaos Engineering
subTools.description: Use when planning, running, or learning from chaos engineering experiments. Triggers on "chaos experiment", "fault injection", "gameday", "resilience test", "blast radius", "steady state", "abort criteria", "Chaos Toolkit", "Chaos Mesh", "Litmus", "Gremlin", "AWS FIS", or any deliberate failure-injection question. Ships experiment designer, blast-radius calculator, and postmortem generator (all stdlib Python), 4 references on chaos principles + experiment design + attack taxonomy + tooling landscape, and a /chaos-experiment slash command. Composes with feature-flags-architect (kill switches as abort triggers) and kubernetes-operator (common chaos targets).
subTools.description_zh: 用於規劃、執行或從混沌工程實驗中學習。觸發於混沌實驗、故障注入、韌性測試、爆風半徑、穩態等關鍵詞，以及 Chaos Toolkit、Chaos Mesh、Litmus、Gremlin、AWS FIS 等工具。附贈實驗設計器、爆風半徑計算器與事後檢討產生器。

subTools.name: Ci Cd Pipeline Builder
subTools.description: Generate pragmatic CI/CD pipelines from detected project stack signals — fast baseline generation, repeatable checks, environment-aware deployment stages. Use when setting up CI for a new project, refactoring existing pipelines, or standardizing deployment workflows across multiple repos.
subTools.description_zh: 根據專案技術堆疊信號產生實用的 CI/CD 流程，含快速基礎設定、可重複檢查與環境感知部署階段。適用於新專案 CI 設定、既有流程重構，或跨多倉庫標準化部署流程。

subTools.name: Codebase Onboarding
subTools.description: Analyze a codebase and generate onboarding documentation for engineers, tech leads, and contractors. Fast fact-gathering and repeatable onboarding outputs. Use when onboarding a new engineer, writing architecture-overview docs for a new project, or producing tech-lead briefings for unfamiliar repos.
subTools.description_zh: 分析程式碼庫並產生工程師、技術主管與合約人員的上手文件。快速蒐集資訊，並提供可重複的上手產出。適用於新工程師上手、為新專案撰寫架構概述文件，或為不熟悉之程式庫製作技術主管簡報時。

subTools.name: Database Designer
subTools.description: Use when the user asks to design database schemas, plan data migrations, optimize queries, choose between SQL and NoSQL, or model data relationships.
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者要求設計資料庫結構、規劃資料遷移、最佳化查詢、選擇 SQL 與 NoSQL，或進行資料關係建模時使用。

subTools.name: Database Schema Designer
subTools.description: Use when the user asks to create ERD diagrams, normalize database schemas, design table relationships, or plan schema migrations.
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者要求建立 ERD 圖表、正規化資料庫結構、設計資料表關聯或規劃結構遷移時使用。

subTools.name: Dependency Auditor
subTools.description: Audit and manage dependencies across multi-language projects. Identifies vulnerabilities, license conflicts, transitive dependency risks, and safe-upgrade paths. Use when auditing third-party packages before release, investigating a CVE, planning a major version bump, or running a license-compliance review. Examples: 'audit our npm dependencies', 'do we have GPL contamination', 'plan the upgrade to React 19'.
subTools.description_zh: 稽核多語言專案的相依套件，識別弱點、授權衝突、傳遞相依風險與安全升級路徑。於釋出前稽核套件、調查 CVE 或規劃大版本升級時使用。範例：「稽核我們的 npm 相依套件」、「是否有 GPL 污染」、「規劃升級 t」

subTools.name: Engineering Advanced Skills
subTools.description: Index of 37 advanced engineering agent skills for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, OpenClaw. Use when browsing or choosing among the POWERFUL-tier engineering skills: agent design, RAG, MCP servers, CI/CD, database design, observability, security auditing, changelog/release automation, reliability (SLO/chaos/flags/operators), platform ops.
subTools.description_zh: Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、Cursor、OpenClaw 等 37 項進階工程代理技能索引。瀏覽或選擇 POWERFUL 層級工程技能時使用：代理設計、RAG、MCP 伺服器、CI/CD、資料庫設計、可觀察性、安全稽核、變更日誌/版本自動化、可靠性（SLO/混沌/功能旗標/算子）、平台營運。

subTools.name: Env Secrets Manager
subTools.description: Manage environment-variable hygiene and secrets safety across local development and production. Practical auditing, drift awareness, rotation readiness. Use when auditing .env files for committed secrets, planning a credential rotation, debugging missing-env-var production incidents, or hardening a new project against secrets leakage.
subTools.description_zh: 管理本地開發與生產環境的環境變數衛生與密碼安全。包含實用稽核、偏移感知與旋轉準備。審視 .env 檔案中的提交密碼、規劃憑證旋轉、除錯生產環境缺失環境變數事故，或強化新專案以防密碼洩漏時使用。

subTools.name: Feature Flags Architect
subTools.description: Use when adding, retiring, or auditing feature flags. Triggers on "add a flag", "ship behind a flag", "rollout plan", "kill switch", "stale flags", "flag debt", "LaunchDarkly", "GrowthBook", "Statsig", "Unleash", "Flipt", or any progressive-delivery question. Ships flag debt scanner, rollout planner, and kill-switch auditor (all stdlib Python), 4 references on flag taxonomy + provider trade-offs + rollout strategies + lifecycle, plus a /flag-cleanup slash command.
subTools.description_zh: 新增或稽核功能旗標時使用。支援 LaunchDarkly、GrowthBook、Statsig、Unleash、Flipt 等平台。提供負債掃描器與緊急停用稽核工具。

subTools.name: Focused Fix
subTools.description: Use when the user asks to fix, debug, or make a specific feature/module/area work end-to-end. Triggers: 'make X work', 'fix the Y feature', 'the Z module is broken', 'focus on [area]'. Not for quick single-bug fixes — this is for systematic deep-dive repair across all files and dependencies.
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者要求系統性修復特定功能或模組時使用。適用於跨檔案的深度修復，而非快速單一眼點修復。

subTools.name: Full Page Screenshot
subTools.description: Use when the user asks to capture a full-page screenshot, long screenshot, or complete page capture of a web page. Handles SPA scroll containers, lazy-loaded images, and very tall pages via Chrome DevTools Protocol with zero external dependencies.
subTools.description_zh: 擷取網頁全頁或長截圖時使用。透過 Chrome DevTools Protocol 處理 SPA 滾動容器與延遲載入影像，無需外部依賴。

subTools.name: Git Worktree Manager
subTools.description: Run parallel feature work safely with Git worktrees. Standardizes branch isolation, port allocation, environment sync, and cleanup so each worktree behaves like an independent local app. Optimized for multi-agent workflows where each agent or terminal session owns one worktree. Use when running multiple feature branches simultaneously, isolating experimental work, or coordinating multi-agent development across the same repo.
subTools.description_zh: 使用 Git 工作樹安全並行開發。標準化分支隔離與環境同步，使每個工作樹如同獨立應用程式。最適化於多 Agent 工作流程。

subTools.name: Interview System Designer
subTools.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "design interview processes", "create hiring pipelines", "calibrate interview loops", "generate interview questions", "design competency matrices", "analyze interviewer bias", "create scoring rubrics", "build question banks", or "optimize hiring systems". Use for designing role-specific interview loops, competency assessments, and hiring calibration systems.
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者要求設計面試流程、建立徵才管道、校準面試輪次、產生面試題目、設計能力矩陣、分析面試官偏見、建立評分量表、建置題目庫或最佳化徵才系統時使用此技能。適用於設計角色特定面試流程、能力評估與徵才校準。

subTools.name: Kubernetes Operator
subTools.description: Use when building a Kubernetes Operator — custom controllers that reconcile CRD state. Triggers on "build an operator", "CRD design", "reconcile loop", "controller-runtime", "kubebuilder", "operator-sdk", "metacontroller", "KOPF", "operator capability levels", or "custom resource". Ships CRD validator, reconcile-loop linter, and OperatorHub capability auditor (all stdlib Python), 4 references on the operator pattern + CRD design + reconcile patterns + tooling landscape, and a /operator-audit slash command. NOT a generic k8s skill — specifically the Operator pattern.
subTools.description_zh: 建置 Kubernetes Operator 時使用——自訂控制器用於同步 CRD 狀態。觸發條件包括「建構 operator」、「CRD 設計」、「reconcile 循環」、「controller-runtime」、「kubebuilder」、「operator-sdk」、「metacontroller」、「KOPF」、「operator 能力層級」或「自訂資源」。提供 CRD 驗證器、reconcile 循環 lint 工具與 OperatorHub 能力檢查器（均為標準 Python），參考文件 4 篇。

subTools.name: Mcp Server Builder
subTools.description: Design and ship production-ready MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers from OpenAPI contracts instead of hand-written tool wrappers. Python and TypeScript support, schema validation, safe evolution. Use when exposing an existing API as an MCP server, building tool integrations for Claude or Codex or Cursor, or scaffolding an MCP project from scratch.
subTools.description_zh: 從 OpenAPI 合約設計並交付生產環境就緒的 MCP（Model Context Protocol）伺服器，而非手寫工具包裝。支援 Python 與 TypeScript、欄位驗證、安全演進。適用於將現有 API 暴露為 MCP 伺服器、為 Claude／Codex／Cursor 建置工具整合，或從零開始建立 MCP 專案骨架。

subTools.name: Migration Architect
subTools.description: Zero-downtime migration planning, compatibility validation, and rollback strategy generation. Tools for system, database, and infrastructure migrations with minimal business impact. Use when planning a database migration, infrastructure cutover, system replacement, or any high-risk transition that needs explicit rollback paths.
subTools.description_zh: 零停機遷移規劃、相容性驗證與回滾策略產生。提供系統、資料庫與基礎設施遷移工具，將商業影響降至最低。適用於規劃資料庫遷移、基礎設施切換、系統更替或任何需要明確回滾路徑的高風險轉換作業。

subTools.name: Monorepo Navigator
subTools.description: Navigate, manage, and optimize monorepos. Covers Turborepo, Nx, pnpm workspaces, and Lerna. Cross-package impact analysis, selective builds/tests on affected packages, remote caching, dependency graph visualization, and structured multi-repo to monorepo migrations. Use when setting up a new monorepo, optimizing CI for a large workspace, debugging cross-package dependency issues, or planning a multi-repo consolidation.
subTools.description_zh: 導航、管理與最佳化 monorepo，涵蓋 Turborepo、Nx、pnpm workspaces 和 Lerna。支援跨套件影響分析、依受影響套件篩選建置與測試、遠端快取、相依圖表視覺化，以及多 repo 遷移至 monorepo 的結構化流程。

subTools.name: Observability Designer
subTools.description: Design production-ready observability strategies combining metrics, logs, and traces. Includes SLI/SLO design, golden-signals monitoring, alert optimization. Use when adding observability to a new service, refactoring alerting that is too noisy, or designing an SLO program before scaling production load.
subTools.description_zh: 設計涵蓋 metrics、logs 與 traces 的生產級可觀測性策略，包含 SLI/SLO 規劃、golden signals 監控與警示最佳化。適用於為新服務加入可觀測性、重整過吵的警示系統，或在擴展前設計 SLO 方案。

subTools.name: Performance Profiler
subTools.description: Systematic performance profiling for Node.js, Python, and Go applications. Identifies CPU, memory, and I/O bottlenecks, generates flamegraphs, analyzes bundle sizes, optimizes database queries, runs load tests with k6 and Artillery. Always measures before and after. Use when investigating a slow endpoint, planning a performance budget, or hunting a memory leak in production.
subTools.description_zh: 針對 Node.js、Python 與 Go 應用程式進行系統性效能剖析，識別 CPU、記憶體與 I/O 瓶頸，產生 flamegraph、分析 bundle 大小、最佳化資料庫查詢，並使用 k6 與 Artillery 執行負載測試。務必在修改前後都進行測量。

subTools.name: Pr Review Expert
subTools.description: Use when the user asks to review pull requests, analyze code changes, check for security issues in PRs, or assess code quality of diffs.
subTools.description_zh: 用於使用者要求審查 pull request、分析程式碼變更、檢查 PR 中的安全問題或評估 diff 的程式碼品質時。

subTools.name: Rag Architect
subTools.description: Use when the user asks to design a RAG pipeline, choose a chunking strategy or embedding model, pick a vector database, or evaluate retrieval quality (precision@k, recall@k, NDCG). Examples: 'design a RAG system for our docs', 'what chunk size should I use for this corpus', 'evaluate my retriever against ground truth'. NOT for general LLM cost tuning (use llm-cost-optimizer) or agent loops over retrieval (use agenthub).
subTools.description_zh: 用於設計 RAG 管線、選擇分塊策略或嵌入模型、挑選向量資料庫，或評估檢索品質（precision@k、recall@k、NDCG）。範例：為文件設計 RAG 系統、決定分塊大小、評估檢索器。不適用於一般 LLM 成本調整（請用 llm-cost-optimizer）或代理人迴圈。

subTools.name: Runbook Generator
subTools.description: Generate operational runbooks from a service name — deployment, incident response, maintenance, and rollback workflows. Templated structure customizable per environment. Use when documenting on-call procedures for a new service, standardizing incident response across teams, or producing runbooks before launching to production.
subTools.description_zh: 根據服務名稱生成操作手冊，涵蓋部署、事件回應、維護與回滾工作流程。結構為範本化，可依環境自訂。用於記錄新服務待命程序、跨團隊標準化事件回應，或上線生產前產出手冊。

subTools.name: Secrets Vault Manager
subTools.description: Use when the user asks to set up secret management infrastructure, integrate HashiCorp Vault, configure cloud secret stores (AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault, GCP Secret Manager), implement secret rotation, or audit secret access patterns.
subTools.description_zh: 用於設定金鑰管理基礎設施、整合 HashiCorp Vault、配置雲端金鑰儲存區（AWS Secrets Manager、Azure Key Vault、GCP Secret Manager）、實作金鑰輪換或審計金鑰存取模式。

subTools.name: Self Eval
subTools.description: Honestly evaluate AI work quality using a two-axis scoring system. Use after completing a task, code review, or work session to get an unbiased assessment. Detects score inflation, forces devil's advocate reasoning, and persists scores across sessions.
subTools.description_zh: 以雙軸評分系統誠實評估 AI 工作品質。在完成任務、程式碼審查或工作階段後使用，取得客觀評估。偵測分數膨脹、強制反向思考，並會在會話中持續保留分數。

subTools.name: Skill Tester
subTools.description: Validate, test, and score the quality of skills within the claude-skills ecosystem. Comprehensive meta-skill: structure validation, Python script testing (syntax + imports + runtime + output format), multi-dimensional quality scoring with letter grades and tier classification (BASIC/STANDARD/POWERFUL). Use when authoring a new skill, auditing existing skills for tier promotion, setting up pre-commit hooks for skill quality, or integrating skill QA into CI.
subTools.description_zh: 驗證、測試並評分 claude-skills 生態系中 skills 的品質。完整 meta-skill：結構驗證、Python 腳本測試（語法＋匯入＋執行時間＋輸出格式）、多維度品質評分搭配字母等級與分級（BASIC/STANDARD/POWERFUL）。撰寫新 skill、審查現有 skill 升級分級、設定 pre-commit 檢查時使用。

subTools.name: Slo Architect
subTools.description: Use when defining, reviewing, or operating SLOs/SLIs/error budgets. Triggers on "define an SLO", "what should our SLO be", "error budget", "burn rate", "SLI", "service level objective", "Google SRE workbook", "multi-window burn-rate alert", or any reliability-target question. Ships SLO designer, error-budget calculator with multi-window burn-rate thresholds, and SLO reviewer that catches the common bugs (target too aggressive, window too short, conflicting SLOs, no SLI definition). 4 references on SLO principles + SLI design + error budget math + composition with feature-flags-architect/chaos-engineering/kubernetes-operator. NOT a generic observability skill — specifically the SLO discipline.
subTools.description_zh: 定義、檢視或運作 SLO/SLI/error budget 時使用。觸發詞：「定義 SLO」「我們的 SLO 應為何」「error budget」「burn rate」「SLI」「service level objective」「Google SRE workbook」「multi-window burn-rate alert」或任何可靠性目標問題。提供 SLO 設計器、具多視窗燃燒率閾值的 error budget 計算器，以及能發現常見疏失的 SLO 審查器。

subTools.name: Spec Driven Workflow
subTools.description: Use when the user asks to write specs before code, define acceptance criteria, plan features before implementation, generate tests from specifications, or follow spec-first development practices.
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者要求先寫規格再寫程式、定義接受標準、實作前規劃功能、從規格生成測試，或遵循 spec-first 開發實踐時使用。

subTools.name: Sql Database Assistant
subTools.description: Use when the user asks to write SQL queries, optimize database performance, generate migrations, explore database schemas, or work with ORMs like Prisma, Drizzle, TypeORM, or SQLAlchemy.
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者要求撰寫 SQL 查詢、最佳化資料庫效能、生成遷移檔、探索資料庫 schema，或使用 Prisma、Drizzle、TypeORM、SQLAlchemy 等 ORM 時使用。

subTools.name: Tc Tracker
subTools.description: Use when the user asks to track technical changes, create change records, manage TC lifecycles, or hand off work between AI sessions. Covers init/create/update/status/resume/close/export workflows for structured code change documentation.
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者要求追蹤技術變更、建立變更記錄、管理 TC 生命週期，或在 AI 工作階段之間移交工作時使用。涵蓋 init/create/update/status/resume/close/export workflow，用於結構化程式碼變更文件。

subTools.name: Tech Debt Tracker
subTools.description: Scan codebases for technical debt, score severity, track trends, and generate prioritized remediation plans. Use when users mention tech debt, code quality, refactoring priority, debt scoring, cleanup sprints, or code health assessment. Also use for legacy code modernization planning and maintenance cost estimation.
subTools.description_zh: 掃描程式碼庫中的技術債務、評分嚴重程度、追蹤趨勢，並生成優先權重的改善計畫。當使用者提到技術債務、程式碼品質、重構優先順序、債務評分、清理衝刺或程式碼健康評估時使用。也適用於舊程式碼現代化規劃與維護成本估算。

subTools.name: Slo Architect
subTools.description: Use when defining, reviewing, or operating SLOs/SLIs/error budgets. Triggers on "define an SLO", "what should our SLO be", "error budget", "burn rate", "SLI", "service level objective", "Google SRE workbook", "multi-window burn-rate alert", or any reliability-target question. Ships SLO designer, error-budget calculator with multi-window burn-rate thresholds, and SLO reviewer that catches the common bugs (target too aggressive, window too short, conflicting SLOs, no SLI definition). 4 references on SLO principles + SLI design + error budget math + composition with feature-flags-architect/chaos-engineering/kubernetes-operator. NOT a generic observability skill — specifically the SLO discipline.
subTools.description_zh: 定義、檢視或執行 SLO／SLI 與錯誤預算時使用。觸發條件包含「定義 SLO」「我們的 SLO 應為何」「錯誤預算」「燃燒率」「SLI」「服務水準目標」「Google SRE workbook」「多視窗燃燒率警報」或任何可靠性目標問題。內建 SLO 設計器、具多視窗燃燒率閾值的錯誤預算計算器，以及可偵測常見問題的 SLO 審查器。

subTools.name: Statistical Analyst
subTools.description: Run hypothesis tests, analyze A/B experiment results, calculate sample sizes, and interpret statistical significance with effect sizes. Use when you need to validate whether observed differences are real, size an experiment correctly before launch, or interpret test results with confidence.
subTools.description_zh: 執行假設檢定、分析 A/B 實驗結果、計算樣本數並解讀具成效大小的統計顯著性。當你需驗證觀察差異是否真實、在推出前正確估算實驗規模，或自信地解讀測試結果時使用。

subTools.name: Strict Api
subTools.description: Use when the user says 'no hallucinations', 'verify APIs', 'reality check', or 'don't invent functions'. Prevents the agent from calling methods, imports, or variables that do not provably exist in the user's installed version.
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者說「不要幻覺」「驗證 API」「實況檢查」或「別發明函式」時使用。此規則可防止代理呼叫、匯入或參照在其已安裝版本中無法證明存在的類別、方法、匯入或變數。

subTools.name: Terraform Patterns
subTools.description: Terraform infrastructure-as-code agent skill and plugin for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, OpenClaw. Covers module design patterns, state management strategies, provider configuration, security hardening, policy-as-code with Sentinel/OPA, and CI/CD plan/apply workflows. Use when: user wants to design Terraform modules, manage state backends, review Terraform security, implement multi-region deployments, or follow IaC best practices.
subTools.description_zh: 用於 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、Cursor、OpenClaw 的 Terraform IaC 代理技能與插件。涵蓋模組設計模式、狀態管理策略、提供者配置、安全強化、Sentinel/OPA 的程式碼政策，以及 CI/CD plan/apply 工作流程。當使用者想設計 Terraform 模組、管理狀態後端、審查 Terraform 安全性或實施多區域部署時使用。

subTools.name: Universal Scraping Architect
subTools.description: Use for web scraping, crawling, document extraction, API parsing, or building validation-heavy data pipelines using Firecrawl or local Python scripts.
subTools.description_zh: 用於網頁爬蟲、爬取、文件提取、API 解析，或使用 Firecrawl 與本地 Python 腳本建置高驗證性資料管線。

subTools.name: Workflow Builder
subTools.description: Design and write deterministic multi-agent workflow scripts (.js files in .claude/workflows/) for Claude Code's Workflow tool. Use when a user wants to build, create, author, scaffold, or run a custom Claude Code workflow, orchestrate sub-agents (fan-out, pipeline, loop, judge-panel), or automate a repeatable multi-step task across fresh-context agents.
subTools.description_zh: 為 Claude Code Workflow 工具設計與撰寫確定的多代理工作流程腳本（放置於 .claude/workflows/ 中的 .js 檔案）。當使用者想建立、生成、撰寫、建立骨架或執行自訂 Claude Code 工作流程、協調子代理（扇出、管線、迴圈、評判小組），或在跨新上下文代理的情況下自動化可重複的多步驟任務時使用。

subTools.name: Write A Skill
subTools.description: Create new agent skills with proper structure, progressive disclosure, and bundled resources. Use when user wants to create, write, build, or author a new skill.
subTools.description_zh: 建立具備正確結構、漸進式揭露與內建資源的新代理技能。當使用者想要建立、撰寫、建構或撰寫新技能時使用。

subTools.name: Zero Hallucination Coder
subTools.description: Runs a disciplined Discuss -> Map -> Decompose -> Execute -> Verify loop that grounds code in verified structure — no invented APIs, no assumed imports, no placeholder code — with a lazy-senior-dev YAGNI ladder that deletes unnecessary code before it is written. Use when a coding task is high-stakes, complex, or spans existing code (auth, databases, migrations, multi-file features), or when the user explicitly asks to plan carefully before coding, avoid hallucinated code, or work rigorously. Not for trivial edits, typos, or throwaway one-off scripts — those do not need the full loop.
subTools.description_zh: 執行嚴謹的「討論 → 映射 → 分解 → 執行 → 驗證」循環，讓程式碼建立在已驗證的結構上，不使用發明 API、未驗證匯入或佔位程式碼，並搭配 lazy-senior-dev YAGNI 階梯，在編寫前刪除不必要的程式碼。當編碼任務具有高風險、複雜性或跨越既有程式（如身份驗證、資料庫、遷移、多檔案功能），或使用者要求最高準確度時使用。

subTools.name: A11y Audit
subTools.description: Accessibility audit skill for scanning, fixing, and verifying WCAG 2.2 Level A and AA compliance across React, Next.js, Vue, Angular, Svelte, and plain HTML codebases. Use when auditing accessibility, fixing a11y violations, checking color contrast, generating compliance reports, or integrating accessibility checks into CI/CD pipelines.
subTools.description_zh: 無障礙稽核技能，用於掃描、修復與驗證 WCAG 2.2 Level A 和 AA 規範，涵蓋 React、Next.js、Vue、Angular、Svelte 及純 HTML 專案。

subTools.name: Google Workspace Cli
subTools.description: Google Workspace administration via the gws CLI (github.com/googleworkspace/cli). Install, authenticate, and automate Gmail, Drive, Sheets, Calendar, Docs, Chat, and Tasks. Run security audits and use local recipe templates and persona bundles. Use for Google Workspace admin, gws CLI setup, Gmail automation, Drive management, or Calendar scheduling.
subTools.description_zh: 透過 gws 命令列管理 Google Workspace。安裝、驗證並自動化 Gmail、Drive、Sheets、Calendar、Docs、Chat 與 Tasks。執行安全稽核並使用在地配方模板與角色套件。

subTools.name: Pw
subTools.description: Production-grade Playwright testing toolkit. Use when the user mentions Playwright tests, end-to-end testing, browser automation, fixing flaky tests, test migration, CI/CD testing, or test suites. Generate tests, fix flaky failures, migrate from Cypress/Selenium, sync with TestRail, run on BrowserStack. 55 templates, 3 agents, smart reporting.
subTools.description_zh: 生產級 Playwright 測試工具包。適用於 Playwright 測試、端到端測試、瀏覽器自動化、修復不穩定測試、測試遷移、CI/CD 測試或測試套件。提供 55 個範本、3 個代理、智慧報告，並支援從 Cypress/Selenium 遷移、與 TestRail 同步、於 BrowserStack 執行。

subTools.name: Extract
subTools.description: Turn a proven pattern or debugging solution into a standalone reusable skill with SKILL.md, reference docs, and examples. Use when the user runs /si:extract or asks to package a recurring solution from memory into a skill.
subTools.description_zh: 將經驗證的模式或除錯方案，透過 SKILL.md、參考文件與範例，包裝成獨立且可重複使用的技能。當使用者執行 /si:extract 或要求將記憶中的常見解決方案打包成技能時使用。

subTools.name: Memory Review
subTools.description: Analyze auto-memory for promotion candidates, stale entries, consolidation opportunities, and health metrics. Use when the user runs /si:memory-review or asks what has been learned and what should be promoted or pruned.
subTools.description_zh: 分析自動記憶體的升級候選、過時條目、整合機會與健康指標。當使用者執行 /si:memory-review 或詢問已學到什麼、哪些內容應升級或修剪時使用。

subTools.name: Memory Status
subTools.description: Memory health dashboard showing line counts, topic files, capacity, stale entries, and recommendations. Use when the user runs /si:memory-status or asks how full or healthy the agent memory is.
subTools.description_zh: 顯示行數、主題檔案、容量、過時條目與建議的記憶健康儀表板。當使用者執行 /si:memory-status 或詢問 Agent 記憶體的飽和度與健康狀況時使用。

subTools.name: Promote
subTools.description: Graduate a proven pattern from auto-memory (MEMORY.md) to CLAUDE.md or .claude/rules/ for permanent enforcement. Use when the user runs /si:promote or asks to make a learned behavior permanent.
subTools.description_zh: 將已驗證的模式從自動記憶體（MEMORY.md）升級至 CLAUDE.md 或 .claude/rules/，以便永久實施。當使用者執行 /si:promote 或要求將學習到的行為永久化時使用。

subTools.name: Remember
subTools.description: Explicitly save important knowledge to auto-memory with timestamp and context. Use when a discovery is too important to rely on auto-capture.
subTools.description_zh: 以時間戳記與上下文，將重要知識明確儲存至自動記憶。當發現過於重要、不宜依賴自動收錄時使用。

subTools.name: Self Improving Agent
subTools.description: Curate Claude Code's auto-memory into durable project knowledge. Analyze MEMORY.md for patterns, promote proven learnings to CLAUDE.md and .claude/rules/, extract recurring solutions into reusable skills. Use when: (1) reviewing what Claude has learned about your project, (2) graduating a pattern from notes to enforced rules, (3) turning a debugging solution into a skill, (4) checking memory health and capacity.
subTools.description_zh: 整理 Claude Code 自動記憶成持久專案知識。分析 MEMORY.md 中的模式，將已驗證的學習成果升級至 CLAUDE.md 與 .claude/rules/，並將重複出現的解法抽取為可重用技能。適用時機：(1) 檢視 Claude 對你專案的學習內容；(2) 將已驗證的模式從筆記升級為強制規則；(3) 把除錯解法轉為技能；(4) 檢查記憶體健康狀況。

subTools.name: Adversarial Reviewer
subTools.description: Adversarial code review that breaks the self-review monoculture. Use when you want a genuinely critical review of recent changes, before merging a PR, or when you suspect Claude is being too agreeable about code quality. Forces perspective shifts through hostile reviewer personas that catch blind spots the author's mental model shares with the reviewer.
subTools.description_zh: 進行對抗式程式碼審查，打破自我審查的單一文化。當你希望對近期變更獲得真正嚴厲的意見、合併 PR 前，或懷疑 Claude 對程式品質太過附和時使用。透過敵意審查者角色強制切換觀點，捕捉作者心智模型與審查者共有的盲點。

subTools.name: Ai Security
subTools.description: Use when assessing AI/ML systems for prompt injection, jailbreak vulnerabilities, model inversion risk, data poisoning exposure, or agent tool abuse. Covers MITRE ATLAS technique mapping, injection signature detection, and adversarial robustness scoring.
subTools.description_zh: 評估 AI/ML 系統的提示注入、越獄弱點、模型反轉風險、資料中毒暴露或 Agent 工具濫用。涵蓋 MITRE ATLAS 技術對映、注入特徵偵測與對抗式魯棒性評分。

subTools.name: Aws Solution Architect
subTools.description: Design AWS architectures for startups using serverless patterns and IaC templates. Use when asked to design serverless architecture, create CloudFormation templates, optimize AWS costs, set up CI/CD pipelines, or migrate to AWS. Covers Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, ECS, Aurora, and cost optimization.
subTools.description_zh: 為新創設計 AWS 架構，採用 Serverless 與 IaC 範本。適用於建立 CloudFormation 範本、優化成本、設定 CI/CD 管道或遷移。涵蓋 Lambda、API Gateway、DynamoDB、ECS 與 Aurora。

subTools.name: Azure Cloud Architect
subTools.description: Design Azure architectures for startups and enterprises. Use when asked to design Azure infrastructure, create Bicep/ARM templates, optimize Azure costs, set up Azure DevOps pipelines, or migrate to Azure. Covers AKS, App Service, Azure Functions, Cosmos DB, and cost optimization.
subTools.description_zh: 為新創與企業設計 Azure 架構。適用於規劃 Azure 基礎建設、建立 Bicep/ARM 範本、優化成本、設定 Azure DevOps 管道或遷移。涵蓋 AKS、App Service、Azure Functions、Cosmos DB 與成本優化。

subTools.name: Cloud Security
subTools.description: Use when assessing cloud infrastructure for security misconfigurations, IAM privilege escalation paths, S3 public exposure, open security group rules, or IaC security gaps. Covers AWS, Azure, and GCP posture assessment with MITRE ATT&CK mapping.
subTools.description_zh: 用於評估雲端基礎建設的安全錯誤設定、IAM 權限提升路徑、S3 公開暴露、開放的安全群組規則或 IaC 安全缺口。涵蓋 AWS、Azure 與 GCP 的安全態勢評估及 MITRE ATT&CK 對映。

subTools.name: Code Reviewer
subTools.description: Code review automation for TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, Swift, Kotlin, C#, .NET, Java, C, C++, Rust, Ruby, PHP, and Dart/Flutter. Analyzes PRs for complexity and risk, checks code quality for SOLID violations and code smells, generates review reports. Use when reviewing pull requests, analyzing code quality, identifying issues, generating review checklists.
subTools.description_zh: 自動化 Code Review，支援 TypeScript、JavaScript、Python 等多種語言。分析 PR 複雜度與風險，檢查 SOLID 違反與程式碼壞味道，生成審查報告。適用於 Pull Request 審查與品質分析。

subTools.name: Email Template Builder
subTools.description: Build complete transactional email systems: React Email templates, provider integration (Resend, Postmark, SendGrid, AWS SES), preview server, i18n support, dark mode, spam optimization, analytics tracking. Use when adding transactional email to a new product, migrating between email providers, refactoring legacy email templates for accessibility, or adding internationalization to existing templates.
subTools.description_zh: 建構完整的交易郵件系統：React Email 模板、提供者整合（Resend、Postmark、SendGrid、AWS SES）、預覽伺服器、i18n 支援、暗色模式、垃圾郵件最佳化、分析追蹤。用於為新產品加入交易郵件、遷移郵件提供者、重構舊版模板以提升無障礙性，或為既有模板加入國際化。

subTools.name: Engineering Skills
subTools.description: Index of the engineering-team skills bundle for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, OpenClaw, and 6 more tools. Architecture, frontend, backend, QA, DevOps, security, AI/ML, data engineering, Playwright, Stripe, AWS, MS365 (stdlib-only Python tools). Use when browsing or choosing among engineering-team role skills — load only the one specialist SKILL.md you need, never bulk-load the bundle.
subTools.description_zh: Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、Cursor、OpenClaw 等工具的 engineering-team 技能套件索引。涵蓋架構、前端、後端、QA、DevOps、安全性、AI/ML、資料工程，以及 Playwright、Stripe、AWS、MS365（僅限 stdlib Python 工具）。用於瀏覽或選擇 engineering-team 角色技能——請只載入所需的單一專業 SKILL.md，避免大量載入整個套件。

subTools.name: Gcp Cloud Architect
subTools.description: Design GCP architectures for startups and enterprises. Use when asked to design Google Cloud infrastructure, deploy to GKE or Cloud Run, configure BigQuery pipelines, optimize GCP costs, or migrate to GCP. Covers Cloud Run, GKE, Cloud Functions, Cloud SQL, BigQuery, and cost optimization.
subTools.description_zh: 為新創與企業設計 GCP 架構。用於被要求設計 Google Cloud 基礎設施、部署至 GKE 或 Cloud Run、設定 BigQuery 管線、最佳化 GCP 成本，或遷移至 GCP 時。涵蓋 Cloud Run、GKE、Cloud Functions、Cloud SQL、BigQuery 與成本最佳化。

subTools.name: Incident Commander
subTools.description: Comprehensive incident response framework from detection through resolution and post-incident review. Battle-tested SRE/DevOps practices: severity classification, timeline reconstruction, structured post-incident analysis. Use when declaring an incident, coordinating multi-team response during an outage, leading a post-mortem, or setting up on-call practices for a new service.
subTools.description_zh: 從偵測到解決與事後回顧的完整事件應變框架。實戰驗證的 SRE/DevOps 實務：嚴重度分級、時間軸重建、結構化事後分析。用於宣告事件、協調多團隊停機恢復、帶領事後檢討或為新服務建立值班機制。

subTools.name: Incident Response
subTools.description: Use when a security incident has been detected or declared and needs classification, triage, escalation path determination, and forensic evidence collection. Covers SEV1-SEV4 classification, false positive filtering, incident taxonomy, and NIST SP 800-61 lifecycle.
subTools.description_zh: 於發現或宣告安全事件時使用，用於分級、分流、決定通報路徑及取證。涵蓋 SEV1-SEV4 分級、誤報過濾、事件分類與 NIST SP 800-61 生命週期。

subTools.name: Ms365 Tenant Manager
subTools.description: Microsoft 365 tenant administration for Global Administrators. Automate M365 tenant setup, Office 365 admin tasks, Azure AD user management, Exchange Online configuration, Teams administration, and security policies. Generate PowerShell scripts for bulk operations, Conditional Access policies, license management, and compliance reporting. Use for M365 tenant manager, Office 365 admin, Azure AD users, Global Administrator, tenant configuration, or Microsoft 365 automation.
subTools.description_zh: Microsoft 365 租戶管理，適用於 Global Administrator。自動化 M365 租戶設定、Office 365 管理任務、Azure AD 使用者管理、Exchange Online 配置、Teams 管理與安全策略。產生 PowerShell 腳本進行批量作業、Conditional Access 策略、授權管理及合規報告。

subTools.name: Named Persona Adversarial Review
subTools.description: Code review through the lens of real engineers' documented philosophies (Torvalds, Thompson, Carmack, Kent Beck, Jobs, Cagan). Complements abstract-role adversarial review with named, sourced perspectives. Use when automated review findings feel generic, when a PR has architectural or UX impact, or when the author wants pre-submit hardening beyond standard checks.
subTools.description_zh: 透過真實工程師已記錄的理念（Torvalds、Thompson、Carmack、Kent Beck、Jobs、Cagan）進行程式碼審查。補充抽象角色的敵對審查，提供具名且可溯源的觀點。當自動化審查結果泛泛、PR 具架構或 UX 影響，或作者希望在提交前強化時使用。

subTools.name: Red Team
subTools.description: Use when planning or executing authorized red team engagements, attack path analysis, or offensive security simulations. Covers MITRE ATT&CK kill-chain planning, technique scoring, choke point identification, OPSEC risk assessment, and crown jewel targeting.
subTools.description_zh: 用於規劃或執行授權紅隊行動、攻擊路徑分析或攻勢安全模擬。涵蓋 MITRE ATT&CK 殺戮鏈規劃、技術評分、節點識別、OPSEC 風險評估及皇冠寶石目標定位。

subTools.name: Security Pen Testing
subTools.description: Use when the user asks to perform security audits, penetration testing, vulnerability scanning, OWASP Top 10 checks, or offensive security assessments. Covers static analysis, dependency scanning, secret detection, API security testing, and pen test report generation.
subTools.description_zh: 用於使用者要求進行安全稽核、滲透測試、弱點掃描、OWASP Top 10 檢查或攻勢安全評估時。涵蓋靜態分析、相依性掃描、機密偵測、API 安全測試及滲透測試報告生成。

subTools.name: Senior Architect
subTools.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "design system architecture", "evaluate microservices vs monolith", "create architecture diagrams", "analyze dependencies", "choose a database", "plan for scalability", "make technical decisions", or "review system design". Use for architecture decision records (ADRs), tech stack evaluation, system design reviews, dependency analysis, and generating architecture diagrams in Mermaid, PlantUML, or ASCII format.
subTools.description_zh: 用於使用者要求設計系統架構、評估微服務與單體、建立架構圖、分析相依性、選擇資料庫、規劃擴充性、進行技術決策或檢視系統設計時。用於架構決策記錄（ADRs）、技術堆疊評估、系統設計審查等。

subTools.name: Senior Backend
subTools.description: Designs and implements backend systems including REST APIs, microservices, database architectures, authentication flows, and security hardening. Use when the user asks to "design REST APIs", "optimize database queries", "implement authentication", "build microservices", "review backend code", "set up GraphQL", "handle database migrations", or "load test APIs". Covers Node.js/Express/Fastify development, PostgreSQL optimization, API security, and backend architecture patterns.
subTools.description_zh: 設計並實現後端系統，包括 REST APIs、微服務、資料庫架構、認證流程及安全強化。當使用者要求設計 REST APIs、優化資料庫查詢、實現認證、建立微服務、檢視後端程式碼、設定 GraphQL、處理資料庫遷移或負載測試 APIs 時使用。

subTools.name: Senior Computer Vision
subTools.description: Computer vision engineering skill for object detection, image segmentation, and visual AI systems. Covers CNN and Vision Transformer architectures, YOLO/Faster R-CNN/DETR detection, Mask R-CNN/SAM segmentation, and production deployment with ONNX/TensorRT. Includes PyTorch, torchvision, Ultralytics, Detectron2, and MMDetection frameworks. Use when building detection pipelines, training custom models, optimizing inference, or deploying vision systems.
subTools.description_zh: 用於物件偵測、影像分割和視覺 AI 系統的電腦視覺工程技能。涵蓋 CNN 和 Vision Transformer 架構，YOLO/Faster R-CNN/DETR 偵測，Mask R-CNN/SAM 分割，以及使用 ONNX/TensorRT 的生產部署。包含 PyTorch、torchvision 等框架。

subTools.name: Senior Data Engineer
subTools.description: Data engineering skill for building scalable data pipelines, ETL/ELT systems, and data infrastructure. Expertise in Python, SQL, Spark, Airflow, dbt, Kafka, and modern data stack. Includes data modeling, pipeline orchestration, data quality, and DataOps. Use when designing data architectures, building data pipelines, optimizing data workflows, implementing data governance, or troubleshooting data issues.
subTools.description_zh: 資料工程技能，用於構建可擴展資料管線、ETL/ELT 系統及資料基礎設施。專精於 Python、SQL、Spark、Airflow、dbt、Kafka 和現代資料堆疊。包含資料建模、管線編排、資料品質和 DataOps。當設計資料架構、構建資料管線、優化資料工作流程、實施資料治理或排除資料故障時使用。

subTools.name: Senior Data Scientist
subTools.description: World-class senior data scientist skill specialising in statistical modeling, experiment design, causal inference, and predictive analytics. Covers A/B testing (sample sizing, two-proportion z-tests, Bonferroni correction), difference-in-differences, feature engineering pipelines (Scikit-learn, XGBoost), cross-validated model evaluation (AUC-ROC, AUC-PR, SHAP), and MLflow experiment tracking — using Python (NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn), R, and SQL. Use when designing or analysing controlled experiments, building and evaluating classification or regression models, performing causal analysis on observational data, engineering features for structured tabular datasets, or translating statistical findings into data-driven business decisions.
subTools.description_zh: 世界級資深資料科學家技能，專精於統計建模、實驗設計、因果推論和預測分析。涵蓋 A/B 測試（樣本大小、兩比例 z 檢定、Bonferroni 校正）、差異中的差異、特徵工程管線（Scikit-learn、XGBoost）、交叉驗證模型評估（AUC-ROC、AUC-PR、SHAP）和 MLflow 實驗追蹤。

subTools.name: Senior Devops
subTools.description: Comprehensive DevOps skill for CI/CD, infrastructure automation, containerization, and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure). Includes pipeline setup, infrastructure as code, deployment automation, and monitoring. Use when setting up pipelines, deploying applications, managing infrastructure, implementing monitoring, or optimizing deployment processes.
subTools.description_zh: 全面的 DevOps 技能，用於 CI/CD、基礎設施自動化、容器化和雲端平台（AWS、GCP、Azure）。包含管線設定、基礎設施即程式碼、部署自動化和監控。當設定管線、部署應用程式、管理基礎設施、實施監控或優化部署流程時使用。

subTools.name: Senior Frontend
subTools.description: Frontend development skill for React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS applications. Use when building React components, optimizing Next.js performance, analyzing bundle sizes, scaffolding frontend projects, implementing accessibility, or reviewing frontend code quality.
subTools.description_zh: React、Next.js、TypeScript 和 Tailwind CSS 應用的前端開發技巧。用於建構 React 元件、最佳化 Next.js 效能、分析套件大小、架構前端專案、實現無障礙功能，或審查前端程式碼品質。

subTools.name: Senior Fullstack
subTools.description: Fullstack development toolkit with project scaffolding for Next.js, FastAPI, MERN, and Django stacks, code quality analysis with security and complexity scoring, and stack selection guidance. Use when the user asks to "scaffold a new project", "create a Next.js app", "set up FastAPI with React", "analyze code quality", "audit my codebase", "what stack should I use", "generate project boilerplate", or mentions fullstack development, project setup, or tech stack comparison.
subTools.description_zh: 包含 Next.js、FastAPI、MERN 和 Django 堆疊的專案架構工具、具有安全性與複雜度評分的程式碼品質分析，以及堆疊選擇指引。用於架構新專案、建立 Next.js 應用、設定 FastAPI 搭配 React、分析程式碼品質、審計程式碼庫、決定使用何種堆疊，或產生專案範本。

subTools.name: Senior Ml Engineer
subTools.description: ML engineering skill for productionizing models, building MLOps pipelines, and integrating LLMs. Covers model deployment, feature stores, drift monitoring, RAG systems, and cost optimization. Use when the user asks about deploying ML models to production, setting up MLOps infrastructure (MLflow, Kubeflow, Kubernetes, Docker), monitoring model performance or drift, building RAG pipelines, or integrating LLM APIs with retry logic and cost controls. Focused on production and operational concerns rather than model research or initial training.
subTools.description_zh: 用於模型生產化、建構 MLOps 管線和整合 LLM 的 ML 工程技巧。涵蓋模型部署、特徵商店、漂移監控、RAG 系統和成本最佳化。用於將 ML 模型部署到生產環境、設定 MLOps 基礎設施（MLflow、Kubeflow、Kubernetes、Docker）、監控模型效能或漂移、建構 RAG 管線，或整合 LLM。

subTools.name: Senior Prompt Engineer
subTools.description: Use when the user asks to optimize prompts, design prompt templates, evaluate LLM outputs with an eval set, measure RAG retrieval quality, validate agent/tool configurations, analyze token usage, or design structured-output contracts. Covers eval-driven prompt iteration, RAG metrics (relevance, faithfulness, coverage), agent workflow validation, and token/cost budgeting — all model-agnostic, with three stdlib Python tools.
subTools.description_zh: 用於最佳化提示、設計提示模板、以評估集評估 LLM 輸出、測量 RAG 檢索品質、驗證 agent／工具配置、分析 token 使用量，或設計結構化輸出契約。涵蓋以評估為驅動的提示迭代、RAG 指標（相關性、忠實度、覆蓋率）、agent 工作流程驗證，以及 token／成本預算——所有技巧皆不依賴特定模型。

subTools.name: Senior Qa
subTools.description: Generates unit tests, integration tests, and E2E tests for React/Next.js applications. Scans components to create Jest + React Testing Library test stubs, analyzes Istanbul/LCOV coverage reports to surface gaps, scaffolds Playwright test files from Next.js routes, mocks API calls with MSW, creates test fixtures, and configures test runners. Use when the user asks to "generate tests", "write unit tests", "analyze test coverage", "scaffold E2E tests", "set up Playwright", "configure Jest", "implement testing patterns", or "improve test quality".
subTools.description_zh: 為 React／Next.js 應用產生單元測試、整合測試和 E2E 測試。掃描元件以建立 Jest + React Testing Library 測試骨架、分析 Istanbul／LCOV 覆蓋率報告以找出缺口、從 Next.js 路由架構 Playwright 測試檔案、以 MSW 模擬 API 呼叫、建立測試夾具，以及設定測試執行器。用於產生測試、撰寫單元測試等需求。

subTools.name: Senior Secops
subTools.description: Senior SecOps engineer skill for application security, vulnerability management, compliance verification, and secure development practices. Runs SAST/DAST scans, generates CVE remediation plans, checks dependency vulnerabilities, creates security policies, enforces secure coding patterns, and automates compliance checks against SOC2, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, and GDPR. Use when conducting a security review or audit, responding to a CVE or security incident, hardening infrastructure, implementing authentication or secrets management, running penetration test prep, checking OWASP Top 10 exposure, or enforcing security controls in CI/CD pipelines.
subTools.description_zh: 應用程式安全、漏洞管理、合規驗證和安全開發實踐的資深 SecOps 工程師技巧。執行 SAST／DAST 掃描、產生 CVE 修復計畫、檢查相依性漏洞、建立安全政策、強制執行安全編碼模式，並自動化針對 SOC2、PCI-DSS、HIPAA 和 GDPR 的合規檢查。用於進行安全審查。

subTools.name: Senior Security
subTools.description: Use when the user asks for STRIDE threat modeling, DREAD risk scoring, data-flow-diagram threat analysis, or a quick secret scan — or when a security request needs routing to the right specialist skill (pen-testing, incident response, cloud posture, red team, AI security, threat hunting, secure code review). This skill owns threat modeling; everything else routes to a sibling.
subTools.description_zh: 用於 STRIDE 威脅建模、DREAD 風險評分、資料流圖威脅分析，或快速掃描資安機密——或當安全需求需要路由至正確的專門技巧（滲透測試、事件回應、雲端姿態、紅隊、AI 安全、威脅獵殺、安全程式碼審查）。此技巧負責威脅 modeling；其他需求會路由至同層級的其他技巧。

subTools.name: Stripe Integration Expert
subTools.description: Production-grade Stripe integrations: subscriptions with trials and proration, one-time payments, usage-based billing, checkout sessions, idempotent webhook handlers, customer portal, and invoicing. Covers Next.js, Express, and Django patterns. Use when integrating Stripe for the first time, debugging webhook reliability issues, migrating from a different payment provider, or adding usage-based billing to an existing subscription product.
subTools.description_zh: 生產級 Stripe 整合：含試期和價差調整的訂閱、一次性付款、用量計費、Checkout 工作階段、冪等 webhook 處理程式、客戶入口網站和發票。涵蓋 Next.js、Express 和 Django 模式。用於首次整合 Stripe、除錯 webhook 可靠性問題、從其他付費提供者遷移，或加入用量計費。

subTools.name: Tdd Guide
subTools.description: Test-driven development skill for writing unit tests, generating test fixtures and mocks, analyzing coverage gaps, and guiding red-green-refactor workflows across Jest, Pytest, JUnit, Vitest, and Mocha. Use when the user asks to write tests, improve test coverage, practice TDD, generate mocks or stubs, or mentions testing frameworks like Jest, pytest, or JUnit.
subTools.description_zh: 測試驅動開發技能，用於撰寫單元測試、產生測試 fixtures 與 mocks、分析覆蓋率缺口，並引導紅綠重構工作流程，適用於 Jest、Pytest、JUnit、Vitest 和 Mocha。使用者詢問撰寫測試、提升覆蓋率、練習 TDD、產生 mocks 或 stubs，或提及測試框架時使用。

subTools.name: Tech Stack Evaluator
subTools.description: Technology stack evaluation and comparison with TCO analysis, security assessment, and ecosystem health scoring. Use when comparing frameworks, evaluating technology stacks, calculating total cost of ownership, assessing migration paths, or analyzing ecosystem viability.
subTools.description_zh: 進行技術棧評估與比較，包含 TCO 分析、安全性評估與生態系健康評分。適用於比較框架、評估技術棧、計算總擁有成本、評估遷移路徑，或分析生態系可行性時使用。

subTools.name: Threat Detection
subTools.description: Use when hunting for threats in an environment, analyzing IOCs, or detecting behavioral anomalies in telemetry. Covers hypothesis-driven threat hunting, IOC sweep generation, z-score anomaly detection, and MITRE ATT&CK-mapped signal prioritization.
subTools.description_zh: 用於環境中的威脅獵捕、分析 IOCs，或偵測遙測資料中的行為異常。涵蓋假設驅動的威脅獵捕、IOC 掃瞄產生、z-score 異常偵測，以及 MITRE ATT&CK 對應的訊號優先排序。

subTools.name: Snowflake Development
subTools.description: Use when writing Snowflake SQL, building data pipelines with Dynamic Tables or Streams/Tasks, using Cortex AI functions, creating Cortex Agents, writing Snowpark Python, configuring dbt for Snowflake, or troubleshooting Snowflake errors.
subTools.description_zh: 用於撰寫 Snowflake SQL、使用 Dynamic Tables 或 Streams/Tasks 建構資料管線、使用 Cortex AI 函數、建立 Cortex Agents、撰寫 Snowpark Python、為 Snowflake 設定 dbt，或除錯 Snowflake 錯誤時使用。

subTools.name: Business Investment Advisor
subTools.description: Business investment analysis and capital allocation advisor. Use when evaluating whether to invest in equipment, real estate, a new business, hiring, technology, or any capital expenditure. Also use for ROI calculations, IRR, NPV, payback period, build vs buy decisions, lease vs buy analysis, vendor evaluation, or deciding where to allocate limited budget for maximum return.
subTools.description_zh: 商業投資分析與資本配置顧問。用於評估是否投資設備、房地產、新事業、人力、技術或任何資本支出。也可用於計算投資報酬率、內部報酬率、淨現值、回收期，以及自行開發或購買決策、租賃或購買分析、供應商評估，或決定如何配置有限預算以實現最大回報。

subTools.name: Finance Skills
subTools.description: Router/index for the 2 finance skills bundled in this plugin: financial-analyst (ratio analysis, DCF valuation, budget variance, rolling forecasts) and saas-metrics-coach (ARR/MRR, churn, CAC/LTV, NRR, quick ratio). Use when a finance request doesn't obviously match one skill and you need to pick the right one (e.g., 'analyze these financials', 'how healthy are my SaaS metrics').
subTools.description_zh: 本外掛包含的兩個財務技能的路由／索引：財務分析師（比率分析、DCF 估值、預算差異、滾動預測）與 SaaS 指標教練（ARR/MRR、流失率、CAC/LTV、NRR、快速比率）。當財務請求無法明顯對應單一技能，且需要選擇正確技能時使用（例如「分析這些財務報表」、「我的 SaaS 指標健康嗎」）。

subTools.name: Financial Analyst
subTools.description: Performs financial ratio analysis, DCF valuation, budget variance analysis, and rolling forecast construction for strategic decision-making. Use when analyzing financial statements, building valuation models, assessing budget variances, or constructing financial projections and forecasts. Also applicable when users mention financial modeling, cash flow analysis, company valuation, financial projections, or spreadsheet analysis.
subTools.description_zh: 執行財務比率分析、DCF 估值、預算差異分析與滾動預測建構，以支援策略決策。用於分析財務報表、建立估值模型、評估預算差異，或建構財務預測與預估。也可適用於使用者提及財務模型、現金流分析、公司估值、財務預測等情境。

subTools.name: Saas Metrics Coach
subTools.description: SaaS financial health advisor. Use when a user shares revenue or customer numbers, or mentions ARR, MRR, churn, LTV, CAC, NRR, or asks how their SaaS business is doing.
subTools.description_zh: SaaS 財務健康顧問。用於使用者分享營收或客戶數字，或提及 ARR、MRR、流失率、LTV、CAC、NRR，或詢問其 SaaS 業務狀況時。

subTools.name: Loop Library
subTools.description: Discover, find, compare, audit, repair, adapt, and design repeatable AI-agent loops with explicit triggers, actions, verification, stopping conditions, guardrails, and handoffs. Use when a user asks to analyze a codebase for potential loops, mine coding-thread history for work done more than once, turn repeated engineering work into a loop, find or recommend a published loop, create a recurring agent workflow or automation cadence, turn an outcome into a bounded copy-ready loop, or review an existing loop for weak checks, unsafe authority, unbounded repetition, stale state, or unclear stopping behavior.
subTools.description_zh: 發現、找出、比較、稽核、修復、調整及設計可重複的 AI 代理循環，包含明確觸發條件、動作、驗證、停止條件、防護措施與交接機制。當使用者要求分析程式庫中的潛在循環、從編寫歷程中找出重複工作，或將重複工程轉為循環時使用。

subTools.name: Design System
subTools.description: Captures the user's brand identity once via a 10-question onboarding wizard (primary/accent HEX + heading + body Google Fonts + design style editorial/technical/minimal/playful + default output directory + syntax theme + TOC behavior + optional logo/company), validates body-text and link contrast against WCAG 2.2 AA, derives 12 CSS custom properties in HSL space, and stores the result for every markdown-html converter to consume. Use before any markdown-html conversion. Triggers on first-run onboarding ("set up the brand", "configure markdown-html", "run onboarding"), on explicit reset ("reset the design system", "re-onboard"), and is checked by every converter via config_loader.py before rendering. Refuses to save if body-text contrast fails AA 4.5:1 or the output dir isn't writable. Precedence: project (./.markdown-html/) > global (~/.config/markdown-html/) > built-in defaults; MARKDOWN_HTML_NO_CONFIG=1 bypasses.
subTools.description_zh: 透過 10 題入門Wizard 記錄使用者品牌識別（主要/強調色 HEX、標題與內文字型、設計風格、輸出目錄、語法主題、目錄行為等），依據 WCAG 2.2 AA 驗證對比度，衍生 12 個 HSL CSS 自訂屬性並儲存，供後續生成使用。

subTools.name: Markdown Html Orchestrator
subTools.description: Use when a user wants to convert any markdown file in their Claude project into a single-file, lightly-interactive HTML — long-form documents (specs, plans, RFCs, reports, explainers), code reviews with diffs and severity-tagged annotations, or slide decks. Triggers on "convert this markdown to HTML", "make this an HTML file", "turn this into an interactive document", "render this report as HTML", "PR writeup as HTML", "slides from this markdown". Forks context to route to one of three converter sub-skills (md-document, md-review, md-slides) based on a deterministic doctype classifier, after the user has run the design-system onboarding once. Refuses if input is under 100 lines (per Shihipar — markdown still wins below the threshold) or design-system isn't onboarded. Distinct from Anthropic's official Playground plugin (which is interactive prompt-tuning controls with sliders/knobs/prompt-copy-back) and from marketing/landing/ (which is a landing-page generator).
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者要求將專案中的 Markdown 檔案轉換為單頁輕互動式 HTML 時使用，適用於規格書、計畫、RFC、報告、程式碼審查或投影片等。觸發語句包括「轉成 HTML」「做出 HTML 檔案」等。

subTools.name: Md Document
subTools.description: Converts long-form markdown (specs, RFCs, reports, plans, explainers) into a single-file, lightly-interactive HTML document with sticky TOC, scrollspy, search filter, code-copy buttons, and design-system-driven brand tokens. Triggers when the markdown-html-orchestrator classifies an input as DOCUMENT, or when invoked directly via /cs:md-document. Reads the design-system config via config_loader.py and inlines the user's 12 derived CSS custom properties; refuses to render if onboarding hasn't run. Single-file output — Google Fonts + Prism.js CDN are the only externals; no framework runtime, no build step. Use after orchestrator routing or after design-system onboarding is confirmed.
subTools.description_zh: 將長篇 Markdown 文件（規格、RFC、報告、計畫）轉換為單頁輕互動式 HTML，具備懸浮目錄、滾動偵測、搜尋篩選與程式碼複製按鈕，並套用設計系統品牌色彩。由編排器分類觸發或直接呼叫使用。

subTools.name: Md Review
subTools.description: Converts a markdown PR writeup or code review (one with ```diff fenced blocks and severity-tagged > [!BLOCKER]/[!MAJOR]/[!MINOR]/[!NIT] callouts) into a single-file 2-column HTML review — unified-diff on the left, severity-tagged annotation cards on the right, top jump-nav listing every finding, mandatory named reviewer footer. Triggers when the markdown-html-orchestrator classifies an input as REVIEW, or when invoked directly via /cs:md-review. Refuses without explicit --reviewer (a code review must name a human), refuses if no diff hunks present (route to md-document instead), and refuses to encode severity in color only (every badge ships color + icon + aria-label per WCAG 1.4.1). Use after orchestrator routing.
subTools.description_zh: 將包含 ```diff 程式碼塊與嚴重性標籤註解的 markdown PR 說明或程式碼檢視，轉換為單檔 2欄 HTML 檢視——左側 unified-diff，右側嚴重性標籤註解卡片，頂部跳躍導航列出所有發現，底部強制 reviewer 署名。輸入經 markdown-html-orchestrator 分類為 RE 時觸發。

subTools.name: Md Slides
subTools.description: Converts a markdown deck (slides separated by `
subTools.description_zh: 將以 `---` 分隔的 markdown 簡報稿轉換為單檔 HTML 投影片，支援頁面導覽、鍵盤翻頁、簡報模式。

subTools.name: Landing
subTools.description: Generates a premium single-page HTML landing page with 3D CSS animations, GSAP scroll effects, and mouse-parallax depth. Forcing intake (product + elevator pitch, audience register, brand overrides, tone) locks down positioning before any copy or markup is written, so the page reflects the actual product rather than generic boilerplate. Use whenever the user says 'landing for X', 'create a landing page', 'build a landing page', 'make a landing page for X', 'I need a web page for Y', or provides product/service details and wants a polished website. Also triggers on 'promotional page', 'product page', 'one-pager', 'web presence', 'sales page'. Outputs a single self-contained HTML file (Claude Code) or HTML artifact (Claude.ai). Supports configurable brand colors via CSS custom property overrides.
subTools.description_zh: 產出高品質單頁 HTML Landing 頁，含 3D CSS 動畫、GSAP 捲動效果與滑鼠視差深層效果。強制先取得產品說明、電梯簡報、目標客群與品牌設定，再撰寫文案與排版，確保頁面反映真實產品而非通用樣板。使用者提到「landing for X」或「建立 landing」時使用。

subTools.name: Ab Test Setup
subTools.description: When the user wants to plan, design, or implement an A/B test or experiment. Also use when the user mentions "A/B test," "split test," "experiment," "test this change," "variant copy," "multivariate test," "hypothesis," "conversion experiment," "statistical significance," or "test this." For tracking implementation, see analytics-tracking.
subTools.description_zh: 使用者希望規劃、設計或實作 A/B 測試或實驗時使用。提及「A/B test」、「split test」、「experiment」、「test this change」、「variant copy」、「multivariate test」、「hypothesis」、「conversion experiment」、「statistical significance」或「test this」時觸發。追蹤實作請見 analytics-tracking。

subTools.name: Ad Creative
subTools.description: When the user needs to generate, iterate, or scale ad creative for paid advertising. Use when they say 'write ad copy,' 'generate headlines,' 'create ad variations,' 'bulk creative,' 'iterate on ads,' 'ad copy validation,' 'RSA headlines,' 'Meta ad copy,' 'LinkedIn ad,' or 'creative testing.' This is pure creative production — distinct from paid-ads (campaign strategy). Use ad-creative when you need the copy, not the campaign plan.
subTools.description_zh: 用於產生、迭代或大規模製作付費廣告的創意素材。當使用者提到撰寫廣告文案、產生標題、建立廣告變體、批量創意、RSA 標題、Meta 廣告、LinkedIn 廣告或創意測試時使用。純創意製作，與廣告活動策略不同。

subTools.name: Aeo
subTools.description: Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) skill — optimize content to be cited by AI language models (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Mistral) as authoritative sources. Distinct from SEO — AEO optimizes for citation in LLM-generated responses, not search rankings. Use when planning content for AI-first search audiences, auditing existing content for E-E-A-T signals, tracking which pages get cited by which LLMs, or building a citation-friendly content strategy. Triggers — 'AEO audit', 'optimize for ChatGPT', 'get cited by Perplexity', 'LLM citation strategy', 'answer engine optimization', 'content for AI search', 'E-E-A-T audit'. Output is a markdown audit report (default) or JSON for pipeline integration. Stdlib-only Python tools.
subTools.description_zh: 答案引擎最佳化（AEO）技能 — 優化內容使其能被 AI 語言模型（ChatGPT、Perplexity、Claude、Gemini、Mistral）引用為權威來源。與 SEO 不同：AEO 著重於在 LLM 生成回應中的引用，而非搜尋排名。適用於規劃 AI 優先搜尋受眾的內容。

subTools.name: Analytics Tracking
subTools.description: Set up, audit, and debug analytics tracking implementation — GA4, Google Tag Manager, event taxonomy, conversion tracking, and data quality. Use when building a tracking plan from scratch, auditing existing analytics for gaps or errors, debugging missing events, or setting up GTM. Trigger keywords: GA4 setup, Google Tag Manager, GTM, event tracking, analytics implementation, conversion tracking, tracking plan, event taxonomy, custom dimensions, UTM tracking, analytics audit, missing events, tracking broken. NOT for analyzing marketing campaign data — use campaign-analytics for that. NOT for BI dashboards — use product-analytics for in-product event analysis.
subTools.description_zh: 設定、稽核與除錯分析追蹤實作，涵蓋 GA4、Google Tag Manager、事件分類、轉換追蹤與資料品質。適用於從零開始建立追蹤計畫、稽核現有分析資料缺口或錯誤、除錯遺漏事件，或設定 GTM。觸發關鍵字：GA4 設定、Google Tag Manager、事件追蹤、轉換追蹤。

subTools.name: App Store Optimization
subTools.description: App Store Optimization (ASO) toolkit for researching keywords, analyzing competitor rankings, generating metadata suggestions, and improving app visibility on Apple App Store and Google Play Store. Use when the user asks about ASO, app store rankings, app metadata, app titles and descriptions, app store listings, app visibility, or mobile app marketing on iOS or Android. Supports keyword research and scoring, competitor keyword analysis, metadata optimization, A/B test planning, launch checklists, and tracking ranking changes.
subTools.description_zh: App Store Optimization（ASO）工具組，用於研究關鍵字、分析競爭對手排名、產生元資料建議，並提升在 Apple App Store 與 Google Play Store 的應用程式能見度。當使用者詢問 ASO、應用程式商店排名、元資料、標題描述或 iOS/Android 行動應用行銷時使用。

subTools.name: Brand Guidelines
subTools.description: When the user wants to apply, document, or enforce brand guidelines for any product or company. Also use when the user mentions 'brand guidelines,' 'brand colors,' 'typography,' 'logo usage,' 'brand voice,' 'visual identity,' 'tone of voice,' 'brand standards,' 'style guide,' 'brand consistency,' or 'company design standards.' Covers color systems, typography, logo rules, imagery guidelines, and tone matrix for any brand — including Anthropic's official identity.
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者希望套用、文件或執行產品或公司的品牌指南時使用。也適用於提及品牌色彩、字型排版、商標使用、品牌語氣、視覺識別、品牌一致性或公司設計標準等情境。涵蓋色彩系統、字型、商標規範、影像指南與音調指引。

subTools.name: Campaign Analytics
subTools.description: Analyzes campaign performance with multi-touch attribution, funnel conversion analysis, and ROI calculation for marketing optimization. Use when analyzing marketing campaigns, ad performance, attribution models, conversion rates, or calculating marketing ROI, ROAS, CPA, and campaign metrics across channels.
subTools.description_zh: 運用多觸點歸因、漏斗轉換分析與 ROI 計算，分析活動績效以優化行銷。適用於分析行銷活動、廣告效能、歸因模型、轉換率，或跨管道計算行銷 ROI、ROAS、CPA 與活動指標。

subTools.name: Churn Prevention
subTools.description: Reduce voluntary and involuntary churn through cancel flow design, save offers, exit surveys, and dunning sequences. Use when designing or optimizing a cancel flow, building save offers, setting up dunning emails, or reducing failed-payment churn. Trigger keywords: cancel flow, churn reduction, save offers, dunning, exit survey, payment recovery, win-back, involuntary churn, failed payments, cancel page. NOT for customer health scoring or expansion revenue — use customer-success-manager for that.
subTools.description_zh: 透過取消流程設計、挽留優惠、退出問卷與催款序列，降低自願性與非自願性流失。適用於設計或優化取消流程、建立挽留優惠、設定催款郵件，或減少付款失敗流失。觸發關鍵字：取消流程、流失降低、挽留優惠、催款、退出問卷、付款恢復、挽回、付款失敗。

subTools.name: Cold Email
subTools.description: When the user wants to write, improve, or build a sequence of B2B cold outreach emails to prospects who haven't asked to hear from them. Use when the user mentions 'cold email,' 'cold outreach,' 'prospecting emails,' 'SDR emails,' 'sales emails,' 'first touch email,' 'follow-up sequence,' or 'email prospecting.' Also use when they share an email draft that sounds too sales-y and needs to be humanized. Distinct from email-sequence (lifecycle/nurture to opted-in subscribers) — this is unsolicited outreach to new prospects. NOT for lifecycle emails, newsletters, or drip campaigns (use email-sequence).
subTools.description_zh: 用於撰寫、改進或建立 B2B 冷呼叫外展電子郵件序列，對象為未主動要求接收訊息的潛在客戶。適用於提及冷呼叫、冷外展、開發郵件、SDR 郵件、銷售郵件、首次接觸、跟進序列或郵件開發。當使用者分享過於推銷感的草稿並需要人性化調整時也使用。

subTools.name: Competitor Alternatives
subTools.description: When the user wants to create competitor comparison or alternative pages for SEO and sales enablement. Also use when the user mentions 'alternative page,' 'vs page,' 'competitor comparison,' 'comparison page,' '[Product] vs [Product],' '[Product] alternative,' 'competitive landing pages,' 'switch from competitor,' or 'comparison content.' Covers four formats: singular alternative, plural alternatives, you vs competitor, and competitor vs competitor. Emphasizes deep research, modular content architecture, and varied section types beyond feature tables.
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者想建立競爭對手比較或替代方案頁面，用於 SEO 和銷售賦能。也適用於提到「替代方案頁面」、「vs 頁面」、「競爭對手比較」等情境。涵蓋四種格式：單數替代方案、複數替代方案等。

subTools.name: Content Creator
subTools.description: Deprecated redirect skill that routes legacy 'content creator' requests to the correct specialist. Use when a user invokes 'content creator', asks to write a blog post, article, guide, or brand voice analysis (routes to content-production), or asks to plan content, build a topic cluster, or create a content calendar (routes to content-strategy). Does not handle requests directly — identifies user intent and redirects to content-production for writing/SEO/brand-voice tasks or content-strategy for planning tasks.
subTools.description_zh: 已淘汰的轉接技能，將舊版「內容創作人」請求導向正確專家。當使用者呼叫「內容創作人」、撰寫部落格文章或品牌語氣分析（轉至內容生產），或規劃內容、建立主題叢集（轉至內容策略）時使用。不直接處理請求，僅負責識別使用者意圖。

subTools.name: Content Humanizer
subTools.description: Makes AI-generated content sound genuinely human — not just cleaned up, but alive. Use when content feels robotic, uses too many AI clichés, lacks personality, or reads like it was written by committee. Triggers: 'this sounds like AI', 'make it more human', 'add personality', 'it feels generic', 'sounds robotic', 'fix AI writing', 'inject our voice'. NOT for initial content creation (use content-production). NOT for SEO optimization (use content-production Mode 3).
subTools.description_zh: 讓 AI 生成內容聽起來真正像人寫的——不只是潤飾，而是有生命力。適用於內容感覺機械、使用太多 AI 套語、缺乏個性，或讀起來像委員會撰寫。觸發條件：「這聽起來像 AI」、「讓它更像人」等。不適用於初始內容創作。

subTools.name: Content Production
subTools.description: Full content production pipeline — takes a topic from blank page to published-ready piece. Use when you need to execute content: write a blog post, article, or guide end-to-end. Triggers: 'write a post about', 'draft an article', 'create content for', 'help me write', 'I need a blog post'. NOT for content strategy or calendar planning (use content-strategy). NOT for repurposing existing content (use content-repurposing). NOT for social captions only.
subTools.description_zh: 完整內容生產流程——從空白頁到發布-ready 成品。適用於執行內容：撰寫部落格文章、文章或指南。觸發條件：「寫一篇關於...」、「起草文章」等。不適用於內容策略或日曆規劃（請用 content-strategy）。不適用於再利用現有內容。

subTools.name: Content Strategy
subTools.description: When the user wants to plan a content strategy, decide what content to create, or figure out what topics to cover. Also use when the user mentions \"content strategy,\" \"what should I write about,\" \"content ideas,\" \"blog strategy,\" \"topic clusters,\" or \"content planning.\" For writing individual pieces, see copywriting. For SEO-specific audits, see seo-audit.
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者想規劃內容策略、決定要創作什麼內容，或研究要涵蓋哪些主題。也適用於提到「內容策略」、「我該寫什麼」、「內容點子」、「部落格策略」、「主題叢集」等情境。撰寫單篇文章請見文案編輯。SEO 專屬審查請見 seo-audit。

subTools.name: Copy Editing
subTools.description: When the user wants to edit, review, or improve existing marketing copy. Also use when the user mentions 'edit this copy,' 'review my copy,' 'copy feedback,' 'proofread,' 'polish this,' 'make this better,' or 'copy sweep.' This skill provides a systematic approach to editing marketing copy through multiple focused passes.
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者想編輯、檢視或改進現有行銷文案。也適用於提到「編輯這文案」、「檢視我的文案」、「文案回饋」、「校對」、「潤飾這文案」等情境。本技能提供系統化方式，透過多次專注階段來編輯行銷文案。

subTools.name: Copywriting
subTools.description: When the user wants to write, rewrite, or improve marketing copy for any page — including homepage, landing pages, pricing pages, feature pages, about pages, or product pages. Also use when the user says \"write copy for,\" \"improve this copy,\" \"rewrite this page,\" \"marketing copy,\" \"headline help,\" or \"CTA copy.\" For email copy, see email-sequence. For popup copy, see popup-cro.
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者想撰寫、改寫或改進任何頁面的行銷文案，包括首頁、登陸頁面、定價頁面、功能頁面、關於頁面或產品頁面。也適用於提到「為...撰寫文案」、「改進這文案」、「改寫這頁面」等情境。電子郵件文案請見 email-sequence。pop-up 文案請見 popup-cro。

subTools.name: Email Sequence
subTools.description: When the user wants to create or optimize an email sequence, drip campaign, automated email flow, or lifecycle email program. Also use when the user mentions "email sequence," "drip campaign," "nurture sequence," "onboarding emails," "welcome sequence," "re-engagement emails," "email automation," or "lifecycle emails." For in-app onboarding, see onboarding-cro.
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者想建立或優化電子郵件序列、延遲郵件活動、自動化郵件流程或生命週期郵件方案。也適用於提到「電子郵件序列」、「延遲郵件活動」、「培育序列」、「新人郵件」等情境。App 內新手引導請見 onboarding-cro。

subTools.name: Form Cro
subTools.description: When the user wants to optimize any form that is NOT signup/registration — including lead capture forms, contact forms, demo request forms, application forms, survey forms, or checkout forms. Also use when the user mentions "form optimization," "lead form conversions," "form friction," "form fields," "form completion rate," or "contact form." For signup/registration forms, see signup-flow-cro. For popups containing forms, see popup-cro.
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者想要最佳化非註冊類型的表單時使用，包括潛在客戶收集表單、聯絡表單、示範申請表、申請表、問卷或結帳表單。當使用者提及「表單最佳化」、「潛在客戶表單轉換率」、「表單阻力」、「表單欄位」或「聯絡表單」時也適用。註冊表單請參見 signup-flow-cro。

subTools.name: Free Tool Strategy
subTools.description: When the user wants to build a free tool for marketing — lead generation, SEO value, or brand awareness. Use when they mention 'engineering as marketing,' 'free tool,' 'calculator,' 'generator,' 'checker,' 'grader,' 'marketing tool,' 'lead gen tool,' 'build something for traffic,' 'interactive tool,' or 'free resource.' Covers idea evaluation, tool design, and launch strategy. For pure SEO content strategy (no tool), use seo-audit or content-strategy instead.
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者想用免費工具進行行銷，用於產生潛在客戶、提升 SEO 價值或品牌能見度時使用。適用於提及「工程即行銷」、「免費工具」、「計算機」、「產生器」、「檢查器」等情境。涵蓋創意評估、工具設計與發布策略。純 SEO 內容請參考其他技能。

subTools.name: Launch Strategy
subTools.description: When the user wants to plan a product launch, feature announcement, or release strategy. Also use when the user mentions 'launch,' 'Product Hunt,' 'feature release,' 'announcement,' 'go-to-market,' 'beta launch,' 'early access,' 'waitlist,' 'product update,' 'GTM plan,' 'launch checklist,' or 'launch momentum.' This skill covers phased launches, channel strategy, and ongoing launch momentum.
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者想要規劃產品發布、功能公告或發售策略時使用。當提及「發布」、「Product Hunt」、「功能發布」、「公告」、「上市計畫」、「 Beta 發布」、「早鳥-access」、「候名單」時也適用。此技能涵蓋分階段發布、管道策略與持續發布動能。

subTools.name: Local Seo Manager
subTools.description: Manage local SEO for service-area businesses — appliance repair, HVAC, plumbing, cleaning, and any business that serves customers at their location. Use when the user wants to: audit Google Business Profile, generate neighborhood service area pages, check NAP consistency across directories, create LocalBusiness schema, or write review responses. Triggers: 'local SEO', 'Google Business Profile', 'GBP', 'service area page', 'NAP consistency', 'local citations', 'LocalBusiness schema', 'review responses', 'Google Maps ranking'. NOT for national SEO (use seo-audit). NOT for general schema (use schema-markup). NOT for AI answer-engine visibility (use aeo).
subTools.description_zh: 為服務特定區域的企業管理在地 SEO，如電器維修、暖通空調、水管、清潔等業務。當使用者需要審核 Google 商業資料、產生 Neighborhood 服務範圍頁面、檢查 NAP 一致性、建立 LocalBusiness schema 或撰寫評論回應時使用。觸發詞：'local SEO'、'Google Business Profile'、'G'。

subTools.name: Marketing Context
subTools.description: Create and maintain the marketing context document that all marketing skills read before starting. Use when the user mentions 'marketing context,' 'brand voice,' 'set up context,' 'target audience,' 'ICP,' 'style guide,' 'who is my customer,' 'positioning,' or wants to avoid repeating foundational information across marketing tasks. Run this at the start of any new project before using other marketing skills.
subTools.description_zh: 建立並維護所有行銷技能在開始前都會讀取的行銷脈絡檔案。當使用者提及「行銷脈絡」、「品牌語調」、「設定脈絡」、「目標受眾」、「ICP」、「風格指南」或想了解「我的客戶是誰」時使用。建議在新專案開始時優先執行，避免在各行銷任務中重複基礎資訊。

subTools.name: Marketing Demand Acquisition
subTools.description: Creates demand generation campaigns, optimizes paid ad spend across LinkedIn, Google, and Meta, develops SEO strategies, and structures partnership programs. Use when planning demand gen strategy, growth marketing, advertising campaigns, PPC optimization, lead generation, pipeline generation, or marketing budgets. Covers multi-channel acquisition (Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Meta Ads), CAC analysis, MQL/SQL workflows, attribution modeling, technical SEO, and co-marketing partnerships. Default calibration profile is a Series A+ B2B SaaS scaling internationally (EU/US/Canada, hybrid PLG/Sales-Led) — adapt benchmarks for other stages and motions rather than skipping the skill.
subTools.description_zh: 建立需求產生Campaign，最佳化 Google、LinkedIn 與 Meta 上的付費廣告預算，制定 SEO 策略與合作計畫。適用於規劃需求產生策略、成長行銷、廣告Campaign、PPC 最佳化、潛在客戶產生或行銷預算。涵蓋多渠道取得（Google Ads、LinkedIn Ads、Meta Ads）與 CAC 分析。

subTools.name: Marketing Ideas
subTools.description: When the user needs marketing ideas, inspiration, or strategies for their SaaS or software product. Also use when the user asks for 'marketing ideas,' 'growth ideas,' 'how to market,' 'marketing strategies,' 'marketing tactics,' 'ways to promote,' or 'ideas to grow.' This skill provides 139 proven marketing approaches organized by category.
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者需要 SaaS 或軟體產品的行銷點子、靈感或策略時使用。也適用於詢問「行銷點子」、「成長點子」、「如何行銷」等情境。此技能提供 139 種經過驗證的行銷方法，按類別分類整理。

subTools.name: Marketing Ops
subTools.description: Central router for the marketing skill ecosystem. Use when unsure which marketing skill to use, when orchestrating a multi-skill campaign, or when coordinating across content, SEO, CRO, channels, and analytics. Also use when the user mentions 'marketing help,' 'campaign plan,' 'what should I do next,' 'marketing priorities,' or 'coordinate marketing.'
subTools.description_zh: 行銷技能生態系的中央路由。當不確定應使用哪個行銷技能、協調多技能 Campaign，或需要跨內容、SEO、CRO、管道與分析進行協調時使用。當使用者提及「行銷協助」、「Campaign 計畫」或「行銷優先順序」時也適用。

subTools.name: Marketing Psychology
subTools.description: When the user wants to apply psychological principles, mental models, or behavioral science to marketing. Also use when the user mentions 'psychology,' 'mental models,' 'cognitive bias,' 'persuasion,' 'behavioral science,' 'why people buy,' 'decision-making,' or 'consumer behavior.' This skill provides 70+ mental models organized for marketing application.
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者希望將心理學原理、心智模型或行為科學應用於行銷時使用。也適用於提及「心理學」「心智模型」「認知偏差」「說服」「行為科學」「消費者決策」等情境。此 skill 提供超過 70 個針對行銷應用組織的心智模型。

subTools.name: Marketing Skills
subTools.description: Directory and router for the marketing skills library. Use when you need to find the right marketing skill for a task, see what marketing capabilities exist, or get oriented in this plugin. 44 specialist skills across 8 pods (content, SEO + AEO, CRO, channels, growth, intelligence, sales enablement, ops), 59 stdlib Python tools. Routes to one skill — it does not execute marketing work itself.
subTools.description_zh: 行銷技能函式庫的目錄與路由器。用於尋找適切的行銷 skill、檢視現有能力或快速上手本 plugin。涵蓋 8 大模組共 44 個專門 skill 與 59 個 Python 工具。路由至單一 skill，本身不執行行銷工作。

subTools.name: Marketing Strategy Pmm
subTools.description: Product marketing skill for positioning, GTM strategy, competitive intelligence, and product launches. Use when the user asks about product positioning, go-to-market planning, competitive analysis, target audience definition, ICP definition, market research, launch plans, or sales enablement. Covers April Dunford positioning, ICP definition, competitive battlecards, launch playbooks, and international market entry. Produces deliverables including positioning statements, battlecard documents, launch plans, and go-to-market strategies.
subTools.description_zh: 產品行銷 skill，涵蓋定位、GTM 策略、競爭情報與產品上市。適用於產品定位、市場進入規劃、競爭分析、目標受眾與 ICP 定義、市場研究、上市計畫或銷售賦能等需求。包含 April Dunford 定位法、競爭對戰卡與上市攻略。

subTools.name: Onboarding Cro
subTools.description: When the user wants to optimize post-signup onboarding, user activation, first-run experience, or time-to-value. Also use when the user mentions "onboarding flow," "activation rate," "user activation," "first-run experience," "empty states," "onboarding checklist," "aha moment," or "new user experience." For signup/registration optimization, see signup-flow-cro. For ongoing email sequences, see email-sequence.
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者希望優化註冊後的導用流程、使用者活化、首次使用體驗或價值實現時間。也適用於提及「導用流程」「活化率」「首次使用體驗」「空狀態」「導用清單」「Aha 時刻」等情境。註冊/登入優化請見 signup-flow-cro；持續性 Email 序列請見 em。

subTools.name: Page Cro
subTools.description: When the user wants to optimize, improve, or increase conversions on any marketing page — including homepage, landing pages, pricing pages, feature pages, or blog posts. Also use when the user says "CRO," "conversion rate optimization," "this page isn't converting," "improve conversions," or "why isn't this page working." For signup/registration flows, see signup-flow-cro. For post-signup activation, see onboarding-cro. For forms outside of signup, see form-cro. For popups/modals, see popup-cro.
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者希望最佳化或提升任何行銷頁面（包含首頁、登陸頁面、定價頁面、功能頁面或部落格文章）的轉換率時使用。當使用者提到「CRO」、「轉換率最佳化」、「此頁面轉換不佳」、「提升轉換」或「此頁面為何無法運作」時亦可使用。若為註冊流程，請參考 signup-flow-cro；若為註冊後啟動，請參考 post-signup-activation。

subTools.name: Paid Ads
subTools.description: When the user wants help with paid advertising campaigns on Google Ads, Meta (Facebook/Instagram), LinkedIn, Twitter/X, or other ad platforms. Also use when the user mentions 'PPC,' 'paid media,' 'ad copy,' 'ad creative,' 'ROAS,' 'CPA,' 'ad campaign,' 'retargeting,' or 'audience targeting.' This skill covers campaign strategy, ad creation, audience targeting, and optimization.
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者需要協助處理 Google Ads、Meta（Facebook／Instagram）、LinkedIn、Twitter／X 或其他廣告平台的付費廣告活動時使用。當使用者提到「PPC」、「付費媒體」、「廣告文案」、「廣告素材」、「ROAS」、「CPA」、「廣告活動」、「再行銷」或「受眾定位」時亦可使用。本技能涵蓋活動策略、廣告創作、受眾定位與最佳化。

subTools.name: Paywall Upgrade Cro
subTools.description: When the user wants to create or optimize in-app paywalls, upgrade screens, upsell modals, or feature gates. Also use when the user mentions "paywall," "upgrade screen," "upgrade modal," "upsell," "feature gate," "convert free to paid," "freemium conversion," "trial expiration screen," "limit reached screen," "plan upgrade prompt," or "in-app pricing." Distinct from public pricing pages (see page-cro) — this skill focuses on in-product upgrade moments where the user has already experienced value.
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者希望建立或最佳化應用內付費牆、升級畫面、附加銷售彈出視窗或功能門檻時使用。當使用者提到「付費牆」、「升級畫面」、「升級彈出視窗」、「附加銷售」、「功能門檻」、「免費轉付費」、「免費增值轉換」、「試用到期畫面」、「限制達到畫面」、「方案升級提示」或「應用內定價」時亦可使用。本技能與公開定價頁面不同（請參考 page-cro）。

subTools.name: Popup Cro
subTools.description: When the user wants to create or optimize popups, modals, overlays, slide-ins, or banners for conversion purposes. Also use when the user mentions "exit intent," "popup conversions," "modal optimization," "lead capture popup," "email popup," "announcement banner," or "overlay." For forms outside of popups, see form-cro. For general page conversion optimization, see page-cro.
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者希望建立或最佳化用於轉換目的的彈出視窗、模態視窗、覆蓋層、滑入區塊或橫幅時使用。當使用者提到「跳出意圖」、「彈出視窗轉換」、「模態最佳化」、「名單捕捉彈出視窗」、「電子郵件彈出視窗」、「公告橫幅」或「覆蓋層」時亦可使用。若為彈出視窗外的表單，請參考 form-cro；若為一般頁面轉換最佳化，請參考 page-cro。

subTools.name: Pricing Strategy
subTools.description: Design, optimize, and communicate SaaS pricing — tier structure, value metrics, pricing pages, and price increase strategy. Use when building a pricing model from scratch, redesigning existing pricing, planning a price increase, or improving a pricing page. Trigger keywords: pricing tiers, pricing page, price increase, packaging, value metric, per seat pricing, usage-based pricing, freemium, good-better-best, pricing strategy, monetization, pricing page conversion, Van Westendorp. NOT for broader product strategy — use product-strategist for that. NOT for customer success or renewals — use customer-success-manager for expansion revenue.
subTools.description_zh: 設計、優化並傳達 SaaS 定價——分層結構、價值指標、定價頁面與調價策略。適用從零建立、重新設計、規劃調漲或改善定價頁面。觸發詞：定價分層、按人頭計價、依用量計費、免費增值等。

subTools.name: Programmatic Seo
subTools.description: When the user wants to create SEO-driven pages at scale using templates and data. Also use when the user mentions "programmatic SEO," "template pages," "pages at scale," "directory pages," "location pages," "[keyword] + [city] pages," "comparison pages," "integration pages," or "building many pages for SEO." For auditing existing SEO issues, see seo-audit.
subTools.description_zh: 使用模板與資料大規模建立 SEO 導向網頁。觸發詞包含程式化 SEO、模板頁面、大規模建頁、目錄頁面、地點頁面、[關鍵字]+[城市] 頁面、比較頁面、整合頁面等。稽核現有 SEO 問題請參見 seo-audit。

subTools.name: Prompt Engineer Toolkit
subTools.description: Turns marketing prompts into tested, versioned production assets: A/B prompt evaluation against structured test cases, immutable prompt version history with diffs, ready-to-use marketing prompt templates (ad copy, email campaigns, social posts, landing pages, SEO meta), and an LLM-governance playbook for marketing teams (claim discipline, disclosure rules, human-review gates). Use when a marketing team relies on AI-generated content and needs prompt quality to be measurable and safe — or when the user mentions 'prompt engineering,' 'improve my prompts,' 'prompt templates,' 'prompt versioning,' 'AI content workflow,' or 'AI governance for marketing.'
subTools.description_zh: 將行銷提示轉化為經測試且可追溯版本的生產資產，提供 A/B 提示評估、版本歷史差異記錄、即用型提示範本（廣告、郵件、社群、落地頁、SEO 標頭），以及 LLM 治理手冊（聲明規範、揭露規則、人工審查閘門）。

subTools.name: Referral Program
subTools.description: When the user wants to design, launch, or optimize a referral or affiliate program. Use when they mention 'referral program,' 'affiliate program,' 'word of mouth,' 'refer a friend,' 'incentive program,' 'customer referrals,' 'brand ambassador,' 'partner program,' 'referral link,' or 'growth through referrals.' Covers program mechanics, incentive design, and optimization — not just the idea of referrals but the actual system.
subTools.description_zh: 設計、啟動或優化推薦與聯盟行銷方案。觸發詞含推薦方案、聯盟方案、口碑傳播、推薦好友、獎勵方案、品牌大使、合作夥伴方案等。涵蓋方案機制、獎勵設計與最佳化。

subTools.name: Schema Markup
subTools.description: When the user wants to implement, audit, or validate structured data (schema markup) on their website. Use when the user mentions 'structured data,' 'schema.org,' 'JSON-LD,' 'rich results,' 'rich snippets,' 'schema markup,' 'FAQ schema,' 'Product schema,' 'HowTo schema,' or 'structured data errors in Search Console.' Also use when someone asks why their content isn't showing rich results or wants to improve AI search visibility. NOT for general SEO audits (use seo-audit) or technical SEO crawl issues (use site-architecture).
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者希望實作、稽核或驗證網站上的結構化資料（schema markup）。適用情境包括提及「結構化資料」、「schema.org」、「JSON-LD」、「豐富結果」等相關關鍵詞。

subTools.name: Seo Audit
subTools.description: When the user wants to audit, review, or diagnose SEO issues on their site. Also use when the user mentions "SEO audit," "technical SEO," "why am I not ranking," "SEO issues," "on-page SEO," "meta tags review," or "SEO health check." For building pages at scale to target keywords, see programmatic-seo. For adding structured data, see schema-markup.
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者希望稽核、檢視或診斷網站的 SEO 問題。適用情境包括提及「SEO 稽核」、「技術 SEO」、「搜尋排名低落」、「頁面 SEO」、「語法標籤檢視」或「SEO 健康度檢查」。

subTools.name: Signup Flow Cro
subTools.description: When the user wants to optimize signup, registration, account creation, or trial activation flows. Also use when the user mentions "signup conversions," "registration friction," "signup form optimization," "free trial signup," "reduce signup dropoff," or "account creation flow." For post-signup onboarding, see onboarding-cro. For lead capture forms (not account creation), see form-cro.
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者希望最佳化註冊、建立帳戶或免費試用啟動流程。適用情境包括提及「註冊轉換率」、「註冊摩擦」、「表單最佳化」或「減少註冊流失率」。
