subTools.description_zh: 建立小紅書風格的封面圖片——色彩鮮豔、生活化，搭配適合中國社群平台的質感文字疊加效果。

subTools.name: Social Media Video
subTools.description: Brand-aware social media video creator. Reads brand-identity.md, ICP.md, and messaging.md to write a post/storyboard, craft an optimized Seedance 2.0 Director prompt, generate reference frames with the best available image model, and produce platform-ready video.
subTools.description_zh: 具備品牌意識的社群影片製作工具。讀取品牌識別、目標受眾與核心訊息檔案，撰寫貼文或腳本，編寫優化後的 Seedance 2.0 導向提示，以最佳影像模型生成參考幀，並產出可直接發布的影片。

subTools.name: Social Pack
subTools.description: Re-render a hero image into Instagram, TikTok, YouTube-shorts and Twitter/X aspect ratios.
subTools.description_zh: 將一張主題圖片重新裁切為 Instagram、TikTok、YouTube Shorts 和 Twitter/X 的適用比例。

subTools.name: Ugc Ads Workflow
subTools.description: Create a User-Generated Content (UGC) video ad by combining a human selfie and a product image, then generating a video script and an animated ad.
subTools.description_zh: 結合真人自拍與商品圖片，建立使用者生成內容（UGC）影片廣告，並生成影片腳本與動畫廣告。

subTools.name: Youtube Shorts
subTools.description: Auto-generate viral 9:16 YouTube Shorts (or TikTok / Reels clips) from a long-form video. Thin platform-aware wrapper around the AI Clipping skill — picks sensible defaults for short-form social platforms (9:16, 30–60s sweet spot) and delegates the actual highlight extraction + crop to muapi.ai's `/ai-clipping` endpoint.
subTools.description_zh: 自動從長影片生成病毒式傳播的9:16 YouTube Shorts（或TikTok／Reels片段）。作為AI Clipping技能的平台感知封裝，為短片社交平台選取合理的預設值（9:16比例、30–60秒最佳區間），並將實際的亮點提取與裁切工作委派給muapi.ai的`/ai-clipping`端點。

subTools.name: Action Figure Generator
subTools.description: Convert a photo of a person into a custom 3D action figure, complete with collectible toy packaging.
subTools.description_zh: 將人物照片轉化為客製化3D動作人偶，並包含收藏玩具包裝。

subTools.name: Ad Creative
subTools.description: Generate a high-converting ad creative set — hero image, ad copy variations, and platform-optimized crops for Meta, Google Display, and LinkedIn.
subTools.description_zh: 生成高轉換率的廣告創意組合——包含主視覺圖、廣告文案變體，以及針對Meta、Google Display和LinkedIn的平台最佳化裁切版本。

subTools.name: Amazon Product Listing
subTools.description: Generate a complete Amazon product listing image set — hero image, lifestyle shot, infographic with features, and comparison/detail closeups optimized for Amazon standards.
subTools.description_zh: 產生完整的Amazon商品上架圖片組合，包含主視覺圖、生活風格攝影、功能資訊圖表，以及符合Amazon標準的最佳化對比與細節特寫。

subTools.name: Blog Header
subTools.description: Create a professional, eye-catching blog post header image sized for web (1200×628) with optional title composition guidance.
subTools.description_zh: 建立專業、吸睛的部落格文章封面圖像（1200×628），可附加標題排版建議。

subTools.name: Brand Kit
subTools.description: Generate a cohesive brand visual kit — logo concept, color palette moodboard, and typography pairing suggestions.
subTools.description_zh: 產生完整品牌視覺套件——標誌概念、色彩配色情緒版與字體搭配建議。

subTools.name: Brochures
subTools.description: Generate a professional multi-page brochure design — cover, inner spread, and back cover — for business, real estate, events, or product launches.
subTools.description_zh: 產生專業多頁傳單設計——封面、內頁與封底，適用於企業、房產、活動或產品發布。

subTools.name: Chibi Collage Effect
subTools.description: Turn a real lifestyle photo into a polished "chibi clone sticker diary" image — the original person stays photorealistic, surrounded by 5–8 kawaii chibi mini-clones, scrapbook doodles, and handwritten-style captions that match the scene.
subTools.description_zh: 將真實生活照轉為精緻「Q版貼紙日記」風格影像——人物保持寫實，周圍環繞 5–8 個可愛 Q版小人、剪貼簿塗鴉與手寫風格說明文字。

subTools.name: Color Analysis Board
subTools.description: Turn a portrait photo into a high-end editorial "Color Analysis Board" in a luxury fashion-magazine style (Dior / Ralph Lauren aesthetic) — best colors, undertone, makeup guide, capsule wardrobe, hair & jewelry recommendations, all laid out on a clean beige/ivory grid.
subTools.description_zh: 將肖像照轉為高端編輯風格的「色彩分析板」——以奢華時尚雜誌風格呈現最佳色彩、膚色底調、彩妝指南、衣櫥建議與髮飾配搭，整齊排列於米白色網格上。

subTools.name: Couple Grid Creator
subTools.description: Create a stylized 6-box grid featuring a couple in various romantic poses and outfits, with each pose framed inside a unique cardboard box packaging.
subTools.description_zh: 建立風格化六格方格，展示情侶的多種浪漫姿勢與穿搭，每格皆以獨特紙箱包裝框圍呈現。

subTools.name: Design Guide
subTools.description: Create a comprehensive brand design guide — color palette, typography pairings, UI component previews, and visual identity rules with example mockups.
subTools.description_zh: 建立完整品牌設計指南——色彩配色、字體搭配、UI 元件預覽，以及附範例模擬圖的視覺識別規範。

subTools.name: Fashion Try On
subTools.description: Virtually try on different outfits by combining a person's photo and a clothing item, then optionally generate a professional fashion model video.
subTools.description_zh: 虛擬試穿不同穿搭——結合人物照片與服裝品，並可產出專業時尚模特兒影片。

subTools.name: Floor Plan Rendering
subTools.description: Design a 2D floor plan and convert it into a realistic, high-quality 3D architectural rendering.
subTools.description_zh: 設計 2D 平面圖，並轉換為逼真且高品質的 3D 建築渲染圖。

subTools.name: Interior Design
subTools.description: Create professional interior design visualizations — redesign existing rooms, generate new room concepts, or visualize specific furniture styles in a space.
subTools.description_zh: 創作專業的室內設計視覺化效果——重新設計現有空間、產生新房型概念，或在空間中呈現特定傢俱風格。

subTools.name: Interior Design Visualizer
subTools.description: Visualize interior design by generating an empty room and filling it with stylish furniture and decor, or by redesigning an existing room.
subTools.description_zh: 透過產生空屋並填入時尚傢俱與裝飾，或重新設計現有空間，來實現室內設計的視覺化。

subTools.name: Keyboard Art Maker
subTools.description: Generate artistic top-down photos of keyboard keycaps arranged to spell out custom text messages.
subTools.description_zh: 產生藝術性的鍵盤鍵帽俯拍照，將鍵帽排列拼出客製化文字訊息。

subTools.name: Logo Branding
subTools.description: Design a professional logo with full branding package — primary logo, variations (dark/light/icon-only), color palette, and real-world application mockups.
subTools.description_zh: 設計專業 Logo 並提供完整品牌企劃——主 Logo、多種變體（深色／淺色／純圖形）、色彩方案與真實應用場景模擬圖。

subTools.name: Logo Creator
subTools.description: Engineer professional-grade brand logos using geometric primitives and negative space — generates minimalist, scalable vector-style marks via muapi.ai
subTools.description_zh: 運用幾何基礎形狀與負空間，打造專業級品牌 Logo——透過 muapi.ai 產生極簡、可縮放的向量風格標誌。

subTools.name: Logo Generator
subTools.description: Quickly generate a single polished logo for any brand — fast, focused, single output with clean vector aesthetic and accurate brand name text.
subTools.description_zh: 快速為任何品牌產生單一精緻 Logo——快速聚焦、輸出乾淨的向量美學與精準的品牌名稱文字。

subTools.name: Multi Angle Reshoot
subTools.description: Re-render a subject or scene from multiple dramatic camera angles, such as fish-eye, bird's-eye, low-angle, and macro, while maintaining consistent identity and detail.
subTools.description_zh: 從多個戲劇性攝影角度重新渲染主體或場景，如魚眼、鳥瞰、低角度和微距，同時保持一致的identity與細節。

subTools.name: Multi Angle Shots
subTools.description: Generate a complete set of multi-angle product shots — front, side, back, top-down, and 45-degree perspective — for comprehensive product visualization.
subTools.description_zh: 生成完整的多角度產品攝影——正面、側面、背面、俯視、45度角視點——提供全面的產品視覺化。

subTools.name: Nano Banana
subTools.description: Reasoning-driven image generation using structured creative briefs (Gemini 3 style) — generates high-fidelity images via muapi.ai with logic-based prompting
subTools.description_zh: 透過結構化創意簡報（Gemini 3 風格）進行推理驅動影像生成——以邏輯提示方式，經 muapi.ai 產出高擬真圖像。

subTools.name: Photo Pack Generator
subTools.description: Generate a pack of professional or aesthetic photos from a single reference image while preserving the exact identity of the person.
subTools.description_zh: 從單張參考圖片產生一組專業或美觀的照片，並完整保留人物樣貌。

subTools.name: Selfie With Celebrities
subTools.description: Generate a realistic behind-the-scenes selfie of the user with a celebrity or main actor from a specific movie, followed by an option to generate a cinematic long-take video connecting multiple selfies.
subTools.description_zh: 生成您與名人或特定電影主角的寫實後台自拍照，並提供選項將多張自拍串接成電影感長鏡頭影片。

subTools.name: Storyboard
subTools.description: Generate N keyframes for a short story or scene sequence (image only, no video).
subTools.description_zh: 為短篇故事或場景序列產生 N 個關鍵幀（僅圖片，不含影片）。

subTools.name: Ui Design
subTools.description: Generate high-fidelity UI/UX mockups for mobile and web apps using Atomic Design principles — creates wireframes and design systems via muapi.ai
subTools.description_zh: 採用 Atomic Design 原則，為行動裝置與網頁應用產生高擬真 UI/UX 模型——透過 muapi.ai 建立線框圖與設計系統。

subTools.name: Url To Design
subTools.description: Analyze a website URL and generate a redesigned, improved UI — recreate the visual design with modern aesthetics, better hierarchy, and fresh brand direction.
subTools.description_zh: 分析網站網址並產出重新設計且改良的 UI——以現代美學、更好的層級與嶄新的品牌方向重建視覺設計。

subTools.name: Youtube Thumbnail
subTools.description: Design a high-CTR YouTube thumbnail — striking imagery, bold text placement, and emotional face/subject if needed.
subTools.description_zh: 設計高點擊率 YouTube 縮圖——搭配吸睛 imagery、大膽文字配置，以及在需要時加入具有情感張力的臉部或主體。

subTools.name: Workflow
subTools.description: Build, run, and visualize multi-step AI generation workflows. The AI architect translates natural language descriptions into connected node graphs — chain image generation, video creation, enhancement, and editing into automated pipelines.
subTools.description_zh: 建置、執行並可視化多步驟 AI 生成流程。AI 架構師將自然語言描述轉換為串接的節點圖表，將圖片生成、影片製作、增強與剪輯串成自動化管線。

tools.useCase: Generate high-quality visual and audio assets directly within AI coding environments like Claude Code or Cursor.
advantages: Supports multi-modal generation including images, video, and audio
Integrates with popular AI coding agents like Claude Code and Cursor
Leverages muapi.ai for high-quality content creation
negativeConstraints: Do not use for editing or manipulating existing media files
Not suitable for real-time video streaming or live rendering
Requires external API access via muapi.ai and is not fully offline
tools.description_zh: AI 代理技能，使用 muapi.ai 生成圖片、影片和音訊。
tools.useCase_zh: 直接在 Claude Code 或 Cursor 等 AI 程式設計環境中生成高品質視覺和音訊資產。
tools.advantages_zh: 支援多模態生成，包括圖片、影片和音訊，整合 Claude Code 和 Cursor 等熱門 AI 程式設計代理，運用 muapi.ai 進行高品質內容創作
negativeConstraints_zh: 勿用於編輯或操作現有媒體檔案。
不適用於即時影片串流或即時渲染。
需透過 muapi.ai 使用外部 API，非完全離線可用。

tools.name: Anime
tools.description: Lightweight JavaScript animation library for CSS, SVG, DOM, and JS objects.
tools.useCase: Ideal for adding smooth UI transitions, scroll-triggered effects, and interactive web page animations.
advantages: Unified API for animating CSS properties, SVG paths, DOM attributes, and JavaScript objects.
High performance with hardware-accelerated transforms and a minimal bundle size.
Built-in timeline control, advanced easing functions, and staggered animation support.
negativeConstraints: Avoid for complex 3D WebGL rendering or heavy video frame manipulation.
Not suitable for native mobile or desktop application UI development.
Unideal for real-time physics simulations requiring continuous high-frequency updates.
tools.description_zh: 輕量級 JavaScript 動畫函式庫，適用於 CSS、SVG、DOM 和 JS 物件。
tools.useCase_zh: 適合為 UI 過渡效果、捲軸觸發效果和互動式網頁動畫增添流暢感。
tools.advantages_zh: 統一的 API 用於動畫處理 CSS 屬性、SVG 路徑、DOM 屬性和 JavaScript 物件。採用硬體加速轉換和最小捆綁包大小，實現高程式碼。內建時間軸控制、進階緩動函數和錯開動畫支援。
negativeConstraints_zh: 避免用於複雜的 3D WebGL 渲染或重度影片影格操作。
不適合原生行動裝置或桌面應用程式 UI 開發。
不適用於需持續高頻更新之即時物理模擬。

tools.name: Understand Anything
tools.description: Transform code into interactive knowledge graphs for search, exploration, and Q&A.
triggers: 把代碼庫轉成知識圖譜
查詢業務邏輯的知識圖譜
把代碼轉成可搜索的圖譜
分析整個項目的代碼結構
tools.useCase: Onboard new developers by converting complex repositories into searchable, queryable visual graphs.
advantages: Creates interactive visual graphs that clarify code relationships better than static documentation.
Integrates with popular AI coding tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot.
Supports natural language search and questioning across the entire codebase.
negativeConstraints: Not intended for real-time data streaming or live dashboard monitoring.
Avoid for trivial single-file projects where standard IDE navigation suffices.
tools.description_zh: 將程式碼轉換為用於搜尋、探索和問答的互動式知識圖譜。
tools.useCase_zh: 透過將複雜倉庫轉換為可搜尋、可查詢的視覺圖表，協助新開發者上線。
tools.advantages_zh: 建立互動式視覺圖表，比靜態文件更能清楚呈現程式碼關係，整合 Claude Code、Cursor 和 Copilot 等熱門 AI 程式設計工具，支援跨整個程式碼庫的自然語言搜尋和提問。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適用於即時資料串流或即時儀表板監控。
避免用於標準 IDE 導航已足夠的簡單單檔專案。

tools.name: Andrej Karpathy Skills
tools.description: Behavioral guidelines to reduce common LLM coding mistakes — derived from Andrej Karpathy observations. 4 core principles: Think Before Coding, Simplicity First, Surgical Changes, Goal-Driven Execution.
triggers: 避免 AI 編程錯誤
減少 LLM 常見失誤

subTools.name: Karpathy Guidelines
subTools.description: Behavioral guidelines to reduce common LLM coding mistakes. 4 core principles: Think Before Coding, Simplicity First, Surgical Changes, Goal-Driven Execution.
subTools.description_zh: 減少 LLM 常見程式錯誤的行為準則。四項核心原則：先思考再寫碼、簡單優先、精準修改、目標導向執行。

tools.useCase: When an AI agent or developer needs behavioral guardrails to avoid common LLM coding mistakes such as over-engineering, hidden confusion, and unchecked assumptions.
advantages: Directly reduces unnecessary changes in diffs through surgical change discipline
Forces explicit assumption surfacing before any implementation begins
Bias toward caution over speed prevents costly rewrites from overcomplication
negativeConstraints: These guidelines bias toward caution over speed — not suitable for trivial tasks where judgment should override
Single behavioral skill specification requiring thoughtful integration with project-specific workflows
tools.description_zh: 減少常見 LLM 程式設計錯誤的行為準則——源自 Andrej Karpathy 的觀察。4 項核心原則：編碼前思考、簡潔優先、精確變更、目標驅動執行。
tools.useCase_zh: 當 AI 代理或開發者需要行為守則以避免常見 LLM 程式設計錯誤，例如過度設計、隱藏混淆和未經驗證的假設。
tools.advantages_zh: 透過精確變更紀律直接減少差異中的不必要變更，在任何實作開始前強制明確揭露假設，偏向謹慎而非速度的做法可防止過度複雜導致的昂貴重寫
negativeConstraints_zh: 這些準則偏向謹慎而非速度——不適用於應由判斷力主導的簡單任務
單一行為技能規範，需與專案特定工作流程深思熟慮地整合

tools.name: Eigenflux Arena
tools.description: Framework for multi-agent communication and broadcasting within a shared network environment.
triggers: 讓多個 AI agent 互相通信
多個 AI 共享狀態
讓不同 AI 交換資訊
建立 agent 通訊協定
tools.useCase: Build a decentralized system where multiple AI agents exchange information or coordinate actions in real-time.
advantages: Enables direct agent-to-agent communication without a central broker.
Supports efficient one-to-many broadcasting for shared network updates.
Open-source framework allows for easy customization and integration.
negativeConstraints: Do not use for single-agent applications that do not require inter-agent communication.
Avoid for systems requiring strict centralized data governance over all traffic.
Not suitable for applications needing guaranteed microsecond-level latency.
tools.description_zh: 用於共同網路環境中多代理通訊和廣播的框架。
tools.useCase_zh: 建構去中心化系統，讓多個 AI 代理能夠即時交換資訊或協調動作。
tools.advantages_zh: 無需中央中介即可實現代理間直接通訊，支援高效的單對多廣播用於共享網路更新，開放原始碼框架便於自訂和整合。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不應用於不需要代理間通訊的單一代理應用程式。
避免用於要求對所有流量實施嚴格集中式資料治理的系統。
不適用於需要保證微秒級延遲的應用程式。

tools.name: Council of High Intelligence
tools.description: Structured multi-perspective deliberation framework. Assigns hard questions to deliberately different analytical personas, forces direct disagreement, and returns a verdict preserving unresolved questions, dissent, kill criteria, and next concrete action.

requirements: Claude Code / Codex / Gemini CLI / OpenCode (one or more)

tools.useCase: High-stakes engineering decisions with material downside, competing values, or irreversible choices — e.g., architectural trade-offs, pricing models, shipping deadlines, risk assessments.
advantages: 18 grounded analytical personas with structured reasoning methods and known blind spots
Three modes: Full (complete protocol), Quick (breadth without adversarial round), Duo (single polarity)
Named triads for domain-specific panels (architecture, strategy, ethics, debugging, risk, etc.)
Multi-provider routing separates polarity pairs across different model families
Verdicts lead with unresolved items, kill criteria, and one concrete next step
Evidence labels separate FACT, INFERENCE, ASSUMPTION, UNKNOWN
Claude Code plugin marketplace support for one-click installation
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for factual lookups — use direct answers or primary documentation instead
Avoid for cheap and reversible choices — run an experiment instead
Do not convene a council to manufacture support for a decision already made
Requires significant token budget for full protocol deliberation
tools.description_zh: 結構化的多視角審議框架。將艱難問題分配給刻意不同的分析人格，強制直接表達分歧，並返回保留未決問題、異議、判定標準與下一步具體行動的結論。
tools.useCase_zh: 高風險的程式決策，涉及實質影響、相互衝突的價值觀或不可逆的決定——例如架構取捨、定價模式、上線時程、風險評估。
tools.advantages_zh: 18種紮根的分析人格，具備結構化推理方法與已知盲點，三種模式：完整（完整協議）、快速（廣度而無需對抗輪次）、雙人（單一極性），針對特定領域命名的小組（架構、策略、倫理、除錯、風險等），多提供者路由將極性配對分散至不同模型系列，結論以未決問題為先
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適用於事實查詢——應改用直接回答或主要文件
避免用於便宜且可逆轉的選擇——應執行實驗取代
不應為了製造對既定決策的支持而召開理事會
完整協議審議需要大量的 token 預算

tools.name: Grok Build
tools.description: Grok Build is an open-source coding agent harness and TUI for interacting with Grok models.
triggers: 用 Grok 審查程式碼
用 Grok 生成程式片段
用 Grok 建立 Coding Agent
用 Grok 整合開發流程
用 Grok 自動化編程任務
用 Grok 模型輔助編碼
tools.useCase: Developers use Grok Build to orchestrate autonomous coding sessions, debug codebases, and manage software engineering workflows via an interactive terminal interface.
advantages: Fullscreen, mouse-interactive TUI designed for efficient coding agent control.
Extensible architecture supports custom tools and tailored development workflows.
Optimized for leveraging Grok's advanced reasoning in software engineering tasks.
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for non-code tasks such as creative writing or image generation.
Avoid for simple Q&A queries where a lightweight chat interface is more appropriate.
Not designed as a production-ready backend API for end-user applications.
tools.description_zh: Grok Build 是開放原始碼的程式設計代理框架與終端介面，用於與 Grok 模型互動。
tools.useCase_zh: 開發者使用 Grok Build 來協調自主程式設計工作階段、偵錯程式庫，並透過互動式終端介面管理軟體工程工作流程。
tools.advantages_zh: 全螢幕、滑鼠互動的 TUI 介面，專為高效程式代理控制而設計，可擴展架構支援自訂工具與客製化開發工作流程，針對利用 Grok 先進推理能力於軟體工程任務而最佳化。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適用於非程式碼任務，例如創意寫作或圖片生成。
避免用於簡單問答查詢，此類情境改用輕量聊天介面更為合適。
並非為終端用戶應用程式設計的生產環境後端 API。

tools.name: Codex Dream Skin
tools.description: Visual theme for coding environments with dream-inspired aesthetics.
triggers: 給編碼環境加視覺主題
自訂編程界面夢幻風格
為編碼軟體換夢幻皮膚
tools.useCase: Provides developers with an immersive, aesthetically pleasing interface for writing and reviewing code.
advantages: Dream-inspired color palette reduces visual fatigue
Seamless integration with popular code editors
Enhances focus during extended programming sessions
negativeConstraints: Not recommended for accessibility-critical applications
May lack support for specialized development tools
Best suited for personal rather than team environments
tools.description_zh: 具有夢幻美學風格的程式設計環境視覺主題。
tools.useCase_zh: 為開發者提供沉浸感強且美觀的介面，用於撰寫與檢視程式碼。
tools.advantages_zh: 夢幻風格配色降低視覺疲勞，與主流程式編輯器無縫整合，增強長時間程式設計時的專注力。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不建議用於對無障礙性要求嚴格的應用程式
可能缺乏對專業開發工具的支援
較適合個人使用而非團隊環境

tools.name: Lingbot Map
tools.description: Real-time feed-forward 3D scene reconstruction from continuous video streams.
triggers: 從串流影片建構三維模型
持續錄影重建立體場景
用影片做實時三維重建
實時重建環境的三維模型
tools.useCase: Deploy it in autonomous robots or AR apps that require instant 3D environment mapping from live camera feeds.
advantages: Zero iterative optimization enables sub-second inference
Natively processes continuous video streams into coherent 3D scenes
Scalable architecture supports dynamic and changing environments
negativeConstraints: Do not use when offline photogrammetric precision is mandatory
Avoid for single-image 3D generation without temporal input
Not intended for explicit mesh extraction or CAD modeling workflows
tools.description_zh: 從連續影片串流即時前饋 3D 場景重建。
tools.useCase_zh: 部署於需要即時從即時攝影機串流進行 3D 環境建圖的自主機器人或 AR 應用程式。
tools.advantages_zh: 零迭代最佳化實現亞秒級推理，原生將連續影片串流處理為一致的 3D 場景，可擴展架構支援動態與變化環境。
negativeConstraints_zh: 當離線攝影測量精度為必要條件時，請勿使用
避免用於沒有時間序列輸入下的單張影像 3D 生成
不適用於明確的網格（mesh）提取或 CAD 建模工作流程

tools.name: Opencut
tools.description: Open-source video editor featuring timeline editing, effects, transitions, and multi-track support.
tools.useCase: Content creators can produce and export short-form videos locally without relying on proprietary cloud services.
advantages: Fully open-source with self-hosted deployment options for enhanced data privacy.
Multi-track timeline editing with built-in effects, transitions, and text overlays.
Cross-platform desktop and web interface designed for lightweight performance.
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for professional Hollywood-grade VFX or advanced color grading workflows.
Avoid for real-time multi-user cloud collaboration requiring enterprise permission systems.
Not ideal for hardware-accelerated 8K RAW footage processing on low-end devices.
tools.description_zh: 開放原始碼影片編輯器，具備時間軸編輯、特效、轉場與多軌支援。
tools.useCase_zh: 內容創作者可在本地製作並匯出短影片，無需依賴封閉雲端服務。
tools.advantages_zh: 完全開放原始碼，提供自架部署選項以增強資料隱私，多軌時間軸編輯內建特效、轉場與文字疊加，跨平台桌面與網頁介面設計輕量高效能。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合專業好萊塢等級的 VFX 或進階色彩調色工作流程。
需企業級權限系統的實時多人雲端協作請避免使用。
低階裝置上處理硬體加速的 8K RAW 影片素材並非理想選擇。

tools.name: Voicebox
tools.description: Open-source AI voice studio for local voice cloning, transcription, and speech synthesis.
tools.useCase: Content creators can locally clone a specific voice to generate natural-sounding narration without relying on cloud APIs.
advantages: Supports local inference with CUDA and MLX for hardware-accelerated performance.
Integrates Whisper for accurate speech-to-text transcription alongside TTS capabilities.
Enables privacy-focused voice cloning and synthesis entirely on user hardware.
negativeConstraints: Do not use for real-time video conferencing or live streaming voice modulation.
Avoid for tasks requiring managed cloud hosting or serverless API integration.
Not suitable for non-audio workflows such as image generation or code compilation.
tools.description_zh: 開源 AI 語音工作室，用於本地語音克隆、轉錄與語音合成。
tools.useCase_zh: 內容創作者可在本地克隆特定語音，生成自然的旁白，無需依賴雲端 API。
tools.advantages_zh: 支援 CUDA 與 MLX 本地推理，提供硬體加速效能。整合 Whisper 進行精準語音轉文字轉錄，並具備 TTS 能力。專注隱私的語音克隆與合成完全在用戶硬體上執行。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不建議用於實時影片會議或直播串流的聲音調變。
避免用於需要雲端託管或無伺服器 API 整合的任務。
不適合圖像生成或程式編譯等非音訊工作流程。

tools.name: Wand Enhancer
tools.description: Advanced UX and interoperability extension for the WeMod Wand desktop app.
tools.useCase: A WeMod power user wants to improve the Wand desktop client's interface and workflow.
advantages: Provides an enhanced user experience compared to the default Wand client.
Improves interoperability between WeMod and other applications.
Built with C# and WPF for a native Windows desktop experience.
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for non-Windows operating systems due to WPF dependency.
Avoid if you require official WeMod support or closed-source stability.
Do not use as a standalone game mod manager without the WeMod ecosystem.
tools.description_zh: WeMod Wand 桌面應用程式的進階 UX 與互通性擴充功能。
tools.useCase_zh: WeMod 重度使用者希望改善 Wand 桌面客戶端的介面與工作流程。
tools.advantages_zh: 提供比預設 Wand 客戶端更佳的用戶體驗。改善 WeMod 與其他應用程式之間的互通性。以 C# 和 WPF 開發，提供原生 Windows 桌面體驗。
negativeConstraints_zh: 因依賴 WPF，不適用於非 Windows 作業系統。
若需要官方 WeMod 支援或封閉源的穩定性請避免使用。
不建議在 WeMod 生態系外作為獨立的遊戲模組管理器使用。

tools.name: Memos
tools.description: Self-hosted, lightweight note-taking app with Markdown support and real-time sync.
tools.useCase: Ideal for developers or teams needing a fast, private space to jot down code snippets, meeting notes, or daily logs without cloud dependency.
advantages: Zero-config Docker deployment with SQLite backend for minimal resource usage.
Real-time Markdown editing with instant preview and comprehensive REST API.
Complete data ownership with self-hosting and zero third-party tracking.
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for complex document management requiring version control or rich media attachments.
Unsuitable for collaborative workspaces needing granular permission roles or enterprise SSO integration.
Avoid for high-volume knowledge bases requiring advanced search indexing or AI summarization.
tools.description_zh: 輕量級自我託管筆記應用，支援 Markdown 與即時同步。
tools.useCase_zh: 適合需要快速、私密空間記錄程式碼片段、會議記錄或每日日誌的開發者或團隊，無雲端依賴。
tools.advantages_zh: 零設定 Docker 部署，搭配 SQLite 後端，資源消耗極低。即時 Markdown 編輯，含即時預覽與完整 REST API。自我託管確保資料完全掌控，零第三方追蹤。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合需要版本控制或豐富媒體附件的複雜檔案管理。
不適合需要細粒度許可角色或企業 SSO 整合的協作工作區。
避免用於需要進階搜尋索引或 AI 摘要的高容量知識庫。

tools.name: Memos (MemTensor)
tools.description: Self-evolving memory OS for AI agents with persistent storage and skill reuse.
triggers: 保存 AI 對話記錄
複用 AI 技能模組
tools.useCase: Enabling an AI agent to retain long-term user preferences and reusable skills across multiple sessions.
advantages: Ultra-persistent memory ensures long-term context retention.
Cross-task skill reuse minimizes redundant learning efforts.
Hybrid retrieval optimizes accuracy while reducing token consumption.
negativeConstraints: Stateless applications that do not require memory persistence.
Non-LLM based traditional software systems.
Single-turn queries needing immediate responses without context.
tools.description_zh: 具備持久化儲存與技能復用的 AI 代理自演化記憶作業系統。
tools.useCase_zh: 讓 AI 代理能在多個工作階段中保留長期使用者偏好與可復用的技能。
tools.advantages_zh: 超高持久化記憶確保長期語境保留。跨任務技能復用減少冗餘學習。混合式檢索在降低 token 消耗的同時優化準確率。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不需要記憶體持久化的無狀態應用程式。
基於 LLM 之外的傳統軟體系統。
需要立即回應且無需上下文的一步查詢。

tools.name: Metaharness
tools.description: Scaffold branded AI agent harnesses with MCP, memory, and multi-agent support.
triggers: 搭建 AI agent 框架
設定 AI 代理記憶體
創建沙箱化 AI 環境
實作多個 AI agent 協作
初始化 AI 系統骨架
部署具隔離性的 AI agent
串接 MCP 工具的 AI 架構

subTools.name: Compare Harnesses
subTools.description: Diff two scaffolded harnesses (ADR-031). Reports manifest meta drift + host list + per-file fingerprint changes (added/removed/changed). Exits 0 IDENTICAL, 1 DRIFT, 2 missing manifest. Use --bundle for the ADR-031 schema-1 JSON envelope.
subTools.description_zh: 比較兩個已建立的 harness（ADR-031），回報 manifest 中繼資料差異、主機清單與各檔案指紋變更（新增／移除／變更）。回傳 0 表示相同、1 表示有差異、2 表示缺少 manifest。使用 --bundle 可取得 ADR-031 schema-1 JSON 包裝。

subTools.name: Create Harness
subTools.description: Scaffold your own focused AI agent harness — pick host (Claude Code, Codex, pi.dev, Hermes), template, agents, skills, and ship a npm-publishable harness with its own npx CLI. Use when a user asks to "create my own agent harness", "scaffold a harness", "make a custom Claude Code plugin like ruflo", or "build a vertical AI assistant for X".
subTools.description_zh: 建立專屬 AI agent harness——選擇主機（Claude Code、Codex、pi.dev、Hermes）、範本、agents、skills，產出可直接 npm publish 的 harness 與其專屬 npx CLI。當使用者要求「建立我自己的 agent harness」、「產生 harness」或「為 X 打造垂直 AI 助手」時使用。

subTools.name: Diag Harness
subTools.description: Kernel-version skew check (ADR-027). Reports manifest surface + manifest kernel + installed kernel + verdict (match/patch-diff/minor-diff/major-diff). Exits 1 on minor/major skew with a copy-pasteable `npm install @metaharness/kernel@X.Y.Z` next step. Exits 2 if no .harness/manifest.json at path.
subTools.description_zh: 檢查核心版本落差（ADR-027），回報 manifest 表面、manifest 核心、已安裝核心及判斷結果（符合／patch 差異／minor 差異／major 差異）。minor 或 major 落差時回傳 1 並提供可複製貼上的 `npm install @metaharness/kernel@X.Y.Z` 指令。若路徑下無 .harness/manifest.json 則回傳 2。

subTools.name: Example Harness
subTools.description: Scaffold a ready-made AI agent harness in one command from the 19 published @metaharness/* example packages — 9 host integrations (Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, pi.dev, OpenClaw, RVM, Copilot, OpenCode, GitHub Actions) + 10 vertical pods (devops, research, trading, support, legal, coding, education, sales, gaming, repo-maintainer).
subTools.description_zh: 透過單一指令從 19 個已發布的 @metaharness/* 範例套件建立即用型 AI agent harness——含 9 種主機整合（Claude Code、Codex、Hermes、pi.dev、OpenClaw、RVM、Copilot、OpenCode、GitHub Actions）與 10 種垂直領域 pod（devops、research、trading、support、legal、coding、education、sales、gaming、repo-maintainer）。

subTools.name: Harness Secrets
subTools.description: GCP Secret Manager integration: validate setup, fetch values, or confirm an NPM_TOKEN is non-revoked via `npm whoami`. Used for publish-time token rotation without long-lived keys in CI.
subTools.description_zh: GCP Secret Manager 整合：驗證設定、取得機密值，或透過 `npm whoami` 確認 NPM_TOKEN 未遭撤銷。用於發布時替換 token，避免在 CI 中使用長期有效的金鑰。

subTools.name: List Templates
subTools.description: List the available harness templates and what each one ships with. Use when the user asks "what templates are available", "what verticals does the harness generator support", or "show me what I can scaffold".
subTools.description_zh: 列出可用的 harness 範本及各範本所包含的套件。當使用者詢問「有哪些範本可用」、「harness 產生器支援哪些垂直領域」或「顯示我可以產生什麼」時使用。

subTools.name: Oia Manifest
subTools.description: Emit .harness/oia-manifest.json declaring layer alignment with the OIA v0.1 9-layer reference architecture. Self-describes the harness's MCP wiring, witness signing, audit log, identity posture (always 'none' at v0.1). --check verifies an existing manifest, --dry-run prints without writing, --json emits to stdout.
subTools.description_zh: 產出 .harness/oia-manifest.json，宣告與 OIA v0.1 九層參考架構的層級對齊。自我描述 harness 的 MCP 接線、witness 簽章、稽核日誌與身分狀態（v0.1 固定為 'none'）。--check 驗證既有 manifest、--dry-run 僅印出不寫入、--json 輸出至 stdout。

subTools.name: Publish Harness
subTools.description: Publish a generated harness to npm — runs the smoke test, signs the witness manifest, and dispatches `npm publish --provenance` from your tagged release.
subTools.description_zh: 將產生的 harness 發布至 npm——執行煙測、簽署 witness manifest，並從你標記的 release 觸發 `npm publish --provenance`。

subTools.name: Repo Genome
subTools.description: 7-section readiness scorecard for a LOCAL repo. Reports repo type + agent topology + MCP risk + test confidence + release readiness + recommended harness plan + scorecard. Exit 0 ready, 1 needs-work, 2 blocked. --json for the 6-field scorecard, --bundle for the ADR-031 schema-1 envelope.
subTools.description_zh: 針對本機倉庫的7段就緒度評分表。回報倉庫類型、agent拓撲、MCP風險、測試信心、發布準備度、推薦的harness計畫與評分表。--json輸出6字段評分表，--bundle輸出ADR-031 schema-1封套。

subTools.name: Score Harness
subTools.description: 5-dimension scorecard (0-100, grade A/B/C/F) for a scaffolded harness. Dimensions: Repo understanding (25%), Agent usefulness (25%), MCP safety (20%), Test coverage (15%), Publish readiness (15%). Emits a 6-field badges block (score + mcpRisk + 4 booleans) ready for the harness README. Exit 0 A/B, 1 C, 2 F.
subTools.description_zh: 針對已搭建harness的5維度評分表（0-100分，A/B/C/F等級）。維度：倉庫理解25%、agent實用性25%、MCP安全性20%、測試覆蓋率15%、發布準備度15%。輸出6字段徽章區塊（分數+MCP風險+4個布林值）供harness README使用。

subTools.name: Threat Model
subTools.description: MCP threat-model artifact for a scaffolded harness. Reports allowed/denied tools, dangerous permissions count, secrets reachability, network/shell/file-write grants, default-deny posture. Verdict: clean (exit 0) / medium (exit 1) / high (exit 2). The 'enterprise gold' artifact for PR + compliance review.
subTools.description_zh: MCP 威脅模型成果物，用於腳手架化測試環境。回報允許/拒絕的工具、危險權限數量、機密可達性、網路/指令列/檔案寫入授權，以及預設拒絕的防禦姿態。結論：安全（退出碼 0）／中等風險（退出碼 1）／高風險（退出碼 2）。PR 與合規審查的企業級黃金標準成果物。

subTools.name: Upgrade Harness
subTools.description: Drift detection + apply for a scaffolded harness. Re-renders the template with the same vars, computes added/removed/changed file plan, and applies with Git-style conflict markers or .rej files. Default is dry-run.
subTools.description_zh: 針對已搭建的模板進行漂移檢測與套用。以相同變數重新渲染模板，計算新增／移除／變更的檔案計畫，並以 Git 風格衝突標記或 .rej 檔案套用。預設為 dry-run。

subTools.name: Validate Harness
subTools.description: Release-readiness umbrella check for a scaffolded harness — runs doctor, witness verify, hardcoded-path scan, MCP server config, and GCP Secret Manager validation in one shot. Exits non-zero if any sub-check fails.
subTools.description_zh: 針對已搭建模板的一次性發布就緒總體檢查——執行 doctor、見證驗證、硬編碼路徑掃描、MCP 伺服器設定與 GCP Secret Manager 驗證。任一子檢查失敗即回傳非零值。

subTools.name: Verify Witness
subTools.description: Verify the Ed25519 witness manifest of a scaffolded harness. Fast yes/no signature check that proves the publisher signed this exact file set — separate from the full release-readiness umbrella in validate-harness.
subTools.description_zh: 驗證已搭建模板的 Ed25519 見證清單。快速的有／無簽章檢查，可證明發布者已簽署這組特定檔案——此為獨立檢查，不同於 validate-harness 中的完整發布就緒總體檢查。

tools.useCase: Build a custom-branded AI coding assistant with persistent memory and MCP integration for team workflows.
advantages: Generates a complete agent environment with npx CLI, MCP server, and memory out of the box.
Supports multiple AI backends including Claude Code, Codex, and hardware-isolated RVM sandboxes.
Enables witness-signed releases for secure, verifiable agent updates.
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for simple script execution or one-off automation tasks without an agent framework.
Avoid if you need a managed cloud-hosted agent service rather than a self-hosted scaffold.
Not ideal for non-AI software development projects.
tools.description_zh: 使用 MCP、記憶與多代理支援來建構品牌化 AI 代理底座的雛型工具。
tools.useCase_zh: 建構具備持久記憶與 MCP 整合的自訂品牌 AI 編程助手，適用於團隊工作流程。
tools.advantages_zh: 透過 npx CLI 一鍵生成完整的代理環境，內建 MCP 伺服器與記憶功能。支援多種 AI 後端，包括 Claude Code、Codex 及硬體隔離的 RVM 沙箱。支援見證簽章發布，實現安全可驗證的代理更新。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合沒有 agent 框架的簡單腳本執行或一次性自動化任務。
避免選擇需要托管雲端 agent 服務而非自架結構框架的專案。
不適合非 AI 軟體開發專案。

tools.name: Self Harness
tools.description: Open-source guide for building robust runtime architectures for long-running AI agents.
triggers: 設定長期運行Agent的容錯機制
建立穩定AI Agent運作環境
處理Agent執行異常的救援機制
架構可自我修復的Agent系統
設定Agent生命週期管理流程
實作Agent執行中斷後的自動恢復
建立高可用性AI Agent運行架構
tools.useCase: Useful when developing autonomous agents that require persistent state management and error recovery over extended periods.
advantages: Teaches patterns for resilient agent infrastructure
Addresses challenges in long-duration autonomous execution
Covers Harness Engineering principles for LLM-based systems
negativeConstraints: Do not use for simple chatbot implementations lacking complex state
Avoid for projects needing a pre-built agent framework rather than architectural guidance
Not intended for non-AI software development tasks
tools.description_zh: 建構長期執行 AI 代理之健壯執行階段架構的開源指南。
tools.useCase_zh: 適合開發需要持久狀態管理與長期錯誤恢復的自主代理。
tools.advantages_zh: 教導 resilient 代理基礎設施模式、解決長時間自主執行的挑戰、涵蓋 LLM 系統的 Harness Engineering 原則
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適用於缺乏複雜狀態的簡單聊天機器人實作。
避免用於需要預建 agent 框架而非架構指導的專案。
不適用於非 AI 軟體開發任務。

tools.name: Browser Harness
tools.description: Autonomous self-healing browser automation framework for LLM-driven web task execution.
tools.useCase: Automating complex, multi-step e-commerce checkouts or dynamic form submissions without manual script maintenance.
advantages: Self-healing UI selectors adapt automatically to DOM changes
Leverages CDP for reliable headless and cloud browser integration
Native LLM orchestration minimizes prompt engineering overhead
negativeConstraints: Real-time high-frequency trading systems requiring sub-millisecond latency
Static internal dashboards better handled by simple HTTP requests
Strict zero-trust environments blocking external CDP connections
tools.description_zh: 適用於 LLM 驅動網頁任務執行的自主自我修復瀏覽器自動化框架。
tools.useCase_zh: 自動化複雜的多步驟電商結帳或動態表單提交，無需手動維護腳本。
tools.advantages_zh: 自我修復 UI 選擇器自動適應 DOM 變更、利用 CDP 實現可靠的無頭及雲端瀏覽器整合、原生 LLM 編排最小化 prompt engineering 負擔
negativeConstraints_zh: 需要子毫秒延遲的即時高頻交易系統。
以簡單 HTTP 請求即可處理的靜態內部儀表板。
封鎖外部 CDP 連線的嚴格零信任環境。

tools.name: OpenHarness
tools.description: Open-source framework for building, running, and benchmarking autonomous LLM agents with personalization.
triggers: 搭建 LLM agent 框架
評測 AI agent 效能
執行 LLM agent 流程
評估 AI 代理任務表現
訓練自閉環 LLM 系統
測試多工具 agent 整合
建構可微調的自動代理
tools.useCase: Researchers can use it to evaluate and compare different LLM agent architectures across standardized tasks while leveraging a built-in personal assistant.
advantages: Provides a standardized benchmarking environment for evaluating autonomous agent performance.
Supports modular tool integration and customizable agent configurations.
Includes a built-in personal agent for immediate usability and personalization testing.
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for production-grade, low-latency applications requiring strict service-level agreements.
Avoid using for simple deterministic script automation that does not require LLM-based reasoning.
Not designed for fine-tuning base language models rather than orchestrating agent behaviors.
tools.description_zh: 用於建構、執行與基準測試具個人化自主 LLM 代理的開源框架。
tools.useCase_zh: 研究者可藉由內建的個人助理，在標準化任務上評估並比較不同 LLM 代理架構。
tools.advantages_zh: 提供標準化的基準測試環境以評估自主代理效能、支援模組化工具整合與可自訂代理配置、內建個人代理即時可用並支援個人化測試
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合需要嚴格服務級協定（SLA）的生產環境、低延遲應用。
避免用於不需要基於 LLM 推理的簡單確定性腳本自動化。
非為微調基礎語言模型而設計，而是用於協調代理行為。

tools.name: Humanizer
tools.description: Text processing skill to remove AI writing patterns and make content sound natural.
tools.useCase: Rewrite AI-generated blog posts or marketing copy to bypass detection tools and improve readability.
advantages: Eliminates repetitive phrasing common in automated output.
Maintains original intent while varying sentence structure.
Integrates into development workflows for fast text iteration.
negativeConstraints: Avoid for legal, medical, or technical docs needing exact terminology.
Do not use for formal academic papers requiring strict objectivity.
Not intended for code generation or structured data formatting.
tools.description_zh: 文字處理技能，用於移除 AI 寫作模式並讓內容讀起來更自然。
tools.useCase_zh: 改寫 AI 產生的部落格文章或行銷文案，以繞過檢測工具並提升可讀性。
tools.advantages_zh: 消除自動化輸出中常見的重複句法、在維持原意的前提下變化句式、可整合至開發工作流程以加速文字迭代
negativeConstraints_zh: 避免用於需要精確術語的法律、醫療或技術文件。
勿用於需要嚴格客觀性的正式學術論文。
不適用於程式碼產生或結構化資料格式化。

tools.name: Humanizer Zh TW
tools.description: Traditional Chinese AI text humanizer that optimizes natural flow and removes machine-generated traces.
triggers: 改善 AI 生成文本
tools.useCase: Transform AI-generated marketing copy or blog posts into fluent Traditional Chinese to pass manual review or enhance reader experience.
advantages: Optimized specifically for Traditional Chinese idioms and tone
Effectively reduces AI detection scores while improving readability
Lightweight Agent Skill architecture for seamless workflow integration
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for documents requiring strict retention of technical jargon or legal clauses
Ineffective for processing pure English or Simplified Chinese content
Not recommended for highly structured data or code generation tasks
tools.description_zh: 繁體中文 AI 文字人性化技能，優化自然流暢度並移除機器生成痕跡。
tools.useCase_zh: 將 AI 產生的行銷文案或部落格文章轉為流暢的繁體中文，以通過人工審查或提升讀者體驗。
tools.advantages_zh: 專為繁體中文成語與語氣最佳化、有效降低 AI 檢測分數並提升可讀性、輕量 Agent Skill 架構，無縫整合工作流程
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合需要嚴格保留技術術語或法律條款的文件
處理純英文或簡體中文內容效果有限
不建議用於高度結構化的資料或程式碼產生任務

tools.name: Stop Slop
tools.description: Detects and removes AI-generated phrasing and stylistic tells from written text.
tools.useCase: Use this tool when editing blog posts or marketing copy to ensure the writing sounds naturally human rather than machine-generated.
advantages: Identifies common AI writing patterns like excessive hedging, repetitive transitions, and unnatural phrasing.
Provides actionable replacements to restore authentic voice and readability.
Integrates as a lightweight skill file for quick workflow adoption.
negativeConstraints: Do not use for code generation, data analysis, or strictly technical documentation.
Avoid on creative fiction that intentionally mimics AI or uses experimental stylistic choices.
Not suitable for multilingual content unless explicitly configured for those languages.
tools.description_zh: 偵測並移除書面文字中的 AI 生成用語與風格特徵。
tools.useCase_zh: 用於編輯部落格文章或行銷文案時，確保文字讀起來自然像人類而非機器生成。
tools.advantages_zh: 識別常見 AI 寫作模式，如過度保留、重複轉接詞和不自然用語。提供可執行的替換建議，恢復真實語氣與可讀性。整合為輕量級技能檔，便於快速納入工作流。
negativeConstraints_zh: 勿用於程式碼產生、資料分析或嚴格技術文件。
避免用於刻意模仿 AI 或使用實驗性風格選擇的創意小說。
不適合多語內容，除非明確配置支援該等語言。

tools.name: Ai Flavor Remover
tools.description: Strips AI-generated writing patterns to make text sound more natural and human-like.
tools.useCase: Use this tool to refine AI-drafted blog posts or emails before publishing to ensure they read naturally.
advantages: Eliminates common AI clichés and repetitive sentence structures.
Enhances content authenticity by mimicking human writing style.
Optimized for compatibility with modern LLM outputs like Gemini 2.5 Pro.
negativeConstraints: Do not use for code generation or technical documentation requiring exact syntax.
Avoid for legal or medical texts where precise terminology is critical.
Not suitable for creative writing that intentionally requires a stylized voice.
tools.description_zh: 去除 AI 生成寫作模式，使文字聽起來更自然、更像人類書寫。
tools.useCase_zh: 用於發布前精修 AI 草擬的部落格文章或電子郵件，確保閱讀自然流暢。
tools.advantages_zh: 消除常見 AI 陳腔濫調與重複句式。透過模仿人類寫作風格提升內容真實感。針對 Gemini 2.5 Pro 等現代 LLM 輸出最佳化。
negativeConstraints_zh: 勿用於需要精確語法的程式碼產生或技術文件。
避免用於對精確術語至關重要的法律或醫療文本。
不適合需要刻意風格化語氣的創意寫作。

tools.name: Remove Ai Flavor Writing Skill
tools.description: Claude Code skill to humanize Chinese AI text by removing template patterns and robotic phrasing.
triggers: 去除 AI 寫作痕跡
把 AI 文改成人話
潤色 AI 生成內容
檢查文字有沒有 AI 味
去掉生硬的機械化表達
tools.useCase: Rewrite an AI-generated Chinese article or email to sound natural and remove obvious machine-written patterns.
advantages: Targets specific Chinese AI writing artifacts like template sentences and fake engagement endings.
Integrates directly into Codex workflows as a compact, reusable skill.
Preserves core meaning while significantly improving text naturalness.
negativeConstraints: Do not use for English text, as it is specialized for Chinese writing patterns.
Avoid for creative fiction requiring specific stylistic flourishes.
Not suitable for formal legal or academic documents where rigid structure is mandatory.
tools.description_zh: Claude Code 技能，透過移除模板模式與機械用語，讓中文 AI 文字更人性化。
tools.useCase_zh: 改寫 AI 生成的中文文章或電子郵件，使其讀來自然並去除明顯機器寫作痕跡。
tools.advantages_zh: 針對特定中文 AI 寫作瑕疵，如模板句與虛假互動結尾。可直掛入 Codex 工作流，作為精簡可複用的技能。在大幅改善文字自然度的同時保留核心意涵。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適用於英文文本，因專為中文寫作模式設計。
對於需要特定文風修辭的創意小說不適用。
不適合需要嚴格結構的正式法律或學術文件。

tools.name: Shuorenhua
tools.description: Chinese-first rewrite skill removing AI tone from text while preserving facts for developer tools.
tools.useCase: Rewrite an AI-generated changelog or commit message in Chinese to sound natural and human-written before publishing.
advantages: Preserves factual accuracy and technical details during tone correction.
Optimized for Chinese language nuances and natural phrasing.
Compatible with popular AI coding assistants like Cursor and Claude Code.
negativeConstraints: Do not use for creative fiction or literary writing requiring stylized expression.
Avoid for formal legal or medical documents needing strict terminology.
Not intended for translating foreign languages; focuses on rewriting existing Chinese text.
tools.description_zh: 以中文為主的改寫技能，在保留事實的前提下去除 AI 語調，適用於開發者工具。
tools.useCase_zh: 用於發布前改寫 AI 生成的中文更新日誌或提交訊息，使其讀起來自然且像人類書寫。
tools.advantages_zh: 在語調修正過程中保留事實準確性與技術細節。針對中文語境與自然用語最佳化。相容於 Cursor 與 Claude Code 等流行 AI 程式設計助手。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適用於需要文藝表達的創意小說或文學創作。
不適合需要嚴格術語的正式法律或醫療文件。
不意用於翻譯外文；專注於改寫現有中文文本。

subTools.name: Writer Pro One
subTools.description: 精確復現特定作者的中文寫作風格。適用於：(1) 以該風格從零生成文章，(2) 將AI風格或其他風格的文章改寫為該風格，(3) 在同一次任務裡對草稿做終稿打磨/精修（保持作者筆力，不得改成中性說明書），(4) 審閱文章是否符合該風格，(5) 結構保真地將非簡體中文翻譯為簡體中文（保留原始結構與不可改動片段，如人名/專名、代碼、代碼塊、URL 等；不擅自增刪）。核心特徵：半文半白的用詞、長短交替的句式節奏、類比先行的論證方式、冷麪熱心的情感表達、第一人稱介入的立場標定；並在不破壞作者習慣的前提下，清除顯眼的 AI 寫作痕跡（24 項檢測）。觸發詞：寫作、改寫、風格、潤色、重寫、精修、再優化、二稿、終稿、最終版、翻譯、譯、translate、翻成、譯成、轉為簡體。
subTools.description_zh: 精確復現特定作者的中文寫作風格。適用於從零生成文章、改寫、終稿精修、風格審閱，以及結構保真地將非簡體中文翻譯為簡體中文。核心特徵：半文半白用詞、長短交替句式、類比先行論證、冷麪熱心情感、第一人稱介入立場；並在不破壞作者習慣的前提下清除顯眼的 AI 寫作痕跡（24 項檢測）。

subTools.name: De AI Writing

subTools.description_zh: 中文寫作、改寫、潤色、翻譯和審閱的去 AI 味技能。用於保留原意和原文風格，減少路標詞、講義腔、模板句式、協作口吻和 AI 痕跡。預設輕量加載，按任務只讀取必要參考章節。

subTools.name: Good Writing
subTools.description: 復現特定作者中文寫作風格的輕量 Skill。用於從零寫作、改寫、終稿精修、風格審閱和結構保真翻譯。默認先讀風格摘要，不再啓動時通讀完整範文或大型檢測清單。
subTools.description_zh: 復現特定作者中文寫作風格的輕量 Skill。用於從零寫作、改寫、終稿精修、風格審閱和結構保真翻譯。預設先讀風格摘要，不再啟動時通讀完整範文或大型檢測清單。

Enhances narrative voice and tonal authenticity

negativeConstraints: Do not use for generating or debugging programming code

tools.useCase_zh: 此技能用於潤飾 AI 草擬的創意寫作或文章，使其讀來自然且無明顯機器生成痕跡。
tools.advantages_zh: 消除 LLM 輸出常見的重複句式。強化敘事語氣與語調真實感。最佳化提示，獲得更以人為中心的寫作結果。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適用於生成或除錯程式碼。
不適合需要精確術語的嚴格技術文件。
不適合事實性資料分析或數學推理。

tools.name: Writing Agent
tools.description: AI ghost writer with multi-platform formatting, strict QA, and originality validation.
tools.useCase: Ideal for marketing teams needing rapid, platform-specific blog posts that pass AI detection checks.
advantages: Built-in 40-point quality assurance pipeline ensures high editorial standards.
Native support for 18 distinct publishing platforms with automatic formatting.
Triple-detector validation bypasses major AI content filters for seamless publication.
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for generating legally binding contracts or medical advice requiring human certification.
Unsuitable for real-time collaborative editing or interactive conversational workflows.
Avoid for highly regulated academic research requiring verifiable primary source citations.
tools.description_zh: AI 幽靈寫手，支援多平台格式設定、嚴格 QA，以及原創性驗證。
tools.useCase_zh: 適合需要快速產出各平台專用部落格文章、且能通過 AI 檢測的行銷團隊。
tools.advantages_zh: 內建 40 項品質保證流程，確保高水準編輯標準。原生支援 18 種不同發布平台並自動格式化。三重偵測器驗證，繞過主要 AI 內容過濾器，實現無縫發布。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合生成需人工認證的具法律約束力合約或醫療建議。
不適合即時協作編輯或互動式對話工作流程。
不適合需要可驗證原始文獻引用的受高度規範之學術研究。

tools.name: MathModelAgent
tools.description: Agent for mathematical modeling that auto-generates complete, submission-ready research papers.
triggers: 完成數學建模比賽論文
tools.useCase: Ideal for math modeling competition participants needing to rapidly draft a structured paper from a problem statement.
advantages: Automates the full pipeline from problem interpretation to final document generation.
Produces professionally formatted papers suitable for direct submission.
Bilingual support for Chinese and English academic writing contexts.
negativeConstraints: Not appropriate for tasks requiring physical experiments or raw data collection.
Should not replace human judgment for verifying mathematical proofs or logical consistency.
Avoid for non-mathematical research domains like pure literature or arts.
tools.description_zh: 數學建模 Agent，可自動生成完整、可直接提交的論文。
tools.useCase_zh: 適合數學建模競賽參賽者，能快速從題目撰寫結構化論文。
tools.advantages_zh: 自動化從問題解析到最終文件生成的完整流程。產出專業排版的論文，可直接提交。支援中英雙語學術寫作情境。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適用於需要物理實驗或原始資料收集的工作。
不應取代人類對於驗證數學證明或邏輯一致性之判斷。
避免用於純文學或藝術等非數學研究領域。

tools.name: Blender
tools.description: Open-source 3D creation suite for modeling, animation, rendering, and video editing.
tools.useCase: Ideal for indie developers and artists building complete 3D assets, rigging characters, and rendering cinematic scenes without software licensing fees.

Unified pipeline combining modeling, sculpting, animation, compositing, and video editing in one application.
Extensive Python API and addon ecosystem enabling deep workflow customization and automation.
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for lightweight browser-based 3D visualization or real-time web interactions.
Inappropriate for precision CAD work, parametric mechanical design, or manufacturing-grade tolerances.
Poor fit for mobile-first game development where minimal build size and low overhead are critical.
tools.description_zh: 開源 3D 創作軟體，用於建模、動畫、渲染與影片編輯。
tools.useCase_zh: 適合獨立開發者與藝術家建立完整 3D 資產、為角色綁架，以及渲染電影級場景，且無需支付軟體授權費用。
tools.advantages_zh: 完全免費且開源，持續由社群驅動更新並支援跨平台。整合建模、雕刻、動畫、合成與影片編輯於單一應用程式的統一流程。提供廣泛的 Python API 與擴充元件生態系，實現深度的工作流程客製化與自動化。

不適合用於精確 CAD 工作、參數化機械設計或符合製造級公差的場景。
不適合用於對建置體積與資源開銷要求極低的行動裝置優先遊戲開發。

tools.name: Vibe Trading (HKUDS Research)
tools.description: Multi-agent LLM trading system using MCP for automated financial strategy execution.
triggers: 多代理自動化交易系統
自動化投資組合再平衡
tools.useCase: Best for developers prototyping autonomous trading bots that require natural language orchestration of market analysis and execution.
advantages: Integrates Model Context Protocol (MCP) for flexible tool connectivity.
Uses multi-agent architecture for collaborative financial decision-making.
Python-based design allows rapid customization for fintech workflows.
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for ultra-low-latency high-frequency trading requiring microsecond execution.
Avoid for strategies requiring guaranteed profits due to inherent LLM unpredictability.
Do not use for non-financial general-purpose automation tasks.
tools.description_zh: 使用 MCP 的多 Agent LLM 交易系統，用於自動化財務策略執行。
tools.useCase_zh: 最適合正在原型構建自主交易機器人（需以自然語言協調市場分析與執行）的開發者。
tools.advantages_zh: 整合 Model Context Protocol (MCP)，提供靈活的工具串接。採用多 Agent 架構進行協作式財務決策。Python 基底設計，利於快速客製化 fintech 工作流程。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合需要微秒級執行速度的超高延遲高頻交易。
不適用於因 LLM 本質不可預測而要求保證獲利的策略。
不應用於非金融用途的通用自動化任務。

tools.name: OmniRoute
tools.description: Unified AI gateway for 231+ providers with token compression and smart fallbacks.
triggers: 壓縮 AI Token 費用
自動切換 AI 提供商
統一接入多個 AI 接口
單一入口呼叫所有 AI 模型
智能降級失效 AI 服務
代理不同 AI 廠商呼叫
批量替換 API 接口呼叫
降低大語言模型使用成本
tools.useCase: Connect IDE plugins like Cursor or Cline to multiple LLM providers through a single local endpoint while reducing API costs via token compression.
advantages: Access 231+ providers including 50+ free options from one endpoint.
RTK+Caveman stacked compression saves 15-95% tokens.
Smart auto-fallback ensures reliability across providers.
negativeConstraints: Avoid for production workloads requiring dedicated GPU acceleration.
Not suitable if you need a fully managed hosted service without local setup.
Do not use for enterprise compliance scenarios requiring strict data residency guarantees without custom configuration.
tools.description_zh: 統一 AI 閘道，支援 231 個以上提供者，具備 token 壓縮與智慧後退機制。
tools.useCase_zh: 透過單一本地端點將 IDE 外掛（如 Cursor 或 Cline）連線至多個 LLM 提供者，同時透過 token 壓縮降低 API 成本。
tools.advantages_zh: 從單一端點存取 231 個以上提供者，包含 50 個以上免費選項。RTK+Caveman 疊加壓縮節省 15-95% token。智慧自動後退機制確保跨提供者可靠性。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合需要專屬 GPU 加速的生產環境負載。
如果您需要無需本地設定的完整託管服務，則不適用。
不適合需要在無客製化設定的情況下符合嚴格資料 residency 保證的企業合規情境。

tools.name: OpenThoughts Agent
tools.description: Open-source infrastructure and data recipes for training robust AI agents.
triggers: 生成 agent 訓練數據
匯編 agent 數據配方
建構 agent 訓練 pipeline
開發 AI agent 訓練數據
準備 agent 訓練資料
打造 agent 數據配方
tools.useCase: Ideal for researchers developing custom AI agents who need reproducible data recipes and training infrastructure.
advantages: Provides structured data recipes for generating high-quality agent training datasets.
Offers robust infrastructure to streamline the training workflow for AI agents.
Open-source framework enables customization for specific agentic model architectures.
negativeConstraints: Not intended for simple conversational chatbots requiring no tool-use capabilities.
Unsuitable for users seeking a pre-trained, ready-to-deploy agent solution.
Does not support non-LLM based traditional rule-based automation workflows.
tools.description_zh: 用於訓練穩健 AI 代理的開源基礎設施與資料配方。
tools.useCase_zh: 適合需要可重現資料配方與訓練基礎設施、開發客製化 AI 代理的研究人員。
tools.advantages_zh: 提供結構化資料配方，用於產生高品質代理訓練資料集。提供強健的基礎設施，簡化 AI 代理的訓練工作流程。開源框架支援針對特定代理模型架構進行客製化。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適用於不需要工具使用能力的簡單對話式聊天機器人。
不適合正在尋找預訓練、即可部署的 Agent 解決方案的使用者。
不支援基於非 LLM 的傳統規則型自動化工作流程。

tools.name: Financial Services
tools.description: Specialized AI tool for financial analysis, compliance checks, and risk management.

subTools.name: Audit Xls
subTools.description: Audit a spreadsheet for formula accuracy, errors, and common mistakes. Scopes to a selected range, a single sheet, or the entire model (including financial-model integrity checks like BS balance, cash tie-out, and logic sanity). Triggers on "audit this sheet", "check my formulas", "find formula errors", "QA this spreadsheet", "sanity check this", "debug model", "model check", "model won't balance", "something's off in my model", "model review".
subTools.description_zh: 稽核試算表的公式正確性、錯誤與常見失誤。可指定範圍、單一儲存格，或整個模型（含資產負債表平衡、現金對帳等財務完整性檢查）。觸發條件：稽核這個儲存格、檢查我的公式、找出公式錯誤、QA這個試算表、合理性檢查、除錯模型、模型無法平衡。

subTools.name: Earnings Analysis
subTools.description: Create professional equity research earnings update reports (8-12 pages, 3,000-5,000 words) analyzing quarterly results for companies already under coverage. Fast-turnaround format focusing on beat/miss analysis, key metrics, updated estimates, and revised thesis. Includes 1-3 summary tables and 8-12 charts. Use when user requests "earnings update", "quarterly update", "earnings analysis", "Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4 results", or post-earnings report.
subTools.description_zh: 為已覆核的公司產出專業股票研究獲利更新報告（8-12頁、3,000-5,000字），分析季度成果。聚焦超標/未達標分析、關鍵指標、更新預估與修正論點，含1-3個摘要表格與8-12張圖表。觸發條件：獲利更新、季度更新、獲利分析、Q1/Q2/…。

subTools.name: Earnings Preview
subTools.description: Build pre-earnings analysis with estimate models, scenario frameworks, and key metrics to watch. Use before a company reports quarterly earnings to prepare positioning notes, set up bull/bear scenarios, and identify what will move the stock. Triggers on "earnings preview", "what to watch for [company] earnings", "pre-earnings", "earnings setup", or "preview Q[X] for [company]".
subTools.description_zh: 建立獲利前分析，包含預估模型、情境框架與關鍵指標，用於準備定位報告、設定牛熊情境，並識別會影響股價的要素。觸發條件：獲利預覽、[公司]獲利要注意什麼、獲利前分析、獲利設定、預覽[公司]第[X]季。

subTools.name: Model Update
subTools.description: Update financial models with new data — quarterly earnings, management guidance, macro changes, or revised assumptions. Adjusts estimates, recalculates valuation, and flags material changes. Use after earnings, guidance updates, or when assumptions need refreshing. Triggers on "update model", "plug earnings", "refresh estimates", "update numbers for [company]", "new guidance", or "revise estimates".
subTools.description_zh: 以新資料更新財務模型——季度獲利、管理層指引、宏觀變化或修正假設。調整預估、重新計算估值，並標記重大變動。觸發條件：更新模型、填入獲利資料、刷新預估、為[公司]更新數字、新指引、修正預估。

subTools.name: Morning Note
subTools.description: Draft concise morning meeting notes summarizing overnight developments, trade ideas, and key events for coverage stocks. Designed for the 7am morning meeting format — tight, opinionated, actionable. Triggers on "morning note", "morning meeting", "what happened overnight", "trade idea", "morning call prep", or "daily note".
subTools.description_zh: 撰寫簡潔晨間會議筆記，總結 overnight 動態、交易構想與覆核股票的重點事件，專為早7點會議格式設計——精煉、具觀點、可執行。觸發條件：晨間筆記、晨間會議、overnight 發生了什麼、交易構想、晨間電話準備、每日筆記。

subTools.name: Xlsx Author
subTools.description: Produce a .xlsx file on disk (headless) instead of driving a live Excel workbook — for managed-agent sessions with no open Office app.
subTools.description_zh: 在磁碟上直接產出 .xlsx 檔案（無頭模式），而非操控實體 Excel 工作簿——適用於未開啟 Office 應用程式的受管代理作業階段。

subTools.name: Audit Xls
subTools.description: Audit a spreadsheet for formula accuracy, errors, and common mistakes. Scopes to a selected range, a single sheet, or the entire model (including financial-model integrity checks like BS balance, cash tie-out, and logic sanity). Triggers on "audit this sheet", "check my formulas", "find formula errors", "QA this spreadsheet", "sanity check this", "debug model", "model check", "model won't balance", "something's off in my model", "model review".
subTools.description_zh: 稽核試算表的公式正確性、錯誤與常見失誤。可指定範圍、單一儲存格，或整個模型（含資產負債表平衡、現金對帳等財務完整性檢查）。觸發條件：稽核這個儲存格、檢查我的公式、找出公式錯誤、QA這個試算表、合理性檢查、除錯模型、模型無法平衡。

subTools.name: Break Trace
subTools.description: Root-cause a reconciliation break to its source transaction or posting — follow the audit trail from the break row back to the originating entry on each side and state what differs and why. Use after gl-recon has classified a break.
subTools.description_zh: 將對帳差異追溯至原始交易或過帳——從差異列沿審計軌跡回溯至雙方各自的原始登入項目，說明差異內容與原因。在 gl-recon 已將差異分類後使用。

subTools.name: Gl Recon
subTools.description: Reconcile general ledger to subledger for a trade date or period — match at the position or transaction level, surface breaks, and classify each break by likely cause. Use for daily or month-end recon runs across asset classes.
subTools.description_zh: 將總賬與子分類賬對賬，用於特定交易日或期間——在部位或交易層級進行匹配、顯示差異，並按可能原因分類。用於資產類別的每日或月末對賬作業。

subTools.name: Xlsx Author
subTools.description: Produce a .xlsx file on disk (headless) instead of driving a live Excel workbook — for managed-agent sessions with no open Office app.
subTools.description_zh: 在磁碟上產生 .xlsx 檔案（無頭模式），而非驅動實際 Excel 工作簿——適用於沒有開啟 Office 應用程式的受管理代理工作階段。

subTools.name: Kyc Doc Parse
subTools.description: Parse an investor or client onboarding packet into structured KYC fields — identity, ownership, control, source of funds, and document inventory. Use as the first step of KYC screening; output feeds the rules engine.
subTools.description_zh: 將投資人或客戶入賬資料包解析為結構化 KYC 欄位——身分、所有權、控制權、資金來源及文件清單。作為 KYC 篩選的第一步，輸出供規則引擎使用。

subTools.name: Kyc Rules
subTools.description: Apply the firm's KYC/AML rules grid to a parsed onboarding record — assign a risk rating, list every rule outcome with the rule cited, and flag what's missing or escalation-worthy. Use after kyc-doc-parse; this skill decides nothing, it scores and routes.
subTools.description_zh: 將公司 KYC/AML 規則矩陣套用於已解析的入賬記錄——指派風險評等，列出每項規則結果與引用規則，標記遺漏或需上報事項。此技能僅評分與路由，不做決策。

subTools.name: Xlsx Author
subTools.description: Produce a .xlsx file on disk (headless) instead of driving a live Excel workbook — for managed-agent sessions with no open Office app.
subTools.description_zh: 在磁碟上產生 .xlsx 檔案（無頭模式），而非驅動實際 Excel 工作簿——適用於沒有開啟 Office 應用程式的受管理代理工作階段。

subTools.name: Competitive Analysis
subTools.description: Framework for building competitive landscape decks — market positioning, competitor deep-dives, comparative analysis, strategic synthesis. Use when the user asks for a competitive landscape, competitor analysis, peer comparison, market positioning assessment, strategic review, or investment memo deck. Also triggers on "who are the competitors to X", "benchmark X against peers", "build a market map", or any request to systematically evaluate competitive dynamics across an industry.
subTools.description_zh: 建構競爭格局簡報的框架——市場定位、競爭對手深度剖析、比較分析、策略綜述。用於競爭格局、同業比較、市場定位評估或投資簡報等需求。觸發條件包含市場地圖建構指令。

subTools.name: Idea Generation
subTools.description: Systematic stock screening and investment idea sourcing. Combines quantitative screens, thematic research, and pattern recognition to surface new long and short ideas. Use when looking for new ideas, running screens, or conducting thematic sweeps. Triggers on "idea generation", "stock screen", "find ideas", "what looks interesting", "screen for", "new ideas", or "pitch me something".
subTools.description_zh: 系統性股票篩選與投資構想 sourcing，結合量化篩選、主題研究與模式識別呈現新長空構想。用於尋找構想、執行篩選或主題掃掠，觸發詞包含股票篩選、尋找構想、向我推銷等。

subTools.name: Pptx Author
subTools.description: Produce a .pptx file on disk (headless) instead of driving a live PowerPoint document — for managed-agent sessions with no open Office app.
subTools.description_zh: 在本機磁碟直接產生 .pptx 檔案（無頭模式），而非驅動現有的 PowerPoint 文件，適用於未開啟 Office 應用程式的受管代理工作階段。

subTools.name: Sector Overview
subTools.description: Create comprehensive industry and sector landscape reports covering market dynamics, competitive positioning, key players, and thematic trends. Use for client requests, sector initiations, thematic research pieces, or internal knowledge building. Triggers on "sector overview", "industry report", "market landscape", "sector analysis", "industry deep dive", or "thematic research".
subTools.description_zh: 製作涵蓋市場動態、競爭定位、關鍵參與者與主題趨勢的產業全景報告，用於客戶需求、產業啟動、主題研究或內部知識建構。觸發詞為「sector overview」、「industry report」、「market landscape」、「sector analysis」、「industry deep dive」或「thematic research」。

subTools.name: Client Report
subTools.description: Generate professional client-facing performance reports with portfolio returns, allocation breakdowns, and market commentary. Suitable for quarterly or annual distribution. Triggers on "client report", "performance report", "quarterly report for [client]", "generate reports", or "client statement".
subTools.description_zh: 產生專業客戶版績效報告，包含投資組合報酬、配置明細與市場評論，適合季報或年報分發。觸發詞為「client report」、「performance report」、「quarterly report for [client]」、「generate reports」或「client statement」。

subTools.name: Client Review
subTools.description: Prepare for client review meetings with portfolio performance summary, allocation analysis, talking points, and action items. Pulls together account data into a concise meeting-ready format. Use before quarterly reviews, annual checkups, or ad-hoc client meetings. Triggers on "client review", "meeting prep for [client]", "quarterly review", "prep for [client name]", or "client meeting".
subTools.description_zh: 為客戶審查會議準備投資組合績效摘要、配置分析、討論重點與行動項目，整合帳戶資料成精簡格式。適用季/年度審查或臨時會議。觸發詞為「client review」、「meeting prep for [client]」、「quarterly review」、「prep for [client name]」或「client meeting」。

subTools.name: Investment Proposal
subTools.description: Create professional investment proposals for prospective clients. Covers the firm's approach, proposed allocation, expected outcomes, and fee structure. Use when pitching new clients or presenting a new investment strategy. Triggers on "investment proposal", "prospect presentation", "pitch new client", "proposal for [client]", or "new client presentation".
subTools.description_zh: 為潛在客戶製作專業投資提案，涵蓋公司做法、建議配置、預期成果與費率結構，用於接洽新客戶或展示新策略。觸發詞為「investment proposal」、「prospect presentation」、「pitch new client」、「proposal for [client]」或「new client presentation」。

subTools.description: Produce a .pptx file on disk (headless) instead of driving a live PowerPoint document — for managed-agent sessions with no open Office app.
subTools.description_zh: 在本機磁碟直接產生 .pptx 檔案（無頭模式），而非驅動現有的 PowerPoint 文件，適用於未開啟 Office 應用程式的受管代理工作階段。

subTools.name: 3 Statement Model
subTools.description: Complete, populate and fill out 3-statement financial model templates (Income Statement, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow Statement) . Use when asked to fill out model templates, complete existing model frameworks, populate financial models with data, complete a partially filled IS/BS/CF framework, or link integrated financial statements within an existing template structure. Triggers include requests to fill in, complete, or populate a 3-statement model template
subTools.description_zh: 完成並填滿損益表、資產負債表、現金流量表等三表財務模型範本，用於填寫模型範本、完成現有架構、填入財務資料，或連結現有模板內的綜合財務報表。

subTools.name: Audit Xls
subTools.description: Audit a spreadsheet for formula accuracy, errors, and common mistakes. Scopes to a selected range, a single sheet, or the entire model (including financial-model integrity checks like BS balance, cash tie-out, and logic sanity). Triggers on "audit this sheet", "check my formulas", "find formula errors", "QA this spreadsheet", "sanity check this", "debug model", "model check", "model won't balance", "something's off in my model", "model review".
subTools.description_zh: 稽核試算表的公式準確度、錯誤與常見問題，可限定範圍、單一工作表或整個模型，包含資產負債平衡、現金核對與邏輯合理性檢查。觸發詞為「audit this sheet」、「check my formulas」、「find formula errors」、「QA this spreadsheet」、「sanity check this」、「debug model」、「model check」、「model won't balance」。

subTools.name: Dcf Model
subTools.description: Real DCF (Discounted Cash Flow) model creation for equity valuation. Retrieves financial data from SEC filings and analyst reports, builds comprehensive cash flow projections with proper WACC calculations, performs sensitivity analysis, and outputs professional Excel models with executive summaries. Use when users need to value a company using DCF methodology, request intrinsic value analysis, or ask for detailed financial modeling with growth projections and terminal value calculations.
subTools.description_zh: 用於股權估值的真實折現現金流 (DCF) 模型建立。從 SEC 申報與分析師報告擷取財務資料，搭配 WACC 計算建構全面現金流預測，執行敏感度分析，輸出含執行摘要的專業 Excel 模型。當使用者需以 DCF 方法估值或進行內在價值分析時使用。

subTools.name: Lbo Model
subTools.description: This skill should be used when completing LBO (Leveraged Buyout) model templates in Excel for private equity transactions, deal materials, or investment committee presentations. The skill fills in formulas, validates calculations, and ensures professional formatting standards that adapt to any template structure.
subTools.description_zh: 用於完成 Excel 中的買入型收購 (LBO) 模型範本，適用於私募股權交易、投資組合文件或投資委員會簡報。此技能會填入公式、驗證計算，並確保符合專業格式標準，可適應任何範本結構。

subTools.description: Build the period-end accrual schedule — for each accrual, compute the entry, cite the support, and draft the JE. Use during month-end close; the JE is a draft for controller approval, not a posting.
subTools.description_zh: 建置期末應計排程 — 針對每筆應計項目，計算分錄、引用憑證支援，並草擬分錄。適用於月結流程；分錄僅供財務主管核可之草稿，非正式過帳。

Scopes to a selected range, a single sheet, or the entire model (including financial-model integrity checks like BS balance, cash tie-out, and logic sanity). Triggers on "audit this sheet", "check my formulas", "find formula errors", "QA this spreadsheet", "sanity check this", "debug model", "model check", "model won't balance", "something's off in my model", "model review".
subTools.description_zh: 查核試算表之公式正確性、錯誤與常見疏失。可限定範圍、單一工作表或整個模型（含資產負債表平衡、現金調節等財務模型完整性檢查）。觸發指令包括「查核此表」「檢查我的公式」等。

subTools.name: Roll Forward
subTools.description: Build a roll-forward schedule for a balance-sheet account — beginning balance plus activity less reversals equals ending balance, with each component tied to GL. Use for month-end close packages and audit support.
subTools.description_zh: 建置資產負債科目之期初期末調節表 — 期初餘額加活動量減衝銷等於期末餘額，各組件均與總帳勾稽。適用於月結報告包與查核支援。

subTools.name: Variance Commentary
subTools.description: Write flux commentary for every P&L and balance-sheet line over threshold — current vs prior period and vs budget, with the driver explained from underlying activity. Use for the month-end close package and management reporting.
subTools.description_zh: 針對所有超過門檻的損益表與資產負債表明細撰寫波動說明 — 列示本期對前期與對預算之差異，並從根本活動解釋差異驅動因素。適用於月結報告包與管理層報表。

subTools.name: Xlsx Author
subTools.description: Produce a .xlsx file on disk (headless) instead of driving a live Excel workbook — for managed-agent sessions with no open Office app.
subTools.description_zh: 在磁碟上產生 .xlsx 檔案（無頭模式），而非操作活頁簿——適用於無開啟 Office 應用程式的受管代理工作階段。

subTools.name: 3 Statement Model
subTools.description: Complete, populate and fill out 3-statement financial model templates (Income Statement, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow Statement) . Use when asked to fill out model templates, complete existing model frameworks, populate financial models with data, complete a partially filled IS/BS/CF framework, or link integrated financial statements within an existing template structure. Triggers include requests to fill in, complete, or populate a 3-statement model template
subTools.description_zh: 完成、填滿三表財務模型範本（損益表、資產負債表、現金流量表）。當要求填寫模型範本、完成現有模型架構、以資料填入財務模型、完成部分填好的 IS/BS/CF 框架，或在現有範本結構中連結綜合財務報表時使用。觸發情境包含相關請求。

subTools.name: Audit Xls
subTools.description: Audit a spreadsheet for formula accuracy, errors, and common mistakes. Scopes to a selected range, a single sheet, or the entire model (including financial-model integrity checks like BS balance, cash tie-out, and logic sanity). Triggers on "audit this sheet", "check my formulas", "find formula errors", "QA this spreadsheet", "sanity check this", "debug model", "model check", "model won't balance", "something's off in my model", "model review".
subTools.description_zh: 稽核試算表的公式正確性、錯誤與常見疏失。可限定範圍、單一工作表或整個模型（含資產負債平衡、現金對帳、邏輯合理性等財務模型完整性檢查）。觸發語句包含「稽核此工作表」「檢查我的公式」「找出公式錯誤」「試算表 QA」「合理性檢查」「除錯模型」等。

subTools.name: Dcf Model
subTools.description: Real DCF (Discounted Cash Flow) model creation for equity valuation. Retrieves financial data from SEC filings and analyst reports, builds comprehensive cash flow projections with proper WACC calculations, performs sensitivity analysis, and outputs professional Excel models with executive summaries. Use when users need to value a company using DCF methodology, request intrinsic value analysis, or ask for detailed financial modeling with growth projections and terminal value calculations.
subTools.description_zh: 用於股權估值的真實 DCF（現金流量折現）模型。從 SEC 申報文件和分析師報告中提取財務資料，建立完整的現金流量預測與 WACC 計算，執行敏感性分析，產出附帶執行摘要的專業 Excel 模型。適用於公司估值或內在價值分析需求。

subTools.name: Deck Refresh
subTools.description: Updates a presentation with new numbers — quarterly refreshes, earnings updates, comp rolls, rebased market data. Use whenever the user asks to "update the deck with Q4 numbers", "refresh the comps", "roll this forward", "swap in the new earnings", "change all the $485M to $512M", or any request to swap figures across an existing deck without rebuilding it.
subTools.description_zh: 用新資料更新簡報，包括季度更新、財報更新、比較分析表、重新基準化的市場資料。當使用者要求「用 Q4 資料更新簡報」、「刷新比較資料」、「往前推演」、「替換最新財報」或更換現有簡報數字時使用。

subTools.name: Ib Check Deck
subTools.description: Investment banking presentation quality checker. Reviews a pitch deck or client-ready presentation for (1) number consistency across slides, (2) data-narrative alignment, (3) language polish against IB standards, (4) visual and formatting QC. Use whenever the user asks to review, check, QC, proof, or do a final pass on a deck, pitch, or client materials — including requests like "check my numbers", "reconcile figures across slides", "is this client-ready", or "what am I missing before I send this out".
subTools.description_zh: 投資銀行簡報品質檢查工具。審查推介簡報或客戶級簡報的：(1) 各頁數字一致性、(2) 資料與敘述一致性、(3) 語言是否符合投行標準、(4) 視覺與格式檢查。適用於簡報、推介或客戶材料的最終檢查需求。

subTools.name: Lbo Model
subTools.description: This skill should be used when completing LBO (Leveraged Buyout) model templates in Excel for private equity transactions, deal materials, or investment committee presentations. The skill fills in formulas, validates calculations, and ensures professional formatting standards that adapt to any template structure.
subTools.description_zh: 用於建立 LBO（槓桿收購）Excel 模型模板，適用於私募股權交易、交易文件或投資委員會簡報。此技能會填入公式、驗證計算結果，並確保符合專業格式標準，可適應任何模板結構。

subTools.name: Pitch Deck
subTools.description: Populates investment banking pitch deck templates with data from source files. Use when: user provides a PowerPoint template to fill in, user has source data (Excel/CSV) to populate into slides, user mentions populating or filling a pitch deck template, or user needs to transfer data into existing slide layouts. Not for creating presentations from scratch.
subTools.description_zh: 從來源檔案資料填充投資銀行簡報模板。適用情境：使用者提供 PowerPoint 模板需填入、有 Excel/CSV 資料需填入投影片、提到填充簡報模板，或需將資料轉入現有投影片版面。不適用於從頭建立簡報。

subTools.name: Pptx Author
subTools.description: Produce a .pptx file on disk (headless) instead of driving a live PowerPoint document — for managed-agent sessions with no open Office app.
subTools.description_zh: 在磁碟上產生 .pptx 檔案（無頭模式），而非操作現有的 PowerPoint 文件——適用於未開啟 Office 應用程式的託管代理工作階段。

subTools.name: Sector Overview
subTools.description: Create comprehensive industry and sector landscape reports covering market dynamics, competitive positioning, key players, and thematic trends. Use for client requests, sector initiations, thematic research pieces, or internal knowledge building. Triggers on "sector overview", "industry report", "market landscape", "sector analysis", "industry deep dive", or "thematic research".
subTools.description_zh: 製作涵蓋市場動態、競爭定位、關鍵參與者與主題趨勢的全面產業概覽報告。適用客戶需求、產業啟動、主題研究或內部知識建立。觸發詞包含「sector overview」「industry report」「market landscape」「sector analysis」「industry deep dive」「thematic research」。

subTools.name: Xlsx Author
subTools.description: Produce a .xlsx file on disk (headless) instead of driving a live Excel workbook — for managed-agent sessions with no open Office app.
subTools.description_zh: 在磁碟上產生 .xlsx 檔案（無頭模式），而非操作現有的 Excel 工作簿——適用於未開啟 Office 應用程式的託管代理工作階段。

subTools.name: Audit Xls
subTools.description: Audit a spreadsheet for formula accuracy, errors, and common mistakes. Scopes to a selected range, a single sheet, or the entire model (including financial-model integrity checks like BS balance, cash tie-out, and logic sanity). Triggers on "audit this sheet", "check my formulas", "find formula errors", "QA this spreadsheet", "sanity check this", "debug model", "model check", "model won't balance", "something's off in my model", "model review".
subTools.description_zh: 稽核試算表的公式準確性、錯誤與常見問題。可指定範圍、單一工作表或整個模型（含資產負債平衡、現金對帳、邏輯合理性等財務模型完整性檢查）。觸發語句包括「稽核這個工作表」、「檢查我的公式」、「找出公式錯誤」、「QA 這個試算表」、「合理性檢查」、「除錯模型」、「模型檢查」、「模型無法平衡」。

subTools.name: Nav Tieout
subTools.description: Tie an LP statement to the fund's NAV pack — recompute the LP's capital account from the NAV components and flag any line that doesn't agree. Use before LP statements are distributed.
subTools.description_zh: 將 LP 聲明與基金的 NAV 包對帳，根據 NAV 組成項目重新計算 LP 的資本帳戶，並標記任何不符的行。在分發 LP 聲明前使用。

subTools.name: Xlsx Author
subTools.description: Produce a .xlsx file on disk (headless) instead of driving a live Excel workbook — for managed-agent sessions with no open Office app.
subTools.description_zh: 以無頭模式在磁碟上產生 .xlsx 檔案，而非操作開啟中的 Excel — 適用於沒有開啟 Office 應用程式的托管代理工作階段。

subTools.name: Ic Memo
subTools.description: Draft a structured investment committee memo for PE deal approval. Synthesizes due diligence findings, financial analysis, and deal terms into a professional IC-ready document. Use when preparing for investment committee, writing up a deal, or creating a formal recommendation. Triggers on "write IC memo", "investment committee memo", "deal write-up", "prepare IC materials", or "recommendation memo".
subTools.description_zh: 草擬結構化的投審會備忘錄，用於私募股權交易審批。整合盡職調查結果、財務分析與交易條款，形成專業的投審會準備文件。適用於籌備投審會、撰寫交易報告或建立正式建議時。觸發語句包括「撰寫投審會備忘錄」、「投資委員會備忘錄」、「交易報告」、「準備投審會資料」或「建議備忘錄」。

subTools.name: Portfolio Monitoring
subTools.description: Track and analyze portfolio company performance against plan. Ingests monthly/quarterly financial packages (Excel, PDF), extracts KPIs, flags variances to budget, and produces summary dashboards. Use when reviewing portfolio company financials, preparing board materials, or monitoring covenant compliance. Triggers on "review portfolio company", "monthly financials", "how is [company] performing", "covenant check", or "portfolio update".
subTools.description_zh: 追蹤並分析投資組合公司表現與計畫的比較。接收月度/季度財務報告套件（Excel、PDF），提取 KPI，標記與預算的差異，並產生摘要儀表板。當檢視投資組合公司財務、準備董事會材料或監控 covenant 合規時使用。觸發條件為 'review portfolio company'、'monthly financials'、'how is [company] performing'。

subTools.name: Returns Analysis
subTools.description: Build quick IRR/MOIC sensitivity tables for PE deal evaluation. Models returns across entry multiple, leverage, exit multiple, growth, and hold period scenarios. Use when sizing up a deal, stress-testing assumptions, or preparing IC returns exhibits. Triggers on "returns analysis", "IRR sensitivity", "MOIC table", "what's the return at", "model the returns", or "back of the envelope".
subTools.description_zh: 為 PE 交易評估建立快速的 IRR/MOIC 敏感性表格。模擬在不同進入倍數、槓桿、退出倍數、成長和持有期間情境下的報酬。當評估交易、壓力測試假設或準備 IC 報酬展示時使用。觸發條件為 'returns analysis'、'IRR sensitivity'、'MOIC table'、'what's the return at'、'model the returns' 或 'back of the envelope'。

subTools.name: Xlsx Author
subTools.description: Produce a .xlsx file on disk (headless) instead of driving a live Excel workbook — for managed-agent sessions with no open Office app.
subTools.description_zh: 在磁碟上產生 .xlsx 檔案（無頭模式），而非驅動實際的 Excel 工作簿 —— 適用於沒有開啟 Office 應用程式的管理代理 sessions。

subTools.name: Bond Futures Basis
subTools.description: Analyze the bond futures basis by pricing futures, identifying the cheapest-to-deliver, and comparing with yield curves to assess delivery option value and basis trading opportunities. Use when analyzing bond futures, computing the basis, identifying CTD bonds, calculating implied repo rates, or evaluating basis trades.
subTools.description_zh: 透過對沖期貨定價、識別最便宜可交割債券，並與殖利率曲線比較，以評估交割選擇權價值及基差交易機會。當分析債券期貨、計算基差、識別 CTD 債券、計算隱含回購利率或評估基差交易時使用。

subTools.name: Bond Relative Value
subTools.description: Perform relative value analysis on bonds by combining pricing, yield curve context, credit spreads, and scenario stress testing. Use when analyzing bond richness/cheapness, computing spread decomposition, comparing bonds, assessing bond value vs curves, or running rate shock scenarios.
subTools.description_zh: 結合定價、殖利率曲線背景、信用利差和情境壓力測試，執行債券相對價值分析。當分析債券定價高低、計算利差分解、比較債券、評估債券相對於曲線的價值或執行利率衝擊情境時使用。

subTools.name: Equity Research
subTools.description: Generate comprehensive equity research snapshots combining analyst consensus estimates, company fundamentals, historical prices, and macroeconomic context. Use when researching stocks, comparing estimates to actuals, analyzing company financials, assessing equity valuations, or building investment cases.
subTools.description_zh: 結合分析師共識估算、公司基本因素、歷史價格和宏觀經濟背景，產生全面性的股票研究快照。當研究股票、比較估算與實際值、分析公司財務、評估股票估值或建構投資論點時使用。

subTools.name: Fixed Income Portfolio
subTools.description: Review fixed income portfolios by pricing multiple bonds, retrieving reference data, analyzing cashflows, and running scenario analysis. Use when reviewing bond portfolios, computing portfolio duration and DV01, analyzing cashflow waterfalls, stress testing rate scenarios, or assessing portfolio composition.
subTools.description_zh: 透過對沖多檔債券、取得參考資料、分析現金流和執行情境分析，檢視固定收益投資組合。當檢視債券投資組合、計算投資組合 duration 和 DV01、分析現金流瀑布、壓力測試利率情境或評估投資組合組成時使用。

subTools.name: Fx Carry Trade
subTools.description: Evaluate FX carry trade opportunities by combining spot rates, forward points, interest rate differentials, volatility surface analysis, and historical price trends. Use when analyzing carry trades, comparing FX forward curves, assessing carry-to-vol ratios, or evaluating currency pair opportunities.
subTools.description_zh: 結合即期匯率、遠期點數、利率差異、波動率曲面分析和歷史價格趨勢，評估外匯利差交易機會。當分析利差交易、比較外匯遠期曲線、評估利差對波動率比率或評估貨幣對機會時使用。

subTools.name: Macro Rates Monitor
subTools.description: Build macroeconomic and rates dashboards combining macro indicators, yield curves, inflation breakevens, and swap rates. Use when monitoring macro conditions, analyzing yield curve shape, decomposing real vs nominal rates, assessing policy rate expectations, or evaluating financial conditions.
subTools.description_zh: 整合宏觀指標、殖利率曲線、通膨損益平衡點與掉期利率，建構宏觀與利率儀表板。適用於監控宏觀條件、分析殖利率曲線形狀、拆解實質與名目利率、評估政策利率預期或檢視金融條件。

subTools.name: Option Vol Analysis
subTools.description: Analyze option volatility by combining vol surface data, option pricing with Greeks, and historical price data to assess implied vs realized volatility. Use when pricing options, analyzing volatility surfaces, computing Greeks, assessing vol premiums, or evaluating vol trading strategies.
subTools.description_zh: 結合波動度surface資料、含Greek的選擇權定價與歷史價格資料，分析選擇權波動度，評估隱含與實現波動度之差。適用於選擇權定價、波動度surface分析、Greek計算、波動度溢價評估或波動度交易策略檢視。

subTools.name: Swap Curve Strategy
subTools.description: Analyze the interest rate swap curve by pricing swaps at multiple tenors, overlaying government and inflation curves, and identifying curve trade opportunities. Use when analyzing swap curves, computing swap spreads, decomposing real rates, identifying steepener/flattener/butterfly trades, or comparing swap rates across currencies.
subTools.description_zh: 針對多期程評價掉期，疊加公債與通膨曲線，識別曲線交易機會。適用於分析掉期曲線、計算掉期利差、拆解實質利率、識別陡縮／平坦化／蝴蝶交易，或比較不同貨幣的掉期利率。

subTools.name: Earnings Preview Beta
subTools.description: Generate a concise 4-5 page equity research earnings preview for a single company. Analyzes the most recent earnings transcript, competitor landscape, valuation, and recent news to produce a professional HTML report.
subTools.description_zh: 為單一公司產出4至5頁精簡的股票的權益研究獲利Preview。分析最新獲利電話會議紀錄、競爭者格局、估值與近期新聞，產出專業HTML報告。

subTools.name: Funding Digest
subTools.description: Generate a polished one-page PowerPoint slide summarizing key takeaways from recent funding rounds and notable capital markets activity across a user's watched sectors or companies. Use this skill when the user asks for a deal flow summary, weekly recap, funding digest, transaction roundup, or capital markets briefing. Triggers on: 'deal flow digest', 'weekly funding recap', 'deal roundup', 'transaction summary this week', 'what happened in [sector] this week', 'capital markets update', or any request to compile recent funding activity into a briefing slide. Produces a professional single-slide PPTX with key takeaways, valuation data, and Capital IQ deal links.
subTools.description_zh: 生成精選的一頁 PowerPoint 簡報，總結近期融資輪次及使用者關注領域或公司的資本市場活動要點。當使用者要求交易流程摘要、每週回顧、融資摘要、交易整理或資本市場簡報時使用此技能。觸發詞包括：交易流程摘要、每週融資回顧、交易整理、交易匯總等。

subTools.name: Tear Sheet
subTools.description: Generate professional company tear sheets using S&P Capital IQ data via the Kensho LLM-ready API MCP server.
