Use this skill whenever the user asks for a tear sheet, company one-pager, company profile, fact sheet, company snapshot, or company overview document — especially when they mention a specific company name or ticker. Also trigger when users ask for equity research summaries, M&A company profiles, corporate development target profiles, sales/BD meeting prep documents, or any concise single-company financial summary. This skill supports four audience types: equity research, investment banking/M&A, corporate development, and sales/business development. If the user doesn't specify an audience, ask. Works for both public and private companies.
subTools.description_zh: 透過 S&P Capital IQ 資料及 Kensho LLM-ready API MCP 伺服器，生成專業的公司概覽表。當使用者要求公司概覽表、公司一頁摘要、公司資料表、事實摘要、公司快照或公司概述檔案時使用此技能，特別是在提及特定公司名稱或股票代號時。亦適用於股票研究摘要、併購公司前景等需求。

subTools.name: Catalyst Calendar
subTools.description: Build and maintain a calendar of upcoming catalysts across a coverage universe — earnings dates, conferences, product launches, regulatory decisions, and macro events. Helps prioritize attention and position ahead of events. Triggers on "catalyst calendar", "upcoming events", "what's coming up", "earnings calendar", "event calendar", or "catalyst tracker".
subTools.description_zh: 建立並維護涵蓋標的 upcoming 催化劑行事曆，包括財報日期、會議、產品發布、監管決策及宏觀事件。協助優先處理關注事項並提前布局。觸發詞包括：「催化劑行事曆」、「即將發生事件」、「 upcoming 動態」、「財報日曆」、「行事曆」或「催化劑追蹤」。

subTools.name: Earnings Analysis
subTools.description: Create professional equity research earnings update reports (8-12 pages, 3,000-5,000 words) analyzing quarterly results for companies already under coverage. Fast-turnaround format focusing on beat/miss analysis, key metrics, updated estimates, and revised thesis. Includes 1-3 summary tables and 8-12 charts. Use when user requests "earnings update", "quarterly update", "earnings analysis", "Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4 results", or post-earnings report.
subTools.description_zh: 製作專業的股票研究獲利更新報告（8-12 頁，3,000-5,000 字），分析已覆蓋公司的季度業績。快速產出格式著重超標/未達標分析、關鍵指標、更新預估及修正投資論述。包含 1-3 個摘要表格及 8-12 張圖表。當使用者要求「獲利更新」、「季度更新」、「獲利分析」、「Q1/Q2/」時使用。

subTools.name: Earnings Preview
subTools.description: Build pre-earnings analysis with estimate models, scenario frameworks, and key metrics to watch. Use before a company reports quarterly earnings to prepare positioning notes, set up bull/bear scenarios, and identify what will move the stock. Triggers on "earnings preview", "what to watch for [company] earnings", "pre-earnings", "earnings setup", or "preview Q[X] for [company]".
subTools.description_zh: 運用預估模型、情境框架與關鍵指標，進行財報前的分析準備。用於編寫部位建議、建立牛熊情境，並找出可能影響股價的變數。觸發條件包含「earnings preview」、「what to watch for [公司] earnings」、「pre-earnings」、「earnings setup」或「preview Q[X] for [公司]」。

subTools.name: Idea Generation
subTools.description: Systematic stock screening and investment idea sourcing. Combines quantitative screens, thematic research, and pattern recognition to surface new long and short ideas. Use when looking for new ideas, running screens, or conducting thematic sweeps. Triggers on "idea generation", "stock screen", "find ideas", "what looks interesting", "screen for", "new ideas", or "pitch me something".
subTools.description_zh: 系統性選股與投資構思發掘，結合量化篩選、主題研究與模式辨識，尋找新多頭與空頭構想。適用於尋找新標的、執行篩選或進行主題掃描。觸發條件包含「idea generation」、「stock screen」、「find ideas」、「what looks interesting」、「screen for」、「new ideas」或「pitch me something」。

subTools.name: Initiating Coverage
subTools.description: Create institutional-quality equity research initiation reports through a 5-task workflow. Tasks must be executed individually with verified prerequisites - (1) company research, (2) financial modeling, (3) valuation analysis, (4) chart generation, (5) final report assembly. Each task produces specific deliverables (markdown docs, Excel models, charts, or DOCX reports). Tasks 3-5 have dependencies on earlier tasks.
subTools.description_zh: 透過五步驟工作流建立機構級股票研究啟動報告。任務須依序執行且滿足前置條件：(1) 公司研究 (2) 財務建模 (3) 估值分析 (4) 圖表生成 (5) 最終報告組裝。各任務產生特定交付物（markdown 文件、Excel 模型、圖表或 DOCX 報告），任務 3–5 存在相依性。

subTools.name: Model Update
subTools.description: Update financial models with new data — quarterly earnings, management guidance, macro changes, or revised assumptions. Adjusts estimates, recalculates valuation, and flags material changes. Use after earnings, guidance updates, or when assumptions need refreshing. Triggers on "update model", "plug earnings", "refresh estimates", "update numbers for [company]", "new guidance", or "revise estimates".
subTools.description_zh: 用新資料更新財務模型，包含季報、管理層指引、宏觀變動或假設修正。調整預估、重新計算估值並標記重大變更。適用於財報後、指引更新或假設需更新時。觸發條件包含「update model」、「plug earnings」、「refresh estimates」、「update numbers for [公司]」、「new guidance」或「revise estimates」。

subTools.name: Morning Note
subTools.description: Draft concise morning meeting notes summarizing overnight developments, trade ideas, and key events for coverage stocks. Designed for the 7am morning meeting format — tight, opinionated, actionable. Triggers on "morning note", "morning meeting", "what happened overnight", "trade idea", "morning call prep", or "daily note".
subTools.description_zh: 草擬簡潔的晨會筆記，摘要隔夜發展、交易構想與覆蓋股關鍵事件。專為早上七點的晨會格式設計——精煉、有見地、可執行。觸發詞包括「morning note」、「morning meeting」、「overnight 發生了什麼事」、「trade idea」、「morning call prep」、「daily note」。

subTools.name: Sector Overview
subTools.description: Create comprehensive industry and sector landscape reports covering market dynamics, competitive positioning, key players, and thematic trends. Use for client requests, sector initiations, thematic research pieces, or internal knowledge building. Triggers on "sector overview", "industry report", "market landscape", "sector analysis", "industry deep dive", or "thematic research".
subTools.description_zh: 製作全面的產業與Sector landscape 報告，涵蓋市場動態、競爭定位、關鍵參與者與主題趨勢。適用於客戶請求、Sector 啟動、主題研究或內部知識建立。觸發詞包括「sector overview」、「industry report」、「market landscape」、「sector analysis」、「industry deep dive」、「thematic research」。

subTools.name: Thesis Tracker
subTools.description: Maintain and update investment theses for portfolio positions and watchlist names. Track key data points, catalysts, and thesis milestones over time. Use when updating a thesis with new information, reviewing position rationale, or checking if a thesis is still intact. Triggers on "update thesis for [company]", "is my thesis still intact", "thesis check", "add data point to [company]", or "review my positions".
subTools.description_zh: 維護並更新投資組合部位與觀察名單的投資論點。隨時間追蹤關鍵資料、催化劑與論點里程碑。用於用新資訊更新論點、檢視部位合理性，或檢查論點是否仍成立。觸發詞包括「update thesis for [公司]」、「is my thesis still intact」、「thesis check」、「add data point to [公司]」、「review」。

subTools.name: 3 Statement Model
subTools.description: Complete, populate and fill out 3-statement financial model templates (Income Statement, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow Statement) . Use when asked to fill out model templates, complete existing model frameworks, populate financial models with data, complete a partially filled IS/BS/CF framework, or link integrated financial statements within an existing template structure. Triggers include requests to fill in, complete, or populate a 3-statement model template
subTools.description_zh: 完成、填充並填寫三表財務模型範本（損益表、資產負債表、現金流量表）。用於要求填寫模型範本、完成現有模型框架、以資料填充財務模型、完成部分填寫的 IS/BS/CF 框架，或在現有範本結構中連結整合的財務報表。觸發詞包括要求「fill out model templates」、「complete existing model frameworks」、「populate financial models with data」、「complete a partially filled IS/BS/CF framework」、「link integrated financial statements within an existing template structure」。

subTools.name: Audit Xls
subTools.description: Audit a spreadsheet for formula accuracy, errors, and common mistakes. Scopes to a selected range, a single sheet, or the entire model (including financial-model integrity checks like BS balance, cash tie-out, and logic sanity). Triggers on "audit this sheet", "check my formulas", "find formula errors", "QA this spreadsheet", "sanity check this", "debug model", "model check", "model won't balance", "something's off in my model", "model review".
subTools.description_zh: 稽核試算表的公式準確性、錯誤與常見疏失。可針對選定範圍、單一資料表或整個模型進行檢查（包含資產負債表平衡、現金調節等財務模型完整性驗證）。觸發語句：稽核此資料表、檢查我的公式、尋找公式錯誤、QA 此試算表、合理性檢查、除錯模型、模型無法平衡。

subTools.name: Clean Data Xls
subTools.description: Clean up messy spreadsheet data — trim whitespace, fix inconsistent casing, convert numbers-stored-as-text, standardize dates, remove duplicates, and flag mixed-type columns. Use when data is messy, inconsistent, or needs prep before analysis. Triggers on "clean this data", "clean up this sheet", "normalize this data", "fix formatting", "dedupe", "standardize this column", "this data is messy".
subTools.description_zh: 清理雜亂的試算表資料——移除空白字元、修正大小寫不一致、轉換文字型數字、標準化日期、去除重複值，並標記混合型欄位。當資料髒亂、不一致或分析前需處理時使用。觸發語句：清理這些資料、整理此資料表、標準化這些資料、修正格式、去重複、標準化此欄位。

subTools.name: Competitive Analysis
subTools.description: Framework for building competitive landscape decks — market positioning, competitor deep-dives, comparative analysis, strategic synthesis. Use when the user asks for a competitive landscape, competitor analysis, peer comparison, market positioning assessment, strategic review, or investment memo deck. Also triggers on "who are the competitors to X", "benchmark X against peers", "build a market map", or any request to systematically evaluate competitive dynamics across an industry.
subTools.description_zh: 建構競爭情勢簡報的框架——市場定位、競爭對手深度分析、比較分析與策略綜合。用於競爭環境、競爭對手分析、同業比較、市場定位評估、策略檢視或投資備忘錄簡報。觸發語句：X 的競爭對手是誰、將 X 與同業比較、建立市場地圖。

subTools.name: Dcf Model
subTools.description: Real DCF (Discounted Cash Flow) model creation for equity valuation. Retrieves financial data from SEC filings and analyst reports, builds comprehensive cash flow projections with proper WACC calculations, performs sensitivity analysis, and outputs professional Excel models with executive summaries. Use when users need to value a company using DCF methodology, request intrinsic value analysis, or ask for detailed financial modeling with growth projections and terminal value calculations.
subTools.description_zh: 建立真實的 DCF（現金流折現）模型用於股票估值。從 SEC 申報與分析師報告擷取財務資料，建立完整的現金流預測與 WACC 計算，進行靈敏度分析，並輸出專業 Excel 模型與執行摘要。適用場景：需以 DCF 方法為公司估值、要求內在設計價值分析。

subTools.name: Deck Refresh
subTools.description: Updates a presentation with new numbers — quarterly refreshes, earnings updates, comp rolls, rebased market data. Use whenever the user asks to "update the deck with Q4 numbers", "refresh the comps", "roll this forward", "swap in the new earnings", "change all the $485M to $512M", or any request to swap figures across an existing deck without rebuilding it.
subTools.description_zh: 用新資料更新簡報，包含季度刷新、 earnings 更新、比較公司清單、基準重新調整的市場資料。適用情境：當使用者要求「用 Q4 數字更新簡報」、「刷新比較資料」、「向前推演」、「換入新的 earnings」或「將所有 4.85 億美元改為 5.12 億美元」。

subTools.name: Ib Check Deck
subTools.description: Investment banking presentation quality checker. Reviews a pitch deck or client-ready presentation for (1) number consistency across slides, (2) data-narrative alignment, (3) language polish against IB standards, (4) visual and formatting QC. Use whenever the user asks to review, check, QC, proof, or do a final pass on a deck, pitch, or client materials — including requests like "check my numbers", "reconcile figures across slides", "is this client-ready", or "what am I missing before I send this out".
subTools.description_zh: 投資銀行簡報品質檢查器。審查簡報，確保（1）各頁數字一致性、（2）資料與敘述相符、（3）語言符合 IB 標準、（4）視覺與格式 QC。適用情境：使用者要求審核、檢查、QC、校對或做最終審查，如「幫我檢查數字」。

subTools.name: Lbo Model
subTools.description: This skill should be used when completing LBO (Leveraged Buyout) model templates in Excel for private equity transactions, deal materials, or investment committee presentations. The skill fills in formulas, validates calculations, and ensures professional formatting standards that adapt to any template structure.
subTools.description_zh: 適用於在 Excel 中建立 LBO（槓桿買收）模型模板，用於私募股權交易、投標文件或投資委員會簡報。此技能自動填入公式、驗證計算結果，並確保符合專業格式的標準，能適應任何模板結構。

subTools.name: Ppt Template Creator
subTools.description: Creates self-contained PPT template SKILLS (not presentations) from user-provided PowerPoint templates. Use ONLY when a user wants to create a reusable skill from their template. For creating actual presentations, use the pptx skill instead.
subTools.description_zh: 根據使用者提供的 PowerPoint 範本，建立可複用的簡報範本技能（非製作簡報）。僅當使用者想要從範本建立技能時使用；若需建立實際簡報，請改用 pptx 技能。

subTools.name: Pptx Author
subTools.description: Produce a .pptx file on disk (headless) instead of driving a live PowerPoint document — for managed-agent sessions with no open Office app.
subTools.description_zh: 直接在磁碟上產生 .pptx 檔案（無頭模式），而非操作開啟中的 PowerPoint 文件——適用於未開啟 Office 應用程式的受管理代理 sessions。

subTools.name: Skill Creator
subTools.description: Guide for creating effective skills. This skill should be used when users want to create a new skill (or update an existing skill) that extends Claude's capabilities with specialized knowledge, workflows, or tool integrations.
subTools.description_zh: 有效建立技能的指引。當使用者想要建立新技能或更新現有技能、以擴充 Claude 具備專業知識或工作流程能力時使用此技能。

subTools.name: Xlsx Author
subTools.description: Produce a .xlsx file on disk (headless) instead of driving a live Excel workbook — for managed-agent sessions with no open Office app.
subTools.description_zh: 直接在磁碟上產生 .xlsx 檔案（無頭模式），而非操作開啟中的 Excel 工作簿——適用於未開啟 Office 應用程式的受管理代理 sessions。

subTools.name: Accrual Schedule
subTools.description: Build the period-end accrual schedule — for each accrual, compute the entry, cite the support, and draft the JE. Use during month-end close; the JE is a draft for controller approval, not a posting.
subTools.description_zh: 編製期末應計項目明細表——針對每一筆應計項目計算分錄、引用憑證，並草擬傳票。適用於月結作業；該傳票僅為核可草案，非正式入帳。

subTools.name: Break Trace
subTools.description: Root-cause a reconciliation break to its source transaction or posting — follow the audit trail from the break row back to the originating entry on each side and state what differs and why. Use after gl-recon has classified a break.
subTools.description_zh: 追查對帳差異的根本原因至源頭交易或分錄——沿著稽核軌跡從差異列回溯至雙方原始分錄，說明差異內容與原因。於 gl-recon 完成差異分類後使用。

subTools.name: Gl Recon
subTools.description: Reconcile general ledger to subledger for a trade date or period — match at the position or transaction level, surface breaks, and classify each break by likely cause. Use for daily or month-end recon runs across asset classes.
subTools.description_zh: 就交易日期或期間將總帳與子帳對帳——於部位或交易層級進行匹配，揭露差異，並依可能原因分類每一筆差異。用於跨資產類別的日常或月結對帳作業。

subTools.name: Nav Tieout
subTools.description: Tie an LP statement to the fund's NAV pack — recompute the LP's capital account from the NAV components and flag any line that doesn't agree. Use before LP statements are distributed.
subTools.description_zh: 將投資人對帳單與基金淨值明細核對——由淨值項目重新計算投資人資本帳戶，並標示任何不符項目。於投資人對帳單寄送前使用。

subTools.name: Roll Forward
subTools.description: Build a roll-forward schedule for a balance-sheet account — beginning balance plus activity less reversals equals ending balance, with each component tied to GL. Use for month-end close packages and audit support.
subTools.description_zh: 建立 Balance Sheet 科目的餘額試算表——期初餘額加活動減衝銷等於期末餘額，各 component 連接到 GL。用於月結套件和審計支援。

subTools.name: Variance Commentary
subTools.description: Write flux commentary for every P&L and balance-sheet line over threshold — current vs prior period and vs budget, with the driver explained from underlying activity. Use for the month-end close package and management reporting.
subTools.description_zh: 為超過門檻的每條 P&L 和 Balance Sheet 項目撰寫變動說明——本期 vs 前期及 vs 預算，並從基礎活動解釋驅動因素。用於月結套件和管理報告。

subTools.name: Buyer List
subTools.description: Build and organize a universe of potential acquirers for sell-side M&A processes. Identifies strategic and financial buyers, assesses fit, and prioritizes outreach. Use when preparing for a sell-side mandate, building a buyer universe, or evaluating potential partners. Triggers on "buyer list", "buyer universe", "potential acquirers", "who would buy this", "strategic buyers", or "financial sponsors".
subTools.description_zh: 建立並組織賣方 M&A 流程中潛在收購方的名單。識別戰略性和財務買方，評估契合度並優先排序 outreach。用於準備賣方委託、建立買方名單或評估潛在合作夥伴。觸發詞包括「buyer list」、「buyer universe」、「potential acquirers」、「who would buy this」、「strategic buyers」、「financial sponsor」。

subTools.name: Cim Builder
subTools.description: Structure and draft a Confidential Information Memorandum for sell-side M&A processes. Organizes company information into a professional, investor-ready document with consistent formatting and narrative flow. Use when preparing sell-side materials, drafting a CIM, or organizing company data for a sale process. Triggers on "CIM", "confidential information memorandum", "offering memorandum", "info memo", "draft CIM", or "sell-side materials".
subTools.description_zh: 為賣方 M&A 流程結構化和起草 Confidential Information Memorandum。將公司資訊組織成專業、投資者就緒的文件，具有一致的格式和敘事流程。用於準備賣方材料、起草 CIM 或為出售流程組織公司資料。觸發詞包括「CIM」、「confidential information memorandum」、「offering memorandum」、「info m」。

subTools.name: Datapack Builder
subTools.description: Build professional financial services data packs from various sources including CIMs, offering memorandums, SEC filings, web search, or MCP servers. Extract, normalize, and standardize financial data into investment committee-ready Excel workbooks with consistent structure, proper formatting, and documented assumptions. Use for M&A due diligence, private equity analysis, investment committee materials, and standardizing financial reporting across portfolio companies. Do not use for simple financial calculations or working with already-completed data packs.
subTools.description_zh: 從各種來源（包括 CIMs、offering memorandums、SEC filings、網頁搜尋或 MCP 伺服器）建構專業的金融服務資料包。提取、標準化和規範化財務資料到投資委員會就緒的 Excel 工作簿，具有一致的結構、適當的格式和記錄的假設。用於 M&A 盡職調查、私人股本分析、投資委員會材料。

subTools.name: Deal Tracker
subTools.description: Track multiple live deals with milestones, deadlines, action items, and status updates. Maintains a deal pipeline view and surfaces upcoming deadlines and overdue items. Use when managing a book of business, tracking process milestones, or preparing for weekly deal reviews. Triggers on "deal tracker", "deal status", "where are we on", "process update", "deal pipeline", or "weekly deal review".
subTools.description_zh: 追蹤多個進行中的交易，包括里程碑、截止日期、行動項目和狀態更新。維護交易 pipeline 視圖並顯示即將到來的截止日期和逾期項目。用於管理業務組合、追蹤流程里程碑或準備每週交易審查。觸發詞包括「deal tracker」、「deal status」、「where are we on」、「process update」、「deal pipeline」、「weekly deal review」。

subTools.name: Merger Model
subTools.description: Build accretion/dilution analysis for M&A transactions. Models pro forma EPS impact, synergy sensitivities, and purchase price allocation. Use when evaluating a potential acquisition, preparing merger consequences analysis for a pitch, or advising on deal terms. Triggers on "merger model", "accretion dilution", "M&A model", "pro forma EPS", "merger consequences", or "deal impact analysis".
subTools.description_zh: 為 M&A 交易建構 accretion/dilution 分析。建模 pro forma EPS 影響、synergy sensitivities 和 purchase price allocation。用於評估潛在收購、為簡報準備 merger consequences 分析或就交易條款提供建議。觸發詞包括「merger model」、「accretion dilution」、「M&A model」、「pro forma EPS」、「merger consequences」、「deal impact analysis」。

subTools.name: Pitch Deck
subTools.description: Populates investment banking pitch deck templates with data from source files. Use when: user provides a PowerPoint template to fill in, user has source data (Excel/CSV) to populate into slides, user mentions populating or filling a pitch deck template, or user needs to transfer data into existing slide layouts. Not for creating presentations from scratch.
subTools.description_zh: 從來源檔案填充投資銀行簡報模板資料。用於：使用者提供要填寫的 PowerPoint 模板、使用者有 source data (Excel/CSV) 要填入簡報、使用者提到填充或填寫 pitch deck 模板，或使用者需要將資料轉移到現有的簡報版面配置。不適用於從頭開始創建簡報。

subTools.name: Process Letter
subTools.description: Draft process letters and bid instructions for sell-side M&A processes. Covers initial indication of interest (IOI) instructions, final bid procedures, and management meeting logistics. Triggers on "process letter", "bid instructions", "IOI letter", "bid procedures", "final round letter", or "management meeting invite".
subTools.description_zh: 起草賣方併購流程的流程函與投標指引，涵蓋初步意向（IOI）指示、最終投標程序與管理會議後勤。觸發詞包括「process letter」、「bid instructions」、「IOI letter」、「bid procedures」、「final round letter」、「management meeting invite」。

subTools.name: Teaser
subTools.description: Draft anonymous one-page company teasers for sell-side M&A processes. Creates a compelling summary without revealing the company's identity, designed to gauge buyer interest before NDA execution. Triggers on "teaser", "blind teaser", "anonymous profile", "one-pager for process", or "draft teaser for sell-side".
subTools.description_zh: 為賣方 M&A 撰寫匿名單頁公司簡介，不揭露身份，供簽署 NDA 前評估買方興趣。觸發詞為 teaser、blind teaser 等。

subTools.name: Kyc Doc Parse
subTools.description: Parse an investor or client onboarding packet into structured KYC fields — identity, ownership, control, source of funds, and document inventory. Use as the first step of KYC screening; output feeds the rules engine.
subTools.description_zh: 解析開戶資料為結構化 KYC 欄位（身分、持股、控制權、資金來源、檔案清單），作為篩選第一步，輸出供規則引擎使用。

subTools.name: Kyc Rules
subTools.description: Apply the firm's KYC/AML rules grid to a parsed onboarding record — assign a risk rating, list every rule outcome with the rule cited, and flag what's missing or escalation-worthy. Use after kyc-doc-parse; this skill decides nothing, it scores and routes.
subTools.description_zh: 將公司的 KYC/AML 規則套用至已解析的入職記錄——分配風險評級，列出每項規則結果並註明所引用規則，標記遺漏或需升級項目。於 kyc-doc-parse 後使用；此技能僅評分與分流，不做決定。

subTools.name: Ai Readiness
subTools.description: Scan the portfolio for the highest-leverage AI opportunities and rank where to deploy operating-partner time. Ingests quarterly updates and financials across multiple portfolio companies, identifies quick wins at each, and stacks them into a single ranked action list. Use during quarterly portfolio reviews, annual planning, or when deciding which companies get AI investment first. Triggers on "AI readiness", "AI opportunity scan", "where should we deploy AI", "AI across the portfolio", "AI quick wins", or "which portcos are ready for AI".
subTools.description_zh: 掃描投資組合中的最高槓桿 AI 機會，排序營運合夥人時間部署優先順序。匯入多家被投資公司的季報更新與財務資料，找出快速成效，整併為單一排序行動清單。適用於季報審查、年度規劃，或決策哪些公司優先獲得 AI 投資。觸發條件含「AI

subTools.name: Dd Checklist
subTools.description: Generate and track comprehensive due diligence checklists tailored to the target company's sector, deal type, and complexity. Covers all major workstreams with request lists, status tracking, and red flag escalation. Use when kicking off diligence, organizing a data room review, or tracking outstanding items. Triggers on "dd checklist", "due diligence tracker", "diligence request list", "what do we still need", or "data room review".
subTools.description_zh: 產生並追蹤針對目標公司產業、交易類型與複雜度客製化的完整盡職調查清單。涵蓋所有主要工作項目的請求清單、狀態追蹤與紅旗升級。適用於啟動盡職調查、組織資料室審查，或追蹤待辦事項。觸發條件含「dd checklist」、「due diligence tracker」、「diligence request list」、「what do w

subTools.name: Dd Meeting Prep
subTools.description: Prepare for due diligence meetings — management presentations, expert network calls, customer references, and advisor sessions. Generates targeted question lists, benchmarks to reference, and red flags to probe. Use before any diligence meeting or call. Triggers on "prep for management meeting", "diligence call prep", "expert call questions", "customer reference questions", or "meeting prep for [company]".
subTools.description_zh: 準備盡職調查會議——管理層簡報、專家網路電話、客戶參考與顧問會談。產生針對性問題清單、參考基準與需深入探查的紅旗。適用於任何盡職調查會議或電話前。觸發條件含「prep for management meeting」、「diligence call prep」、「expert call questions」、「customer reference questions」或「meeting prep for [c

subTools.name: Deal Screening
subTools.description: Quickly screen inbound deal flow — CIMs, teasers, and broker materials — against the fund's investment criteria. Extracts key deal metrics, runs a pass/fail framework, and outputs a one-page screening memo. Use when reviewing new deal flow, triaging inbound materials, or deciding whether to take a first call. Triggers on "screen this deal", "review this CIM", "should we look at this", "triage this teaser", or "deal screening".
subTools.description_zh: 依據基金的投資標準，快速篩選incoming 交易流程（CIM、簡報與仲介資料）。萃取關鍵交易指標、執行通過/不通過評估，並產出一頁式篩選備忘錄。適用於審核新交易、分類incoming 資料或決定是否進行首次洽談。觸發關鍵字：「screen this deal」「review this CIM」「should we look at this」「triage this」

subTools.name: Deal Sourcing
subTools.description: PE deal sourcing workflow — discover target companies, check CRM for existing relationships, and draft personalized founder outreach emails. Use when sourcing new deals, prospecting companies in a sector, or reaching out to founders. Triggers on "find companies", "source deals", "draft founder email", "check if we've seen this company", or "outreach to founder".
subTools.description_zh: PE 投資案尋找工作流——發現目標公司、查詢 CRM 既有關係，並草擬個人化創辦人 outreach 郵件。適用於尋找新投資案、探討特定產業標的，或聯繫創辦人。觸發關鍵字：「find companies」「source deals」「draft founder email」「check if we've seen this company」「outreach to founder」。

subTools.name: Ic Memo
subTools.description: Draft a structured investment committee memo for PE deal approval. Synthesizes due diligence findings, financial analysis, and deal terms into a professional IC-ready document. Use when preparing for investment committee, writing up a deal, or creating a formal recommendation. Triggers on "write IC memo", "investment committee memo", "deal write-up", "prepare IC materials", or "recommendation memo".
subTools.description_zh: 撰寫結構化的投資委員會（IC）備忘錄，供 PE 投資案審批使用。整合盡職調查結果、財務分析與交易條件，產出專業的 IC 可用文件。適用於準備投委會、撰寫投資案報告或製作正式建議書。觸發關鍵字：「write IC memo」「investment committee memo」「deal write-up」「prepare IC materials」「recommendation memo」。

subTools.name: Portfolio Monitoring
subTools.description: Track and analyze portfolio company performance against plan. Ingests monthly/quarterly financial packages (Excel, PDF), extracts KPIs, flags variances to budget, and produces summary dashboards. Use when reviewing portfolio company financials, preparing board materials, or monitoring covenant compliance. Triggers on "review portfolio company", "monthly financials", "how is [company] performing", "covenant check", or "portfolio update".
subTools.description_zh: 追蹤並分析被投資公司對標計畫的績效。匯入月度／季度財務套件（Excel、PDF），萃取 KPI、標記預算偏差，並產生摘要儀表板。適用於檢視被投資公司財務、準備董事會材料或監控契約遵守情況。觸發關鍵字：「review portfolio company」「monthly financials」「how is [company] performing」。

subTools.name: Returns Analysis
subTools.description: Build quick IRR/MOIC sensitivity tables for PE deal evaluation. Models returns across entry multiple, leverage, exit multiple, growth, and hold period scenarios. Use when sizing up a deal, stress-testing assumptions, or preparing IC returns exhibits. Triggers on "returns analysis", "IRR sensitivity", "MOIC table", "what's the return at", "model the returns", or "back of the envelope".
subTools.description_zh: 快速建構 PE 投資案的 IRR/MOIC 敏感度分析表。針對進入價乘數、槓桿、退出乘數、成長率與持有期間進行報酬建模。用於評估投資案、壓力測試假設或準備 IC 報酬報告。觸發條件包含「報酬分析」、「IRR 敏感度」、「MOIC 表」、「報酬多少」、「建模報酬」或「粗略估算」。

subTools.name: Unit Economics
subTools.description: Analyze unit economics for PE targets — ARR cohorts, LTV/CAC, net retention, payback periods, revenue quality, and margin waterfall. Essential for software/SaaS, recurring revenue, and subscription businesses. Use when evaluating revenue quality, building a cohort analysis, or assessing customer economics. Triggers on "unit economics", "cohort analysis", "ARR analysis", "LTV CAC", "net retention", "revenue quality", or "customer economics".
subTools.description_zh: 分析 PE 標的的單位經濟效益——ARR 世代、LTV/CAC、淨留存率、回收期間、營收質量與毛利瀑布圖。適用於軟體／SaaS、經常性收入與訂閱型業務。用於評估營收質量、建構世代分析或檢視客戶經濟效益。觸發條件包含「單位經濟效益」、「世代分析」、「ARR 分析」、「LTV CAC」、「淨留存率」。

subTools.name: Value Creation Plan
subTools.description: Structure post-acquisition value creation plans with revenue, cost, and operational levers mapped to an EBITDA bridge. Includes 100-day priorities, KPI targets, and accountability frameworks. Use when planning post-close execution, preparing operating partner materials, or building a board-ready value creation roadmap. Triggers on "value creation plan", "100-day plan", "post-close plan", "EBITDA bridge", "operating plan", or "value creation levers".
subTools.description_zh: 建構收購後價值創造計畫，將營收、成本與營運槓桿對應至 EBITDA 橋接圖。涵蓋前 100 天優先事項、KPI 目標與問責框架。用於規劃交割後執行、準備營運合作夥伴資料或建立董事會級價值創造藍圖。觸發條件包含「價值創造計畫」、「100 天計畫」、「交割後計畫」、「EBITDA 橋」。

subTools.name: Client Report
subTools.description: Generate professional client-facing performance reports with portfolio returns, allocation breakdowns, and market commentary. Suitable for quarterly or annual distribution. Triggers on "client report", "performance report", "quarterly report for [client]", "generate reports", or "client statement".
subTools.description_zh: 產生專業客戶用績效報告，包含投資組合報酬、配置明細與市場評論。適合季報或年報發送。觸發條件包含「客戶報告」、「績效報告」、「[客戶名] 季報」、「產生報告」或「客戶對帳單」。

subTools.name: Client Review
subTools.description: Prepare for client review meetings with portfolio performance summary, allocation analysis, talking points, and action items. Pulls together account data into a concise meeting-ready format. Use before quarterly reviews, annual checkups, or ad-hoc client meetings. Triggers on "client review", "meeting prep for [client]", "quarterly review", "prep for [client name]", or "client meeting".
subTools.description_zh: 整理組合績效摘要、配置分析、會議重點與行動項目，準備客戶評議會議。適合季度檢視、年度健檢或臨時客戶會面。觸發條件："客戶評議"、"[客戶] 會議準備"、"季度評議"、"為 [客戶名稱] 準備" 或 "客戶會議"。

subTools.name: Financial Plan
subTools.description: Build or update a comprehensive financial plan covering retirement projections, education funding, estate planning, and cash flow analysis. Use for new client onboarding, annual plan reviews, or scenario modeling. Triggers on "financial plan", "retirement plan", "can I retire", "education funding", "estate plan", "cash flow analysis", or "plan update".
subTools.description_zh: 建立或更新全面財務規劃，涵蓋退休預測、教育資金、遺產規劃與現金流分析。適用於新客戶導入、年度計畫檢視或情境模擬。觸發條件："財務規劃"、"退休規劃"、"我可以退休了嗎"、"教育資金"、"遺產規劃"、"現金流分析" 或 "規劃更新"。

subTools.name: Investment Proposal
subTools.description: Create professional investment proposals for prospective clients. Covers the firm's approach, proposed allocation, expected outcomes, and fee structure. Use when pitching new clients or presenting a new investment strategy. Triggers on "investment proposal", "prospect presentation", "pitch new client", "proposal for [client]", or "new client presentation".
subTools.description_zh: 為潛在客戶製作專業投資提案，包含公司方針、擬議配置、預期成效與費用結構。適合進行新客戶說服或提出全新投資策略時使用。觸發條件："投資提案"、"潛在客戶簡報"、"說服新客戶"、"[客戶] 的提案" 或 "新客戶簡報"。

subTools.name: Portfolio Rebalance
subTools.description: Analyze portfolio allocation drift and generate rebalancing trade recommendations across accounts. Considers tax implications, transaction costs, and wash sale rules. Triggers on "rebalance", "portfolio drift", "allocation check", "rebalancing trades", or "my portfolio is out of balance".
subTools.description_zh: 分析投資組合配置偏離程度，並跨帳戶產生再平衡交易建議。考量稅務影響、交易成本與洗售規則。觸發關鍵字包含「rebalance」、「portfolio drift」、「allocation check」、「rebalancing trades」或「my portfolio is out of balance」。

subTools.name: Tax Loss Harvesting
subTools.description: Identify tax-loss harvesting opportunities across taxable accounts. Finds positions with unrealized losses, suggests replacement securities, and tracks wash sale windows. Triggers on "tax-loss harvesting", "TLH", "harvest losses", "tax losses", "unrealized losses", or "year-end tax planning".
subTools.description_zh: 識別應稅帳戶中的稅務虧損收割機會。找出未實現虧損部位，建議替代標的，並追蹤洗售窗口。觸發關鍵字包含「tax-loss harvesting」、「TLH」、「harvest losses」、「tax losses」、「unrealized losses」或「year-end tax planning」。

tools.useCase: A financial institution uses this tool to analyze market reports and ensure regulatory compliance.
advantages: Domain-specific expertise for banking and investment queries.
Automates complex compliance and risk assessment workflows.
Integrates with financial data sources for accurate insights.
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for real-time trading execution or high-frequency algorithms.
Should not replace licensed financial advisors for personalized investment decisions.
tools.description_zh: 專為財務分析、合規檢查與風險管理設計的 AI 工具。
tools.useCase_zh: 金融機構使用此工具分析市場報告並確保法規遵循。
tools.advantages_zh: 具備銀行與投資領域的專業知識。自動化複雜的合規與風險評估工作流程。整合金融資料來源，提供準確洞察。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合用於即時交易執行或高頻演算法。
不應用於取代持牌財務顧問進行個人化投資決策。

tools.name: Knowledge Work Plugins
tools.description: Open-source plugins for knowledge workers using Claude Cowork.

subTools.name: Instrument Data To Allotrope
subTools.description: Convert laboratory instrument output files (PDF, CSV, Excel, TXT) to Allotrope Simple Model (ASM) JSON format or flattened 2D CSV. Use this skill when scientists need to standardize instrument data for LIMS systems, data lakes, or downstream analysis. Supports auto-detection of instrument types. Outputs include full ASM JSON, flattened CSV for easy import, and exportable Python code for data engineers. Common triggers include converting instrument files, standardizing lab data, preparing data for upload to LIMS/ELN systems, or generating parser code for production pipelines.
subTools.description_zh: 將實驗室儀器輸出檔案（PDF、CSV、Excel、TXT）轉換為 Allotrope Simple Model（ASM）JSON 格式或平坦化 2D CSV。適用於科學家需要將儀器資料標準化以對接 LIMS 系統、資料湖或下游分析的情境。支援自動偵測儀器類型，輸出包含完整 ASM JSON、易於匯入的平坦化 CSV，以及可匯出的 Python 程式碼。

subTools.name: Nextflow Development
subTools.description: Run nf-core bioinformatics pipelines (rnaseq, sarek, atacseq) on sequencing data. Use when analyzing RNA-seq, WGS/WES, or ATAC-seq data—either local FASTQs or public datasets from GEO/SRA. Triggers on nf-core, Nextflow, FASTQ analysis, variant calling, gene expression, differential expression, GEO reanalysis, GSE/GSM/SRR accessions, or samplesheet creation.
subTools.description_zh: 在定序資料上執行 nf-core 生物資訊管線（如 rnaseq、sarek、atacseq）。適用於分析 RNA-seq、WGS/WES 或 ATAC-seq 資料，無論是本地 FASTQ 檔案或來自 GEO/SRA 的公開資料集。觸發條件包括 nf-core、Nextflow、FASTQ 分析、變異呼叫、表現基因分析、差異表現、GEO 重新分析、GSE/GSM/SRR 編號或樣本表單建立。

subTools.name: Scientific Problem Selection
subTools.description: This skill should be used when scientists need help with research problem selection, project ideation, troubleshooting stuck projects, or strategic scientific decisions. Use this skill when users ask to pitch a new research idea, work through a project problem, evaluate project risks, plan research strategy, navigate decision trees, or get help choosing what scientific problem to work on. Typical requests include "I have an idea for a project", "I'm stuck on my research", "help me evaluate this project", "what should I work on", or "I need strategic advice about my research".
subTools.description_zh: 當科學家需要協助進行研究問題選擇、專案構想、解決卡關專案或做出戰略性科學決策時使用。適合用於提新研究點子、處理專案問題、評估風險、規劃研究策略、瀏覽決策樹，或協助選擇要攻關的科學問題。

subTools.name: Scvi Tools
subTools.description: Deep learning for single-cell analysis using scvi-tools. This skill should be used when users need (1) data integration and batch correction with scVI/scANVI, (2) ATAC-seq analysis with PeakVI, (3) CITE-seq multi-modal analysis with totalVI, (4) multiome RNA+ATAC analysis with MultiVI, (5) spatial transcriptomics deconvolution with DestVI, (6) label transfer and reference mapping with scANVI/scArches, (7) RNA velocity with veloVI, or (8) any deep learning-based single-cell method. Triggers include mentions of scVI, scANVI, totalVI, PeakVI, MultiVI, DestVI, veloVI, sysVI, scArches, variational autoencoder, VAE, batch correction, data integration, multi-modal, CITE-seq, multiome, reference mapping, latent space.
subTools.description_zh: 使用 scvi-tools 進行單細胞分析的深度學習工具。適用於以下情境：(1) 使用 scVI/scANVI 進行資料整合與批次校正，(2) 使用 PeakVI 分析 ATAC-seq，(3) 使用 totalVI 進行 CITE-seq 多模態分析，(4) 使用 MultiVI 分析 multiome RNA+ATAC，(5) 使用 DestVI 進行空間轉錄體去摻混，(6) 使用 scANVI/scArc 進行標籤轉移與參考映射。

subTools.name: Single Cell Rna Qc
subTools.description: Performs quality control on single-cell RNA-seq data (.h5ad or .h5 files) using scverse best practices with MAD-based filtering and comprehensive visualizations. Use when users request QC analysis, filtering low-quality cells, assessing data quality, or following scverse/scanpy best practices for single-cell analysis.
subTools.description_zh: 使用 scverse 最佳實踐，對單細胞 RNA-seq 資料（.h5ad 或 .h5 檔案）執行品質控制，包含基於 MAD 的過濾與全面視覺化。用於 QC 分析、過濾低品質細胞、評估資料品質，或遵循 scverse/scanpy 最佳實踐時。

subTools.name: Start
subTools.description: Set up your bio-research environment and explore available tools. Use when first getting oriented with the plugin, checking which literature, drug-discovery, or visualization MCP servers are connected, or surveying available analysis skills before starting a new project.
subTools.description_zh: 設定 bio-research 環境並探索可用工具。初次使用此插件、檢查已連接的文獻或藥物發現 MCP 伺服器，或在開始新專案前檢視可用的分析技能時使用。

subTools.name: Customer Escalation
subTools.description: Package an escalation for engineering, product, or leadership with full context. Use when a bug needs engineering attention beyond normal support, multiple customers report the same issue, a customer is threatening to churn, or an issue has sat unresolved past its SLA.
subTools.description_zh: 彙整完整背景，將問題升級至工程、產品或主管部門。適用於：需工程介入的程式錯誤、多位客戶回報相同問題、客戶威脅流失，或已超 SLA 未解決的案子。

subTools.name: Customer Research
subTools.description: Multi-source research on a customer question or topic with source attribution. Use when a customer asks something you need to look up, investigating whether a bug has been reported before, checking what was previously told to a specific account, or gathering background before drafting a response.
subTools.description_zh: 跨來源調查客戶問題或主題，並提供來源出處。適用於：客戶提問需查證、確認是否曾回報相同問題、查閱該客戶先前回應，或擬定回覆前蒐集背景資料。

subTools.name: Draft Response
subTools.description: Draft a professional customer-facing response tailored to the situation and relationship. Use when answering a product question, responding to an escalation or outage, delivering bad news like a delay or won't-fix, declining a feature request, or replying to a billing issue.
subTools.description_zh: 根據情境與客戶關係，撰寫專業的對外回覆。適用於：回答產品問題、回覆升級或停服務通知、傳達延遲或不修復等壞消息、拒絕功能請求，或處理帳單問題。

subTools.name: Kb Article
subTools.description: Draft a knowledge base article from a resolved issue or common question. Use when a ticket resolution is worth documenting for self-service, the same question keeps coming up, a workaround needs to be published, or a known issue should be communicated to customers.
subTools.description_zh: 將已解決的問題或常見問答撰寫為知識庫文章。適用於：工單解法值得公開供自助查詢、相同問題反覆出現、需公布因應措施，或向客戶說明已知問題。

subTools.name: Ticket Triage
subTools.description: Triage and prioritize a support ticket or customer issue. Use when a new ticket comes in and needs categorization, assigning P1-P4 priority, deciding which team should handle it, or checking whether it's a duplicate or known issue before routing.
subTools.description_zh: 對支援工單或客戶問題進行分流與優先級排序。適用於：新進工單的分類、assign P1‑P4 優先級、決定由哪個團隊處理，或路由前確認是否為重複/已知問題。

subTools.name: Analyze
subTools.description: Answer data questions -- from quick lookups to full analyses. Use when looking up a single metric, investigating what's driving a trend or drop, comparing segments over time, or preparing a formal data report for stakeholders.
subTools.description_zh: 回答各類資料問題，從快速查詢到完整分析皆可。適用於：查詢單一指標、調查趨勢或下降成因、比較不同時段區段，或為利害關係人準備正式資料報告。

subTools.name: Build Dashboard
subTools.description: Build an interactive HTML dashboard with charts, filters, and tables. Use when creating an executive overview with KPI cards, turning query results into a shareable self-contained report, building a team monitoring snapshot, or needing multiple charts with filters in one browser-openable file.
subTools.description_zh: 建置包含圖表、篩選器與資料表的互動式 HTML 儀表板。適用於：建立包含 KPI 卡片的長官概覽、將查詢結果轉為可分享之自包含報告、建置團隊監控縮影，或需要在單一可於瀏覽器開啟的檔案中整合多張圖表與篩選器。

subTools.name: Create Viz
subTools.description: Create publication-quality visualizations with Python. Use when turning query results or a DataFrame into a chart, selecting the right chart type for a trend or comparison, generating a plot for a report or presentation, or needing an interactive chart with hover and zoom.
subTools.description_zh: 使用 Python 建立出版品質的視覺化圖表。適用於：將查詢結果或 DataFrame 轉為圖表、為趨勢或比較選擇適當圖表類型、產生報告或簡報用圖，或需要帶懸停與縮放功能的互動式圖表。

subTools.name: Data Visualization
subTools.description: Create effective data visualizations with Python (matplotlib, seaborn, plotly). Use when building charts, choosing the right chart type for a dataset, creating publication-quality figures, or applying design principles like accessibility and color theory.
subTools.description_zh: 使用 Python（matplotlib、seaborn、plotly）製作有效的資料視覺化。適合用於建立圖表、選擇適切的圖表類型、製作出版品質的圖形，或應用無障礙設計與色彩理論等設計原則時。

subTools.name: Explore Data
subTools.description: Profile and explore a dataset to understand its shape, quality, and patterns. Use when encountering a new table or file, checking null rates and column distributions, spotting data quality issues like duplicates or suspicious values, or deciding which dimensions and metrics to analyze.
subTools.description_zh: 分析與探索資料集，了解其結構、品質與模式。適合用於初次接觸新表格或檔案、檢查空值率與欄位分佈、發現重複或異常值等資料品質問題，或決定要分析哪些維度與指標時。

subTools.name: Sql Queries
subTools.description: Write correct, performant SQL across all major data warehouse dialects (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, PostgreSQL, etc.). Use when writing queries, optimizing slow SQL, translating between dialects, or building complex analytical queries with CTEs, window functions, or aggregations.
subTools.description_zh: 為所有主流資料倉儲語法（Snowflake、BigQuery、Databricks、PostgreSQL 等）撰寫正確且高效的 SQL。適合用於撰寫查詢、最佳化慢速 SQL、跨語法轉換，或建立使用 CTE、視窗函數與聚合的複雜分析查詢時。

subTools.name: Statistical Analysis
subTools.description: Apply statistical methods including descriptive stats, trend analysis, outlier detection, and hypothesis testing. Use when analyzing distributions, testing for significance, detecting anomalies, computing correlations, or interpreting statistical results.
subTools.description_zh: 應用描述性統計、趨勢分析、異常偵測與假設檢定等統計方法。適合用於分析分佈、檢定顯著性、偵測異常、計算相關性或解讀統計結果時。

subTools.name: Validate Data
subTools.description: QA an analysis before sharing -- methodology, accuracy, and bias checks. Use when reviewing an analysis before a stakeholder presentation, spot-checking calculations and aggregation logic, verifying a SQL query's results look right, or assessing whether conclusions are actually supported by the data.
subTools.description_zh: 在分享前對分析進行 QA——包含方法、準確性與偏誤檢查。適合用於主管簡報前檢視分析、抽驗計算與聚合邏輯、確認 SQL 查詢結果合理，或評估結論是否真的有資料支撐時。

subTools.name: Write Query
subTools.description: Write optimized SQL for your dialect with best practices. Use when translating a natural-language data need into SQL, building a multi-CTE query with joins and aggregations, optimizing a query against a large partitioned table, or getting dialect-specific syntax for Snowflake, BigQuery, Postgres, etc.
subTools.description_zh: 依最佳實踐為你的 SQL 語法撰寫最佳化查詢。適合用於將自然語言需求轉換成 SQL、建立包含 joins 與聚合的多層 CTE 查詢、針對大型分割區表最佳化查詢，或取得 Snowflake、BigQuery、Postgres 等語法特定語法時。

subTools.name: Accessibility Review
subTools.description: Run a WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility audit on a design or page. Trigger with "audit accessibility", "check a11y", "is this accessible?", or when reviewing a design for color contrast, keyboard navigation, touch target size, or screen reader behavior before handoff.
subTools.description_zh: 對設計或網頁執行 WCAG 2.1 AA 無障礙稽核。輸入「audit accessibility」、「check a11y」、「is this accessible?」，或在交付前檢視色彩對比、鍵盤導航、觸控目標大小或螢幕閱讀器行為時觸發。

subTools.name: Design Critique
subTools.description: Get structured design feedback on usability, hierarchy, and consistency. Trigger with "review this design", "critique this mockup", "what do you think of this screen?", or when sharing a Figma link or screenshot for feedback at any stage from exploration to final polish.
subTools.description_zh: 取得針對易用性、資訊層級與一致性的結構化設計回饋。輸入指定觸發詞，或於從探索至最終微調階段分享 Figma 連結與截圖時使用。

subTools.name: Design Handoff
subTools.description: Generate developer handoff specs from a design. Use when a design is ready for engineering and needs a spec sheet covering layout, design tokens, component props, interaction states, responsive breakpoints, edge cases, and animation details.
subTools.description_zh: 根據設計稿產出開發交接規格。設計已交付工程，需涵蓋版面配置、設計 token、元件屬性、互動狀態、響應式斷點與動畫細節時使用。

subTools.name: Design System
subTools.description: Audit, document, or extend your design system. Use when checking for naming inconsistencies or hardcoded values across components, writing documentation for a component's variants, states, and accessibility notes, or designing a new pattern that fits the existing system.
subTools.description_zh: 稽核、記錄或擴展設計系統。檢查元件命名與硬編碼值、撰寫變體狀態說明及無障礙要點，或設計符合現有系統的新模式。

subTools.name: Research Synthesis
subTools.description: Synthesize user research into themes, insights, and recommendations. Use when you have interview transcripts, survey results, usability test notes, support tickets, or NPS responses that need to be distilled into patterns, user segments, and prioritized next steps.
subTools.description_zh: 整合使用者研究為主題、洞察與建議。將訪談、問卷、測試筆記、客服工單或 NPS 回應，歸納為模式、使用者分群與優先步驟。

subTools.name: User Research
subTools.description: Plan, conduct, and synthesize user research. Trigger with "user research plan", "interview guide", "usability test", "survey design", "research questions", or when the user needs help with any aspect of understanding their users through research.
subTools.description_zh: 規劃、執行與整合使用者研究。當使用者需要透過研究理解受眾時觸發，例如撰寫研究計畫、訪談大綱、可用性測試、問卷設計或研究問題。

subTools.name: Ux Copy
subTools.description: Write or review UX copy — microcopy, error messages, empty states, CTAs. Trigger with "write copy for", "what should this button say?", "review this error message", or when naming a CTA, wording a confirmation dialog, filling an empty state, or writing onboarding text.
subTools.description_zh: 撰寫或檢視 UX 文案——微文案、錯誤訊息、空狀態、行動呼籲。當需要為按鈕命名、撰寫確認對話框、填寫空狀態或著手撰寫引導流程文字時觸發。

subTools.name: Architecture
subTools.description: Create or evaluate an architecture decision record (ADR). Use when choosing between technologies (e.g., Kafka vs SQS), documenting a design decision with trade-offs and consequences, reviewing a system design proposal, or designing a new component from requirements and constraints.
subTools.description_zh: 建立或評估架構決策記錄（ADR）。用於在技術之間做出選擇（如 Kafka 與 SQS）、記錄具有取捨與影響的設計決策、審查系統設計提案，或根據需求與限制設計新組件。

subTools.name: Code Review
subTools.description: Review code changes for security, performance, and correctness. Trigger with a PR URL or diff, "review this before I merge", "is this code safe?", or when checking a change for N+1 queries, injection risks, missing edge cases, or error handling gaps.
subTools.description_zh: 審查程式碼變更的安全性、效能與正確性。可用 PR URL 或 diff 觸發，或使用「合併前請審視」「這程式碼安全嗎？」等指令，亦可在檢查 N+1 查詢、注入風險、邊界情況或錯誤處理落差時使用。

subTools.name: Debug
subTools.description: Structured debugging session — reproduce, isolate, diagnose, and fix. Trigger with an error message or stack trace, "this works in staging but not prod", "something broke after the deploy", or when behavior diverges from expected and the cause isn't obvious.
subTools.description_zh: 結構化除錯流程：重現問題、隔離原因、診斷與修復。當收到錯誤訊息或堆疊追蹤、遇到「測試環境正常但生產環境失效」、「部署後出現異常」或行為偏離預期且原因不明時觸發。

subTools.name: Deploy Checklist
subTools.description: Pre-deployment verification checklist. Use when about to ship a release, deploying a change with database migrations or feature flags, verifying CI status and approvals before going to production, or documenting rollback triggers ahead of time.
subTools.description_zh: 部署前驗證清單。當即將發版、部署包含資料庫遷移或功能開關的變更、檢查 CI 狀態與核准流程，或事先記錄回滾觸發條件時使用。

subTools.name: Documentation
subTools.description: Write and maintain technical documentation. Trigger with "write docs for", "document this", "create a README", "write a runbook", "onboarding guide", or when the user needs help with any form of technical writing — API docs, architecture docs, or operational runbooks.
subTools.description_zh: 撰寫與維護技術文件。觸發情境包含「為...撰寫文件」、「建立 README」、「編寫操作手冊/新人指引」，或需要協助完成 API 文件、架構說明、營運手冊等技術寫作時使用。

subTools.name: Incident Response
subTools.description: Run an incident response workflow — triage, communicate, and write postmortem. Trigger with "we have an incident", "production is down", an alert that needs severity assessment, a status update mid-incident, or when writing a blameless postmortem after resolution.
subTools.description_zh: 執行事件回應流程：分診、溝通與撰寫事後檢討報告。當回報「發生事件」、「生產環境當機」、需評估告警嚴重性、提供事件中期更新，或事件解決後撰寫不責備的事後報告時觸發。

subTools.name: Standup
subTools.description: Generate a standup update from recent activity. Use when preparing for daily standup, summarizing yesterday's commits and PRs and ticket moves, formatting work into yesterday/today/blockers, or structuring a few rough notes into a shareable update.
subTools.description_zh: 根據近期活動產生站會更新。用於準備每日站會時，摘要昨天的提交與 PR、票務狀態，將工作整理成昨天／今天／阻礙事項，或將零碎筆記組織成可分享的進度報告。

subTools.name: System Design
subTools.description: Design systems, services, and architectures. Trigger with "design a system for", "how should we architect", "system design for", "what's the right architecture for", or when the user needs help with API design, data modeling, or service boundaries.
subTools.description_zh: 設計系統、服務與架構。當使用者提出設計系統、架構規劃、API 設計、資料建模或服務邊界等需求時觸發。

subTools.name: Tech Debt
subTools.description: Identify, categorize, and prioritize technical debt. Trigger with "tech debt", "technical debt audit", "what should we refactor", "code health", or when the user asks about code quality, refactoring priorities, or maintenance backlog.
subTools.description_zh: 識別、分類並優先處理技術債。當使用者提到技術債、要求重構建議、關注程式碼品質或維護 backlog 時觸發。

subTools.name: Testing Strategy
subTools.description: Design test strategies and test plans. Trigger with "how should we test", "test strategy for", "write tests for", "test plan", "what tests do we need", or when the user needs help with testing approaches, coverage, or test architecture.
subTools.description_zh: 設計測試策略與測試計畫。當使用者詢問測試方法、測試覆蓋率、測試架構等需求時觸發。

subTools.name: Digest
subTools.description: Generate a daily or weekly digest of activity across all connected sources. Use when catching up after time away, starting the day and wanting a summary of mentions and action items, or reviewing a week's decisions and document updates grouped by project.
subTools.description_zh: 生成每日或每週的活動摘要，整合所有連線來源的動態。適用於休假後趕進度、開工前掌握提及事項與待處理事項，或回顧一週的決策與專案文件更新。

subTools.name: Knowledge Synthesis
subTools.description: Combines search results from multiple sources into coherent, deduplicated answers with source attribution. Handles confidence scoring based on freshness and authority, and summarizes large result sets effectively.
subTools.description_zh: 將多個來源的搜尋結果整合成連貫且去重的答案，並附上出處。根據新穎度與權威性進行信心度評分，有效摘要大量結果集。

subTools.name: Search
subTools.description: Search across all connected sources in one query. Trigger with "find that doc about...", "what did we decide on...", "where was the conversation about...", or when looking for a decision, document, or discussion that could live in chat, email, cloud storage, or a project tracker.
subTools.description_zh: 單次查詢跨所有連線來源搜尋。當需要尋找文件、決策或討論，或資料可能位於聊天、電子郵件、雲端儲存或專案追蹤工具時使用。

subTools.name: Search Strategy
subTools.description: Query decomposition and multi-source search orchestration. Breaks natural language questions into targeted searches per source, translates queries into source-specific syntax, ranks results by relevance, and handles ambiguity and fallback strategies.
subTools.description_zh: 查詢拆解與多來源搜尋協調。將自然語言問題拆解為針對各來源的定向搜尋，轉換為各來源專屬語法，依相關性排序結果，並處理歧義與備用策略。

subTools.name: Source Management
subTools.description: Manages connected MCP sources for enterprise search. Detects available sources, guides users to connect new ones, handles source priority ordering, and manages rate limiting awareness.
subTools.description_zh: 管理企業搜尋的 MCP 連線來源。偵測可用來源、引導使用者連接新來源、處理來源優先順序，並管理速率限制相關認知。

subTools.name: Audit Support
subTools.description: Support SOX 404 compliance with control testing methodology, sample selection, and documentation standards. Use when generating testing workpapers, selecting audit samples, classifying control deficiencies, or preparing for internal or external audits.
subTools.description_zh: 協助 SOX 404 合規，涵蓋控制測試方法、抽樣選取與文件標準。用於產生測試工作底稿、選取查核樣本、分類控制缺陷，或準備內外部查核。

subTools.name: Close Management
subTools.description: Manage the month-end close process with task sequencing, dependencies, and status tracking. Use when planning the close calendar, tracking close progress, identifying blockers, or sequencing close activities by day.
subTools.description_zh: 透過任務順序、依賴關係與狀態追蹤來管理月結流程。用於規劃結算日曆、追蹤月結進度、識別阻礙因素，或按日期安排月結活動。

subTools.name: Financial Statements
subTools.description: Generate financial statements (income statement, balance sheet, cash flow) with period-over-period comparison and variance analysis. Use when preparing a monthly or quarterly P&L, closing the books and need to flag material variances, comparing actuals to budget, building a financial summary for leadership review, or looking up GAAP presentation requirements and period-end adjustments.
subTools.description_zh: 生成損益表、資產負債表與現金流量表，並進行同期比較與差異分析。用於編製月度或季度損益表、結帳時標記重大差異、比較實際值與預算，或查詢 GAAP 呈現要求與期末調整。

subTools.name: Journal Entry
subTools.description: Prepare journal entries with proper debits, credits, and supporting detail. Use when booking month-end accruals (AP, payroll, prepaid), recording depreciation or amortization, posting revenue recognition or deferred revenue adjustments, or documenting an entry for audit review.
subTools.description_zh: 編制分錄，包含正確的借方、貸方與 supporting detail。適用於入帳月結應計項目（應付帳款、薪資、預付款）、記錄折舊或攤銷、過帳收入認列或遞延收入調整，或記錄供稽核複核用的分錄。

subTools.name: Journal Entry Prep
subTools.description: Prepare journal entries with proper debits, credits, and supporting documentation for month-end close. Use when booking accruals, prepaid amortization, fixed asset depreciation, payroll entries, revenue recognition, or any manual journal entry.
subTools.description_zh: 編制分錄，含正確借方、貸方與 supporting documentation，用於月結。適用於入帳應計項目、預付款攤銷、固定資產折舊、薪資分錄、收入認列或任何人工分錄。

subTools.name: Reconciliation
subTools.description: Reconcile accounts by comparing GL balances to subledgers, bank statements, or third-party data. Use when performing bank reconciliations, GL-to-subledger recs, intercompany reconciliations, or identifying and categorizing reconciling items.
subTools.description_zh: 透過比對總帳餘額與明細帳、銀行對帳單或第三方資料進行對帳。適用於銀行對帳、總帳對明細帳、公司間對帳，或辨識與分類對帳差異項目。

subTools.name: Sox Testing
subTools.description: Generate SOX sample selections, testing workpapers, and control assessments. Use when planning quarterly or annual SOX 404 testing, pulling a sample for a control (revenue, P2P, ITGC, close), building a testing workpaper template, or evaluating and classifying a control deficiency.
subTools.description_zh: 產生 SOX 抽樣選取、測試工作底稿與控制評估。適用於規劃季報或年度 SOX 404 測試、針對控制（收入、P2P、ITGC、月結）抽樣、建立測試工作底稿範本，或評估與分類控制缺陷。

subTools.name: Variance Analysis
subTools.description: Decompose financial variances into drivers with narrative explanations and waterfall analysis. Use when analyzing budget vs. actual, period-over-period changes, revenue or expense variances, or preparing variance commentary for leadership.
subTools.description_zh: 以敘述說明與 waterfall analysis 分解財務差異至驅動因素。適用於分析預算與實際差異、期對期變動、收入或費用差異，或為管理層編制差異說明。

subTools.name: Comp Analysis
subTools.description: Analyze compensation — benchmarking, band placement, and equity modeling. Trigger with "what should we pay a [role]", "is this offer competitive", "model this equity grant", or when uploading comp data to find outliers and retention risks.
subTools.description_zh: 分析薪酬：基準比對、薪帶位階與 equity modeling。可由「某職位該給多少薪」「這份 offer 是否具競爭力」「測算這筆股權授予」觸發，或上傳薪酬資料找出 outlier 與留任風險。

subTools.name: Draft Offer
subTools.description: Draft an offer letter with comp details and terms. Use when a candidate is ready for an offer, assembling a total comp package (base, equity, signing bonus), writing the offer letter text itself, or prepping negotiation guidance for the hiring manager.
subTools.description_zh: 撰寫含薪酬細節與條件的聘用通知。適用於候選人已準備好 receiving offer、組裝 total comp package（本薪、股權、簽約獎金）、撰寫通知文字，或為用人主管準備談判指引。

subTools.name: Interview Prep
subTools.description: Create structured interview plans with competency-based questions and scorecards. Trigger with "interview plan for", "interview questions for", "how should we interview", "scorecard for", or when the user is preparing to interview candidates.
subTools.description_zh: 建立結構化面試計畫，含能力本位問題與 scorecard。可由「某某職位的面試計畫」「面試題目」「如何面試」「scorecard」觸發，或使用者準備面試候選人時使用。

subTools.name: Onboarding
subTools.description: Generate an onboarding checklist and first-week plan for a new hire. Use when someone has a start date coming up, building the pre-start task list (accounts, equipment, buddy), scheduling Day 1 and Week 1, or setting 30/60/90-day goals for a new team member.
subTools.description_zh: 生成新人到職清單與首週計畫。適用於：開工日前準備任務清單（帳號、設備、導師）、安排第一天行程，或設定 30/60/90 天目標。

subTools.name: Org Planning
subTools.description: Headcount planning, org design, and team structure optimization. Trigger with "org planning", "headcount plan", "team structure", "reorg", "who should we hire next", or when the user is thinking about team size, reporting structure, or organizational design.
subTools.description_zh: 計算頭數、設計組織架構與團隊結構優化。觸發詞包含「org planning」「headcount plan」「team structure」「reorg」等。

subTools.name: People Report
subTools.description: Generate headcount, attrition, diversity, or org health reports. Use when pulling a headcount snapshot for leadership, analyzing turnover trends by team, preparing diversity representation metrics, or assessing span of control and flight risk across the org.
subTools.description_zh: 生成頭數、離職率、多元性、組織健康報告。適用於：提供領導層頭數快照、分析團隊離職趨勢或評估管理幅度。

subTools.name: Performance Review
subTools.description: Structure a performance review with self-assessment, manager template, and calibration prep. Use when review season kicks off and you need a self-assessment template, writing a manager review for a direct report, prepping rating distributions and promotion cases for calibration, or turning vague feedback into specific behavioral examples.
subTools.description_zh: 結構化績效評核流程，包含自我評估、經理模板與評等校準準備。適用於：評核季啟動時生成模板，或撰寫經理評語。

subTools.name: Policy Lookup
subTools.description: Find and explain company policies in plain language. Trigger with "what's our PTO policy", "can I work remotely from another country", "how do expenses work", or any plain-language question about benefits, travel, leave, or handbook rules.
subTools.description_zh: 用白話查找並解釋公司政策。觸發詞如「PTO 政策是什麼」「能否海外遠端工作」等關於福利、出差、休假或手冊規則的問題。

subTools.name: Recruiting Pipeline
subTools.description: Track and manage recruiting pipeline stages. Trigger with "recruiting update", "candidate pipeline", "how many candidates", "hiring status", or when the user discusses sourcing, screening, interviewing, or extending offers.
subTools.description_zh: 追蹤及管理招募流程各階段。觸發詞包含「recruiting update」「candidate pipeline」「hiring status」或討論人才來源、面試、發 offer 等情境。

subTools.name: Brief
subTools.description: Generate contextual briefings for legal work — daily summary, topic research, or incident response. Use when starting your day and need a scan of legal-relevant items across email, calendar, and contracts, when researching a specific legal question across internal sources, or when a developing situation (data breach, litigation threat, regulatory inquiry) needs rapid context.
subTools.description_zh: 生成法律工作用的情境摘要，例如每日摘要、主題研究或事件回應。適用於：啟動新的一天掃描法律相關事項，或快速掌握資料洩漏等緊急狀況。

subTools.name: Compliance Check
subTools.description: Run a compliance check on a proposed action, product feature, or business initiative, surfacing applicable regulations, required approvals, and risk areas. Use when launching a feature that touches personal data, when marketing or product proposes something with regulatory implications, or when you need to know which approvals and jurisdictional requirements apply before proceeding.
subTools.description_zh: 對擬議行動、產品功能或商業活動執行合規檢查，列出適用法規、必要核准與風險區域。適用於：推出涉及個人資料的功能，或行銷提案具法規影響時。

subTools.name: Legal Response
subTools.description: Generate a response to a common legal inquiry using configured templates, with built-in escalation checks for situations that shouldn't use a templated reply. Use when responding to data subject requests, litigation hold notices, vendor legal questions, NDA requests from business teams, or subpoenas.
subTools.description_zh: 使用配置的範本生成常見法律查詢的回覆，並內建升級檢查以處理不適合範本回覆的情況。適用於回應資料主體請求、訴訟保全通知、供應商法律問題、NDA請求或傳單。

subTools.name: Legal Risk Assessment
subTools.description: Assess and classify legal risks using a severity-by-likelihood framework with escalation criteria. Use when evaluating contract risk, assessing deal exposure, classifying issues by severity, or determining whether a matter needs senior counsel or outside legal review.
subTools.description_zh: 使用嚴重度與可能性框架評估並分類法律風險，內建升級標準。適用於評估合約風險、判斷交易曝險、依嚴重度分類問題，或決定事項是否需資深律師或外部法律審查。

subTools.name: Meeting Briefing
subTools.description: Prepare structured briefings for meetings with legal relevance and track resulting action items. Use when preparing for contract negotiations, board meetings, compliance reviews, or any meeting where legal context, background research, or action tracking is needed.
subTools.description_zh: 為具法律意義的會議準備結構化簡報，並追蹤後續行動項目。適用於契約談判、董事會會議、合規審查，或需要法律背景研究與行動追蹤的任何場合。

subTools.name: Review Contract
subTools.description: Review a contract against your organization's negotiation playbook — flag deviations, generate redlines, provide business impact analysis. Use when reviewing vendor or customer agreements, when you need clause-by-clause analysis against standard positions, or when preparing a negotiation strategy with prioritized redlines and fallback positions.
subTools.description_zh: 依據組織的談判指南檢視契約——標註偏離條款、生成紅線修改建議、提供業務影響分析。適用於 Vendor 或客戶協議、逐條對照標準立場，或準備優先排序的談判策略時使用。

subTools.name: Signature Request
subTools.description: Prepare and route a document for e-signature — run a pre-signature checklist, configure signing order, and send for execution. Use when a contract is finalized and ready to sign, when verifying entity names, exhibits, and signature blocks before sending, or when setting up an envelope with sequential or parallel signers.
subTools.description_zh: 準備並送交文件進行電子簽章——執行簽署前檢查清單、設定簽署順序並發送至執行階段。適用於合約已定稿待簽署、發送前核對實體名稱、附件與簽署區塊，或設定依序或並行簽署人的套件。

subTools.name: Triage Nda
subTools.description: Rapidly triage an incoming NDA and classify it as GREEN (standard approval), YELLOW (counsel review), or RED (full legal review). Use when a new NDA arrives from sales or business development, when screening for embedded non-solicits, non-competes, or missing carveouts, or when deciding whether an NDA can be signed under standard delegation.
subTools.description_zh: 快速分類收到的 NDA，判定為 GREEN（標準核准）、YELLOW（律師審查）或 RED（完整法律審查）。適用於從業務或商務拓展收到新 NDA、檢視是否含有嵌入式不挖角/不競爭條款或遺漏例外，或決定能否在標準授權下簽署。

subTools.name: Vendor Check
subTools.description: Check the status of existing agreements with a vendor across all connected systems — CLM, CRM, email, and document storage — with gap analysis and upcoming deadlines. Use when onboarding or renewing a vendor, when you need a consolidated view of what's signed and what's missing (MSA, DPA, SOW), or when checking for approaching expirations and surviving obligations.
subTools.description_zh: 跨所有已串接系統（CLM、CRM、電子郵件、文件儲存）檢查與廠商的現有協議狀態，提供差異分析與即將到期的期限提醒。適用於廠商入網或續約、需要簽署狀態總覽（MSA、DPA、SOW），或檢視即將到期與存續義務。

subTools.name: Brand Review
subTools.description: Review content against your brand voice, style guide, and messaging pillars, flagging deviations by severity with specific before/after fixes. Use when checking a draft before it ships, when auditing copy for voice consistency and terminology, or when screening for unsubstantiated claims, missing disclaimers, and other legal flags.
subTools.description_zh: 依據品牌語氣、風格指南與訊息支柱審核內容，標記偏離程度並提供具體修正範例。適用於校對定稿前草稿、審核文案語氣一致性與用詞，或檢視未經佐證的主張、遺漏免責聲明與其他法律疑慮。

subTools.name: Campaign Plan
subTools.description: Generate a full campaign brief with objectives, audience, messaging, channel strategy, content calendar, and success metrics. Use when planning a product launch, lead-gen push, or awareness campaign, when you need a week-by-week content calendar with dependencies, or when translating a marketing goal into a structured, executable plan.
subTools.description_zh: 產出完整活動企劃，含目標、受眾、訊息、頻道策略、內容日曆與成效指標。適用於產品上市、引薦或宣傳活動規劃，以及需帶相依關係的週際內容日曆。

subTools.name: Competitive Brief
subTools.description: Research competitors and generate a positioning and messaging comparison with content gaps, opportunities, and threats. Use when building sales battlecards, when finding positioning gaps and messaging angles competitors haven't claimed, or when a competitor makes a move and you need to assess the impact.
subTools.description_zh: 進行競品研究，產出定位與訊息比較分析，涵蓋內容缺口、機會與威脅。適用於製作銷售對戰卡、尋找未佔據的定位角度，或評估競爭對手舉動之影響。

subTools.name: Content Creation
subTools.description: Draft marketing content across channels — blog posts, social media, email newsletters, landing pages, press releases, and case studies. Use when writing any marketing content, when you need channel-specific formatting, SEO-optimized copy, headline options, or calls to action.
subTools.description_zh: 跨頻道起草行銷內容，含部落格、社群、電子報、落地頁、新聞稿與案例研究。適用於需各頻道格式、SEO 文案、標題選項或行動呼籲時。

subTools.name: Draft Content
subTools.description: Draft blog posts, social media, email newsletters, landing pages, press releases, and case studies with channel-specific formatting and SEO recommendations. Use when writing any marketing content, when you need headline or subject line options, or when adapting a message for a specific platform, audience, and brand voice.
subTools.description_zh: 撰寫部落格、社群、電子報、落地頁、新聞稿與案例研究，提供各頻道格式與 SEO 建議。適用於需標題或主旨選項，或針對特定平台與受眾調整訊息時。

subTools.name: Email Sequence
subTools.description: Design and draft multi-email sequences with full copy, timing, branching logic, exit conditions, and performance benchmarks. Use when building onboarding, lead nurture, re-engagement, win-back, or product launch flows, when you need a complete drip campaign with A/B test suggestions, or when mapping a sequence end-to-end with a flow diagram.
subTools.description_zh: 設計並撰寫多封郵件序列，包含完整文案、排程、分支邏輯、結束條件與效能基準。適用於建立新使用者引導、潛在客戶培育、重新喚醒、客戶回流或產品上市流程，需要完整漸進式Campaign並提供 A/B 測試建議，或想用流程圖完整規劃序列時。

subTools.name: Performance Report
subTools.description: Build a marketing performance report with key metrics, trend analysis, wins and misses, and prioritized optimization recommendations. Use when wrapping a campaign, when preparing weekly, monthly, or quarterly channel summaries for stakeholders, or when you need data translated into an executive summary with next-period priorities.
subTools.description_zh: 建立行銷績效報告，包含關鍵指標、趨勢分析、成果與缺失，以及優先順序分級的優化建議。適用於活動收尾、為利害關係人準備每週／每月／每季頻道摘要，或需要將資料轉化為管理階層摘要並附上下期優先事項時。

subTools.name: Seo Audit
subTools.description: Run a comprehensive SEO audit — keyword research, on-page analysis, content gaps, technical checks, and competitor comparison. Use when assessing a site's SEO health, when finding keyword opportunities and content gaps competitors own, or when you need a prioritized action plan split into quick wins and strategic investments.
subTools.description_zh: 執行全面 SEO 檢測，包含關鍵字研究、頁面分析、內容缺口與技術檢查，適用於評估網站 SEO 健康狀態、挖掘競爭對手持有的關鍵字機會，或制定優先行動計畫。

subTools.name: Capacity Plan
subTools.description: Plan resource capacity — workload analysis and utilization forecasting. Use when heading into quarterly planning, the team feels overallocated and you need the numbers, deciding whether to hire or deprioritize, or stress-testing whether upcoming projects fit the people you have.
subTools.description_zh: 進行資源容量規劃與工作負載分析，適用於季前規劃、團隊人力過載時評估數字，或壓力測試新專案是否符合現有編制。

subTools.name: Change Request
subTools.description: Create a change management request with impact analysis and rollback plan. Use when proposing a system or process change that needs approval, preparing a change record for CAB review, documenting risk and rollback steps before a deployment, or planning stakeholder communications for a rollout.
subTools.description_zh: 建立變更管理請求，包含影響分析與復原計畫。用於提出需核准的系統或流程變更、準備變更記錄供 CAB 審查、記錄部署前的風險與復原步驟，或規劃上線時的利害關係人溝通。

subTools.name: Compliance Tracking
subTools.description: Track compliance requirements and audit readiness. Trigger with "compliance", "audit prep", "SOC 2", "ISO 27001", "GDPR", "regulatory requirement", or when the user needs help tracking, preparing for, or documenting compliance activities.
subTools.description_zh: 追蹤合規要求與稽核準備。以『compliance』、『audit prep』、『SOC 2』、『ISO 27001』、『GDPR』、『regulatory requirement』觸發，或當使用者需要協助追蹤、準備或記錄合規活動時。

subTools.name: Process Doc
subTools.description: Document a business process — flowcharts, RACI, and SOPs. Use when formalizing a process that lives in someone's head, building a RACI to clarify who owns what, writing an SOP for a handoff or audit, or capturing the exceptions and edge cases of how work actually gets done.
subTools.description_zh: 文件化商業流程——流程圖、RACI 與 SOP。用於將僅存在腦中的流程正式化、建立 RACI 以釐清責任歸屬、為交接或稽核撰寫 SOP，或捕捉實際工作流程中的例外與邊緣案例。

subTools.name: Process Optimization
subTools.description: Analyze and improve business processes. Trigger with "this process is slow", "how can we improve", "streamline this workflow", "too many steps", "bottleneck", or when the user describes an inefficient process they want to fix.
subTools.description_zh: 分析並改善商業流程。以『這個流程太慢』、『如何改進』、『精簡此工作流程』、『步驟太多』、『瓶頸』觸發，或當使用者描述想要修正的低效率流程時。

subTools.name: Risk Assessment
subTools.description: Identify, assess, and mitigate operational risks. Trigger with "what are the risks", "risk assessment", "risk register", "what could go wrong", or when the user is evaluating risks associated with a project, vendor, process, or decision.
subTools.description_zh: 識別、評估與減輕營運風險。以『有哪些風險』、『風險評估』、『風險登記冊』、『可能出什麼錯』觸發，或當使用者評估與專案、供應商、流程或決策相關的風險時。

subTools.name: Runbook
subTools.description: Create or update an operational runbook for a recurring task or procedure. Use when documenting a task that on-call or ops needs to run repeatably, turning tribal knowledge into exact step-by-step commands, adding troubleshooting and rollback steps to an existing procedure, or writing escalation paths for when things go wrong.
subTools.description_zh: 建立或更新重複性任務或程序的營運手冊。用於記錄待命或營運團隊需重複執行的任務、將部落知識轉為精確的逐步指令、在現有程序中加入疑難排解與復原步驟，或撰寫異常時的升級途徑。

subTools.name: Status Report
subTools.description: Generate a status report with KPIs, risks, and action items. Use when writing a weekly or monthly update for leadership, summarizing project health with green/yellow/red status, surfacing risks and decisions that need stakeholder attention, or turning a pile of project tracker activity into a readable narrative.
subTools.description_zh: 產生包含 KPI、風險與行動項目的狀態報告。用於為高階管理層撰寫每週或每月更新、以綠/黃/紅狀態總結專案健康狀況、浮現需利害關係人關注的風險與決策，或將專案追蹤器活動轉為易讀的敘事。

subTools.name: Vendor Review
subTools.description: Evaluate a vendor — cost analysis, risk assessment, and recommendation. Use when reviewing a new vendor proposal, deciding whether to renew or replace a contract, comparing two vendors side-by-side, or building a TCO breakdown and negotiation points before procurement sign-off.
subTools.description_zh: 評估供應商——成本分析、風險評估與建議。用於審查新供應商提案、決定續約或更換合約、並列比較兩個供應商，或採購簽署前建立 TCO 分析與談判要點。

subTools.name: Enrich Lead
subTools.description: Instant lead enrichment. Drop a name, company, LinkedIn URL, or email and get the full contact card with email, phone, title, company intel, and next actions.
subTools.description_zh: 即時豐富客戶資訊。輸入姓名、公司、LinkedIn URL 或電子郵件，即可獲取完整的聯繫卡，包含電子郵件、電話、職位、公司背景資訊及後續行動建議。

subTools.name: Prospect
subTools.description: Full ICP-to-leads pipeline. Describe your ideal customer in plain English and get a ranked table of enriched decision-maker leads with emails and phone numbers.
subTools.description_zh: 完整的理想客戶資料（ICP）至潛在客戶流程。用普通英語描述您的理想客戶，即可獲得經過豐富的決策者潛在客戶排名表格，包含電子郵件和電話號碼。

subTools.name: Sequence Load
subTools.description: Find leads matching criteria and bulk-add them to an Apollo outreach sequence. Handles enrichment, contact creation, deduplication, and enrollment in one flow.
subTools.description_zh: 尋找符合條件的潛在客戶，並批次新增至 Apollo 推廣序列。在單一流程中處理豐富資料、建立聯絡人、去重及入檔。

subTools.name: Account Research
subTools.description: Research a company using Common Room data. Triggers on 'research [company]', 'tell me about [domain]', 'pull up signals for [account]', 'what's going on with [company]', or any account-level question.
subTools.description_zh: 使用 Common Room 資料研究公司。當偵測到「research [company]」、「tell me about [domain]」、「pull up signals for [account]」、「what's going on with [company]」或任何帳戶層級問題時觸發。

subTools.name: Call Prep
subTools.description: Prepare for a customer or prospect call using Common Room signals. Triggers on 'prep me for my call with [company]', 'prepare for a meeting with [company]', 'what should I know before talking to [company]', or any call preparation request.
subTools.description_zh: 使用 Common Room 訊號準備客戶或潛在客戶會面。當偵測到「prep me for my call with [company]」、「prepare for a meeting with [company]」、「what should I know before talking to [company]」或任何會前準備請求時觸發。

subTools.name: Compose Outreach
subTools.description: Generate personalized outreach messages using Common Room signals. Triggers on 'draft outreach to [person]', 'write an email to [name]', 'compose a message for [contact]', or any outreach drafting request.
subTools.description_zh: 使用 Common Room 訊號生成個人化外展訊息。觸發時機：「撰寫給 [人] 的外展訊息」、「寫一封 Email 給 [姓名]」、「為 [聯絡人] 撰寫訊息」或任何外展草稿需求。

subTools.name: Contact Research
subTools.description: Research a specific person using Common Room data. Triggers on 'who is [name]', 'look up [email]', 'research [contact]', 'is [name] a warm lead', or any contact-level question.
subTools.description_zh: 使用 Common Room 資料研究特定人物。觸發時機：「[姓名] 是誰」、「查詢 [Email]」、「研究 [聯絡人]」、「[姓名] 是否是暖熱線索」或任何聯絡人層級問題。

subTools.name: Prospect
subTools.description: Build targeted account or contact lists using Common Room's Prospector. Triggers on 'find companies that match [criteria]', 'build a prospect list', 'find contacts at [type of company]', 'show me companies hiring [role]', or any list-building request.
subTools.description_zh: 使用 Common Room Prospector 建立目標客戶或聯絡人清單。觸發時機：「尋找符合 [條件] 的公司」、「建立潛在客戶清單」、「尋找 [公司類型] 的聯絡人」、「顯示正招聘 [職位] 的公司」或任何清單建置需求。

subTools.name: Weekly Prep Brief
subTools.description: Generate a comprehensive weekly briefing for all external calls in the next 7 days. Triggers on 'weekly prep brief', 'prepare my week', 'what calls do I have this week', 'Monday prep', or any weekly planning request.
subTools.description_zh: 生成未來 7 天所有外部會議的全面每週簡報。觸發時機：「每週準備簡報」、「準備我的週末」、「我這週有什麼會議」、「週一準備」或任何每週規劃需求。

subTools.name: Slack Messaging
subTools.description: Guidance for composing well-formatted, effective Slack messages using mrkdwn syntax
subTools.description_zh: 指導如何使用 mrkdwn 語法撰寫格式良好、有效的 Slack 訊息

subTools.name: Slack Search
subTools.description: Guidance for effectively searching Slack to find messages, files, channels, and people
subTools.description_zh: 指導如何有效搜尋 Slack 以查找訊息、檔案、頻道和人員

subTools.name: Build Zoom Bot
subTools.description: Build a Zoom meeting bot, recorder, or real-time media workflow. Use when joining meetings programmatically, processing live media or transcripts, or combining Meeting SDK, RTMS, and backend services.
subTools.description_zh: 建立 Zoom 會議機器人、錄音機或即時媒體工作流程。當需要以程式方式加入會議、處理即時媒體或轉錄，或結合 Meeting SDK、RTMS 與後端服務時使用。

subTools.name: Build Zoom Meeting App
subTools.description: Build or embed a Zoom meeting flow. Use when implementing Meeting SDK joins, web or mobile meeting embeds, meeting lifecycle flows, or when deciding between Meeting SDK and Video SDK.
subTools.name_zh: 建立 Zoom 會議應用程式
subTools.description_zh: 建立或嵌入 Zoom 會議流程。當實作 Meeting SDK 加入、網頁或行動裝置會議嵌入、會議生命週期流程，或在 Meeting SDK 與 Video SDK 之間做選擇時使用。

subTools.name: Choose Zoom Approach
subTools.description: Choose the right Zoom architecture for a use case. Use when deciding between REST API, Webhooks, WebSockets, Meeting SDK, Video SDK, Zoom Apps SDK, Zoom MCP, Phone, Contact Center, or a hybrid approach.
subTools.description_zh: 為使用情境選擇適當的 Zoom 架構。在 REST API、Webhooks、WebSockets、Meeting SDK、Video SDK、Zoom Apps SDK、Zoom MCP、Phone、Contact Center 或混合方案間做決策時使用。

subTools.name: Cobrowse Sdk
subTools.description: Reference skill for Zoom Cobrowse SDK. Use after routing to a collaborative-support workflow when implementing browser co-browsing, annotation tools, privacy masking, remote assist, or PIN-based session sharing.
subTools.description_zh: Zoom Cobrowse SDK 參考技能。實作瀏覽器共覽、註解工具、隱私遮罩、遠端協助或 PIN 登入共用工作階段時使用。

subTools.name: Contact Center
subTools.description: Reference skill for Zoom Contact Center. Use after routing to a contact-center workflow when implementing app, web, or native integrations; engagement context and state handling; campaigns; callbacks; or version-drift troubleshooting.
subTools.description_zh: Zoom Contact Center 參考技能。實作應用、網頁或原生整合、互動內容與狀態處理、活動、回呼，或版本漂移疑難排解時使用。

subTools.name: Android
subTools.description: Zoom Contact Center SDK for Android. Use for native Android chat/video/ZVA/scheduled callback integrations, campaign mode, service lifecycle, and rejoin handling.
subTools.description_zh: Zoom Contact Center Android SDK。用於原生 Android 聊天、影片、ZVA 與排程回呼整合、活動模式、服務生命週期與重新加入處理。

subTools.name: Ios
subTools.description: Zoom Contact Center SDK for iOS. Use for native iOS chat/video/ZVA/scheduled callback integrations, app lifecycle bridging, rejoin flow, and callback handling.
subTools.description_zh: Zoom Contact Center iOS SDK。用於原生 iOS 聊天、影片、ZVA 與排程回呼整合、應用程式生命週期橋接、重新加入流程與回呼處理。

subTools.name: Web
subTools.description: Zoom Contact Center SDK for Web. Use for web chat/video/campaign embeds, engagement event handling, app-context integrations, and Smart Embed postMessage workflows.
subTools.description_zh: Zoom Contact Center Web SDK。用於網頁聊天、影片、活動嵌入、互動事件處理、應用上下文整合與 Smart Embed postMessage 工作流程。

subTools.name: Debug Zoom
subTools.description: Debug a broken Zoom integration by isolating the failure point and routing into the right Zoom references. Use when auth, API, webhook, SDK, or MCP behavior is failing and you need a ranked hypothesis list plus verification steps.
subTools.description_zh: 隔離故障點並導向適當的 Zoom 參考資料，以除錯損壞的 Zoom 整合。當驗證、API、webhook、SDK 或 MCP 行為失效時使用，提供排序後的假設清單與驗證步驟。

subTools.name: Debug Zoom Integration
subTools.description: Debug broken Zoom implementations quickly. Use when auth, webhooks, SDK joins, MCP transport, or real-time media workflows are failing and you need to isolate the layer before proposing a fix.
subTools.description_zh: 快速除錯損壞的 Zoom 實作。當驗證、webhooks、SDK 加入、MCP 傳輸或即時媒體工作流程失效時，先隔離問題層再提出修復方案。

subTools.name: Design Mcp Workflow
subTools.description: Design a Zoom MCP workflow for Claude. Use when deciding whether Zoom MCP fits a task, when planning tool-based AI workflows, or when separating MCP responsibilities from REST API responsibilities.
subTools.name_zh: 設計 MCP 工作流程
subTools.description_zh: 為 Claude 設計 Zoom MCP 工作流程。用於評估 Zoom MCP 是否適用、規劃基於工具 AI 工作流程，或區分 MCP 與 REST API 職責時。

subTools.name: General
subTools.description: Cross-product Zoom reference skill. Use after the workflow is clear when you need shared platform guidance, app-model comparisons, authentication context, scopes, marketplace considerations, or API-vs-MCP routing.
subTools.description_zh: 跨產品 Zoom 參考技能。工作流程確定後，需要平台指南、應用模型比較、認證上下文、權限範圍、市場考量或 API 與 MCP 路由時使用。

subTools.name: Meeting Sdk
subTools.description: Reference skill for Zoom Meeting SDK. Use after routing to a meeting-embed workflow when implementing real Zoom meeting joins, platform-specific SDK behavior, auth and join flows, waiting room issues, or meeting bot patterns.
subTools.description_zh: Zoom Meeting SDK 參考技能。路由至會議嵌入工作流程後，實作直接加入會議、平台特定 SDK 行為、驗證與加入流程、等候室問題或會議機器人模式時使用。

subTools.name: Linux
subTools.description: Zoom Meeting SDK for Linux - C++ headless meeting bots with raw audio/video access, transcription, recording, and AI integration for server-side automation
subTools.description_zh: Zoom Meeting SDK for Linux – C++ 無頭會議機器人，具備原始音訊／視訊存取、轉錄、錄影與 AI 整合，用於伺服器端自動化

subTools.name: React Native
subTools.description: Zoom Meeting SDK for React Native. Use when embedding Zoom meetings in React Native iOS/Android apps with @zoom/meetingsdk-react-native, JWT auth, join/start flows, platform setup, and native bridge troubleshooting.
subTools.description_zh: Zoom Meeting SDK for React Native。用於將 Zoom 會議嵌入 React Native iOS/Android 應用程式、JWT 認證、加入/開始流程、平台設定與原生橋接除錯。

subTools.name: Oauth
subTools.description: Reference skill for Zoom authentication. Use after routing to an auth workflow when choosing app credentials, grant types, scopes, token refresh behavior, or debugging Zoom OAuth failures.
