subTools.description_zh: Zoom 認證參考技能。用於選擇應用程式憑證、授權類型、範圍、權杖刷新行為或除錯 Zoom OAuth 失敗時。

subTools.name: Phone
subTools.description: Reference skill for Zoom Phone. Use after routing to a phone workflow when implementing OAuth, Phone APIs, webhooks, Smart Embed events, URI schemes, CRM or CTI dialers, or call handling automation.
subTools.description_zh: Zoom Phone 參考技能。用於實作 OAuth、Phone API、webhook、Smart Embed 事件、URI scheme、CRM 或 CTI 撥號器、來電處理自動化時。

subTools.name: Plan Zoom Integration
subTools.description: Turn a Zoom integration idea into an implementation plan with architecture, auth, and delivery milestones. Use when you need a practical build plan, phased delivery sequence, risk list, and next-step recommendation.
subTools.description_zh: 將Zoom整合構想轉化為實施計畫，包含架構設計、認證方式與交付里程碑。需要實務建置計畫、分階段交付順序、風險清單與下一步建議時使用。

subTools.name: Plan Zoom Product
subTools.description: Choose the right Zoom building surface for a use case and explain the tradeoffs clearly. Use when deciding between REST API, Webhooks, WebSockets, Meeting SDK, Video SDK, Zoom Apps SDK, Phone, Contact Center, or MCP for a specific product idea or integration goal.
subTools.description_zh: 為特定應用情境選擇合適的Zoom建置平台，清楚說明各方案優缺點。在REST API、Webhooks、WebSockets、Meeting SDK、Video SDK、Zoom Apps SDK、Phone、Contact Center或MCP之間做決策時使用。

subTools.name: Probe Sdk
subTools.description: Reference skill for Zoom Probe SDK. Use after routing to a preflight workflow when testing browser compatibility, media permissions, audio or video diagnostics, and network readiness before users join.
subTools.description_zh: Zoom Probe SDK參考技能。導向預檢工作流程後使用，用於測試瀏覽器相容性、媒體權限、音視訊診斷與網路就緒狀態。

subTools.name: Rest Api
subTools.description: Reference skill for Zoom REST API. Use after choosing an API-based workflow when you need endpoint selection, resource-management patterns, OAuth requirements, rate-limit awareness, or API error debugging.
subTools.description_zh: Zoom REST API參考技能。選擇基於API的工作流程後使用，用於端點選取、資源管理模式、OAuth需求、速率限制認知或API錯誤除錯。

subTools.name: Rivet Sdk
subTools.description: Reference skill for Zoom Rivet SDK. Use after routing to a Rivet-based server workflow when implementing auth handling, webhook consumers, API wrappers, multi-module composition, or Lambda receiver patterns.
subTools.description_zh: Zoom Rivet SDK參考技能。導向基於Rivet的伺服器工作流程後使用，用於實作認證處理、webhook消費、API包裝、多模組組合或Lambda接收器模式。

subTools.name: Rtms
subTools.description: Reference skill for Zoom RTMS. Use after routing to a live-media workflow when processing real-time audio, video, chat, transcripts, screen share, or contact-center voice streams.
subTools.description_zh: Zoom RTMS參考技能。導向即時媒體工作流程後使用，用於處理即時音訊、視訊、聊天、字幕、螢幕分享或客服語音串流。

subTools.name: Scribe
subTools.description: Reference skill for Zoom AI Services Scribe. Use after routing to a transcription workflow when handling uploaded or stored media, Build-platform JWT auth, fast mode transcription, batch jobs, or transcript pipeline design.
subTools.description_zh: Zoom AI Services Scribe參考技能。導向轉錄工作流程後使用，用於處理上傳或儲存的媒體、Build平台JWT認證、快速模式轉錄、批次工作或轉錄管線設計。

subTools.name: Setup Zoom Mcp
subTools.description: Decide when Zoom MCP is the right fit and produce a safe setup plan for Claude. Use when planning AI workflows over Zoom data, deciding between MCP and REST, or defining a hybrid MCP architecture.
subTools.description_zh: 判斷Zoom MCP是否適合，並為Claude產生安全設定計畫。規劃Zoom資料上的AI工作流程、在MCP與REST間抉擇，或定義混合MCP架構時使用。

subTools.name: Setup Zoom Oauth
subTools.description: Implement Zoom authentication correctly. Use when setting up app credentials, choosing an OAuth grant, requesting scopes, handling token refresh, or debugging auth failures.
subTools.description_zh: 正確實現 Zoom 驗證。於設定 app 認證、選擇 OAuth 授權、請求範圍、處理權杖刷新或除錯驗證失敗時使用。

subTools.name: Start
subTools.description: Start here for any Zoom integration or app idea. Use when you need to choose the right Zoom surface, shape the architecture, or route into the correct implementation skill without reading the whole Zoom doc set first.
subTools.description_zh: 任何 Zoom 整合或 app 構想請由此開始。當需要選擇合適的 Zoom 界面、設計架構，或引導至正確的實作技能，而無需先閱讀整個 Zoom 文件集時使用。

subTools.name: Team Chat
subTools.description: Reference skill for Zoom Team Chat. Use after routing to a chat workflow when building user-scoped messaging integrations, chatbot experiences, rich cards, buttons, slash commands, or chat webhooks.
subTools.description_zh: Zoom Team Chat 參考技能。當建立使用者範圍的訊息整合、聊天機器人體驗、豐富卡片、按鈕、斜線指令或聊天 webhook 時，路由至聊天工作流程後使用。

subTools.name: Ui Toolkit
subTools.description: Reference skill for Zoom Video SDK UI Toolkit. Use after routing to a web video workflow when you want prebuilt React UI instead of building a fully custom Video SDK interface.
subTools.description_zh: Zoom Video SDK UI 工具包參考技能。欲使用預先建構的 React UI 而非建立完全客製化的 Video SDK 介面時，路由至網頁影片工作流程後使用。

subTools.name: Video Sdk
subTools.description: Reference skill for Zoom Video SDK. Use after routing to a custom-session workflow when the user needs full control over the video experience rather than an actual Zoom meeting.
subTools.description_zh: Zoom Video SDK 的參考技能。當使用者需要對影片體驗擁有完整控制權，而非使用實際的 Zoom 會議時，在導向自訂工作階段工作流後使用此技能。

subTools.name: Linux
subTools.description: Zoom Video SDK for Linux - C++ headless bots, raw audio/video capture/injection, Qt/GTK integration, Docker support
subTools.description_zh: Linux 版 Zoom Video SDK — C++ 無頭機器人，原始音訊／視訊擷取與注入，Qt／GTK 整合，Docker 支援

subTools.name: Web
subTools.description: Zoom Video SDK for Web - JavaScript/TypeScript integration for browser-based video sessions, real-time communication, screen sharing, recording, and live transcription
subTools.description_zh: Zoom Video SDK for Web——適用於瀏覽器的 JavaScript/TypeScript 整合，支援即時影片通話、螢幕分享、錄製與即時轉錄功能

subTools.name: Windows
subTools.description: Zoom Video SDK for Windows - C++ integration for video sessions, raw audio/video capture, screen sharing, recording, and real-time communication
subTools.description_zh: Zoom Video SDK for Windows——C++ 整合，支援影片通話、原始音視訊擷取、螢幕分享、錄製與即時通訊

subTools.name: Virtual Agent
subTools.description: Reference skill for Zoom Virtual Agent. Use after routing to a virtual-agent workflow when implementing web embeds, Android or iOS wrapper integrations, knowledge-base sync, lifecycle handling, or troubleshooting.
subTools.description_zh: Zoom Virtual Agent 參考技能。實作網頁嵌入、Android 或 iOS 封裝整合、知識庫同步、生命週期處理或除錯時，於導向 Virtual Agent 工作流程後使用

subTools.name: Android
subTools.description: Zoom Virtual Agent Android integration via WebView. Use for Java/Kotlin bridge callbacks, native URL handling, support_handoff relay, and lifecycle-safe embedding.
subTools.description_zh: 透過 WebView 整合 Zoom Virtual Agent Android。適用於 Java/Kotlin 橋接回呼、原生 URL 處理、support_handoff 轉發與安全的生命週期嵌入

subTools.name: Ios
subTools.description: Zoom Virtual Agent iOS integration via WKWebView. Use for Swift/Objective-C script injection, message handlers, support_handoff relay, and URL routing policies.
subTools.description_zh: 透過 WKWebView 進行 Zoom Virtual Agent iOS 整合。適用於 Swift／Objective-C 腳本注入、訊息處理常式、支援轉接中繼與 URL 路由政策。

subTools.name: Web
subTools.description: Zoom Virtual Agent SDK for web embeds. Use for campaign or entry ID chat launch, event-driven controls, user context updates, and CSP-safe deployment.
subTools.description_zh: Zoom Virtual Agent Web 嵌入 SDK。適用於活動或入口 ID 對話啟動、事件驅動控制、使用者內容更新與 CSP 安全部署。

subTools.name: Webhooks
subTools.description: Reference skill for Zoom webhooks. Use after routing to an event-driven workflow when implementing subscriptions, signature verification, delivery handling, retries, or event-type selection.
subTools.description_zh: Zoom webhooks 參考技能。路由至事件驅動工作流程後使用，用於實作訂閱、簽章驗證、送達處理、重試與事件類型選取。

subTools.name: Websockets
subTools.description: Reference skill for Zoom WebSockets. Use after routing to a low-latency event workflow when persistent connections, faster event delivery, or security constraints make WebSockets preferable to webhooks.
subTools.description_zh: Zoom WebSockets 參考技能。路由至低延遲事件工作流程後使用，當持續連線、快速事件送達或安全限制使 WebSockets 比 webhooks 更合適時。

subTools.name: Zoom Apps Sdk
subTools.description: Reference skill for Zoom Apps SDK. Use after routing to an in-client app workflow when building web apps that run inside Zoom meetings, webinars, the main client, or Zoom Phone.
subTools.description_zh: Zoom Apps SDK 參考技能。路由至客戶端內嵌應用程式工作流程後使用，用於開發在 Zoom 會議、網路研討會、主客戶端或 Zoom Phone 內執行的網頁應用程式。

subTools.name: Zoom Mcp
subTools.description: Guidance for the bundled Zoom MCP connectors. Use after routing to an MCP workflow when planning or troubleshooting tool-based access to meetings, recordings, meeting assets, or transcripts. Route Zoom Docs requests to the dedicated Docs MCP server and Whiteboard-specific requests to `zoom-mcp/whiteboard`.
subTools.description_zh: 隨附 Zoom MCP 連接器的指引。路由至 MCP 工作流程後使用，用於規劃或排除會議、錄影、會議資產或逐字稿的基於工具存取問題。Zoom Docs 請求請導向專屬 Docs MCP 伺服器，Whiteboard 特定請求導向 `zoom-mcp/whiteboard`。

subTools.name: View Pdf
subTools.description: Interactive PDF viewer. Use when the user wants to open, show, or view a PDF and collaborate on it visually — annotate, highlight, stamp, fill form fields, place signature/initials, or review markup together. Not for summarization or text extraction (use native Read instead).
subTools.description_zh: 互動式 PDF 檢視器。當使用者想要開啟、顯示或檢視 PDF 並共同視覺協作時使用——可註解、標示、蓋章、填寫表單欄位、放置簽名／縮寫，或共同檢視標記。不適用於摘要或文字擷取（請改用原生閱讀）。

subTools.name: Competitive Brief
subTools.description: Create a competitive analysis brief for one or more competitors or a feature area. Use when informing product strategy or feature prioritization, building sales battle cards, prepping board or investor materials, or deciding where to differentiate vs. achieve parity.
subTools.description_zh: 為競爭對手或功能領域撰寫競爭分析簡報。適用於制定產品策略、功能優先級排序、建立銷售戰術卡、準備董事會或投資人資料，以及決定如何建立差異化或達成功能對齊。

subTools.name: Metrics Review
subTools.description: Review and analyze product metrics with trend analysis and actionable insights. Use when running a weekly, monthly, or quarterly metrics review, investigating a sudden spike or drop, comparing performance against targets, or turning raw numbers into a scorecard with recommended actions.
subTools.description_zh: 檢視並分析產品指標，包含趨勢分析與可行洞察。適用於執行週／月／季報表、調查突發尖峰或暴跌、對比目標表現，或將原始數字轉化為附建議行動的評分卡。

subTools.name: Product Brainstorming
subTools.description: Brainstorm product ideas, explore problem spaces, and challenge assumptions as a thinking partner. Use when exploring a new opportunity, generating solutions to a product problem, stress-testing an idea, or when a PM needs to think out loud with a sharp sparring partner before converging on a direction.
subTools.description_zh: 以思考夥伴身分激盪產品構想、探索問題領域並挑戰假設。適用於發掘新機會、生成產品問題解決方案、壓力測試構想，或 PM 需先與犀利對手反覆推演再匯聚方向時。

subTools.name: Roadmap Update
subTools.description: Update, create, or reprioritize your product roadmap. Use when adding a new initiative and deciding what moves to make room, shifting priorities after new information comes in, moving timelines due to a dependency slip, or building a Now/Next/Later view from scratch.
subTools.description_zh: 更新、建立或重新排序產品路徑。適用於新增計畫並決定哪些項目讓位、根據新資訊調整優先級、因相依性延誤而移動時間表，或從零開始建構「現在／接下來／未來」三階段檢視。

subTools.name: Sprint Planning
subTools.description: Plan a sprint — scope work, estimate capacity, set goals, and draft a sprint plan. Use when kicking off a new sprint, sizing a backlog against team availability (accounting for PTO and meetings), deciding what's P0 vs. stretch, or handling carryover from the last sprint.
subTools.description_zh: 規劃 Sprint——界定工作範圍、評估容量、設定目標並草擬 Sprint 計畫。適用於啟動新 Sprint、依團隊可用時間（含休假與會議）評估待辦事項規模、區分 P0 與延伸任務，或處理上一輪剩餘工作。

subTools.name: Stakeholder Update
subTools.description: Generate a stakeholder update tailored to audience and cadence. Use when writing a weekly or monthly status for leadership, announcing a launch, escalating a risk or blocker, or translating the same progress into exec-brief, engineering-detail, or customer-facing versions.
subTools.description_zh: 產出量身打造受眾與節奏的利害關係人更新內容。適用於撰寫每週／每月管理階層進度報告、發布上市消息、升級風險或阻礙，或將相同進度轉譯為高管簡報、工程細節、客戶導向等不同版本。

subTools.name: Synthesize Research
subTools.description: Synthesize user research from interviews, surveys, and feedback into structured insights. Use when you have a pile of interview notes, survey responses, or support tickets to make sense of, need to extract themes and rank findings by frequency and impact, or want to turn raw feedback into roadmap recommendations.
subTools.description_zh: 將訪談、問卷與意見反饋等使用者研究資料綜合為結構化洞察。適用於整理大量訪談筆記、問卷回應或客服工單、萃取主題並依頻率與影響程度排列發現結果，或將原始意見轉化為產品路徑建議。

subTools.name: Write Spec
subTools.description: Write a feature spec or PRD from a problem statement or feature idea. Use when turning a vague idea or user request into a structured document, scoping a feature with goals and non-goals, defining success metrics and acceptance criteria, or breaking a big ask into a phased spec.
subTools.description_zh: 根據問題陳述或功能構想撰寫功能規格或產品需求文件。適用於將模糊構想或使用者請求轉為結構化文件、以目標與非目標界定功能範圍、定義成功指標與驗收標準，或將大型需求拆解為分階段規格。

subTools.name: Memory Management
subTools.description: Two-tier memory system that makes Claude a true workplace collaborator. Decodes shorthand, acronyms, nicknames, and internal language so Claude understands requests like a colleague would. CLAUDE.md for working memory, memory/ directory for the full knowledge base.
subTools.description_zh: 雙層記憶系統，讓 Claude 成為真正的職場協作者。解碼速記、縮寫、暱稱及內部用語，讓 Claude 能像同事一樣理解請求。CLAUDE.md 用於工作記憶，memory/ 資料夾用於完整知識庫。

subTools.name: Start
subTools.description: Initialize the productivity system and open the dashboard. Use when setting up the plugin for the first time, bootstrapping working memory from your existing task list, or decoding the shorthand (nicknames, acronyms, project codenames) you use in your todos.
subTools.description_zh: 初始化生產力系統並開啟儀表板。首次設定外掛程式、從現有任務列表引導工作記憶，或解碼任務清單中的速記（暱稱、縮寫、專案代號）時使用。

subTools.name: Task Management
subTools.description: Simple task management using a shared TASKS.md file. Reference this when the user asks about their tasks, wants to add/complete tasks, or needs help tracking commitments.
subTools.description_zh: 使用共用 TASKS.md 檔案進行簡單任務管理。當使用者詢問任務、希望新增或完成任務，或需要協助追蹤承諾時參考此項目。

subTools.name: Update
subTools.description: Sync tasks and refresh memory from your current activity. Use when pulling new assignments from your project tracker into TASKS.md, triaging stale or overdue tasks, filling memory gaps for unknown people or projects, or running a comprehensive scan to catch todos buried in chat and email.
subTools.description_zh: 同步任務並從當前活動更新記憶。當從專案追蹤器拉取新任務至 TASKS.md、篩選陳舊或逾期任務、為未知人員或專案填補記憶空白，或執行全面掃描以捕捉隱藏在對話和郵件中的待辦事項時使用。

subTools.name: Account Research
subTools.description: Research a company or person and get actionable sales intel. Works standalone with web search, supercharged when you connect enrichment tools or your CRM. Trigger with "research [company]", "look up [person]", "intel on [prospect]", "who is [name] at [company]", or "tell me about [company]".
subTools.description_zh: 研究公司或個人，取得可操作的銷售情報。獨立使用網頁搜尋即可，連接擴充工具或 CRM 後效果更佳。觸發指令例如「research [company]」、「look up [person]」、「intel on [prospect]」、「who is [name] at [company]」或「tell me about [company]」。

subTools.name: Call Prep
subTools.description: Prepare for a sales call with account context, attendee research, and suggested agenda. Works standalone with user input and web research, supercharged when you connect your CRM, email, chat, or transcripts. Trigger with "prep me for my call with [company]", "I'm meeting with [company] prep me", "call prep [company]", or "get me ready for [meeting]".
subTools.description_zh: 準備銷售電話，提供帳戶背景、出席者研究和建議議程。獨立使用使用者輸入和網頁研究即可，連接 CRM、郵件、聊天或逐字稿後效果更佳。觸發指令例如「prep me for my call with [company]」、「I'm meeting with [company] prep me」、「call prep [company]」或「get me ready for [meeting]」。

subTools.name: Call Summary
subTools.description: Process call notes or a transcript — extract action items, draft follow-up email, generate internal summary. Use when pasting rough notes or a transcript after a discovery, demo, or negotiation call, drafting a customer follow-up, logging the activity for your CRM, or capturing objections and next steps for your team.
subTools.description_zh: 處理電話筆記或逐字稿，提取行動項目、撰寫後續郵件、生成內部摘要。當貼上初步筆記或逐字稿後用於探索會議、演示或談判會議、撰寫客戶後續郵件、記錄活動至 CRM，或為團隊記錄反對意見和後續步驟時使用。

subTools.name: Competitive Intelligence
subTools.description: Research your competitors and build an interactive battlecard. Outputs an HTML artifact with clickable competitor cards and a comparison matrix. Trigger with "competitive intel", "research competitors", "how do we compare to [competitor]", "battlecard for [competitor]", or "what's new with [competitor]".
subTools.description_zh: 研究競爭對手並建立互動式戰鬥卡。輸出包含可點擊競爭對手卡片和比較矩陣的 HTML 結果。觸發指令例如「competitive intel」、「research competitors」、「how do we compare to [competitor]」、「battlecard for [competitor]」或「what's new with [competitor]」。

subTools.name: Create An Asset
subTools.description: Generate tailored sales assets (landing pages, decks, one-pagers, workflow demos) from your deal context. Describe your prospect, audience, and goal — get a polished, branded asset ready to share with customers.
subTools.description_zh: 根據洽談背景，生成客製化銷售資產（落地頁、簡報、單頁說明、流程影片）。描述目標客戶、受眾與目標，即可產出專業且符合品牌的資產，隨時與客戶分享。

subTools.name: Daily Briefing
subTools.description: Start your day with a prioritized sales briefing. Works standalone when you tell me your meetings and priorities, supercharged when you connect your calendar, CRM, and email. Trigger with "morning briefing", "daily brief", "what's on my plate today", "prep my day", or "start my day".
subTools.description_zh: 以優先順序排定的銷售簡報開啟一天。可直接使用，或連接日曆、CRM 與電子郵件強化效果。觸發詞包括「morning briefing」、「daily brief」、「what's on my plate today」、「prep my day」、「start my day」。

subTools.name: Draft Outreach
subTools.description: Research a prospect then draft personalized outreach. Uses web research by default, supercharged with enrichment and CRM. Trigger with "draft outreach to [person/company]", "write cold email to [prospect]", "reach out to [name]".
subTools.description_zh: 研究目標客戶後，撰寫個人化的 Outreach 內容。預設使用網路搜尋，並可結合資料填補與 CRM 強化。觸發詞包括「draft outreach to [person/company]」、「write cold email to [prospect]」、「reach out to [name]」。

subTools.name: Forecast
subTools.description: Generate a weighted sales forecast with best/likely/worst scenarios, commit vs. upside breakdown, and gap analysis. Use when preparing a quarterly forecast call, assessing gap-to-quota from a pipeline CSV, deciding which deals to commit vs. call upside, or checking pipeline coverage against your number.
subTools.description_zh: 生成加權銷售預測，包含最佳／可能／最差情境、承諾與上浮分配，以及缺口分析。適用於季度預測會議、從 Pipeline CSV 評估缺口、決定承諾或上浮專案，或檢視 Pipeline 覆蓋率。

subTools.name: Pipeline Review
subTools.description: Analyze pipeline health — prioritize deals, flag risks, get a weekly action plan. Use when running a weekly pipeline review, deciding which deals to focus on this week, spotting stale or stuck opportunities, auditing for hygiene issues like bad close dates, or identifying single-threaded deals.
subTools.description_zh: 分析漏斗健康狀況：優先處理商機、標記風險、產出每週行動計畫。適用於每週漏斗檢視、決定本週重點、識別停滯或卡住的機會、審查資料完整性（如錯亂的成交日），或找出單一對接的商機。

subTools.name: Call List
subTools.description: Ranks the top-5 leads most worth calling today, supplies talking points from email history, blocks time on the calendar, and drafts follow-up messages. Accepts optional count and date arguments.
subTools.description_zh: 排出今日最值得拜訪的前五名名單，提供 Email 往來重點作為談話參考，並排定時間與草擬後續訊息。可接受選用參數 count 與 date。

subTools.name: Close Month
subTools.description: Closes the month — reconciles QB vs payment processors, flags gaps, writes P&L narrative, exports close packet. Accepts optional month and save-to arguments.
subTools.description_zh: 完成月結 — 對帳 QB 與支付處理商，標記差額，撰寫損益表敘述，匯出結帳包。支援可選的月份與儲存參數。

subTools.name: Crm Cleanup
subTools.description: Scans HubSpot for stale deals, duplicate contacts, and missing fields, then fixes what the owner approves. Accepts optional scope argument for deals, contacts, or all.
subTools.description_zh: 掃描 HubSpot 找出陳舊業務、重複聯絡人及遺漏欄位，經主人同意後進行修復。可選參數指定針對業務、聯絡人或全部。

subTools.name: Customer Pulse Check
subTools.description: Synthesizes themes from PayPal disputes, HubSpot tickets, and review exports into a top-3 fixable issues list with drafted response templates. Accepts optional since-date argument.
subTools.description_zh: 綜合 PayPal 爭議、HubSpot 工單與評論匯出資料的主題，列出前 3 項可修復問題，並附上回應範本。可選 since-date 參數。

subTools.name: Friday Brief
subTools.description: Delivers the Friday end-of-week pulse — revenue vs prior week, top sellers, wins and watches. Accepts optional lookback window of 7 or 14 days.
subTools.description_zh: 提供每週五的營運概況——與上週營收對比、暢銷商品、近期成果與需關注事項。可選設定7或14天的回顧期間。

subTools.name: Handle Complaint
subTools.description: Handles an incoming customer complaint end-to-end — pulls context, drafts a response, and suggests an operational fix. Accepts optional email or ticket ID argument.
subTools.description_zh: 完整處理顧客投訴——提取相關資料、撰寫回覆，並建議營運改善方案。可選輸入電子郵件或工單ID。

subTools.name: Monday Brief
subTools.description: Generates a one-page Monday morning briefing — cash, sales, pipeline, week ahead, top three to-dos. Accepts optional post destination and save-to arguments.
subTools.description_zh: 產生一頁週一晨間簡報——現金、銷售、銷售線、本週預計事項、前三優先待辦。支援可選的發布目的地與儲存位置參數。

subTools.name: Month Heads Up
subTools.description: Runs on the 25th — shows the next 30-day cash-flow outlook and flags anything that needs attention before month-end. Accepts optional 30 or 60 day horizon.
subTools.description_zh: 每月 25 日執行 — 顯示未來 30 天現金流展望，並標示需在月底前關注的事項。接受可選的 30 或 60 天時間範圍。

subTools.name: Plan Payroll
subTools.description: Forecasts cash, ranks overdue invoices, and stages PayPal reminders so the owner can confidently run payroll. Accepts optional horizon and payroll-date arguments.
subTools.description_zh: 預測現金流、排序逾期發票，並準備 PayPal 提醒，讓老闆能自信地發放薪資。接受可選的時間範圍和薪資發放日期參數。

subTools.name: Price Check
subTools.description: Produces a margin-by-product table and three pricing-scenario data views so the owner can see the full financial picture before making a pricing decision. Accepts optional product name argument.
subTools.description_zh: 生成產品別毛利率表格和三種定價情境檢視，讓老闆在決定價格前看到完整財務概況。接受可選的產品名稱參數。

subTools.name: Quarterly Review
subTools.description: Generates a full QBR narrative — revenue trend, margin trend, customer health, top opportunities and risks — as a presentation-ready PDF or deck. Accepts optional quarter and save-to arguments.
subTools.description_zh: 產生完整 QBR 報告 — 營收趨勢、毛利率趨勢、客戶健康度、主要機會與風險 — 輸出為簡報級別的 PDF 或簡報。接受可選的季度和儲存路徑參數。

subTools.name: Review Contract
subTools.description: Reviews a contract in plain English, surfaces red flags with severity ratings, and produces a marked-up docx/PDF with suggested redlines. Accepts optional file path or DocuSign envelope ID.
subTools.description_zh: 以白話文審查合約、標示具嚴重度評級的風險點，並產出含建議修訂標註的 docx/PDF 文件。接受可選的檔案路徑或 DocuSign 信封 ID。

subTools.name: Run Campaign
subTools.description: Runs an end-to-end marketing campaign — sales analysis, content brief, Canva assets, HubSpot send. Accepts optional lookback and channel arguments.
subTools.description_zh: 執行完整行銷活動流程 — 銷售分析、內容企劃、Canva 素材、HubSpot 發送。接受可選的回溯時間和頻道參數。

subTools.name: Sales Brief
subTools.description: Surfaces top and bottom sellers, identifies seasonality patterns, and produces a 2-week content brief to push winners and clear slow movers. Accepts optional lookback window of 30, 60, or 90 days.
subTools.description_zh: 顯示暢銷與滯銷商品、識別季節性模式，並產出兩週內容企劃以推動熱銷品並清理滯銷品。接受可選的 30、60 或 90 天回溯窗口。

subTools.name: Tax Prep
subTools.description: Prepares tax-season materials — quarterly estimated tax calculation or year-end 1099 prep — and produces an accountant handoff packet. Accepts optional mode and year arguments.
subTools.description_zh: 準備稅季相關材料——包括季度預估稅計算或年終 1099 文件準備——並產出會計師交接包。接受選用的 mode 與 year 參數。

tools.useCase: Knowledge workers can automate repetitive research, documentation, and data synthesis tasks directly within their daily workflow.
advantages: Open-source repository enabling community contributions and transparency.
Tailored specifically for knowledge work scenarios rather than general chat.
Integrates with Claude Cowork for seamless workflow automation.
negativeConstraints: Real-time high-frequency trading execution requiring low-latency infrastructure.
Embedded systems programming or hardware control tasks.
Offline-only environments without internet access to Claude APIs.
tools.description_zh: 供使用 Claude Cowork 的知識工作者使用的開源外掛程式。
tools.useCase_zh: 知識工作者可直接在日常工作流程中自動化重複的研究、文件整理與資料綜合任務。
tools.advantages_zh: 開源存放庫，促進社群貢獻與透明度。專為知識工作場景設計，而非一般對話。與 Claude Cowork 整合，實現無縫工作流程自動化。
negativeConstraints_zh: 需要低延遲基礎設施的即時高頻交易執行。
嵌入式系統程式設計或硬體控制任務。
無法連線到 Claude API 的離線環境。

tools.name: Claude For Legal
tools.description: Curated prompts and workflows for legal professionals using Claude.

subTools.name: Bar Prep Questions
subTools.name_zh: 律師證照考試準備題目

subTools.name: Brief Section Drafter
subTools.description: Draft a brief section in house style, consistent with the case theory — every fact cited, every case checked, every argument tied to the theory. Use when the user says "draft the [section]", "write the statement of facts", "argument section on [issue]", or needs a first draft of a brief section.
subTools.description_zh: 依內部格式與訴訟策略撰寫訴狀章節；事實、案例、論點皆須對照策略。於使用者要求撰寫特定章節、事實陳述或初稿時使用。

subTools.name: Chronology
subTools.description: Build or update a chronology from declared document sources and uploads — dated events extracted, de-duped, and tagged by significance per the matter theory. Use when the user asks to build a chronology or timeline from a production or matter file, says "chron from the production" or "what happened when", or needs a working, statement-of-facts, or witness-specific timeline.
subTools.description_zh: 從指定來源萃取有日期事件、去重、依案件策略標記重要程度。使用者要求建時間軸、時序或事實陳述時使用。

subTools.name: Claim Chart
subTools.description: Build or review an element chart — a patent claim chart (infringement, invalidity, or review) or a civil element chart for any cause of action or defense — with every cell pin-cited and gap detection as the priority output. Use when the user asks for a claim chart, element chart, proof chart, infringement or invalidity contention, element-by-element mapping, or asks "what are we missing to prove [claim]".
subTools.description_zh: 建立或檢視侵權、無效或審議用請求項圖表，涵蓋所有元素並優先輸出缺漏分析。使用者要求元素逐一比對、查缺補漏時使用。

subTools.name: Cold Start Interview
subTools.description: House cold-start for the litigation plugin — branches by role (in-house, firm associate, solo) and side (plaintiff, defense, both), captures risk calibration, landscape, and house style, and writes the practice profile CLAUDE.md. Use on a fresh install, when the user wants to set up or redo the practice profile, or to re-check available integrations.
subTools.description_zh: 依角色與立場分支，捕捉風險、環境與內部風格，寫入 CLAUDE.md。全新安裝或需重設實務檔案時使用。

subTools.name: Demand Draft
subTools.description: Draft a demand letter from a completed intake, gated on a privilege / FRE 408 / waiver / admission checklist, with a .docx output, post-send checklist, and an offer to create a matter. Use when the user says "draft the demand", "write the [type] letter", or has a finished demand intake ready to turn into a sendable draft.
subTools.description_zh: 根據已完成的案件受理資料，撰寫求償通知函（含特權／FRE 408／豁免／自認檢查清單），輸出 .docx 格式並附上寄出後檢查清單，同時提供開立案件的選項。當使用者要求撰寫求償函或已準備好求償資料時使用。

subTools.name: Demand Intake
subTools.description: Pre-drafting context gathering for a demand letter — parties, facts, basis, leverage, BATNA, and privilege filters — written to a structured intake.md the demand-draft skill reads. Use when the user wants to prep a demand letter, run intake before drafting, or capture context for a payment demand, breach/cure notice, cease-and-desist, employment separation, or preservation demand.
subTools.description_zh: 撰寫求償通知函前的背景資訊收集——包括當事人、事實、請求基礎、談判籌碼、最佳替代方案及特權過濾條件，寫入結構化的 intake.md，供 demand-draft 技能讀取。當使用者希望先整理求償背景時使用。

subTools.name: Demand Received
subTools.description: Triage an inbound demand letter — extract fields, cross-check the portfolio, assess merit, present response options with a recommendation, and hand off to matter-intake or demand-intake if escalation is warranted. Use when the user says "we got a demand letter", "triage this demand", or shares an incoming demand to evaluate.
subTools.description_zh: 對 inbound 求償通知進行分流處理——提取欄位、交叉比對案件組合、評估合理性，並提供應對選項與建議；必要時轉介至 matter-intake 或 demand-intake。當收到他人來信求償時使用。

subTools.name: Deposition Prep
subTools.description: Build a deposition outline for a witness — pull their documents from the eDiscovery platform, organize topics around the case theory, and surface impeachment material. Use when the user says "depo prep for [witness]", "build a depo outline", or "prepare for [name]'s deposition".
subTools.description_zh: 為證人建立詢問大綱——從 eDiscovery 平台匯入其文件、依案件理論組織主題，並標示可供彈劾的材料。當使用者要求為特定證人準備詢問大綱時使用。

subTools.name: Legal Hold
subTools.description: Issue, refresh, release, or report on legal holds — drafts the hold notice as .docx, updates legal_hold fields in _log.yaml, and calendars the next refresh. Use when the user says "issue a hold", "refresh hold", "release hold", or asks for a portfolio-wide hold status report.
subTools.description_zh: 發出、更新、解除或查詢訴訟保留（legal hold）狀態——起草 .docx 格式的保留通知，更新 _log.yaml 中的 legal_hold 欄位，並排定下次更新時間。當需要建立或查詢案件組合範圍的保留狀態時使用。

subTools.name: Matter Briefing
subTools.description: Deep briefing on one matter — current posture, what's changed, next deadline, open questions, and a risk re-assessment check, ready before a GC update or outside counsel call. Use when the user says "brief me on [matter]", "where are we on [matter]", or needs a read on a specific matter.
subTools.description_zh: 針對單一案件提供深度簡報——說明現況、變動內容、下一個期限、待解問題，並進行風險重評，方便準備給總法務或外部律師的會議。當需要了解特定案件進展時使用。

subTools.name: Matter Close
subTools.description: Close a matter — capture outcome, final exposure, and lessons, then archive it out of the active portfolio without deleting the record. Use when the user wants to close a matter, says "[matter] is done", or needs to record a settlement, dismissal, judgment, withdrawal, or consolidation outcome.
subTools.description_zh: 結案——記錄結果、最終風險暴露及經驗教訓，並將案件從活躍案件組合中移入封存，但不刪除記錄。當案件已和解、駁回、判決確定、撤回或合併時使用。

subTools.name: Matter Intake
subTools.description: Intake a new matter — uniform questions covering identification, conflicts, source, risk triage, materiality, outside counsel, owners, legal hold, and key dates; writes matter.md and history.md and appends a structured row to _log.yaml. Use when the user says "new matter", "intake this matter", or wants to bring a new matter into the portfolio.
subTools.description_zh: 受理新案件——透過統一問題清單涵蓋識別、利益衝突、來源、風險分流、重大性、外部律師、負責人、訴訟保留及關鍵日期等項目，寫入 matter.md 與 history.md，並在 _log.yaml 追加結構化記錄。當引入新案件至案件組合時使用。

subTools.name: Matter Update
subTools.description: Append a dated event to a matter's history file and refresh the log row — captures new developments, status changes, risk re-assessments, deadline shifts, and settlement authority changes. Use when the user wants to log an update on a matter, note a development, or record a status change against the portfolio.
subTools.description_zh: 將帶日期的事件追加至案件歷史檔案並更新日誌行——記錄新進展、狀態變更、風險重新評估、截止期限移轉及和解權變更。當使用者欲記錄案件更新、註明進展或記錄組合狀態變更時使用。

subTools.name: Matter Workspace
subTools.description: Manage matter workspaces for multi-client practices — create, list, switch, close, or detach the active matter. Use when the user wants to create a new matter workspace, switch the active matter, list matters, archive a matter, or work at practice-level only without an active matter.
subTools.description_zh: 管理多客戶實務的案件工作區——建立、列出、切換、關閉或分離目前案件。當使用者要建立新案件工作區、切換活動案件、列出案件、封存案件，或僅在實務層級操作而無需活動案件時使用。

subTools.name: Oc Status
subTools.description: Generate weekly status-request email drafts to outside counsel across the active portfolio — markdown per matter, plus Gmail drafts when the MCP is available. Use when the user asks for OC status requests, weekly outside counsel check-ins, or wants per-matter status emails drafted from the portfolio log.
subTools.description_zh: 針對活躍組合產生每周外部律師狀態請求郵件草稿——每案以 markdown 呈現，MCP 可用時另加 Gmail 草稿。當使用者要求外部律師狀態請求、每周外聘律師確認，或希望從組合日誌撰寫各案件狀態郵件時使用。

subTools.name: Portfolio Status
subTools.description: Roll up the portfolio from _log.yaml — risk distribution, upcoming deadlines, stale matters, materiality totals, stage distribution, and flagged anomalies. Use when the user asks "where do we stand", "how many open matters", or wants a portfolio rollup or status across all active matters.
subTools.description_zh: 從 _log.yaml 彙整組合——風險分佈、即將到來的期限、滯留案件、重要性總額、階段分佈及標記異常。當使用者詢問「我們現況如何」、「有多少開放案件」，或需要所有活動案件的組合概覽與狀態時使用。

subTools.name: Privilege Log Review
subTools.description: First-pass privilege log review — make the obvious privilege calls and flag the hard ones for attorney review without making close calls. Use when the user says "review the privilege log", "priv log", "check privilege on these docs", or has a log to QA before production.
subTools.description_zh: 進行特權日誌初步審查——作出明顯的特權判斷，並將困難案例標記供律師審查，不輕易做出模糊結論。當使用者表示要「審查特權日誌」、「檢查特權」或需在交付前進行 QA 時使用。

subTools.name: Subpoena Triage
subTools.description: Triage a subpoena served on the company — classify it, analyze scope/burden/privilege, cross-check the portfolio, and produce an objections framework, compliance plan, and deadline calendar. Use when the user says "we got a subpoena", "served with a subpoena", or shares a subpoena, CID, or third-party document request to evaluate.
subTools.description_zh: 對公司收到的傳票進行分流——分類、分析範圍／負擔／特權、交叉比對組合，並產出異議框架、合規計畫與期限日曆。當使用者表示「收到傳票」、「被傳票告知」或分享傳票、CID、第三方文件請求以供評估時使用。

subTools.name: Cold Start Interview
subTools.description: Cold-start interview — builds your watchlist, indexes the policy library, and learns your materiality threshold so the monitor surfaces signal instead of noise. Use on fresh install, when reconfiguring (--redo), or when re-checking what connectors are actually responding (--check-integrations).
subTools.description_zh: 冷啟動訪談 — 建立監控清單、索引政策庫，並學習重要性閾值，讓監控系統聚焦重點而非雜訊。用於全新安裝、重新配置 (--redo) 或檢查連接器是否實際回應 (--check-integrations)。

subTools.name: Comments
subTools.description: Review open NPRM comment periods, log decisions, track deadlines. Use when an NPRM has a comment window open and you need to surface deadlines, decide whether to file, or record a filing / not-filing / waived decision (--decide CMT-ID).
subTools.description_zh: 檢視開放 NPRM 評論期程、記錄決策、追蹤期限。當 NPRM 評論窗口開放且需掌握期限、決定是否提交，或記錄提交／不提交／豁免決策 (--decide CMT-ID) 時使用。

subTools.name: Gaps
subTools.description: Open gaps tracker — what's flagged and not yet closed. Use when the user asks "what gaps are open", "gap tracker", "remediation status", or wants to close (--close GAP-ID) or risk-accept (--accept GAP-ID) a tracked gap.
subTools.description_zh: 開啟差距追蹤器 — 顯示已標記但尚未關閉的項目。當使用者詢問「哪些差距未關閉」、「差距追蹤器」、「補救狀態」，或要關閉 (--close GAP-ID) 或風險接受 (--accept GAP-ID) 某個被追蹤的差距時使用。

subTools.name: Matter Workspace
subTools.description: Manage matter workspaces — create, list, switch, close, or detach the active matter (practice-level). Use when working across multiple clients or matters and you need to keep one engagement's context separate from another, or when a substantive skill needs to know which matter it's working in.
subTools.description_zh: 管理案件工作區 — 建立、列出、切換、關閉或解除附加執行中的案件（實務層級）。當在多個客戶或案件之間工作，需要將一個客戶參與的上下文與其他案件區隔開時使用；或在實質技能需要知道其所屬案件時使用。

subTools.name: Policy Diff
subTools.description: Diff a specific regulatory change against the indexed policy library. Use when a reg has changed and you need to know which policies it touches and what the gap is, when the user says "diff this reg against our policies", "which policy does this affect", or "gap analysis", or when reg-feed-watcher hands off a material item.
subTools.description_zh: 將特定監管變更與索引政策庫進行差異比對。當監管規則變動，需確認影響哪些政策及其差距時使用。適用於使用者說「比對這項監管對我們政策的影響」、「哪個政策會受影響」、「差距分析」，或 reg-feed-watcher 移交重要項目時。

subTools.name: Policy Redraft
subTools.description: Produce a proposed marked-up policy redraft that closes a gap found by /regulatory-legal:gaps or /regulatory-legal:policy-diff. A first draft for internal review — not for direct application to approved policy documents. Use when the user says "redraft the policy", "draft the policy fix", "mark up the policy", or when gap-surfacer hands off a gap for drafting.
subTools.description_zh: 產出標註建議的政策重擬稿，以填補 /regulatory-legal:gaps 或 /regulatory-legal:policy-diff 發現的差距。供內部審查用的初稿，不得直接套用至已核准政策文件。適用於使用者說「重擬政策」、「起草政策修正」、「標註政策」，或 gap-surfacer 移交差距需求撰寫時。

subTools.name: Reg Feed Watcher
subTools.description: Check regulatory feeds now and report what's new since the last check, filtered by your materiality threshold. Use when the user says "check the feeds", "what's new", "regulatory update", when running from the scheduled agent, or when manually pasting a regulatory development for classification and diff.

不適合 30 天以上的歷史分析。
進行深度學術文獻回顧或專有資料庫查詢時，請避免使用。

negativeConstraints_zh: 若使用者為非技術背景且需要 PowerPoint 等複雜圖形設計工具，請避免使用。
若嚴格要求專屬離線檔案格式且不需轉換，則不宜使用。
對於預錄影片製作流程來說，並非理想選擇。

tools.name: Skills (Baoyu Creative)
tools.description: Reusable AI agent skill templates for Claude, Codex, and OpenClaw coding assistants.
triggers: 設計可重用 AI 提示詞
制作 coding assistant 配方
輸出 agent 行為指令
調整 AI 助手工作流

subTools.name: Release Skills
subTools.description: Universal release workflow. Auto-detects version files and changelogs. Supports Node.js, Python, Rust, Claude Plugin, GitHub Releases, annotated tags, historical release backfill, and generic projects. Use when user says "release", "發布", "new version", "bump version", "push", "推送", "release notes", "GitHub Release", or "回填 Release".
subTools.description_zh: 通用版本發布流程。自動偵測版本檔案與變更日誌。支援 Node.js、Python、Rust、Claude Plugin、GitHub Releases、註解式標籤、歷史版本回填及通用專案。當使用者提到「release」、「發布」、「new version」、「bump version」、「push」、「推送」、「release notes」、「GitHub Release」或「回填 Release」時使用。

subTools.name: Baoyu Article Illustrator
subTools.description: Analyzes article structure, identifies positions requiring visual aids, generates illustrations with Type × Style × Palette three-dimension approach. Use when user asks to "illustrate article", "add images", "generate images for article", or "為文章配圖".
subTools.description_zh: 分析文章結構，識別需要視覺輔助的位置，以類型×風格×配色維度生成插圖。當使用者要求「配圖文章」、「新增圖片」、「為文章生成圖片」或「為文章配圖」時使用。

subTools.name: Baoyu Comic
subTools.description: Knowledge comic creator supporting multiple art styles and tones. Creates original educational comics with detailed panel layouts and batch-capable image generation. Use when user asks to create "知識漫畫", "教育漫畫", "biography comic", "tutorial comic", or "Logicomix-style comic".
subTools.description_zh: 知識漫畫創作工具，支援多種藝術風格與語氣。可建立原創教育漫畫，具備詳細版面配置與批次影像生成能力。當使用者要求建立「知識漫畫」、「教育漫畫」、「傳記漫畫」、「教學漫畫」或「邏輯漫畫風格」時使用。

subTools.name: Baoyu Compress Image
subTools.description: Compresses images to WebP (default) or PNG with automatic tool selection. Use when user asks to "compress image", "optimize image", "convert to webp", or reduce image file size.
subTools.description_zh: 自動選取工具將圖片壓縮為 WebP（預設）或 PNG 格式。當使用者要求「壓縮圖片」、「最佳化圖片」、「轉換為 WebP」或減少圖片檔案大小時使用。

subTools.name: Baoyu Cover Image
subTools.description: Generates article cover images with 5 dimensions (type, palette, rendering, text, mood) combining 11 color palettes and 7 rendering styles. Supports cinematic (2.35:1), widescreen (16:9), and square (1:1) aspects. Use when user asks to "generate cover image", "create article cover", or "make cover".
subTools.name_zh: Baoyu Cover Image（寶玉封面圖片）
subTools.description_zh: 根據5個參數（類型、色調、繪圖風格、文字、氛圍）生成文章封面圖片，提供11種色調搭配與7種繪圖風格。支援電影寬幅（2.35:1）、寬螢幕（16:9）與正方形（1:1）比例。當使用者要求「生成封面圖片」、「建立文章封面」或「製作封面」時使用。

subTools.name: Baoyu Danger Gemini Web
subTools.description: Generates images and text via reverse-engineered Gemini Web API. Supports text generation, image generation from prompts, reference images for vision input, and multi-turn conversations. Use when other skills need image generation backend, or when user requests "generate image with Gemini", "Gemini text generation", or needs vision-capable AI generation.
subTools.name_zh: Baoyu Danger Gemini Web（寶玉危險 Gemini 網頁）
subTools.description_zh: 透過逆向工程 Gemini Web API 生成圖片與文字。支援文字生成、從提示詞生成圖片、以參考圖片作為視覺輸入，以及多輪對話。當其他技能需要圖片生成後端，或使用者要求「用 Gemini 生成圖片」、「Gemini 文字生成」，或需要具備視覺能力的 AI 生成時使用。

subTools.name: Baoyu Danger X To Markdown
subTools.description: Converts X (Twitter) tweets and articles to markdown with YAML front matter. Uses reverse-engineered API requiring user consent. Use when user mentions "X to markdown", "tweet to markdown", "save tweet", or provides x.com/twitter.com URLs for conversion.
subTools.description_zh: 將 X（Twitter）貼文與文章轉換為附有 YAML front matter 的 Markdown。使用逆向工程 API，需取得使用者同意。當使用者提及「X 轉 Markdown」、「貼文轉 Markdown」、「儲存貼文」，或提供 x.com/twitter.com 網址要求轉換時使用。

subTools.name: Baoyu Diagram
subTools.description: Create professional, dark-themed SVG diagrams of any type — architecture diagrams, flowcharts, sequence diagrams, structural diagrams, mind maps, timelines, illustrative/conceptual diagrams, and more. Use this skill whenever the user asks for any kind of technical or conceptual diagram, visualization of a system, process flow, data flow, component relationship, network topology, decision tree, org chart, state machine, or any visual representation of structure/logic/process. Also trigger when the user says "畫個圖" "畫一個架構圖" "diagram" "flowchart" "sequence diagram" "draw me a ..." or uploads content and asks to visualize it. Output is always a standalone .svg file.
subTools.description_zh: 建立專業深色主題 SVG 圖表，涵蓋各類架構圖、流程圖、序列圖、結構圖、心智圖、時間線、概念圖等。當使用者要求任何技術或概念性圖表、系統視覺化、流程/資料流、元件關係、網路拓撲、決策樹或組織圖時使用。

subTools.name: Baoyu Electron Extract
subTools.description: Extracts resources and JavaScript from any installed Electron app (`.asar` bundle), restoring original sources from `.js.map` files when available or formatting minified code with Prettier otherwise. Use when user wants to "extract Electron app", "decompile Electron", "get the source code of <app>", "inspect app.asar", "看 Electron 應用源碼", "提取 .asar", or asks how a desktop Electron app is built. Skips `node_modules` and supports both macOS and Windows.
subTools.description_zh: 從已安裝的 Electron 應用程式（`.asar` 套件）擷取資源與 JavaScript，優先從 `.js.map` 檔案還原原始來源，否則以 Prettier 格式化壓縮程式碼。當使用者要求「提取 Electron 應用程式」「反編譯 Electron」「取得 <app> 原始碼」「檢查 app.asar」「查看 Electron 應用源碼」或詢問桌面 Electron 應用程式如何建構時使用。

subTools.name: Baoyu Format Markdown
subTools.description: Formats plain text or markdown files with frontmatter, titles, summaries, headings, bold, lists, and code blocks. Use when user asks to "format markdown", "beautify article", "add formatting", or improve article layout. Outputs to {filename}-formatted.md.
subTools.description_zh: 格式化含 frontmatter、標題、摘要、標題層級、粗體、清單與程式碼區塊的純文字或 Markdown 檔案。當使用者要求「格式化 Markdown」「美化文章」「加入格式」或改善文章版面時使用，輸出至 {filename}-formatted.md。

subTools.name: Baoyu Image Gen
subTools.description: AI image generation with OpenAI GPT Image 2, Azure OpenAI, Google, OpenRouter, DashScope, Z.AI GLM-Image, MiniMax, Jimeng, Seedream, Replicate and Agnes APIs. Supports text-to-image, reference images, aspect ratios, and batch generation from saved prompt files. Sequential by default; use batch parallel generation when the user already has multiple prompts or wants stable multi-image throughput. Use when user asks to generate, create, or draw images.
subTools.description_zh: AI 圖片生成，支援 OpenAI GPT Image 2、Azure OpenAI、Google、OpenRouter、DashScope、Z.AI GLM-Image、MiniMax、Jimeng、Seedream、Replicate 與 Agnes API。支援文字轉圖片、參考圖片、比例調整，以及從已儲存提示檔案批次產生。預設依序執行；當使用者已有多個提示或希望穩定並行產生多張圖片時，使用批次並行模式。

subTools.name: Baoyu Infographic
subTools.description: Generate professional infographics with 21 layout types and 22 visual styles. Analyzes content, recommends layout×style combinations, and generates publication-ready infographics. Use when user asks to create "infographic", "信息圖", "visual summary", "可視化", or "高密度信息大圖".
subTools.description_zh: 產生專業資訊圖表，提供 21 種版面配置與 22 種視覺風格。分析內容後推薦版面×風格組合，輸出可直接發布的資訊圖表。當使用者要求建立「infographic」「資訊圖」「視覺摘要」「可視化」或「高密度資訊大圖」時使用。

subTools.name: Baoyu Markdown To Html
subTools.description: Converts Markdown to styled HTML with WeChat-compatible themes. Supports code highlighting, math, Mermaid (rendered to PNG via headless Chrome), PlantUML, footnotes, alerts, infographics, and optional bottom citations for external links. Use when user asks for "markdown to html", "convert md to html", "md 轉 html", "微信外鏈轉底部引用", or needs styled HTML output from markdown.
subTools.description_zh: 將 Markdown 轉換為含樣式的 HTML，支援微信相容主題、程式碼高亮、數學公式、Mermaid（經無頭 Chrome 渲染為 PNG）、PlantUML、腳註、警示、資訊圖表，以及外部連結底部引用。當使用者要求「Markdown 轉 HTML」「md 轉 html」「微信外鏈轉底部引用」或需要帶樣式的 HTML 輸出時使用。

subTools.name: Baoyu Post To Wechat
subTools.description: Posts content to WeChat Official Account (微信公眾號) via API or Chrome CDP. Supports article posting (文章) with HTML, markdown, or plain text input, and image-text posting (貼圖, formerly 圖文) with multiple images. Markdown article workflows default to converting ordinary external links into bottom citations for WeChat-friendly output. Use when user mentions "發布公眾號", "post to wechat", "微信公眾號", or "貼圖/圖文/文章".
subTools.description_zh: 透過 API 或 Chrome CDP 發布內容至微信公眾號。支援以 HTML、Markdown 或純文字發布文章，以及含多張圖片的貼圖（原名圖文）。Markdown 文章預設將一般外部連結轉為底部引用，以符合微信排版習慣。當使用者要求「發布公眾號」「post to wechat」「微信公眾號」或「貼圖/圖文」時使用。

subTools.name: Baoyu Post To Weibo
subTools.description: Posts content to Weibo (微博). Supports regular posts with text, images, and videos, and headline articles (頭條文章) with Markdown input via Chrome CDP. Use when user asks to "post to Weibo", "發微博", "發布微博", "publish to Weibo", "share on Weibo", "寫微博", or "微博頭條文章".
subTools.description_zh: 發布內容至微博，支援含文字、圖片與影片的普通文章，以及透過 Chrome CDP 以 Markdown 輸入的頭條文章。當使用者要求「發微博」「發布微博」「publish to Weibo」「share on Weibo」「寫微博」或「微博頭條文章」時使用。

subTools.name: Baoyu Post To X
subTools.description: Posts content and articles to X (Twitter). Supports regular posts with images/videos and X Articles (long-form Markdown). In Codex, honor explicit requests for the Codex Chrome plugin/@chrome by using the Chrome Extension workflow; otherwise use Chrome Computer Use when available and fall back to real Chrome CDP scripts only when allowed. Use when user asks to "post to X", "tweet", "publish to Twitter", or "share on X".
subTools.description_zh: 發布內容與文章至 X（Twitter），支援含圖片與影片的普通文章及 X Articles（長篇 Markdown）。在 Codex 環境中，若使用者明確要求使用 Codex Chrome 插件/@chrome，則採用 Chrome Extension 工作流程；否則優先使用 Chrome Computer Use，若不可用且在允許範圍內才回退至真實 Chrome CDP 腳本。

subTools.name: Baoyu Slide Deck
subTools.description: Generates professional slide deck images from content. Creates outlines with style instructions, then generates individual slide images. Use when user asks to "create slides", "make a presentation", "generate deck", "slide deck", or "PPT".
subTools.description_zh: 根據內容產生專業投影片簡報圖片。先建立大綱與風格指示，再逐頁產生簡報圖片。當使用者要求「製作簡報」「產生投影片」「PPT」等需求時使用。

subTools.name: Baoyu Url To Markdown
subTools.description: Fetch any URL and convert to markdown using baoyu-fetch CLI (Chrome CDP with site-specific adapters). Built-in adapters for X/Twitter, YouTube transcripts, Hacker News threads, and generic pages via Defuddle. Handles login/CAPTCHA via interaction wait modes. Use when user wants to save a webpage as markdown.
subTools.description_zh: 使用 baoyu-fetch CLI（Chrome CDP 搭配各網站專用適配器）抓取任意網址並轉換為 Markdown。內建 X/Twitter、YouTube 講稿、Hacker News 討論串及通用網頁的適配器。當使用者想將網頁儲存為 Markdown 時使用。

subTools.name: Baoyu Wechat Summary
subTools.description: Summarizes WeChat group chat highlights into a structured digest using the local wx-cli binary (https://github.com/jackwener/wx-cli). Generates a normal digest by default; a roast (毒舌) version is opt-in. Maintains per-group history (history.json + history-digests.jsonl), per-user profiles, and per-group fact memory (memory.md) across runs, with privacy guardrails baked in. Use when the user asks to "總結群聊", "群聊精華", "群聊摘要", "summarize group chat", "group chat digest", mentions a WeChat group name with a time range, says "幫我看看 XX 群最近聊了什麼", "XX 群有什麼值得看的", or asks to "回溯畫像" / "初始化畫像" / "backfill profiles". Adds the roast version when the user says "毒舌版", "roast 版", "再來個毒舌的", or similar.
subTools.description_zh: 透過本地 wx-cli 工具將微信群組聊天重點整理成結構化摘要。預設產生一般摘要，可選開啟毒舌版本。保留群組歷史紀錄、個人檔案與群組記憶。當使用者要求整理微信群組內容時使用。

subTools.name: Baoyu Xhs Images
subTools.description: Generates infographic image card series with 12 visual styles, 8 layouts, and 3 color palettes. Breaks content into 1-10 cartoon-style image cards optimized for social media engagement. Use when user mentions "小紅書圖片", "小紅書種草", "小綠書", "微信圖文", "微信貼圖", "image cards", "圖片卡片", baoyu-xhs-images, or wants social media infographic series.
subTools.description_zh: 產生資訊圖卡片系列，提供 12 種視覺風格、8 種版面與 3 種配色。將內容拆分為 1～10 張卡通風格卡片，優化社群互動效果。當使用者提到「小紅書圖片」「小紅書種草」「微信圖文」或想製作資訊圖文系列時使用。

subTools.name: Baoyu Youtube Transcript
subTools.description: Downloads YouTube video transcripts/subtitles and cover images by URL or video ID. Supports multiple languages, translation, chapters, and speaker identification. Caches raw data for fast re-formatting. Use when user asks to "get YouTube transcript", "download subtitles", "get captions", "YouTube字幕", "YouTube封面", "視頻封面", "video thumbnail", "video cover image", or provides a YouTube URL and wants the transcript/subtitle text or cover image extracted.
subTools.description_zh: 依網址或影片 ID 下載 YouTube 影片講稿、字幕與封面圖。支援多語言、翻譯、章節與說話者識別，並快取原始資料以利快速重新格式化。當使用者要求取得 YouTube 講稿、下載字幕或提供 YouTube 網址時使用。

tools.useCase: Standardizing AI coding agent behavior across projects by providing modular, reusable skill definitions for repetitive development tasks.
advantages: Provides consistent, reusable skill definitions across multiple AI coding assistants
Supports multi-agent compatibility for Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw
Enables modular task automation through structured prompt templates
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for direct code editing or IDE functionality without an AI agent
Avoid when requiring vendor-specific prompt formats outside the supported agent ecosystem
Not designed for non-AI-assisted manual development workflows
tools.description_zh: 可複用的 AI 代理技能模板，適用於 Claude、Codex 與 OpenClaw 編碼助理。
tools.useCase_zh: 透過提供模組化、可複用的技能定義，在專案中標準化 AI 編碼代理行為。
tools.advantages_zh: 在多款 AI 編碼助理間提供一致且可複用的技能定義；支援 Claude Code、Codex、OpenClaw 等多代理相容；透過結構化提示模板實現模組化任務自動化
negativeConstraints_zh: 若未搭配 AI 代理程式，則不適合直接編輯程式碼或使用 IDE 功能。
若需要該工具生態系統以外、特定廠商專屬的提示詞格式，請避免使用。
並非為無需 AI 輔助的純手動開發流程所設計。

tools.name: Autoresearch
tools.description: Automated research agent for single-GPU nanochat training and experimentation.
tools.useCase: Ideal for researchers wanting to autonomously iterate on small language model architectures and training strategies using limited hardware.
advantages: Fully autonomous research loop reduces manual effort in reading papers and implementing experiments.
Optimized for single-GPU setups, making advanced experimentation accessible without large clusters.
Accelerates the discovery of effective training techniques through rapid automated iteration.
negativeConstraints: Do not use for training massive foundation models requiring multi-node distributed computing.
Avoid for production-grade software deployment as it is designed for research and experimentation.
Not suitable if you require strict human-in-the-loop control over every step of the experiment.
tools.description_zh: 單 GPU nanochat 訓練與實驗的自動化研究代理工具。
tools.useCase_zh: 適合希望在有限硬體上自主迭代小型語言模型架構與訓練策略的研究者使用。
tools.advantages_zh:
完全自主的研究循環減少閱讀論文與實作實驗的manual effort。
最佳化單 GPU 環境，讓進階實驗無需大型叢集即可進行。
透過快速自動化迭代加速有效訓練技術的發現。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不需要用於依賴多節點分散式運算訓練大型基礎模型的場景。
若用於生產環境軟體部署，請避免使用，因其設計目的為研究與實驗。
若要求對實驗的每個步驟進行嚴格的人工介入控制，則不適合使用。

tools.name: Llm Council
tools.description: Multi-model LLM debate system that collaboratively solves complex questions using diverse AI agents.
triggers: 交叉檢視 AI 答案
請多個 AI 共同解答
AI 互相辯論得出結論
讓 AI 辯論後共識
tools.useCase: Use this tool to resolve complex analytical or coding questions by having multiple AI models critique and refine each other's responses.
advantages: Combines strengths of different LLM providers for more robust reasoning.
Reduces hallucinations and bias through iterative peer review and consensus.
Delivers higher quality answers for ambiguous or difficult prompts than single-model inference.
negativeConstraints: Avoid for simple factual queries where a single model or search engine suffices.
Not suitable for low-latency real-time applications due to multi-step processing.
Higher API costs make it inefficient for high-volume, repetitive tasks.
tools.description_zh: 多模型 LLM 辯論系統，透過多樣化 AI 代理協作解決複雜問題。
tools.useCase_zh: 使用此工具讓多個 AI 模型相互批判與精進回應，以解決複雜的分析或程式設計問題。
tools.advantages_zh:
結合不同 LLM 供應商的優勢，提升推理的穩健性。
透過迭代式同行審查與共識機制減少幻覺與偏差。
對模糊或困難的提示提供比單模型推論更高的回答品質。
negativeConstraints_zh: 若為簡單的 factual 查詢且單一模型或搜尋引擎即可滿足，請避免使用。
因需經過多步驟處理，不適合低延遲的即時應用場景。
較高的 API 成本使其在高流量、重複性任務中效益不佳。

tools.name: Reader3
tools.description: Read books interactively with LLMs using retrieval-augmented generation.
tools.useCase: Query specific details or summarize chapters within large PDF books using natural language.
advantages: Enables interactive question-answering over long books.
Utilizes retrieval-augmented generation for accurate context.
Streamlines reading large PDFs through natural language queries.
negativeConstraints: Do not use for generating creative fiction or non-document tasks.
Avoid for extremely short texts where full-context reading is faster than retrieval.
Not suitable for real-time conversational agents without document input.
tools.description_zh: 使用 RAG 與 LLM 互動式閱讀書籍。
tools.useCase_zh: 以自然語言查詢大型 PDF 書籍中的特定細節或總結章節。
tools.advantages_zh:
支援對長篇書籍進行互動式問答。
利用檢索增強生成（RAG）取得準確上下文。
透過自然語言查詢簡化大型 PDF 的閱讀流程。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不應用於創作虛構文學或非文件相關任務。
極短文字若全文閱讀比檢索更快，請避免使用。
不適合沒有文件輸入的即時對話代理程式。

tools.name: Awesome Auto Research Tools
tools.description: Curated AI tools for literature search, paper reading, experiments, and code generation.
tools.useCase: Researchers can quickly discover and integrate automated tools to streamline their academic workflow from literature review to coding.
advantages: Covers the full research lifecycle including literature search, paper analysis, and experiment management
Provides a curated selection of high-quality automated tools
Helps researchers significantly accelerate their academic workflow
negativeConstraints: Do not use this as a standalone software application for direct task execution
Not suitable for non-academic or general productivity needs
Does not provide direct access or installation to the listed tools
tools.description_zh: 精選 AI 工具，涵蓋文獻搜尋、論文閱讀、實驗與程式碼生成。
tools.useCase_zh: 研究者能快速發現並整合自動化工具，從文獻回顧到編碼 streamlined academic workflow。
tools.advantages_zh:
涵蓋完整研究生命周期，包括文獻搜尋、論文分析與實驗管理。
提供精選的高品質自動化工具集合。

tools.useCase: Enhancing AI coding assistants with MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF aligned security prompts.
advantages: Comprehensive coverage of 29 security domains across 6 industry frameworks.
Seamless integration with popular AI coding platforms like Claude Code and Cursor.
Open-source Apache 2.0 license ensures broad accessibility.
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for real-time network traffic analysis or packet inspection.
Ineffective for legacy systems lacking modern API or CLI support.
Does not replace dedicated vulnerability scanning or penetration testing tools.
tools.description_zh: 針對 AI 代理的結構化網路安全技能，對齊至主要框架。
tools.useCase_zh: 透過 MITRE ATT&CK 和 NIST CSF 對齊的安全提示，增強 AI 編碼助手。

negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合用於即時網路流量分析或封包檢查。
對於缺乏現代 API 或 CLI 支援的傳統系統無效。
無法取代專用的漏洞掃描或滲透測試工具。

tools.useCase: Enhancing code security by integrating automated vulnerability detection and secure coding practices into the development workflow.
advantages: Integrates seamlessly with popular AI coding assistants.
Provides specialized cybersecurity knowledge for code generation.
Helps identify and mitigate common security vulnerabilities early.
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for general-purpose non-technical tasks.
Does not replace comprehensive manual security audits.
Ineffective for legacy systems without modern tooling support.
tools.description_zh: 用於 AI 編碼代理（如 Claude Code、Cursor 和 Codex）的網路安全技能。
tools.useCase_zh: 將自動漏洞檢測與安全編碼實踐整合至開發工作流程，以強化程式碼安全性。
tools.advantages_zh: 與受歡迎的 AI 編碼助手無縫整合。提供程式碼生成的專業網路安全知識。幫助早期識別並緩解常見安全漏洞。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合用於一般用途的非技術性任務。
無法取代全面的手動安全審計。
對於沒有現代化工具支援的傳統系統無效。

tools.name: Skills (Emil Design Eng)
tools.description: Curated skills for Design Engineers to enhance productivity and workflow efficiency.

subTools.name: Animation Vocabulary
subTools.description: Reverse-lookup glossary that turns a vague description of a web animation or motion effect into its exact term ("the bouncy thing when a popover opens" → Pop in; "the iOS rubber-band scroll" → Rubber-banding). Use when the user asks "what's it called when…", or describes a motion effect without knowing its name and wants the right word to prompt an AI or designer with. For naming an effect, not designing or building one.
subTools.description_zh: 反查詞彙表，將模糊的網頁動畫或動態效果描述轉換為精確術語（例如「彈跳式 popover 出現效果」→ Pop in）。用於使用者詢問「某種效果叫什麼名字？」或想精確描述動態效果時。

subTools.name: Apple Design
subTools.description: Apple's approach to interface design and fluid, physical motion, translated for the web. Use when building or reviewing gesture-driven UI, spring animations, drag/swipe/sheet interactions, momentum and interruptible transitions, translucent materials and depth, typography (optical sizing, tracking, leading), reduced-motion, or the design foundations (feedback, spatial consistency, restraint) behind Apple-style interfaces.
subTools.description_zh: 將 Apple 的介面設計與流暢物理動態轉譯至網頁環境。用於構建或審查手勢驅動 UI、彈簧動畫、拖曳／滑動／面板互動、慣性與可中斷轉場、半透明材質與深度、排版（光學分級、字距、行高）、減少動態偏好，或背後的設計基礎原則。

subTools.name: Emil Design Eng
subTools.description: This skill encodes Emil Kowalski's philosophy on UI polish, component design, animation decisions, and the invisible details that make software feel great.
subTools.description_zh: 收錄 Emil Kowalski 關於 UI 打磨、元件設計、動畫決策，以及讓軟體感覺出色的隱形細節之設計哲學。

subTools.name: Find Animation Opportunities
subTools.description: Search a codebase or UI for places that don't animate but should, and reject everything that shouldn't. Read-only; it proposes motion with exact values, it does not implement it. Use when the user asks "what could be animated here?" or wants to "make this feel more alive". For fixing existing animations, use improve-animations or review-animations instead.
subTools.description_zh: 掃描程式碼庫或 UI，找出適合加入動畫卻尚未動畫的區塊，並過濾不適合的項目。唯讀模式，會提出具體數值的動態方案，但不執行實作。用於使用者詢問「這裡有什麼可以加動畫？」或「讓界面更有生機」。

subTools.name: Improve Animations
subTools.description: Survey a codebase's animation and motion code as a senior motion advisor, then produce a prioritized audit and self-contained implementation plans for other agents (or cheaper models) to execute. Read-only on source code — it plans improvements, it does not apply them. Use when the user asks to "improve the animations", "audit the motion", "make this app feel better", or wants a roadmap of animation fixes rather than a review of a single diff.
subTools.description_zh: 以資深動態顧問視角檢視程式碼庫中的動畫與動效程式碼，產出優先順序審計報告，並為其他代理或較平價模型提供獨立實作計畫。對原始碼為唯讀，僅規劃改善而不直接套用。用於使用者要求「改善動畫」「審計動效」或「讓應用感覺更好」。

subTools.name: Pick Ui Library
subTools.description: Pick the right library for a given frontend task from a curated, opinionated list — numbers, OTP inputs, charts, command menus, virtualization, drag and drop, toasts, state, styling, and more. Only runs when explicitly invoked; it does not trigger on its own.
subTools.description_zh: 從精心策劃且具立場的清單中，為指定的前端任務挑選最合適的函式庫——涵蓋數字輸入、OTP、圖表、指令選單、虛擬化、拖曳、快顯通知、狀態管理、樣式等。僅在明確呼叫時執行，不會自行觸發。

subTools.name: Review Animations
subTools.description: Reviews animation and motion code against a high craft bar derived from Emil Kowalski's design engineering philosophy. Default to flagging; approval is earned.
subTools.description_zh: 以源自 Emil Kowalski 設計工程哲學的高標準，檢視動畫與動效程式碼。預設採取挑毛病態度，合格需要憑實力爭取。

tools.advantages_zh: 自動以 AI 視覺內容建立投影片，,與 Codex 代理無縫整合，,減少手動設計工作量
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合文字密集的學術論文
需要網路連線才能進行 API 呼叫
僅限於基於圖片的版面配置

tools.name: Skills (MiniMax PPT)
tools.description: MiniMax AI skills repository for modular agent capabilities and functional extensions.

subTools.name: Color Font Skill
subTools.description: Choose presentation-ready color palettes and font pairings for PPT/design tasks. Use when users ask for visual theme choices, brand-safe palettes, or font recommendations. Triggers include: 配色, 色板, 字體, color palette, font, PPT配色, 字體搭配.
subTools.description_zh: 為 PPT/設計任務選擇適用於簡報的配色方案與字體搭配。當使用者詢問視覺主題、品牌安全配色或字體建議時使用。觸發條件包括：配色、色板、字體、color palette、font、PPT配色、字體搭配。

subTools.name: Ppt Editing Skill
subTools.description: Edit existing PowerPoint files or templates with XML-safe workflows. Use for template-based deck updates: analyze layouts, map content to slides, duplicate/reorder/delete slides safely, edit slide XML in parallel, clean orphaned assets, and repack validated PPTX output.
subTools.description_zh: 使用 XML 安全工作流程編輯現有的 PowerPoint 檔案或範本。適用於基於範本的簡報更新：分析版面配置、將內容對應至投影片、安全地複製／重新排序／刪除投影片、平行編輯投影片 XML、清除孤立資產，並重新打包驗證後的 PPTX 輸出。

subTools.name: Ppt Orchestra Skill
subTools.description: Plan and orchestrate multi-slide PowerPoint creation from scratch. Use before generating a full deck with subagents: classify each slide type, enforce visual variety, set typography/spacing rules, and run text-based QA to catch content issues.
subTools.description_zh: 從頭規劃並協調多頁 PowerPoint 的建立。在使用子代理生成完整簡報前應用：分類每頁投影片類型、確保視覺多樣性、設定字體與間距規則，並執行文字品質檢查以發現內容問題。

subTools.name: Slide Making Skill
subTools.description: Implement single-slide PowerPoint pages with PptxGenJS. Use when writing or fixing slide JS files: dimensions, positioning, text/image/chart APIs, styling rules, and export expectations for native .pptx output.
subTools.description_zh: 使用 PptxGenJS 實現單頁投影片。撰寫或修正投影片 JS 檔案時使用：尺寸、定位、文字／圖片／圖表 API、樣式規則，以及原生 .pptx 輸出的匯出預期。

subTools.name: Android Native Dev
subTools.description: Android native application development and UI design guide. Covers Material Design 3, Kotlin/Compose development, project configuration, accessibility, and build troubleshooting. Read this before Android native application development.
subTools.description_zh: Android 原生應用程式開發與 UI 設計指南。涵蓋 Material Design 3、Kotlin/Compose 開發、專案設定、無障礙功能與建置疑難排解。進行 Android 原生應用開發前請閱讀本指南。

subTools.name: Minimax Multimodal Toolkit
subTools.description: Use mmx to generate text, images, video, speech, and music via the MiniMax AI platform. Use when the user wants to create media content, chat with MiniMax models, perform web search, or manage MiniMax API resources from the terminal.
subTools.description_zh: 透過 MiniMax AI 平台使用 mmx 產生文字、圖片、影片、語音與音樂。當使用者想建立媒體內容、與 MiniMax 模型聊天、執行網頁搜尋或從終端機管理 MiniMax API 資源時使用。

subTools.name: Minimax Xlsx
subTools.description: Open, create, read, analyze, edit, or validate Excel/spreadsheet files (.xlsx, .xlsm, .csv, .tsv). Use when the user asks to create, build, modify, analyze, read, validate, or format any Excel spreadsheet, financial model, pivot table, or tabular data file. Covers: creating new xlsx from scratch, reading and analyzing existing files, editing existing xlsx with zero format loss, formula recalculation and validation, and applying professional financial formatting standards. Triggers on 'spreadsheet', 'Excel', '.xlsx', '.csv', 'pivot table', 'financial model', 'formula', or any request to produce tabular data in Excel format.
subTools.description_zh: 開啟、建立、讀取、分析、編輯或驗證 Excel/試算表檔案（.xlsx、.xlsm、.csv、.tsv）。當使用者要求建立、建置、修改、分析、讀取、驗證或格式化任何 Excel 試算表、財務模型、樞紐分析表或表格資料檔案時使用。涵蓋：從頭建立新 xlsx、讀取並分析現有檔案、以零格式損失編輯現有 xlsx、公式重新計算

subTools.name: Pptx Generator
subTools.description: Generate, edit, and read PowerPoint presentations. Create from scratch with PptxGenJS (cover, TOC, content, section divider, summary slides), edit existing PPTX via XML workflows, or extract text with markitdown. Triggers: PPT, PPTX, PowerPoint, presentation, slide, deck, slides.
subTools.description_zh: 生成、編輯與讀取 PowerPoint 簡報。使用 PptxGenJS 從頭建立（含封面、目錄、內容、分節分隔、摘要簡報），透過 XML 工作流程編輯現有 PPTX，或使用 markitdown 萃取文字。觸發詞：PPT、PPTX、PowerPoint、簡報、投影片、簡報集、投影片集

subTools.name: Shader Dev
subTools.description: Comprehensive GLSL shader techniques for creating stunning visual effects — ray marching, SDF modeling, fluid simulation, particle systems, procedural generation, lighting, post-processing, and more.
subTools.description_zh: GLSL Shader 技術大全：涵蓋光線追跡、SDF 建模、流體模擬、粒子系統、程序生成、燈光與後處理，打造震撼視覺效果。

tools.useCase: Integrating pre-built reasoning or tool-use modules into a custom MiniMax-based agent workflow.
advantages: Provides standardized, reusable skill components for rapid agent development.
Seamlessly integrates with the MiniMax AI ecosystem for consistent performance.
Reduces development time by offering ready-to-deploy functional blocks.
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for standalone applications requiring full-stack backend logic.
Inappropriate for tasks unrelated to AI agent skill expansion or modular enhancement.
Cannot be used directly without the MiniMax AI framework integration layer.
tools.description_zh: MiniMax AI 技能儲存庫，用於模組化代理能力與功能延伸。
tools.useCase_zh: 將預先建構的推理或工具使用模組整合至自訂 MiniMax 基礎的代理工作流程。
tools.advantages_zh: 提供標準化、可重複使用的技能元件，加速代理開發。,與 MiniMax AI 生態系無縫整合，確保穩定效能。,提供即插即用的功能模組，減少開發時間。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合需要完整後端邏輯的獨立應用程式。
不適合與 AI 代理程式技能擴展或模組增強無關的任務。
無法在沒有 MiniMax AI 框架整合層的情況下直接使用。

tools.name: Gstack
tools.description: Garry Tan's curated Claude Code setup with 23 opinionated tools for full-stack dev roles.
triggers: 安裝語意化程式碼工具組
tools.useCase: Accelerating solo startup development by automating engineering, design, and QA tasks via a unified CLI.
advantages: Provides specialized personas like CEO and Eng Manager to guide decision-making.
Integrates 23 distinct tools into a cohesive workflow for rapid prototyping.
Leverages Garry Tan's proven methodology for efficient AI-assisted coding.
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for large enterprise teams requiring strict role-based access controls.
Inappropriate for projects needing highly customized, non-opinionated toolchains.
Avoid if you prefer manual oversight over automated AI-driven workflows.
tools.description_zh: Garry Tan 精心策劃的 Claude Code 設定，內含 23 套為全端開發角色設計的專項工具。
tools.useCase_zh: 透過統一的 CLI 自動化工程、設計與 QA 任務，加速個人創業開發。
tools.advantages_zh: 提供 CEO 和工程主管等專業人設以引導決策。,將 23 種不同工具整合為連貫工作流程，加速原型開發。,運用 Garry Tan 驗證有效的方法，實現高效的 AI 輔助編程。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合需要嚴格角色基礎存取控制的企業團隊。
不適合需要高度客製化、無既定偏見的開發工具鏈的專案。
如果您偏好手動監督而非自動化的 AI 工作流程，請避免使用。

tools.name: Presentation Report Preflight
tools.description: Generates a Presentation Strategy Brief before creating PPTs or HTML decks.
tools.useCase: Preparing a structured presentation strategy brief for a quarterly business review before designing slides.
advantages: Ensures strategic alignment before visual design begins
Streamlines handoff between content planning and slide creation
Reduces rework by clarifying key messages early
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for generating actual slide content or visuals
Inappropriate for real-time presentation delivery support
Does not replace detailed slide deck design tools
tools.description_zh: 在建立簡報或 HTML 投影片之前，產生簡報策略簡介。
tools.useCase_zh: 在設計投影片前，為季度業務回顧準備結構化的簡報策略簡介。
tools.advantages_zh: 確保視覺設計開始前的策略一致性，簡化內容規劃與投影片建立之間的交接，透過提前釐清核心訊息減少返工。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合產生實際簡報內容或視覺效果
不適合即時簡報交付支援
無法取代詳細簡報設計工具

tools.name: Huashu Design
tools.description: HTML-native design skill for generating high-fidelity prototypes, slides, and animations.
tools.useCase: Creating interactive UI prototypes or animated presentations directly within a coding environment using HTML/CSS/JS.
advantages: Generates high-fidelity, interactive HTML/CSS/JS outputs instead of static images.
Supports MP4 export for easy sharing of animations and prototypes.
Agent-agnostic and integrates seamlessly with Claude Code workflows.
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for backend logic development or database management.
Inappropriate for generating native mobile app binaries (APK/IPA).
Does not replace dedicated graphic design software like Figma for vector asset creation.
tools.description_zh: 原生 HTML 設計技能，用於產生高擬真原型、簡報和動畫。
tools.useCase_zh: 在程式碼環境中直接使用 HTML/CSS/JS 建立互動式 UI 原型或動畫簡報。
tools.advantages_zh: 產生高擬真、互動式的 HTML/CSS/JS 輸出，而非靜態圖片。支援 MP4 匯出，方便分享動畫和原型。Agent 無關，可無縫整合至 Claude Code 工作流程。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合後端邏輯開發或資料庫管理。
不適合產生原生行動應用程式的二進位檔案（APK/IPA）。
無法取代 Figma 等專用圖形設計軟體來建立向量資產。

tools.name: Archify
tools.description: Generate beautiful architecture diagrams with theme toggle and multi-format export.
triggers: 匯出架構圖為 SVG 或 PNG
切換圖表深色與淺色主題
用程式碼繪製技術流程圖
將需求描述轉成架構示意圖
生成 UML 類圖與序列圖
輸出多格式技術白板圖
tools.useCase: Creating visual system overviews for technical documentation or stakeholder presentations.
advantages: Supports dark/light theme toggles for better readability in different contexts.
Offers multiple export formats including PNG, JPEG, WebP, and SVG.
Integrates seamlessly as a Claude skill for automated diagram generation.
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for generating non-architectural charts like bar graphs or pie charts.
Avoid for real-time collaborative editing sessions requiring instant multi-user sync.
Do not use for creating complex data visualizations requiring statistical analysis.
tools.description_zh: 使用主題切換和多格式匯出功能，產生精美的架構圖。
tools.useCase_zh: 為技術文件或利害關係人簡報建立視覺化系統概覽。
tools.advantages_zh: 提供深色/淺色主題切換，在不同情境下提升可讀性。支援多種匯出格式，包括 PNG、JPEG、WebP 和 SVG。可無縫整合為 Claude skill，實現自動化圖表產生。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合用於產生非架構性圖表，如長條圖或圓餅圖。
避免用於需要即時多使用者同步的協作編輯工作階段。
不適合用於需要統計分析的複雜資料視覺化創作。

tools.name: Claude Code Infrastructure Showcase
tools.description: Showcases Claude Code infrastructure with auto-activation, hooks, and agents.
triggers: 設定 Claude Code 自動啟動
配置 hooks 觸發腳本
寫 pre-commit 鉤子檢查程式碼
設定 Claude Code 工作流程
設定 Claude Code 條件式啟動
tools.useCase: Developers looking to implement advanced automation workflows in Claude Code using custom skills and hooks.
advantages: Demonstrates skill auto-activation for streamlined coding tasks.
Provides practical examples of hooks and agent integration.
Open-source reference for building complex Claude Code environments.
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for users seeking basic CLI command references without customization.
Inappropriate for projects requiring strict enterprise security compliance without review.
Not a standalone tool but a collection of configuration examples.
tools.description_zh: 展示 Claude Code 基礎設施，含自動啟用、鉤子和代理功能。
tools.useCase_zh: 開發者希望使用自訂技能和鉤子在 Claude Code 中實作進階自動化工作流程。
tools.advantages_zh: 展示技能的自動啟用功能，簡化編碼任務。提供鉤子和代理整合的實用範例。作為建構複雜 Claude Code 環境的開源參考。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合尋求基本 CLI 指令參考且無需客製化的使用者。
不適合需要嚴格企業資安防護合規且未經驗證的專案。
並非獨立工具，而是配置範例集合。

tools.name: Airllm
tools.description: Inference large LLMs on low-VRAM GPUs via CPU offloading.
triggers: 用低顯存 GPU 跑大語言模型
將模型參數卸載到 CPU 記憶體
在資源有限的設備上運行大型 LLM
不需要高階顯卡推理大模型
在 8GB 顯存的卡上跑 70B 模型
透過 CPU 離載技術進行大型生成式模型推理
低配電腦跑大語言模型
顯存不足時用記憶體換空間推理 LLM
用普通顯示卡跑大型 AI 模型
tools.useCase: Running 70B parameter models on consumer hardware with limited GPU memory.
advantages: Enables inference of massive models on GPUs with as little as 4GB VRAM
Automatic CPU offloading reduces hardware requirements significantly
Supports various quantization methods for optimized performance
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for high-throughput production serving requiring low latency
Inference speed is slower compared to full GPU-based deployment
Requires sufficient system RAM for model weights storage
tools.description_zh: 透過 CPU offloading，在低 VRAM 的 GPU 上執行大型 LLM 推論。
tools.useCase_zh: 在具備有限 GPU 記憶體的消費型硬體上執行 70B 參數模型。
tools.advantages_zh: 允許在僅有 4GB VRAM 的 GPU 上執行大型模型推論。自動 CPU offloading 大幅降低硬體需求。支援各種量化方法以優化效能。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合需要低延遲的高吞吐量生產環境部署。
推理速度較全 GPU 部署來得慢。
需要足夠的系統 RAM 用於存放模型權重。

tools.name: Ui Skills
tools.description: UI component library for Design Engineers to build consistent interfaces.
triggers: 整合設計與前端程式碼

subTools.name: Baseline Ui
subTools.description: Quickly deslop UI code by fixing spacing, hierarchy, typography, and small layout issues. Use when the interface needs a fast cleanup or polish pass.
subTools.description_zh: 透過修正間距、層級、排版和小型版面問題，快速改善 UI 程式碼。當介面需要快速清理或潤飾時使用。

subTools.name: Create Design Md
subTools.description: Create or update a DESIGN.md from an existing product repository or public website. Use when asked to document an interface's design language, reconstruct its visual system, extract design tokens and guidance from current evidence, or give coding agents persistent UI context. Do not modify product source or promote accidental implementation patterns into design decisions.
subTools.description_zh: 從既有產品程式庫或公開網站建立或更新 DESIGN.md。當被要求記錄介面設計語言、重建視覺系統、從現有證據萃取設計標記與指引，或提供持續 UI 上下文給編碼代理時使用。不要修改產品原始碼，或將偶然實現模式視為設計決策。

subTools.name: Fixing Accessibility
subTools.description: Audit and fix HTML accessibility issues including ARIA labels, keyboard navigation, focus management, color contrast, and form errors. Use when adding interactive controls, forms, dialogs, or reviewing WCAG compliance.
subTools.description_zh: 稽核並修復 HTML 無障礙問題，包含 ARIA 標籤、鍵盤導航、焦點管理、色彩對比與表單錯誤。新增互動控制項、表單、對話框或審查 WCAG 合規性時使用。

subTools.name: Fixing Motion Performance
subTools.description: Audit and fix animation performance issues including layout thrashing, compositor properties, scroll-linked motion, and blur effects. Use when animations stutter, transitions jank, or reviewing CSS/JS animation performance.
subTools.description_zh: 檢查並修正動畫效能問題，包括版面配置閃爍、合成器屬性、捲軸關聯動畫與模糊效果。當動畫卡頓、轉換不順暢，或審查 CSS/JS 動畫效能時使用。

subTools.name: Improve Ui
subTools.description: Audit an existing product surface against its own design evidence, identify verified UI problems, and write self-contained implementation plans for another agent. Strictly read-only on product source. Use when asked to review, refine, improve, or clean up an interface without replacing its identity; investigate design-system drift; or prepare a design handoff.
subTools.description_zh: 稽核現有產品介面的設計實證，找出已驗證的 UI 問題，並撰寫供其他智能體執行的完整實作計畫。僅限讀取產品原始碼。適用於審查、優化或清理介面而不替換其核心；調查設計系統偏移；或準備設計交接。

subTools.name: Ui Skills Root
subTools.description: Use before UI-related work to select the smallest useful UI Skills context through the ui-skills CLI.
subTools.description_zh: 進行 UI 相關工作前，透過 ui-skills CLI 選取最精簡有用的 UI Skills 上下文。

tools.useCase: Accelerating frontend development by providing pre-built, accessible UI components for design engineers.
advantages: Streamlines the creation of consistent user interfaces.
Tailored specifically for design engineers' workflows.
Open-source and easily integrable via GitHub.
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for backend logic implementation.
Inappropriate for mobile-native app development without adaptation.
Does not replace full-stack framework requirements.
tools.description_zh: 供設計工程師建構一致介面所需的 UI 元件程式庫。
tools.useCase_zh: 提供可重複使用且無障礙的 UI 元件，加速前端開發流程。
tools.advantages_zh: 簡化一致使用者介面的建立過程。專為設計工程師的工作流程量身打造。開源，可透過 GitHub 輕鬆整合。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合用於後端邏輯實作。
不適合未適應的手機原生應用程式開發。
無法取代完整前端框架需求。

tools.name: Ossie

triggers: 統一 AI 平台元資料格式
產生機器可讀的元資料
整合不同分析平台的元資料
tools.useCase: Enabling seamless data discovery and integration between disparate BI tools and AI models via a unified semantic layer.
advantages: Vendor-neutral standard ensuring interoperability across diverse data ecosystems
Provides a single source of truth for business definitions and metrics
Facilitates automated governance and consistent semantic interpretation
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for real-time transactional data processing or operational databases
Ineffective for storing raw binary assets like images or video files
Does not replace actual data storage systems but rather describes them
tools.description_zh: Apache OSSIE 標準化分析與 AI 平台間的語義中繼資料交換。
tools.useCase_zh: 透過統一的語義層，促進不同 BI 工具與 AI 模型間的資料探索與整合。
tools.advantages_zh: 供應商中立的標準，確保跨多元資料生態系的互操作性。為業務定義與指標提供單一真相來源。促進自動化治理與一致的語義解釋。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合用於即時交易式資料處理或操作型資料庫。
不適用於儲存原始二進位資產，如圖片或影片檔案。
無法取代實際資料儲存系統，僅供描述之用。

tools.name: Skill Creator

tools.useCase: Developers optimizing an AI agent's capability to handle specific tasks by refining skill definitions and measuring performance improvements.
advantages: Enables precise optimization of skill descriptions for better triggering accuracy.
Provides variance analysis to benchmark skill performance effectively.
Supports full lifecycle management from creation to evaluation.
negativeConstraints: Do not use for general code generation unrelated to agent skills.
Avoid using for direct user-facing customer support interactions.
Not suitable for creating non-agent related software libraries.
tools.description_zh: 建立、編輯並透過變異分析對 agent 技能進行基準測試。
tools.useCase_zh: 開發人員透過精進技能定義並衡量效能改進，優化 AI agent 處理特定任務的能力。
tools.advantages_zh: 支援對技能描述進行精確最佳化，以提升觸發準確率。提供變異分析以有效基準測試技能效能。支援從建立到評估的完整生命週期管理。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不應用於與代理技能無關的通用程式產生。
避免用於直接的用戶服務客服互動。
不適合用於建立與代理無關的軟體函式庫。

tools.name: WorkBuddyGuide
tools.description: Open-source guide for WorkBuddy workflows, Skills, MCP, and multi-agent automation.
tools.useCase: Developers seeking to master WorkBuddy through practical tutorials and real-world automation examples.
advantages: Provides structured, real-world workflow examples for complex tasks.
Covers advanced topics like MCP integration and multi-agent systems.
Open-source and community-driven for continuous updates.
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for users requiring proprietary or closed-source solutions.
May not provide immediate, out-of-the-box software installation without manual setup.
