tools.advantages_zh:
模組化架構便於增刪特定技能。
提供即時脈衝監控，追蹤代理健康狀態與效能。
透過標準化觸發條件，可無縫整合至現有代理框架。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合不需要模組化技能擴展的簡單單一任務腳本。
若低延遲直接執行比靈活的技能管理更重要，則避免使用。
請勿用於標準網頁爬蟲或資料處理管線等非代理應用程式。

tools.name: Tapestry Skills For Claude Code
tools.description: Claude Code skills for downloading articles, PDFs, and YouTube transcripts.

subTools.name: Article Extractor
subTools.description: Extract clean article content from URLs (blog posts, articles, tutorials) and save as readable text. Use when user wants to download, extract, or save an article/blog post from a URL without ads, navigation, or clutter.
subTools.description_zh: 從網址提取乾淨的文章內容（部落格文章、教學文等）並儲存為可讀文字。當使用者想要從網址下載、提取或儲存沒有廣告、導航欄或雜訊的文章/部落格文章時使用。

subTools.name: Learn This
subTools.description: Unified content extraction and action planning. Use when user says "learn-this <URL>", "learn this <URL>", "weave <URL>", "help me plan <URL>", "extract and plan <URL>", "make this actionable <URL>", or similar phrases indicating they want to extract content and create an action plan. Automatically detects content type (YouTube video, article, PDF) and processes accordingly.
subTools.description_zh: 整合內容提取與行動規劃。當使用者說「learn-this <URL>」、「learn this <URL>」、「weave <URL>」、「help me plan <URL>」、「extract and plan <URL>」、「make this actionable <URL>」或類似表示要提取內容並建立行動計畫的說法時使用。自動偵測內容類型（YouTube 影片、文章、PDF）並相應處理。

subTools.name: Scrum Sage
subTools.description: AI-powered Scrum Master and Enterprise Agility Coach based on Jeff Sutherland, Taiichi Ohno, and First Principles thinking. Use when user needs help with Scrum, sprint analysis, backlog refinement, scaling advice, impediment removal, team dynamics, or agile coaching. Activate for questions about Scrum mechanics, Scrum@Scale, flow optimization, or team performance.
subTools.description_zh: 基於 Jeff Sutherland、Taiichi Ohno 和第一性原理思考的 AI 驅動 Scrum Master 與企業敏捷教練。當使用者需要 Scrum、衝刺分析、後備清單精進、擴展建議、阻礙移除、團隊動態或敏捷教練方面的協助時使用。針對 Scrum 機制、Scrum@Scale、流程最佳化或團隊效能相關問題啟動。

subTools.name: Session Log
subTools.description: Summarize the current conversation session and append results to the weekly agent-log. Use when user says "log this", "session log", "summarize this session", or asks to write results to the agent-log.
subTools.description_zh: 摘要目前會話並將結果附加至每週 agent-log。當使用者說「log this」、「session log」、「summarize this session」或要求寫入結果至 agent-log 時使用。

subTools.name: Ship Learn Next
subTools.description: Transform learning content (like YouTube transcripts, articles, tutorials) into actionable implementation plans using the Ship-Learn-Next framework. Use when user wants to turn advice, lessons, or educational content into concrete action steps, reps, or a learning quest.
subTools.description_zh: 使用 Ship-Learn-Next 框架將學習內容（如 YouTube 逐字稿、文章、教學）轉化為可執行的實作計畫。當使用者想要將建議、經驗教訓或教育內容轉化為具體行動步驟、練習或學習任務時使用。

subTools.name: Unblock Action
subTools.description: Help the user unblock a vague or stuck action item by clarifying the intended output, scoping it to today, and identifying the concrete next action. Use when user says "unblock", "unstick", "I'm stuck on", or presents a vague task they can't start.
subTools.description_zh: 協助使用者釐清模糊或卡住的工作項目，明確預期產出，將其範圍縮小到今日，並找出具體的下一步行動。當使用者說「unblock」、「unstick」、「I'm stuck on」或提出無法開始的模糊任務時使用。

subTools.name: Youtube Transcript
subTools.description: Download YouTube video transcripts when user provides a YouTube URL or asks to download/get/fetch a transcript from YouTube. Also use when user wants to transcribe or get captions/subtitles from a YouTube video.
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者提供 YouTube 網址或要求從 YouTube 下載/取得/擷取逐字稿時使用。當使用者想要為 YouTube 影片轉錄或取得字幕時也使用。

tools.useCase: Automating the collection of research materials from web sources directly within the Claude Code environment.
advantages: Seamless integration with Claude Code for streamlined workflows
Supports multiple formats including PDFs and video transcripts
Reduces manual effort in gathering external content
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for generating original creative writing
Ineffective for real-time data streaming or live feeds
Cannot process non-textual media like images or audio files
tools.description_zh: Claude Code 技能，用於下載文章、PDF 與 YouTube 轉錄稿。
tools.useCase_zh: 直接在 Claude Code 環境中自動化從網頁來源蒐集研究資料。
tools.advantages_zh:
與 Claude Code 無縫整合，簡化工作流程。
支援多種格式，包括 PDF 與影片轉錄稿。
減少手動蒐集外部內容的工夫。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合生成原創創意寫作。
對即時資料串流或即時串流無效。
無法處理圖片或音訊等文字以外媒體。

tools.name: Marketingskills
tools.description: Marketing toolkit for AI agents covering CRO, SEO, copywriting, and analytics.
triggers: 產出 Landing Page 文案
tools.useCase: Automating the generation of high-converting landing page copy and SEO meta tags.
advantages: Integrates specialized marketing frameworks into AI workflows
Covers full funnel from SEO to conversion rate optimization
Optimized for Claude Code and Codex environments
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for general-purpose coding tasks unrelated to marketing
Ineffective for non-digital marketing channels like print or TV
Does not replace human strategic oversight for brand voice
tools.description_zh: AI 代理行銷工具組，涵蓋 CRO、SEO、文案撰寫與分析。
tools.useCase_zh: 自動化產生高轉換率登陸頁面文案與 SEO 標籤。
tools.advantages_zh:
將專業行銷框架整合進 AI 工作流程。
涵蓋從 SEO 到轉換率優化（CRO）的完整銷售漏斗。
針對 Claude Code 與 Codex 環境最佳化。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適用於與行銷無關的通用程式設計任務
對印刷或電視等非數位行銷管道效果有限
無法取代品牌語氣的人工策略監督

tools.name: Agent Toolkit
tools.description: Curated skills for AI coding agents to extend dev, docs, and planning workflows.

subTools.name: Agent Md Refactor
subTools.description: Refactor bloated AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, or similar agent instruction files to follow progressive disclosure principles. Splits monolithic files into organized, linked documentation.
subTools.description_zh: 將臃腫的 AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md 或類似代理指令檔重構為符合漸進式揭露原則的結構，把單一大檔拆分為有組織、互相連結的文件。

subTools.name: Backend To Frontend Handoff Docs
subTools.description: Create API handoff documentation for frontend developers. Use when backend work is complete and needs to be documented for frontend integration, or user says 'create handoff', 'document API', 'frontend handoff', or 'API documentation'.
subTools.description_zh: 為前端開發者建立 API 交接文件。於後端工作完成需記錄以便前端整合時使用，或使用者提到「建立交接」、「記錄 API」、「前端交接」「API 文件」時觸發。

subTools.name: C4 Architecture
subTools.description: Generate architecture documentation using C4 model Mermaid diagrams. Use when asked to create architecture diagrams, document system architecture, visualize software structure, create C4 diagrams, or generate context/container/component/deployment diagrams. Triggers include "architecture diagram", "C4 diagram", "system context", "container diagram", "component diagram", "deployment diagram", "document architecture", "visualize architecture".
subTools.description_zh: 使用 C4 模型產生 Mermaid 架構圖。當需要建立架構圖、記錄系統架構、視覺化軟體結構時使用，可產生情境、容器、元件與部署圖。

subTools.name: Codex
subTools.description: Use when the user asks to run Codex CLI (codex exec, codex resume) or references OpenAI Codex for code analysis, refactoring, or automated editing. Uses GPT-5.2 by default for state-of-the-art software engineering.
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者要求執行 Codex CLI（codex exec、codex resume）或提及 OpenAI Codex 進行程式分析、重構或自動編輯時使用。預設採用 GPT-5.2。

subTools.name: Command Creator
subTools.description: This skill should be used when creating a Claude Code slash command. Use when users ask to "create a command", "make a slash command", "add a command", or want to document a workflow as a reusable command. Essential for creating optimized, agent-executable slash commands with proper structure and best practices.
subTools.description_zh: 用於建立 Claude Code 斜線指令。當使用者想「建立指令」「新增指令」或將工作流程轉為可重複使用的指令時使用，協助產生結構完整且符合最佳實踐的斜線指令。

subTools.name: Commit Work
subTools.description: Create high-quality git commits: review/stage intended changes, split into logical commits, and write clear commit messages (including Conventional Commits). Use when the user asks to commit, craft a commit message, stage changes, or split work into multiple commits.
subTools.description_zh: 建立高品質 git 提交：檢視與暫存變更、拆分邏輯提交並撰寫清晰的提交訊息（含 Conventional Commits）。當使用者要求提交、撰寫提交訊息或拆分多個提交時使用。

subTools.name: Crafting Effective Readmes
subTools.description: Use when writing or improving README files. Not all READMEs are the same — provides templates and guidance matched to your audience and project type.
subTools.description_zh: 用於撰寫或改善 README 檔案。提供符合目標讀眾與專案類型的範本與指引，不同類型的 README 適用不同寫法。

subTools.name: Daily Meeting Update
subTools.description: Interactive daily standup/meeting update generator. Use when user says 'daily', 'standup', 'scrum update', 'status update', 'what did I do yesterday', 'prepare for meeting', 'morning update', or 'team sync'. Pulls activity from GitHub, Jira, and Claude Code session history. Conducts 4-question interview (yesterday, today, blockers, discussion topics) and generates formatted Markdown update.
subTools.description_zh: 互動式每日站會／會議更新產生器。從 GitHub、Jira 與 Claude Code 工作階段歷程抓取活動，透過四個問題（昨天、今天、阻礙、討論主題）的訪談產生格式化的 Markdown 更新。

subTools.name: Database Schema Designer
subTools.description: Design robust, scalable database schemas for SQL and NoSQL databases. Provides normalization guidelines, indexing strategies, migration patterns, constraint design, and performance optimization. Ensures data integrity, query performance, and maintainable data models.
subTools.description_zh: 為 SQL 和 NoSQL 資料庫設計強健且可擴展的架構。提供正規化指南、索引策略、遷移模式、約束設計與效能最佳化，確保資料完整性、查詢效能與易維護的資料模型。

subTools.name: Datadog Cli
subTools.description: Datadog CLI for searching logs, querying metrics, tracing requests, and managing dashboards. Use this when debugging production issues or working with Datadog observability.
subTools.description_zh: 用於搜尋日誌、查詢指標、追蹤請求與管理儀表板的 Datadog CLI。適用於偵錯生產環境問題或使用 Datadog 可觀測性工具時。

subTools.name: Dependency Updater
subTools.description: Smart dependency management for any language. Auto-detects project type, applies safe updates automatically, prompts for major versions, diagnoses and fixes dependency issues.
subTools.description_zh: 支援各種語言的智慧相依性管理。自動偵測專案類型、安全地執行更新，對主要版本提出提示，並診斷與修復相依性問題。

subTools.name: Design System Starter
subTools.description: Create and evolve design systems with design tokens, component architecture, accessibility guidelines, and documentation templates. Ensures consistent, scalable, and accessible UI across products.
subTools.description_zh: 建立與演進設計系統，包含設計標記、元件架構、無障礙設計指南與文件範本，確保產品間一致、可擴展且無障礙的 UI。

subTools.name: Difficult Workplace Conversations
subTools.description: Structured approach to workplace conflicts, performance discussions, and challenging feedback using preparation-delivery-followup framework. Use when preparing for tough conversations, addressing conflicts, giving critical feedback, or navigating sensitive workplace discussions.
subTools.description_zh: 結構化的職場衝突處理方式，含績效討論與挑戰性回饋，使用準備-執行-追蹤框架。適於準備棘手對話、處理衝突、給予關鍵回饋或應對敏感職場討論。

subTools.name: Domain Name Brainstormer
subTools.description: Generates creative domain name ideas for your project and checks availability across multiple TLDs (.com, .io, .dev, .ai, etc.). Saves hours of brainstorming and manual checking.
subTools.description_zh: 為你的專案產生創意的網域名稱靈感，並檢查多個 TLD 的可用性（.com、.io、.dev、.ai 等）。節省數小時的腦力激盪和手動檢查。

subTools.name: Draw Io
subTools.description: draw.io diagram creation, editing, and review. Use for .drawio XML editing, PNG conversion, layout adjustment, and AWS icon usage.
subTools.description_zh: draw.io 圖表建立、編輯和審核。適用 .drawio XML 編輯、PNG 轉換、版面調整和 AWS 圖示使用。

subTools.name: Excalidraw
subTools.description: Use when working with *.excalidraw or *.excalidraw.json files, user mentions diagrams/flowcharts, or requests architecture visualization - delegates all Excalidraw operations to subagents to prevent context exhaustion from verbose JSON (single files: 4k-22k tokens, can exceed read limits)
subTools.description_zh: 處理 *.excalidraw 或 *.excalidraw.json 檔案、使用者提及圖表/流程圖、或請求架構視覺化時，委派所有 Excalidraw 操作至 subagents，避免冗長 JSON 耗盡上下文（單檔：4k-22k tokens，可超出讀取限制）。

subTools.name: Feedback Mastery
subTools.description: Navigate difficult conversations and deliver constructive feedback using structured frameworks. Covers the Preparation-Delivery-Follow-up model and Situation-Behavior-Impact (SBI) feedback technique. Use when preparing for difficult conversations, giving feedback, or managing conflicts.
subTools.description_zh: 運用結構化框架處理困難對話並給予建設性迴饋。涵蓋準備─交付─追蹤模型與情境─行為─影響（SBI）技巧。適用於預備困難對話、提供迴饋或處理衝突。

subTools.name: Frontend To Backend Requirements
subTools.description: Document frontend data needs for backend developers. Use when frontend needs to communicate API requirements to backend, or user says 'backend requirements', 'what data do I need', 'API requirements', or is describing data needs for a UI.
subTools.description_zh: 文件化前端資料需求供後端開發者使用。適用於前端需向後端溝通 API 需求，或使用者提到「後端需求」「需要什麼資料」「API 需求」或描述 UI 資料需求時。

subTools.name: Game Changing Features
subTools.description: Find 10x product opportunities and high-leverage improvements. Use when user wants strategic product thinking, mentions '10x', wants to find high-impact features, or says 'what would make this 10x better', 'product strategy', or 'what should we build next'.
subTools.description_zh: 尋找 10 倍產品機會與高槓桿改進。適用於使用者想要策略性產品思考、提到「10x」、尋找高影響力功能，或詢問「什麼能讓它提升 10 倍」「產品策略」「接下來該做什麼」時。

subTools.name: Gemini
subTools.description: Use when the user asks to run Gemini CLI for code review, plan review, or big context (>200k) processing. Ideal for comprehensive analysis requiring large context windows. Uses Gemini 3 Pro by default for state-of-the-art reasoning and coding.
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者要求執行 Gemini CLI 進行程式碼審查、計畫審查或大量上下文（>200k）處理時使用。適合需要大型上下文視窗的綜合分析。預設使用 Gemini 3 Pro 實現頂尖推理與編碼能力。

subTools.name: Gepetto
subTools.description: Creates detailed, sectionized implementation plans through research, stakeholder interviews, and multi-LLM review. Use when planning features that need thorough pre-implementation analysis.
subTools.description_zh: 透過研究、利害關係者訪談和多重 LLM 審查，建立詳細分段實施計畫。用於規劃需全面預先分析的功能。

subTools.name: Jira
subTools.description: Use when the user mentions Jira issues (e.g., "PROJ-123"), asks about tickets, wants to create/view/update issues, check sprint status, or manage their Jira workflow. Triggers on keywords like "jira", "issue", "ticket", "sprint", "backlog", or issue key patterns.
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者提到 Jira 問題（如 PROJ-123）、詢問票證、想建立/檢視/更新問題、檢查 sprint 狀態或管理 Jira 工作流程時使用。觸發關鍵字：jira、issue、ticket、sprint、backlog 或問題金鑰模式。

subTools.name: Lesson Learned
subTools.description: Analyze recent code changes via git history and extract software engineering lessons. Use when the user asks 'what is the lesson here?', 'what can I learn from this?', 'engineering takeaway', 'what did I just learn?', 'reflect on this code', or wants to extract principles from recent work.
subTools.description_zh: 透過 git 歷史分析近期程式碼變更，萃取軟體工程經驗。當使用者問「這段教訓是什麼？」「我能學到什麼？」「工程 takeaway」「反思這段程式碼」或想從近期工作中萃取原則時使用。

subTools.name: Marp Slide
subTools.description: Create professional Marp presentation slides with 7 beautiful themes (default, minimal, colorful, dark, gradient, tech, business). Use when users request slide creation, presentations, or Marp documents. Supports custom themes, image layouts, and "make it look good" requests with automatic quality improvements.
subTools.description_zh: 使用 7 種精美主題（預設、極簡、彩色、深色、漸層、科技、商務）建立專業 Marp 簡報投影片。使用者請求建立投影片、簡報或 Marp 檔案時使用。支援自訂主題、圖片排版，並能自動優化品質。

subTools.name: Meme Factory
subTools.description: Generate memes using the memegen.link API. Use when users request memes, want to add humor to content, or need visual aids for social media. Supports 100+ popular templates with custom text and styling.
subTools.description_zh: 使用 memegen.link API 生成梗圖。當使用者請求製作梗圖、為內容增添趣味，或需要社群媒體視覺輔助工具時使用。支援 100 多款熱門模板，可自訂文字與樣式。

subTools.name: Mermaid Diagrams
subTools.description: Comprehensive guide for creating software diagrams using Mermaid syntax. Use when users need to create, visualize, or document software through diagrams including class diagrams (domain modeling, object-oriented design), sequence diagrams (application flows, API interactions, code execution), flowcharts (processes, algorithms, user journeys), entity relationship diagrams (database schemas), C4 architecture diagrams (system context, containers, components), state diagrams, git graphs, pie charts, gantt charts, or any other diagram type. Triggers include requests to "diagram", "visualize", "model", "map out", "show the flow", or when explaining system architecture, database design, code structure, or user/application flows.
subTools.description_zh: 使用 Mermaid 語法建立軟體圖表的完整指南。當使用者需要建立、視覺化或文件化軟體時使用，包含類別圖（領域建模、物件導向設計）、序列圖（應用程式流程、API 互動）、流程圖（流程、演算法）、實體關係圖（資料庫架構）等。

subTools.name: Mui
subTools.description: Material-UI v7 component library patterns including sx prop styling, theme integration, responsive design, and MUI-specific hooks. Use when working with MUI components, styling with sx prop, theme customization, or MUI utilities.
subTools.description_zh: Material-UI v7 元件庫模式，包含 sx 屬性樣式、主題整合、響應式設計及 MUI 專屬 hooks。當使用 MUI 元件、以 sx 屬性樣式化、自訂主題或使用 MUI 工具函式時使用。

subTools.name: Naming Analyzer
subTools.description: Suggest better variable, function, and class names based on context and conventions.
subTools.description_zh: 根據上下文與慣例，建議更佳的變數、函式與類別命名。

subTools.name: Openapi To Typescript
subTools.description: Converts OpenAPI 3.0 JSON/YAML to TypeScript interfaces and type guards. This skill should be used when the user asks to generate types from OpenAPI, convert schema to TS, create API interfaces, or generate TypeScript types from an API specification.
subTools.description_zh: 將 OpenAPI 3.0 JSON/YAML 轉換為 TypeScript 介面與型別檢查函式。當使用者要求從 OpenAPI 產生型別、將 schema 轉換為 TS、建立 API 介面，或從 API 規格產生 TypeScript 型別時使用。

subTools.name: Perplexity
subTools.description: Web search and research using Perplexity AI. Use when user says "search", "find", "look up", "ask", "research", or "what's the latest" for generic queries. NOT for library/framework docs (use Context7) or workspace questions.
subTools.description_zh: 使用 Perplexity AI 進行網路搜尋與研究。當使用者說「搜尋」、「查找」、「查詢」、「提問」、「研究」或「最新狀況」時使用。不適用於函式庫／框架文件（請用 Context7）或工作區相關問題。

subTools.name: Plugin Forge
subTools.description: Create and manage Claude Code plugins with proper structure, manifests, and marketplace integration. Use when creating plugins for a marketplace, adding plugin components (commands, agents, hooks), bumping plugin versions, or working with plugin.json/marketplace.json manifests.
subTools.description_zh: 建立與管理 Claude Code 外掛，包含適當結構、清單檔與市集整合。當建立外掛、新增外掛元件（指令、代理人、鉤子）、升級外掛版本，或處理 plugin.json／marketplace.json 清單時使用。

subTools.name: Professional Communication
subTools.description: Guide technical communication for software developers. Covers email structure, team messaging etiquette, meeting agendas, and adapting messages for technical vs non-technical audiences. Use when drafting professional messages, preparing meeting communications, or improving written communication.
subTools.description_zh: 指導軟體開發者的技術溝通。涵蓋電子郵件結構、團隊訊息禮儀、會議議程，以及針對技術與非技術受眾調整訊息。在撰寫專業訊息、準備會議通訊或改善書面溝通時使用。

subTools.name: Qa Test Planner
subTools.description: Generate comprehensive test plans, manual test cases, regression test suites, and bug reports for QA engineers. Includes Figma MCP integration for design validation.
subTools.description_zh: 為 QA 工程師產生完整的測試計畫、手動測試案例、回歸測試套件與缺陷報告。包含 Figma MCP 整合用於設計驗證。

subTools.name: React Dev
subTools.description: This skill should be used when building React components with TypeScript, typing hooks, handling events, or when React TypeScript, React 19, Server Components are mentioned. Covers type-safe patterns for React 18-19 including generic components, proper event typing, and routing integration (TanStack Router, React Router).
subTools.description_zh: 當建構使用 TypeScript 的 React 元件、為 hooks 加類型、處理事件，或提到 React TypeScript、React 19、Server Components 時使用。涵蓋 React 18-19 的類型安全模式，包含泛型元件、事件類型標註，以及路由整合（TanStack Router、React Router）。

subTools.name: React Useeffect
subTools.description: React useEffect best practices from official docs. Use when writing/reviewing useEffect, useState for derived values, data fetching, or state synchronization. Teaches when NOT to use Effect and better alternatives.
subTools.description_zh: React useEffect 官方文件最佳實踐。在撰寫或審查 useEffect、用於衍生值的 useState、資料擷取或狀態同步時使用。教導何時不該使用 Effect，以及更好的替代方案。

subTools.name: Reducing Entropy
subTools.description: Manual-only skill for minimizing total codebase size. Only activate when explicitly requested by user. Measures success by final code amount, not effort. Bias toward deletion.
subTools.description_zh: 僅手動觸發的技能，用於最小化整個程式碼庫規模。僅在使用者明確要求時激活。以最終程式碼量衡量成功，而非投入程度。傾向刪除。

subTools.name: Requirements Clarity
subTools.description: Clarify ambiguous requirements through focused dialogue before implementation. Use when requirements are unclear, features are complex (>2 days), or involve cross-team coordination. Ask two core questions - Why? (YAGNI check) and Simpler? (KISS check) - to ensure clarity before coding.
subTools.description_zh: 在實作前透過聚焦對話釐清模糊需求。在需求不明確、功能複雜（超過 2 天）或涉及跨團隊協調時使用。詢問兩個核心問題——Why?（YAGNI 檢查）和 Simpler?（KISS 檢查）——確保寫程式前需求清晰。

subTools.name: Session Handoff
subTools.description: Creates comprehensive handoff documents for seamless AI agent session transfers. Triggered when: (1) user requests handoff/memory/context save, (2) context window approaches capacity, (3) major task milestone completed, (4) work session ending, (5) user says 'save state', 'create handoff', 'I need to pause', 'context is getting full', (6) resuming work with 'load handoff', 'resume from', 'continue where we left off'. Proactively suggests handoffs after substantial work (multiple file edits, complex debugging, architecture decisions). Solves long-running agent context exhaustion by enabling fresh agents to continue with zero ambiguity.
subTools.description_zh: 產生完整的交接文件，實現無縫的 AI 工作階段轉移。觸發時機：(1) 使用者請求交接／記憶／上下文儲存，(2) 上下文視窗接近容量，(3) 主要任務里程碑完成，(4) 工作時段結束，(5) 使用者說「save state」「create handoff」「I need to pause」「context is getting full」，(6) 繼續工作時說「load handoff」「resume from」「continue」。

subTools.name: Ship Learn Next
subTools.description: Transform learning content (like YouTube transcripts, articles, tutorials) into actionable implementation plans using the Ship-Learn-Next framework. Use when user wants to turn advice, lessons, or educational content into concrete action steps, reps, or a learning quest.
subTools.description_zh: 使用 Ship-Learn-Next 框架將學習內容（如 YouTube 轉錄、文章、教學）轉換為可執行的實作計畫。當使用者想把建議、教訓或教育內容轉化為具體行動步驟、練習或學習任務時使用。

subTools.name: Skill Judge
subTools.description: Evaluate Agent Skill design quality against official specifications and best practices. Use when reviewing, auditing, or improving SKILL.md files and skill packages. Provides multi-dimensional scoring and actionable improvement suggestions.
subTools.description_zh: 根據官方規範與最佳實踐評估 Agent 技能的設計品質。在審閱、稽核或改進 SKILL.md 檔案和技能套件時使用。提供多維度評分與可執行的改進建議。

subTools.name: Web To Markdown
subTools.description: Use ONLY when the user explicitly says: 'use the skill web-to-markdown ...' (or 'use a skill web-to-markdown ...'). Converts webpage URLs to clean Markdown by calling the local web2md CLI (Puppeteer + Readability), suitable for JS-rendered pages.
subTools.description_zh: 僅當使用者明確要求時使用。透過本地 web2md CLI（Puppeteer + Readability）將網頁 URL 轉為清爽的 Markdown，適合 JavaScript 渲染的頁面。

subTools.name: Writing Clearly And Concisely
subTools.description: Use when writing prose humans will read—documentation, commit messages, error messages, explanations, reports, or UI text. Applies Strunk's timeless rules for clearer, stronger, more professional writing.
subTools.description_zh: 撰寫人類閱讀的文稿時使用——文件、提交訊息、錯誤訊息、說明、報告或介面文字皆可。套用 Strunk 永恆的寫作規則，讓文章更清晰有力且專業。

subTools.name: Agent Md Refactor
subTools.description: Refactor bloated AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, or similar agent instruction files to follow progressive disclosure principles. Splits monolithic files into organized, linked documentation.
subTools.description_zh: 將臃腫的 AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md 或類似指示檔案重構，遵循漸進式揭露原則。把單一龐大檔案拆分為有組織的連結文件。

subTools.name: Backend To Frontend Handoff Docs
subTools.description: Create API handoff documentation for frontend developers. Use when backend work is complete and needs to be documented for frontend integration, or user says 'create handoff', 'document API', 'frontend handoff', or 'API documentation'.
subTools.description_zh: 為前端開發者建立 API 交接文件。用於後端工作完成需記錄以利前端整合時，或使用者說「建立交接」、「記錄 API」、「前端交接」或「API 文件」時。

subTools.name: C4 Architecture
subTools.description: Generate architecture documentation using C4 model Mermaid diagrams. Use when asked to create architecture diagrams, document system architecture, visualize software structure, create C4 diagrams, or generate context/container/component/deployment diagrams. Triggers include "architecture diagram", "C4 diagram", "system context", "container diagram", "component diagram", "deployment diagram", "document architecture", "visualize architecture".
subTools.description_zh: 使用 C4 模型 Mermaid 圖表產生架構文件。用於要求建立架構圖、記錄系統架構、可視化軟體結構、建立 C4 圖，或產生情境／容器／元件／部署圖時。觸發詞包括「架構圖」、「C4 圖」、「系統情境」、「容器圖」、「元件圖」、「部署圖」、「文件」。

subTools.name: Codex
subTools.description: Use when the user asks to run Codex CLI (codex exec, codex resume) or references OpenAI Codex for code analysis, refactoring, or automated editing. Uses GPT-5.2 by default for state-of-the-art software engineering.
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者要求執行 Codex CLI（codex exec、codex resume）或提及 OpenAI Codex 進行程式碼分析、重構或自動化編輯時使用。預設使用 GPT-5.2，提供最新的軟體工程能力。

subTools.name: Command Creator
subTools.description: This skill should be used when creating a Claude Code slash command. Use when users ask to "create a command", "make a slash command", "add a command", or want to document a workflow as a reusable command. Essential for creating optimized, agent-executable slash commands with proper structure and best practices.
subTools.description_zh: 建立 Claude Code 斜線指令時使用此技能。當使用者要求「建立指令」、「製作斜線指令」、「新增指令」，或希望將工作流程記錄為可重複使用的指令時適用。對建立結構完善、符合最佳實踐的 Agent 可執行斜線指令至關重要。

subTools.name: Commit Work
subTools.description: Create high-quality git commits: review/stage intended changes, split into logical commits, and write clear commit messages (including Conventional Commits). Use when the user asks to commit, craft a commit message, stage changes, or split work into multiple commits.
subTools.description_zh: 建立高品質的 git 提交：檢視與暫存預期變更、拆分為邏輯性提交，並撰寫清晰的提交訊息（含 Conventional Commits）。當使用者要求提交、撰寫提交訊息、暫存變更，或將工作拆分為多個提交時使用。

subTools.name: Crafting Effective Readmes
subTools.description: Use when writing or improving README files. Not all READMEs are the same — provides templates and guidance matched to your audience and project type.
subTools.description_zh: 撰寫或改進 README 檔案時使用。README 形式多種多樣——提供符合受眾與專案類型的範本與指引。

subTools.name: Daily Meeting Update
subTools.description: Interactive daily standup/meeting update generator. Use when user says 'daily', 'standup', 'scrum update', 'status update', 'what did I do yesterday', 'prepare for meeting', 'morning update', or 'team sync'. Pulls activity from GitHub, Jira, and Claude Code session history. Conducts 4-question interview (yesterday, today, blockers, discussion topics) and generates formatted Markdown update.
subTools.description_zh: 互動式每日站會／會議更新產生器。當使用者提到「daily」「standup」「scrum update」「status update」「what did I do yesterday」「prepare for meeting」「morning update」「team sync」時使用。從 GitHub、Jira 與 Claude Code 工作階段歷史取得活動紀錄，進行四問題訪談（昨天、今天、阻塞事項、討論主題），並產生格式化 Markdown 更新。

subTools.name: Database Schema Designer
subTools.description: Design robust, scalable database schemas for SQL and NoSQL databases. Provides normalization guidelines, indexing strategies, migration patterns, constraint design, and performance optimization. Ensures data integrity, query performance, and maintainable data models.
subTools.description_zh: 為 SQL 與 NoSQL 資料庫設計穩固且具延展性的架構。提供正規化準則、索引策略、遷移模式、約束設計與效能最佳化作法，確保資料完整性、查詢效能與可維護的資料模型。

subTools.name: Datadog Cli
subTools.description: Datadog CLI for searching logs, querying metrics, tracing requests, and managing dashboards. Use this when debugging production issues or working with Datadog observability.
subTools.description_zh: 用於搜尋日誌、查詢指標、追蹤請求與管理儀表板的 Datadog CLI 工具。適合除錯生產問題或操作 Datadog 可觀察性平台時使用。

subTools.name: Dependency Updater
subTools.description: Smart dependency management for any language. Auto-detects project type, applies safe updates automatically, prompts for major versions, diagnoses and fixes dependency issues.
subTools.description_zh: 支援各種語言的智慧依賴管理工具。自動偵測專案類型、套用安全更新、對主要版本提出提示，並診斷修復依賴問題。

subTools.name: Design System Starter
subTools.description: Create and evolve design systems with design tokens, component architecture, accessibility guidelines, and documentation templates. Ensures consistent, scalable, and accessible UI across products.
subTools.description_zh: 建立與演進設計系統，提供設計代幣、元件架構、無障礙指引與文件範本，確保產品具備一致、可擴展且友善的使用者介面。

subTools.name: Difficult Workplace Conversations
subTools.description: Structured approach to workplace conflicts, performance discussions, and challenging feedback using preparation-delivery-followup framework. Use when preparing for tough conversations, addressing conflicts, giving critical feedback, or navigating sensitive workplace discussions.
subTools.description_zh: 以準備、交付、追蹤框架處理職場衝突、績效面談與艱難回饋。適合準備困難對話、解決衝突或進行敏感職場溝通時使用。

subTools.name: Domain Name Brainstormer
subTools.description: Generates creative domain name ideas for your project and checks availability across multiple TLDs (.com, .io, .dev, .ai, etc.). Saves hours of brainstorming and manual checking.
subTools.description_zh: 為專案產生創意網域名稱，並檢查多項 TLD（.com、.io、.dev、.ai 等）的可用性，節省腦力激盪與手動檢查時間。

subTools.name: Draw Io
subTools.description: draw.io diagram creation, editing, and review. Use for .drawio XML editing, PNG conversion, layout adjustment, and AWS icon usage.
subTools.description_zh: 用於 draw.io 圖表建立、編輯與檢視，支援 .drawio XML 編輯、PNG 轉換、版面調整及 AWS 圖示使用。

subTools.name: Excalidraw
subTools.description: Use when working with *.excalidraw or *.excalidraw.json files, user mentions diagrams/flowcharts, or requests architecture visualization - delegates all Excalidraw operations to subagents to prevent context exhaustion from verbose JSON (single files: 4k-22k tokens, can exceed read limits)
subTools.description_zh: 處理 *.excalidraw 或 *.excalidraw.json 檔案、使用者提到圖表/流程圖，或需要架構視覺化時使用——將所有 Excalidraw 作業委派給子 agent，避免冗長 JSON 耗盡上下文。

subTools.name: Feedback Mastery
subTools.description: Navigate difficult conversations and deliver constructive feedback using structured frameworks. Covers the Preparation-Delivery-Follow-up model and Situation-Behavior-Impact (SBI) feedback technique. Use when preparing for difficult conversations, giving feedback, or managing conflicts.
subTools.description_zh: 運用結構化框架應對艱難對話並給予建設性回饋，涵蓋準備－交付－追蹤模式及 SBI（情境－行為－影響）回饋技巧。適用於準備困難對話、給予回饋或處理衝突。

subTools.name: Frontend To Backend Requirements
subTools.description: Document frontend data needs for backend developers. Use when frontend needs to communicate API requirements to backend, or user says 'backend requirements', 'what data do I need', 'API requirements', or is describing data needs for a UI.
subTools.description_zh: 為後端開發者記錄前端資料需求。當前端需要向後端溝通 API 需求、使用者提到「後端需求」「需要什麼資料」「API 需求」，或描述 UI 資料需求時使用。

subTools.name: Game Changing Features
subTools.description: Find 10x product opportunities and high-leverage improvements. Use when user wants strategic product thinking, mentions '10x', wants to find high-impact features, or says 'what would make this 10x better', 'product strategy', or 'what should we build next'.
subTools.description_zh: 尋找 10x 產品機會與高槓桿改善。當使用者想要戰略性產品思考、提到「10x」、希望找高影響功能，或說「怎麼讓它更好 10 倍」「產品策略」「接下來該做什麼」時使用。

subTools.name: Gemini
subTools.description: Use when the user asks to run Gemini CLI for code review, plan review, or big context (>200k) processing. Ideal for comprehensive analysis requiring large context windows. Uses Gemini 3 Pro by default for state-of-the-art reasoning and coding.
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者要求執行 Gemini CLI 進行程式碼審查、計畫審查，或處理大型 context（超過 20 萬）時使用。適合需要大型 context window 的全面分析。預設使用 Gemini 3 Pro 進行尖端推理與程式撰寫。

subTools.name: Gepetto
subTools.description: Creates detailed, sectionized implementation plans through research, stakeholder interviews, and multi-LLM review. Use when planning features that need thorough pre-implementation analysis.
subTools.description_zh: 透過研究、利害關係人訪談與多 LLM 審查，產生詳細的分段實作計畫。當規劃需要 thorough pre-implementation analysis 的功能時使用。

subTools.name: Jira
subTools.description: Use when the user mentions Jira issues (e.g., "PROJ-123"), asks about tickets, wants to create/view/update issues, check sprint status, or manage their Jira workflow. Triggers on keywords like "jira", "issue", "ticket", "sprint", "backlog", or issue key patterns.
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者提到 Jira 問題（如「PROJ-123」）、詢問工單、建立／檢視／更新問題、查看衝刺狀態或管理 Jira 工作流程時使用。觸發關鍵字包含 jira、issue、ticket、sprint、backlog 或問題編號樣式。

subTools.name: Lesson Learned
subTools.description: Analyze recent code changes via git history and extract software engineering lessons. Use when the user asks 'what is the lesson here?', 'what can I learn from this?', 'engineering takeaway', 'what did I just learn?', 'reflect on this code', or wants to extract principles from recent work.
subTools.description_zh: 透過 git 歷史分析近期程式變更，並萃取軟體工程經驗。當使用者問「這裡的經驗是什麼？」「我能從中學到什麼？」、「工程收穫」、或想從近期工作中萃取原則時使用。

subTools.name: Marp Slide
subTools.description: Create professional Marp presentation slides with 7 beautiful themes (default, minimal, colorful, dark, gradient, tech, business). Use when users request slide creation, presentations, or Marp documents. Supports custom themes, image layouts, and "make it look good" requests with automatic quality improvements.
subTools.description_zh: 建立專業 Marp 簡報投影片，內建 7 種精美主題（預設、簡約、多彩、深色、漸層、科技、商業）。當使用者要求建立投影片、簡報或 Marp 文件時使用。支援自訂主題、圖片排版，並可自動提升畫面品質。

subTools.name: Meme Factory
subTools.description: Generate memes using the memegen.link API. Use when users request memes, want to add humor to content, or need visual aids for social media. Supports 100+ popular templates with custom text and styling.
subTools.description_zh: 使用 memegen.link API 產生 meme。當使用者要求製作 meme、為內容增添趣味，或需要社群媒體視覺輔助時使用。內建 100 多款熱門模板，支援自訂文字與樣式。

subTools.name: Mermaid Diagrams
subTools.description: Comprehensive guide for creating software diagrams using Mermaid syntax. Use when users need to create, visualize, or document software through diagrams including class diagrams (domain modeling, object-oriented design), sequence diagrams (application flows, API interactions, code execution), flowcharts (processes, algorithms, user journeys), entity relationship diagrams (database schemas), C4 architecture diagrams (system context, containers, components), state diagrams, git graphs, pie charts, gantt charts, or any other diagram type. Triggers include requests to "diagram", "visualize", "model", "map out", "show the flow", or when explaining system architecture, database design, code structure, or user/application flows.
subTools.description_zh: Mermaid 語法繪製軟體圖表的完整指南。當使用者需要建立、視覺化或文件化軟體圖表時使用，包含類別圖（領域建模、物件導向設計）、序列圖（應用程式流程、API 互動、程式執行）、流程圖（流程、演算法、使用者旅程）、實體關聯圖（資料庫 Schema）等。

subTools.name: Mui
subTools.description: Material-UI v7 component library patterns including sx prop styling, theme integration, responsive design, and MUI-specific hooks. Use when working with MUI components, styling with sx prop, theme customization, or MUI utilities.
subTools.description_zh: Material-UI v7 元件庫模式，包含 sx prop 樣式設定、主題整合、響應式設計與 MUI 專屬 hooks。當使用 MUI 元件、以 sx prop 設定樣式、主題客製化或 MUI 工具函式時使用。

subTools.name: Naming Analyzer
subTools.description: Suggest better variable, function, and class names based on context and conventions.
subTools.description_zh: 根據上下文與命名慣例，建議更佳的變數、函數與類別名稱。

subTools.name: Openapi To Typescript
subTools.description: Converts OpenAPI 3.0 JSON/YAML to TypeScript interfaces and type guards. This skill should be used when the user asks to generate types from OpenAPI, convert schema to TS, create API interfaces, or generate TypeScript types from an API specification.
subTools.description_zh: 將 OpenAPI 3.0 JSON/YAML 轉換為 TypeScript 介面與型別守衛。當使用者要求從 OpenAPI 產生型別、將 schema 轉 TS、建立 API 介面，或從 API 規格檔產生 TypeScript 型別時使用。

subTools.name: Perplexity
subTools.description: Web search and research using Perplexity AI. Use when user says "search", "find", "look up", "ask", "research", or "what's the latest" for generic queries. NOT for library/framework docs (use Context7) or workspace questions.
subTools.description_zh: 使用 Perplexity AI 進行網路搜尋與研究。當使用者說「搜尋」、「查找」、「查詢」、「詢問」、「研究」或「最新消息」時使用，適用於一般問題；不適用於函式庫／框架文件（請用 Context7）或工作區問題。

subTools.name: Plugin Forge
subTools.description: Create and manage Claude Code plugins with proper structure, manifests, and marketplace integration. Use when creating plugins for a marketplace, adding plugin components (commands, agents, hooks), bumping plugin versions, or working with plugin.json/marketplace.json manifests.
subTools.description_zh: 建立與管理 Claude Code 插件，包含正確的結構、manifest 與市集整合。當為市集建立插件、新增插件元件（指令、agent、hooks）、更新插件版本，或處理 plugin.json / marketplace.json manifest 時使用。

subTools.name: Professional Communication
subTools.description: Guide technical communication for software developers. Covers email structure, team messaging etiquette, meeting agendas, and adapting messages for technical vs non-technical audiences. Use when drafting professional messages, preparing meeting communications, or improving written communication.
subTools.description_zh: 指導軟體開發者的技術溝通，涵蓋電子郵件結構、團隊訊息禮儀、會議議程，以及針對技術與非技術受眾調整訊息內容。當撰寫專業訊息、準備會議溝通，或改善書面溝通時使用。

subTools.name: Qa Test Planner
subTools.description: Generate comprehensive test plans, manual test cases, regression test suites, and bug reports for QA engineers. Includes Figma MCP integration for design validation.
subTools.description_zh: 為 QA 工程師產生完整測試計畫、手動測試案例、回歸測試套件與錯誤報告。內建 Figma MCP 整合用於設計驗證。

subTools.name: React Dev
subTools.description: This skill should be used when building React components with TypeScript, typing hooks, handling events, or when React TypeScript, React 19, Server Components are mentioned. Covers type-safe patterns for React 18-19 including generic components, proper event typing, and routing integration (TanStack Router, React Router).
subTools.description_zh: 當建構使用 TypeScript 的 React 元件、為 hooks 加型別標註、處理事件，或提及 React TypeScript、React 19、伺服器元件時使用。涵蓋 React 18–19 的型別安全模式，包含泛型元件、正確的事件型別標註與路由整合（TanStack Router、React Router）。

subTools.name: React Useeffect
subTools.description: React useEffect best practices from official docs. Use when writing/reviewing useEffect, useState for derived values, data fetching, or state synchronization. Teaches when NOT to use Effect and better alternatives.
subTools.description_zh: 依據官方文件說明 React useEffect 最佳實踐。當編寫或檢視 useEffect、為衍生值使用 useState、資料取得或狀態同步時使用。教導何時不使用 Effect，以及更好的替代方案。

subTools.name: Reducing Entropy
subTools.description: Manual-only skill for minimizing total codebase size. Only activate when explicitly requested by user. Measures success by final code amount, not effort. Bias toward deletion.

subTools.name: Requirements Clarity
subTools.description: Clarify ambiguous requirements through focused dialogue before implementation. Use when requirements are unclear, features are complex (>2 days), or involve cross-team coordination. Ask two core questions - Why? (YAGNI check) and Simpler? (KISS check) - to ensure clarity before coding.
subTools.description_zh: 透過聚焦對話在實作前澄清模糊需求。適用於需求不明確、功能複雜（>2天）或跨團隊協調情境。詢問兩個核心問題：為什麼？（YAGNI 檢查）和更簡單？（KISS 檢查），確保編碼前清晰。

subTools.name: Session Handoff
subTools.description: Creates comprehensive handoff documents for seamless AI agent session transfers. Triggered when: (1) user requests handoff/memory/context save, (2) context window approaches capacity, (3) major task milestone completed, (4) work session ending, (5) user says 'save state', 'create handoff', 'I need to pause', 'context is getting full', (6) resuming work with 'load handoff', 'resume from', 'continue where we left off'. Proactively suggests handoffs after substantial work (multiple file edits, complex debugging, architecture decisions). Solves long-running agent context exhaustion by enabling fresh agents to continue with zero ambiguity.
subTools.description_zh: 建立完整交接文件，以利順暢的 AI Agent 工作階段轉移。觸發條件：(1) 使用者要求交接/記憶/情境儲存；(2) 情境視窗接近上限；(3) 主要任務里程碑完成；(4) 工作階段結束；(5) 使用者說「儲存狀態」、「建立交接」、「我需要暫停」、「情境快滿了」；(6) 恢復工作時說「載入交接」、「從...繼續」、「繼續」。

subTools.name: Ship Learn Next
subTools.description: Transform learning content (like YouTube transcripts, articles, tutorials) into actionable implementation plans using the Ship-Learn-Next framework. Use when user wants to turn advice, lessons, or educational content into concrete action steps, reps, or a learning quest.
subTools.description_zh: 使用 Ship-Learn-Next 框架，將學習內容（如 YouTube 逐字稿、文章、教學）轉換為可執行的實作計畫。適用於當使用者希望將建議、經驗教訓或教育內容轉化為具體行動步驟、練習或學習任務時。

subTools.name: Skill Judge

subTools.description_zh: 根據官方規格和最佳實踐，評估 Agent 技能設計品質。適用於審查、稽核或改進 SKILL.md 檔案和技能套件。提供多維度評分和可操作的改進建議。

subTools.name: Web To Markdown

subTools.description_zh: 僅當使用者明確說「使用 web-to-markdown 技能 ...」時使用。透過呼叫本機 web2md CLI（Puppeteer + Readability）將網頁 URL 轉換為乾淨的 Markdown，適用於 JavaScript 渲染的頁面。

tools.advantages_zh: 內建反機器人繞過能力以支援穩健自動化、支援平行多工與獨立多工作業、卡住時可無縫移交給人類操作者

negativeConstraints: Not suitable for local or self-hosted notebook management without Google account access

Not appropriate when real-time collaborative editing features are required

處理超過 NotebookLM 來源限制的批量文件時應避免使用

tools.name: Img2threejs

advantages: Produces token-efficient procedural code instead of heavy mesh files

tools.name: Wayfinder
tools.description: Plan large-scale work as investigation tickets on your issue tracker, mapping the path from idea to execution.
triggers: 拆解大型項目為調查任務
規劃從想法到執行的路線圖
追蹤技術決策的分支路徑
探索需求中的不確定領域
識別技術方案的前鋒邊界

install.command: git clone https://github.com/mattpocock/skills.git && cd skills && cp -r skills/engineering/wayfinder ~/.agents/skills/

tools.useCase: A team starting a complex feature with unclear requirements uses Wayfinder to create research, prototype, and task tickets that progressively reduce uncertainty.
advantages: Breaks ambiguous projects into structured investigation tickets (research, prototype, grilling, task) for incremental clarity
Tracks fog-of-war areas explicitly so teams know what is unknown versus resolved
Integrates directly with existing issue trackers, making the plan actionable without extra tooling
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for small, well-defined tasks that do not require exploratory investigation
Not ideal when the team already has a clear, detailed plan and does not need discovery-driven planning
Avoid for single-person quick tasks where creating tickets adds unnecessary overhead
tools.description_zh: 在問題追蹤器上以調查工單規劃大型工作，勾勒出從構想至執行的路徑。
tools.useCase_zh: 一個需求不明的複雜功能開發團隊使用 Wayfinder 建立研究、原型與任務工單，逐步降低不確定性。
tools.advantages_zh: 將模糊的專案拆解為結構化的調查工單（研究、原型、探討、任務），逐步達成清晰度、明確追蹤資訊不明確的領域，讓團隊清楚區分已知與未知事項、直接整合現有問題追蹤器，讓計畫可直接執行而無需額外工具
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合不需要探索性調查的小型、定義明確的任務
當團隊已有清晰詳細的計畫且不需要以探索為導向的規劃時，並非理想選擇
不建議用於單人快速任務，因為建立工單會增加不必要的成本

tools.name: Shepherd

tools.description_zh: 可逆執行基底層，使元代理能夠觀察、分叉、重播和訓練 LLM 代理。
tools.useCase_zh: 構建、監督和訓練需要狀態檢查點、時間旅行除錯和 MCTS 樹搜尋的複雜元代理工作流程。
tools.advantages_zh: 寫時複製程序分叉比 docker commit 快約 5 倍，重播時 ~95% KV 快取重用以實現高效的 LLM 推論，類 Git 可逆追蹤實現無縫狀態分支和時間旅行

subTools.name: Captions Overlay
subTools.description: Overlay doctrine for the embedded-captions workflow — the caption MODEL (drop / rail / embed) and the rule that captions are an OVERLAY composited on top of the film, never a reserved bottom band you shift content up to avoid. Load when adding captions/subtitles to a talking-head or launch video, when deciding whether a phrase should be dropped, ride the verbatim rail, or be promoted to a scarce embedded climax, when laying out a composition that will carry captions (do NOT reserve a keep-out band), or when centering a composition on the true frame center under captions. Quotes the rail+embed model from embedded-captions and constraint #13 (captions overlay, keep-out band retired) from the product-launch-video scene agent. Applies ON TOP of embedded-captions.
subTools.description_zh: 內嵌字幕工作流程的教學原則——字幕模型（隱藏／軌道／嵌入）與規則：字幕是以疊加方式合成於影片上方，而非保留底部空間讓內容上移。當為訪談或開場影片加上字幕、決定是否省略片語、遵循原文軌道，或提升稀有事例時載入此原則。

subTools.name: Changelog Video
subTools.description: Turn a weekly changelog .md into a finished branded changelog video (square 1080, ~45-60s, Annie VO, animated brand background, mock-UI visualizations, lowkey captions). Use when the user provides a changelog/digest markdown and wants the weekly video, or says "changelog video". Self-contained — fonts, background, lexicon, and scripts ship in this skill.
subTools.description_zh: 將每週更新日誌 .md 轉換為完成的品牌更新影片（1080 平方、約 45-60 秒、Annie 語音合成、動畫品牌背景、模擬 UI 視覺化、低調字幕）。當使用者提供更新日誌 markdown 並要求每週影片，或提及「更新日誌影片」時使用。字體、背景、詞彙與腳本均已包含於此技能中。

subTools.name: Cut The Curve
subTools.description: The technique catalog: five velocity-matched SEAMS (zoom-through, INVERSE zoom-through, cut-the-curve, waterfall cut, rack-focus blur-cut) plus the two in-scene techniques — waterfall ENTRY (staggered arrival cascades for title cards / segment openers) and the nudge curve (slow-fast-slow three-phase group slides). Covers partial-travel (~12% of frame) velocity matching via mirrored power4 eases, the Z scale-sign rule, size-scaled blur (10px text / 18-20px full-frame), word-by-word staggered cuts, cascade pacing by element weight, and the 10/65/25 slide ratio. Read before authoring any transition, text-beat handoff, kinetic text entry, or group reposition. [depth, zoom, inverse-zoom, scale-sign, mirrored-zoom, rack-focus, pacing, velocity, cut-the-curve, waterfall, stagger, cascade, kinetic-text, title-card, segment-opener, nudge, slide, easing, group-motion, z-depth, motion-graphics, cinematic, transition, blur, directional-continuity]
subTools.description_zh: 技術目錄：五種速度匹配的接縫（縮放穿透、反向縮放穿透、切割曲線、瀑布切割、移焦模糊切割），以及兩種場景內技術——瀑布進入（標題卡／段落開頭的錯位 cascades）與輕推曲線（慢－快－慢三階段群組滑動）。涵蓋透過鏡射 power4 緩動實現約 12% 畫面比例的Partial-travel速度匹配。

subTools.name: Motion Doctrine
subTools.description: GATEWAY — load FIRST before composing any HyperFrames animation or video. The high-level motion law that makes a multi-scene video feel like ONE continuous camera move instead of a stack of independently-animated slides. Covers the vector law (how you exit determines how you enter, incl. the Z scale-sign rule), the film's current, carrier elements, causal motion, the Seam Gate (build-gate enforcement), the ban on idle wobble (motion must PERFORM, not breathe), stillness-before-climax, and the sustained-motion routes. Routes to the low-level technique skills (cut-the-curve — the full catalog incl. waterfall entry + nudge curve, oversized-cursor, seam-craft). These rules SUPERSEDE generic / upstream motion guidance. [continuity, direction, vector, momentum, seam, transition, ease, performance, idle-motion, narrative-motion, film-grammar]
subTools.description_zh: 入口——組成任何 HyperFrames 動畫或影片時，必須優先載入。讓多場景影片感覺像單一連續攝影機移動的高層動態法則。涵蓋向量法則（退出方式決定進入方式，含 Z 縮放符號規則）、影片流向、載體元素、因果動態，以及接縫閘門（建構閘門執行）。

subTools.name: Oversized Cursor
subTools.description: House-style oversized macOS cursor technique for HyperFrames launch videos. Load whenever a scene involves cursors or a pointer-led action, when kicking off a UI scene, when igniting a morph/transition/typing run with a click, or when a scene reads as static, dead, or stale and needs a cheap high-yield source of motion to carry the viewer's eye and segment them out of the stale state. Covers cursor size/look (incl. brand-motif cursors), the off-screen entry law, tip-targeting and the click tap, click-ignites-the-next-beat, and exit / cross-scene handoff.
subTools.description_zh: HyperFrames 發布影片使用的 macOS 超大遊標技巧。當場景涉及遊標或指針操作、啟動 UI 場景、以點擊觸發形變/過場/輸入段落，或場景呈現靜態沉悶需要動感引導視線時載入。

subTools.name: Seam Craft
subTools.description: Render-correctness doctrine for scene-to-scene seams in HyperFrames launch videos — the prerequisites that make transitions composite correctly on the master timeline. Load when assembling the master timeline / index.html, when a white flash appears at a cut or crossfade seam (especially on dark films), when reasoning about why a transition opacity dip shows through, or when verifying the render-side mechanics of how overlapping scene wrappers blend. Covers the opaque stage-ground (#root background) white-flash guard and how the injector overlaps wrappers, holds final frames, ping-pongs tracks, and stamps lint-clean template code onto the master timeline. Does NOT contain the per-transition catalog — see the transition registry for individual transition entries.
subTools.description_zh: HyperFrames 發布影片場景間接縫的渲染正確性準則——確保過場在母片時間軸上正確合成的前置條件。組裝母片時間軸/index.html、剪輯處出現白閃、過場透明度下降顯現，或驗證渲染結果時載入。

subTools.name: Captions Overlay

Load when adding captions/subtitles to a talking-head or launch video, when deciding whether a phrase should be dropped, ride the verbatim rail, or be promoted to a scarce embedded climax, when laying out a composition that will carry captions (do NOT reserve a keep-out band), or when centering a composition on the true frame center under captions. Quotes the rail+embed model from embedded-captions and constraint #13 (captions overlay, keep-out band retired) from the product-launch-video scene agent. Applies ON TOP of embedded-captions.

subTools.description: Turn a weekly changelog .md into a finished branded changelog video (square 1080, ~45-60s, Annie VO, animated brand background, mock-UI visualizations, lowkey captions). Use when the user provides a changelog/digest markdown and wants the weekly video, or says "changelog video". Self-contained — fonts, background, lexicon, and scripts ship in this skill.
subTools.description_zh: 將每週更新日誌 .md 轉為成品品牌更新影片（1080 正方形、約 45–60 秒、Annie 配音、動畫品牌背景、模擬 UI 視覺、低調字幕）。使用者提供更新日誌 markdown 並要求每週影片，或提到「更新日誌影片」時使用。字型、背景、詞彙與腳本均隨此技能提供。

subTools.name: Cut The Curve
subTools.description: The technique catalog: five velocity-matched SEAMS (zoom-through, INVERSE zoom-through, cut-the-curve, waterfall cut, rack-focus blur-cut) plus the two in-scene techniques — waterfall ENTRY (staggered arrival cascades for title cards / segment openers) and the nudge curve (slow-fast-slow three-phase group slides). Covers partial-travel (~12% of frame) velocity matching via mirrored power4 eases, the Z scale-sign rule, size-scaled blur (10px text / 18-20px full-frame), word-by-word staggered cuts, cascade pacing by element weight, and the 10/65/25 slide ratio. Read before authoring any transition, text-beat handoff, kinetic text entry, or group reposition. [depth, zoom, inverse-zoom, scale-sign, mirrored-zoom, rack-focus, pacing, velocity, cut-the-curve, waterfall, stagger, cascade, kinetic-text, title-card, segment-opener, nudge, slide, easing, group-motion, z-depth, motion-graphics, cinematic, transition, blur, directional-continuity]
subTools.description_zh: 技巧目錄：五種速度匹配的 SEAMS（縮放穿過、反轉縮放穿過、切割曲線、瀑布切割、rack-focus 模糊切割），以及兩種場景內技法——瀑布式進入（標題卡／段落開場的錯落到達級聯）和推擠曲線（慢－快－慢三階段群體滑動）。涵蓋透過鏡射 power4 eases 實現約 12% 畫框行程的速度匹配。

subTools.name: Motion Doctrine
subTools.description: GATEWAY — load FIRST before composing any HyperFrames animation or video. The high-level motion law that makes a multi-scene video feel like ONE continuous camera move instead of a stack of independently-animated slides. Covers the vector law (how you exit determines how you enter, incl. the Z scale-sign rule), the film's current, carrier elements, causal motion, the Seam Gate (build-gate enforcement), the ban on idle wobble (motion must PERFORM, not breathe), stillness-before-climax, and the sustained-motion routes. Routes to the low-level technique skills (cut-the-curve — the full catalog incl. waterfall entry + nudge curve, oversized-cursor, seam-craft). These rules SUPERSEDE generic / upstream motion guidance. [continuity, direction, vector, momentum, seam, transition, ease, performance, idle-motion, narrative-motion, film-grammar]
subTools.description_zh: 入門前置——在編排任何 HyperFrames 動畫或影片前優先載入。讓多場景影片感覺像單一支連續鏡頭，而非一疊獨立動畫投影片的進階動勢原則。涵蓋向量法則（如何退出決定如何進入，含 Z 縮放符號規則）、影片的當前流動、載體元素、因果動勢、縫合閘門（build-gate 執行機制）。

subTools.name: Oversized Cursor
subTools.description: House-style oversized macOS cursor technique for HyperFrames launch videos. Load whenever a scene involves cursors or a pointer-led action, when kicking off a UI scene, when igniting a morph/transition/typing run with a click, or when a scene reads as static, dead, or stale and needs a cheap high-yield source of motion to carry the viewer's eye and segment them out of the stale state. Covers cursor size/look (incl. brand-motif cursors), the off-screen entry law, tip-targeting and the click tap, click-ignites-the-next-beat, and exit / cross-scene handoff.
subTools.description_zh: HyperFrames 發布影片的 House 風格超大型 macOS 游標技法。當場景涉及游標或指向動作、開啟 UI 場景、以點擊觸發變形／轉場／打字序列，或場景顯得靜止呆滯需要低成本高效益的動勢來源來引導觀眾視線時載入。涵蓋游標樣式與動畫設定。

subTools.name: Seam Craft
subTools.description: Render-correctness doctrine for scene-to-scene seams in HyperFrames launch videos — the prerequisites that make transitions composite correctly on the master timeline. Load when assembling the master timeline / index.html, when a white flash appears at a cut or crossfade seam (especially on dark films), when reasoning about why a transition opacity dip shows through, or when verifying the render-side mechanics of how overlapping scene wrappers blend. Covers the opaque stage-ground (#root background) white-flash guard and how the injector overlaps wrappers, holds final frames, ping-pongs tracks, and stamps lint-clean template code onto the master timeline. Does NOT contain the per-transition catalog — see the transition registry for individual transition entries.
subTools.description_zh: HyperFrames 發布影片中場景間縫合的渲染正確性法則——確保轉場在主時間軸上正常合成的前置條件。在組裝主時間軸／index.html、出現白色閃光切割或淡入淡出縫合（特別是暗色影片）、分析轉場透明度凹陷透出原因，或驗證渲染結果時載入。

subTools.name: Faceless Explainer
subTools.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.
subTools.description_zh: 將文章、筆記、主題或簡報等文字，轉化為無臉解說影片。畫面不依賴實際場景或 footage，而是為每個場景量身打造視覺內容，包含字型設計、抽象圖形、圖表與資料視覺化。適用於主題說明、概念解析、操作指南與清單類內容。若內容不明確，請改採 /hyperframes。

subTools.name: Figma
subTools.description: Import Figma content into a HyperFrames composition — rendered assets, brand tokens, components, storyboard sections → reconstructed motion (frames read as states, not slides) (REST/CLI), connector-assisted motion when available, and shaders from a connector or native export. Use when the user pastes a figma.com link or asks to bring a Figma design, frame, logo, brand, or animation into a video/composition.
subTools.description_zh: 將 Figma 內容導入 HyperFrames 組合，含渲染資產、品牌標識、元件與分鏡區塊。框架會以狀態方式被讀取並重建動態效果，支援 REST/CLI、connctor 輔助動畫與 shader 特效。當使用者貼上 figma.com 連結或要求將 Figma 設計、框架、Logo、品牌或動畫嵌入影片時使用。

subTools.name: Hyperframes Animation
subTools.description: All animation knowledge for HyperFrames — atomic motion rules, multi-phase scene blueprints, scene transitions, broader motion-design techniques, AND the seven runtime adapters (GSAP default, plus Lottie, Three.js, Anime.js, CSS keyframes, Web Animations API, TypeGPU). Use for any motion or animation task: pick 2-4 rules and compose, or load a blueprint, or look up runtime-specific API (e.g. GSAP eases / Lottie player / Three.js mixer). Also covers auditing an existing composition's choreography (animation map) and 24 named text-animation effects. HyperFrames-native: single paused timeline, seek-safe, deterministic.
subTools.description_zh: HyperFrames 全套動畫知識：原子級動作規則、多階段場景藍圖、場景轉場與運動設計技術，以及七大執行時適配器（預設 GSAP，另有 Lottie、Three.js、Anime.js、CSS keyframes、Web Animations API、TypeGPU）。任何動效任務都適用：挑 2-4 條規則組件化、載入藍圖，或查特定 runtime API。

subTools.name: Hyperframes Core
subTools.description: The HyperFrames composition contract — build one renderable project. Use for composition structure, the `data-*` timing attributes, `class="clip"`, tracks, sub-compositions, variables, framework-owned media playback, deterministic-render rules, and validation. Read before writing composition HTML.
subTools.description_zh: HyperFrames 的組成合約——建立單一可渲染專案。用於組成結構、`data-*` 時間屬性、`class="clip"`、軌道、子組成、變數、框架自有媒體播放、確定性渲染規則與驗證。撰寫組成 HTML 前請先閱讀。

subTools.name: Hyperframes Creative
subTools.description: Non-animation creative direction for HyperFrames videos. Use for design spec (frame.md / design.md) handling, palettes, typography, narration, beat planning, audio-reactive visuals, composition patterns, and brand / style decisions. For atomic motion patterns and scene blueprints, use `hyperframes-animation`.
subTools.description_zh: HyperFrames 影片的非動畫創意方向。用於設計規範（frame.md / design.md）處理、配色、字體、旁白、節拍規劃、音訊反應視覺、組成模式與品牌／風格決策。原子運動模式與場景藍圖請改用 `hyperframes-animation`。

subTools.name: Hyperframes Registry
subTools.description: Search, install, and wire registry blocks and components into HyperFrames compositions. Use BEFORE hand-building any named visual — whenever a brief, a user, or a storyboard names a look, effect, treatment, or transition such as CRT scanlines, glitch, chromatic aberration, film grain, a shimmer sweep, a chart, a code or terminal window, a map, or a confetti burst — because roughly 400 hosted items already cover many of them and the search ranks all of them with nothing installed, no project, and no account. Also use when running hyperframes add or hyperframes catalog, installing one item or every block matching a tag, wiring an installed item into index.html, or working with hyperframes.json. Covers discovery, install locations, block sub-composition wiring, component snippet merging, and authoring a new block or component to contribute upstream (idea → scaffold → validate → PR).
subTools.description_zh: 搜尋、安裝並接入註冊表區塊與元件至 HyperFrames 組成。凡簡報、使用者或分鏡表提到特定外觀、效果、處理或轉場（如 CRT 掃描線、故障、色差、電影顆粒、閃爍掃掠、圖表、程式碼或終端視窗、地圖、紙花爆發等），請優先使用——註冊表內約有 400 個托管項目。

subTools.name: Media Use
subTools.description: Agent Media OS, the single skill for every media need in a HyperFrames project. Resolve BGM, SFX, image, icon, brand logo, voice, color grade, or LUT into a frozen local file or paste-ready block + ledger record (one verb, `resolve`); generate via TTS / music / image models when the catalog misses; produce voiceover, transcription, captions, and background removal through one shared audio engine; operate on media (cut / reframe / transform); and reuse assets across projects. Also use for vague feedback that real footage looks dark, flat, boring, should feel retro/camcorder/print/ASCII, needs privacy, or needs a media reveal.
subTools.description_zh: Agent Media OS，HyperFrames 專案中唯一滿足所有媒體需求的技能。從目錄解析 BGM、音效、圖片、圖示、品牌 Logo、語音、調色或 LUT，輸出凍結本機檔案或可直接貼上的程式碼區塊，並產生帳目紀錄（動詞：resolve）；目錄缺少時透過 TTS／音樂／影像模型生成；透過共用音訊引擎產出旁白、轉錄、字幕與背景移除。

subTools.name: Music To Video
subTools.description: Turn a music track (an audio file, a video to pull audio from, or a track generated from a mood brief) into a beat-synced video — lyric video, slideshow, or kinetic promo. The music drives all pacing; any user-supplied images/videos are cut onto the same beat grid, and a complete video needs zero assets. Narrated pieces → the input-matched workflow (see /hyperframes). Unclear → /hyperframes.
subTools.description_zh: 將音樂軌道（音檔、可提取音訊的影片，或由情緒簡報生成的曲目）轉換為節奏同步的影片——歌詞MV、投影片或動態宣傳片。音樂主導所有節奏；任何使用者提供的圖片或影片都對齊到同一節奏網格；完整影片不需任何資產。包含旁白的作品轉至輸入配對流程（見 /hyperframes）。不確定→ /hyperframes。

subTools.name: Pr To Video
subTools.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.
subTools.description_zh: 將 GitHub  Pull Request（PR URL、owner/repo#N，或已簽出倉庫中的 'this PR'）轉換為程式碼變更解說影片——由 diff、提交紀錄與檔案組成的更新日誌、功能揭露、修復說明或重構導讀。輸入是程式碼變更，而非網站。非產品宣傳（/product-launch-video）也非無 PR 主題解說（/faceless-explainer）。不確定→ /hyperframes。

subTools.name: Product Launch Video
subTools.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.
subTools.description_zh: 將產品或行銷 URL、貼上腳本或簡報轉換為產品發布／宣傳影片——SaaS 宣傳、功能揭露、產品展示、應用與公司發布。當使用者希望行銷、發布、推廣或揭露產品時使用，適用於任何商業 URL。網站導覽或展示也由此處理——簡報承載「原樣展示」意圖。不確定→ /hyperframes。

subTools.name: Remotion To Hyperframes
subTools.description: Port an existing Remotion (React) composition''s source to HyperFrames HTML. Use ONLY on an explicit ask to port/convert/migrate/translate a Remotion source — one-way, Remotion-only. A passing Remotion mention, reference-only code, or "make something like my Remotion video" is a fresh build (/general-video). Unclear → /hyperframes.
subTools.description_zh: 將現有 Remotion（React）組件的來源移植至 HyperFrames HTML。僅在明確要求移植／轉換／遷移 Remotion 來源時使用——單向且僅限 Remotion。僅提及 Remotion、參考性程式碼，或「做出類似我 Remotion 影片的」皆為全新建置（/general-video）。不確定→ /hyperframes。

subTools.name: Talking Head Recut
subTools.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.
subTools.description_zh: 為訪談、Podcast 影片新增時間軸圖文特效（動態標題、人名條、資料標記、引言、側邊面板、小圖插播），與文字稿同步，支援 16:9/9:16/4:5 畫布，原片不變。

tools.name: Hy3
tools.description: Tencent Hunyuan's 295B MoE reasoning model with strong agentic capabilities and cost-efficient inference.
triggers: 推導複雜邏輯與數學題
分析商業數據生成報告
自動調度網頁搜尋與程式碼執行
低成本處理高頻複雜問答
tools.useCase: Complex multi-step reasoning tasks requiring tool use, such as autonomous research agents that search, analyze, and synthesize information across multiple sources.
advantages: Mixture-of-Experts (295B total / 21B active) architecture enables high reasoning performance with reduced inference cost
Purpose-built agentic workflows with strong tool-use and planning capabilities
Cost-efficient inference makes it practical for production-scale agent deployments
negativeConstraints: Not ideal for simple single-turn Q&A where smaller, faster models suffice
Avoid for real-time low-latency applications requiring sub-second response times
Not suitable for edge or on-device deployment due to large model size
tools.description_zh: 騰訊 Hunyuan 的 295B MoE 推理模型，具備強大代理能力和成本效益推論。
tools.useCase_zh: 需要工具使用的複雜多步驟推理任務，例如跨多來源搜尋、分析和綜合資訊的自主研究代理。
tools.advantages_zh: 專家混合架構（總計 295B / 活躍 21B）實現高推理效能並降低推論成本，專為強大工具使用和規劃能力的代理工作流程設計，成本效益推論使其適用於生產規模的代理部署
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合僅需較小、較快模型即可應付的簡單單輪問答
不適合需要次秒級回應時間的即時低延遲應用
因模型體積龐大，不適合部署於邊緣裝置或端側

tools.name: MiMo V2.5 ASR
tools.description: Xiaomi's multilingual ASR model with dialect recognition and robust performance in complex acoustic environments.
tools.useCase: Transcribing customer service calls in regional dialects across multiple languages for real-time sentiment analysis and quality assurance.
advantages: Supports multilingual speech recognition across diverse languages and dialects
Maintains high accuracy in complex acoustic scenarios such as noisy environments
Optimized for robust real-time speech-to-text processing at scale
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for sign language or visual gesture recognition tasks
Not designed for speaker diarization or multi-speaker separation
Not intended for music transcription or non-speech audio classification
tools.description_zh: 小米的多語言 ASR 模型，具備方言識別和在複雜聲學環境中的穩定表現。
tools.useCase_zh: 轉錄多種語言的地區方言客服電話，用於即時情感分析和品質保證。
tools.advantages_zh: 支援多種語言和方言的多語言語音識別，在噪雜環境等複雜聲學場景中保持高精度，針對大規模穩定即時語音轉文字處理進行優化
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合手語或視覺手勢辨識任務
非為發聲者分離或多說話者分離而設計
不適用於音樂轉錄或非語音音訊分類

tools.name: MiniMax M3
tools.description: Advanced language model with strong reasoning, coding, and agentic capabilities for practical applications.
tools.useCase: Building autonomous AI agents that can plan, reason through complex multi-step tasks, and generate production-ready code.
advantages: Strong reasoning and problem-solving across diverse domains
High-quality code generation with agentic workflow support
Optimized for real-world deployment and practical applications
negativeConstraints: Real-time low-latency applications requiring sub-100ms responses
Highly regulated domains like medical diagnosis or legal advice without human oversight
Resource-constrained edge devices with limited compute
tools.description_zh: 具備強大推理、編碼和代理能力的先進語言模型，適用於實際應用。
tools.useCase_zh: 構建自主 AI 代理，能夠規劃、推理複雜多步驟任務並生成可直接上線使用的程式碼。
tools.advantages_zh: 跨多樣領域的強大推理和問題解決能力，支援代理工作流程的高品質程式碼生成，針對實際部署和實用應用進行優化
negativeConstraints_zh: 需要次百毫秒回應的即時低延遲應用
無人工監督的高度監管領域，如醫療診斷或法律建議
運算資源有限的邊緣裝置

tools.name: GLM 5
tools.description: Z.ai's agentic coding model for autonomous multi-step development workflows.
triggers: 把需求直接變成可運行程式
幫我規劃並實作功能模組
自動拆解需求寫完整程式
tools.useCase: Automating end-to-end software feature development by planning, writing, testing, and iterating code without manual intervention.
advantages: Supports long-horizon autonomous workflows with multi-step planning and execution
Bridges interactive vibe coding with fully agentic engineering capabilities
Reduces manual oversight by handling complex coding tasks independently
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for simple one-off code snippets or trivial scripting tasks
Avoid for real-time latency-sensitive applications requiring instant responses
Not ideal for domains requiring strict regulatory compliance without human review
tools.description_zh: Z.ai 的 agentic 程式碼模型，用於自主多步驟開發工作流程。
tools.useCase_zh: 自動化端到端軟體功能開發，透過規劃、編寫、測試與迭代程式碼，無需人工介入。
tools.advantages_zh: 支援具多步驟規劃與執行的長程自主工作流程，結合互動式協作編碼與完整 agentic 工程能力，獨立處理複雜程式碼任務以降低人工監督需求。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合簡單的即時程式碼片段或瑣碎腳本任務
不適合需要即時回應的延遲敏感應用
不適合需要嚴格法規合規性且無人類審核的領域

tools.name: Step 3.7 Flash
tools.description: High-efficiency Flash model optimized for fast, cost-effective production agentic workflows.
triggers: 低成本的 LLM 呼叫
tools.useCase: Deploying large-scale customer service agents that require sub-second response times while minimizing inference costs.
advantages: Optimized for fast inference with reduced latency in production environments
Cost-efficient architecture designed for high-throughput agentic workflows
Production-ready with real-world agent deployment capabilities
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for research or experimental model development requiring custom architectures
Avoid for tasks requiring deep reasoning or complex multi-step analysis
Not ideal for low-resource environments without GPU acceleration
tools.description_zh: 高效率 Flash 模型，優化於快速且具成本效益的生產環境 agentic 工作流程。
tools.useCase_zh: 部署需要次秒級回應的超大規模客戶服務 agent，同時最小化推論成本。
tools.advantages_zh: 優化快速推論，降低生產環境延遲，具高效能架構專為高吞吐量 agentic 工作流程設計，已通過實際 agent 部署驗證。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合需要自訂架構的研究或實驗性模型開發
不適合需要深度推理或複雜多步驟分析的任務
不適合無 GPU 加速的低資源環境

tools.name: PPT Agent Skills
tools.description: Multi-agent framework for code-driven PPTX generation from HTML, enabling programmatic slide creation.
tools.useCase: Engineering teams can generate investor pitch decks or technical documentation programmatically using version-controlled code instead of manual slide design.
advantages: Generates PPTX directly from HTML, enabling version-controlled and reproducible presentation workflows
Leverages multi-agent collaboration to handle complex, structured content generation across slides
Supports code-driven iteration for rapid prototyping and automated presentation updates
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for visually-heavy presentations requiring custom graphics, animations, or freeform design
Not ideal for non-technical users who prefer GUI-based slide editors like PowerPoint or Google Slides
Not appropriate for one-off presentations where programmatic automation adds unnecessary complexity
tools.description_zh: 多 agent 框架，從 HTML 程式碼驅動生成 PPTX，支援程式化簡報建立。

Built-in privacy safeguards preventing raw data leakage to external LLM providers

tools.description: High-performance in-process SQL OLAP database management system for analytical queries.

advantages: Vectorized columnar execution engine running 10x-100x faster than traditional SQLite

Zero-dependency single binary footprint embedding seamlessly into Python or Node.js applications
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for high-concurrency transactional OLTP web applications with frequent single-row writes
Avoid for distributed multi-node cloud data warehousing workloads requiring petabyte clustering
tools.description_zh: 高績效內嵌式 SQL OLAP 資料庫管理系統，用於分析查詢。
tools.useCase_zh: 對大型 Parquet 檔案、CSV 或 DataFrames 執行高速分析 SQL 查詢，無需任何資料庫設定。
tools.advantages_zh: 向量化列儲存執行引擎，速度比傳統 SQLite 快 10-100 倍；對 Arrow、Pandas 和 Parquet 檔案進行零拷貝查詢，無需複製資料；無相依性的單一二進位檔，可無縫嵌入 Python 或 Node.js 應用程式。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合需要頻繁單列寫入的高併發交易型 OLTP 網頁應用程式

advantages: Written in Rust with multi-threaded parallel execution utilizing all available CPU cores
Lazy evaluation API with query optimizer reducing redundant computations and memory usage
Built natively on Apache Arrow memory model for seamless zero-copy interoperability
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for projects bound to legacy Pandas-specific third-party plugin ecosystems
Avoid when simple lightweight dictionary transformations are sufficient without dataframe overhead

tools.useCase_zh: 使用多執行緒和最佳化延遲查詢計畫，快速處理和操作多 GB 級別的資料集。
tools.advantages_zh: 以 Rust 編寫，利用所有可用 CPU 核心進行多執行緒平行執行；延遲求值 API 搭配查詢最佳化器，減少冗餘計算和記憶體使用；原生建立在 Apache Arrow 記憶體模型上，實現無縫零拷貝互通。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合受限於舊版 Pandas 特定第三方插件生態系的專案
當簡單的輕量字典轉換已足夠時，無需 DataFrame 額外負荷，應避免使用

tools.description: Self-organizing AI second brain for Obsidian + Claude Code. Drop any source and Claude reads, links, and files it into one connected knowledge graph of plain Markdown you own. AI note-taking, personal knowledge management (PKM), and an open-source Notion alternative. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern.

subTools.name: Canvas
subTools.description: Visual layer of the wiki. Add images, text cards, PDFs, and wiki pages to Obsidian canvas files with auto-positioning inside zones. Integrates with /banana for image capture. Triggers on: /canvas, canvas new, canvas add image, canvas add text, canvas add pdf, canvas add note, canvas zone, canvas list, canvas from banana, add to canvas, put this on the canvas, open canvas, create canvas.
subTools.description_zh: Wiki 的視覺層。將圖片、文字卡片、PDF 和 Wiki 頁面新增至 Obsidian 畫布檔案，並在區域內自動定位。與 /banana 整合進行影像擷取。觸發條件：/canvas、canvas new、canvas add image、canvas add text、canvas add pdf、canvas add note、canvas zone、canvas list、canvas from banana、add to canvas、put this on the canvas、open canvas、create canvas。

subTools.name: Defuddle
subTools.description: Strip clutter from web pages before ingesting into the wiki. Removes ads, navigation, headers, footers, and boilerplate: leaving clean readable markdown that saves 40-60% tokens. Triggers on: defuddle, clean this page, strip this url, fetch and clean, clean web content before ingesting, strip ads, remove clutter, clean URL content, readable markdown from URL.
subTools.description_zh: 在將網頁內容納入 Wiki 前移除雜訊。清除廣告、導航列、標頭、頁尾及模板文字，留下清晰易讀的 Markdown，可節省 40–60% 的 token。觸發條件：defuddle、clean this page、strip this url、fetch and clean、clean web content before ingesting、strip ads、remove clutter、clean URL content、readable markdown from URL。

subTools.name: Obsidian Bases
subTools.description: Create and edit Obsidian Bases (.base files): Obsidian's native database layer for dynamic tables, card views, list views, filters, formulas, and summaries over vault notes. Triggers on: create a base, add a base file, obsidian bases, base view, filter notes, formula, database view, dynamic table, task tracker base, reading list base.
subTools.description_zh: 建立與編輯 Obsidian Bases（.base 檔案）：這是 Obsidian 原生的資料庫層，可在 Vault 筆記上提供動態表格、卡片檢視、清單檢視、篩選器、公式與摘要。觸發條件：create a base、add a base file、obsidian bases、base view、filter notes、formula、database view、dynamic table、task tracker base、reading list base。

subTools.name: Obsidian Markdown
subTools.description: Write correct Obsidian Flavored Markdown: wikilinks, embeds, callouts, properties, tags, highlights, math, and canvas syntax. Reference this when creating or editing any wiki page. Triggers on: write obsidian note, obsidian syntax, wikilink, callout, embed, obsidian markdown, wikilink format, callout syntax, embed syntax, obsidian formatting, how to write obsidian markdown.
subTools.description_zh: 撰寫正確的 Obsidian Flavored Markdown：wikilinks、嵌入、callouts、屬性、標籤、高亮、數學語法與 canvas 語法。建立或編輯 wiki 頁面時請參考。觸發條件：撰寫 Obsidian 筆記、Obsidian 語法、wikilink、callout、嵌入、Obsidian Markdown 等。

subTools.name: Think
subTools.description: Apply the 10-principle thinking loop (OBSERVE-OBSERVE-LISTEN-THINK-CONNECT-CONNECT-FEEL-ACCEPT-CREATE-GROW) to any non-trivial problem. Walks Claude through external observation, metacognition, active listening, first-principles analysis, lateral connection, system orchestration, intuition, intellectual humility, generative output, and iterative growth. Triggers on: think this through, 10-principle review, /think, OBSERVE LISTEN THINK, deep think, systematic thinking, structured reasoning, walk this through, audit my thinking, am I thinking about this right.
subTools.description_zh: 對任何非平凡的問題套用 10 原則思考循環（OBSERVE-OBSERVE-LISTEN-THINK-CONNECT-CONNECT-FEEL-ACCEPT-CREATE-GROW），引導進行外部觀察、元認知、主動聆聽、第一性原理分析、側向連結、系統協調、直覺、智識謙虛、生成輸出與迭代成長。觸發條件：think this through、10-principle 等。

subTools.name: Wiki Cli
subTools.description: Default vault-mutation transport for claude-obsidian v1.7+. Wraps the Obsidian CLI (Obsidian 1.12+) as the preferred way to read, write, search, and modify vault notes from Claude — no MCP server, no REST API plugin, no TLS workarounds. Falls back to direct filesystem Read/Write/Edit when the CLI is unavailable. Triggers on: wiki-cli, obsidian cli, obsidian read, obsidian write, obsidian search, daily note, obsidian create, obsidian append, vault transport, which transport, transport detection, obsidian command line.
subTools.description_zh: claude-obsidian v1.7+ 預設 vault 變更傳輸。包裝 Obsidian CLI（需 1.12+）作為從 Claude 讀寫、搜尋與修改 vault 筆記的首選方式；無 MCP 伺服器、REST API 外掛或 TLS 繞過需求。CLI 不可用時回退直接檔案操作。觸發條件：wiki-cli、obsidian cli、read、write、search 等。

subTools.name: Wiki Fold
subTools.description: Rollup of wiki log entries into meta-pages. Reads the last 2^k entries from wiki/log.md, writes a structurally-idempotent fold page to wiki/folds/ that links back to children. Extractive summarization (no invention). Dry-run by default, stdout-only; commit mode writes and accepts that the PostToolUse hook auto-commits. Triggers on: fold the log, run a fold, run wiki-fold, log rollup, roll up log entries.
subTools.description_zh: 彙整 wiki 日誌至 meta 頁面。讀取 wiki/log.md 最後 2^k 條記錄，寫入結構冪等的摺疊頁面至 wiki/folds/ 並連結子頁面。提取式摘要（不編造）。預設 dry-run；commit 模式寫入並接受 PostToolUse hook 自動提交。觸發條件：fold the log、run a fold、wiki-fold 等。

subTools.name: Wiki Ingest
subTools.description: Ingest sources into the Obsidian wiki vault. Reads a source, extracts entities and concepts, creates or updates wiki pages, cross-references, and logs the operation. Supports files, URLs, and batch mode. Triggers on: ingest, process this source, add this to the wiki, read and file this, batch ingest, ingest all of these, ingest this url.
subTools.description_zh: 將來源匯入 Obsidian wiki vault。讀取來源、提取實體與概念、建立或更新 wiki 頁面、交叉引用，並記錄操作。支援檔案、URL 與批次模式。觸發條件：ingest、process this source、add this to the wiki、read and file this、batch ingest 等。

subTools.name: Wiki Mode
subTools.description: Methodology modes for the Compound Vault. Lets the vault declare an organizational style (LYT / PARA / Zettelkasten / Generic) that wiki-ingest, save, and autoresearch consult before filing new pages. Reads `.vault-meta/mode.json`; defaults to `generic` (v1.6/v1.7 behavior) when absent. Per the May 2026 compass artifact, methodology support was priority gap 5 — no other Claude+Obsidian competitor ships it as a first-class skill. Triggers on: set vault mode, switch to PARA, use LYT, what's my vault mode, zettelkasten setup, wiki mode, methodology mode, change mode, configure mode.
subTools.description_zh: Compound Vault 的方法論模式。允許 vault 宣告組織風格（LYT/PARA/Zettelkasten/Generic），wiki-ingest、save 與 autoresearch 在歸檔新頁面前會參考。讀取 `.vault-meta/mode.json`；不存在時預設為 `generic`。

subTools.name: Wiki Query
subTools.description: Answer questions using the Obsidian wiki vault. Reads hot cache first, then index, then relevant pages. Synthesizes answers with citations. Files good answers back as wiki pages. Supports quick, standard, and deep modes. Triggers on: what do you know about, query:, what is, explain, summarize, find in wiki, search the wiki, based on the wiki, wiki query quick, wiki query deep.
subTools.description_zh: 使用 Obsidian wiki vault 回答問題。先讀快取，再索引，最後相關頁面。綜合答案並附引用，並將良好答案回存為 wiki 頁面。支援快速、標準與深度模式。觸發條件：what do you know about、query:、what is、explain 等。

subTools.name: Wiki Retrieve
subTools.description: Hybrid retrieval primitive for the Compound Vault. Replaces the v1.6 static hot→index→drill read order with contextual-prefix + BM25 + cosine-rerank, modeled on Anthropic's Sept 2024 Contextual Retrieval research (35-49-67% retrieval-failure reduction). Opt-in via `bash bin/setup-retrieve.sh`; feature-detected by wiki-query and autoresearch. Triggers on: retrieve, hybrid retrieval, BM25, rerank, contextual retrieval, search the chunks, chunk search, vault search, semantic search, what chunks match, find relevant passages.
subTools.description_zh: Compound Vault 的混合檢索原語。取代 v1.6 靜態讀取順序，採用 contextual-prefix + BM25 + cosine-rerank，基於 Anthropic 2024 年 9 月情境檢索研究。透過腳本選擇加入；由 wiki-query 與 autoresearch 偵測功能。觸發條件：retrieve、hybrid retrieval、BM25、rerank 等。

subTools.name: Code Review
subTools.description: Review the current diff for correctness bugs and reuse/simplification/efficiency cleanups at the given effort level (low/medium: fewer, high-confidence findings; high→max: broader coverage, may include uncertain findings; ultra: deep multi-agent review in the cloud). Pass --comment to post findings as inline PR comments, or --fix to apply the findings to the working tree after the review.
subTools.description_zh: 審查當前 diff 的正確性錯誤與重用／簡化／效率清理，依努力級別（低/中/高/超高）輸出發現；可用 --comment 以行內 PR 評論發布，或 --fix 直接套用至工作樹。
