PSD／PSB 匯入僅支援 8 位元 RGB（不支援 CMYK）；簡單形狀以外的向量與直排文字在匯入時會轉成像素
原始碼需 Xcode 26 以上才能建置

tools.name: clash-verge-rev
tools.description: A modern GUI client based on Tauri, designed to run in Windows, macOS and Linux for tailored proxy experience
tools.useCase: Users who want a cross-platform (Windows, macOS, Linux) graphical client for managing Clash Meta (mihomo) proxy profiles, with TUN mode, system proxy and visual node and rule editing.
advantages: Built on the high-performance Rust and Tauri 2 framework, with a built-in Clash.Meta (mihomo) core and optional Alpha core switching
Provides TUN (virtual network card) mode and system proxy with guard, plus profile management and enhancement through Merge and Script
Supports visual node and rule editing, and WebDAV configuration backup and sync
negativeConstraints: Requires macOS version 11 or later on Apple devices.
The GPL-3.0 license may require legal compliance if used in a proprietary commercial environment.
The user must have an existing Clash configuration file; the tool does not generate the network infrastructure itself.
tools.description_zh: 基於 Tauri 的現代化圖形客戶端，可在 Windows、macOS 與 Linux 上執行，提供量身打造的代理體驗
tools.useCase_zh: 想要跨平台圖形化客戶端來管理 Clash Meta（mihomo）代理配置檔案的用戶，包含 TUN 模式、系統代理與圖形化的節點與規則編輯。
advantages_zh: 基於高效能的 Rust 與 Tauri 2 框架，內建 Clash.Meta（mihomo）核心，並可切換 Alpha 版核心
提供 TUN（虛擬網卡）模式與含守護機制的系統代理，並透過 Merge 與 Script 管理及增強設定檔
支援視覺化節點與規則編輯，以及 WebDAV 設定檔備份與同步
negativeConstraints_zh: 需使用 macOS 11 或更高版本（Apple 裝置）。
GPL-3.0 授權可能在專有商業環境中需遵守相關法律規範。
使用者必須已有 Clash 設定檔；此工具本身不會建立網路基礎架構。

tools.name: how-to-live-better
tools.description: 《高性價比人生指南》全書 528 條的在線單頁閱讀版：手機可讀、可搜索、零依賴、支持離線
tools.useCase: A user wants to read evidence-based life advice on a mobile device without internet access or installing any applications, opening the single-file HTML page directly on their phone or another person's computer.
advantages: Completely self-contained single-file HTML with zero external resources, ensuring readability even when offline.
Immediate usability with no build process or installation required, supporting direct double-click execution or printing.
Integrated full-text keyword search with result highlighting and specific filters for A-level evidence or plain-language explanations.
negativeConstraints: Not suitable for users who expect interactive features, user accounts, or real-time data synchronization, as the content is a static snapshot of the upstream repository.
Requires an upstream clone and Python environment only for regeneration; it cannot dynamically fetch updates from the source book directly in the browser.
tools.useCase_zh: 使用者希望在不行動裝置、無網路連線或不安裝任何應用程式的情況下閱讀基於證據的人生建議，直接在手機或他人電腦上開啟這個單檔案 HTML 頁面。
advantages_zh: 完全自包含的單檔案 HTML，零外部資源依賴，即使斷網也能流暢閱讀。
無需建置或安裝流程，可直接雙擊執行或列印，使用門檻極低。
內建全站關鍵字搜尋與結果高亮，並提供篩選 A 級證據或「說人話」內容的功能。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適合期望具備互動功能、使用者帳號或即時資料同步的使用者，因為內容為上游儲存庫的靜態快照。
僅在重新生成時需要上游複製與 Python 環境；無法直接在瀏覽器中動態從源書籍擷取更新。
tools.description_zh: 《高性價比人生指南》全書 528 條的在線單頁閱讀版：手機可讀、可搜索、零依賴、支援離線

tools.name: magpie
tools.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.
tools.useCase: A developer using multiple AI coding agents (like Claude Code and Codex) switches their underlying models from a unified macOS/Windows/Linux menu bar or TUI without manually editing configuration files.
advantages: Automatically fails over to the next account or model in a routing group when a quota is exhausted, ensuring the agent never sees an error.
Consolidates management of multiple AI coding agents and providers into a single local gateway with a unified interface.
Supports a wide range of deployment environments including native desktop apps, CLI, Docker, and Termux on Linux.
negativeConstraints: Not necessary for users who only use a single AI coding agent exclusively on its vendor's own native plan.
Requires local installation or a gateway instance; purely cloud-hosted agents that do not support custom base URLs or local configuration injection cannot be managed directly.
tools.useCase_zh: 一名同時使用多個 AI 編碼代理（例如 Claude Code 與 Codex）的開發者，透過統一的 macOS、Windows 或 Linux 選單列或 TUI，無須手動編輯設定檔即可切換其底層模型。
advantages_zh: 當配額用盡時，會自動切換至路由群組中的下一個帳戶或模型，確保代理不會收到錯誤訊息。
透過單一本地網關與統一介面，整合管理多個 AI 編碼代理與供應商。
支援多種部署環境，包括原生桌面應用程式、CLI、Docker 以及 Linux 上的 Termux。
tools.description_zh: 每個 Agent 的模型。一個地方。Codex 在 DeepSeek，Claude Code 在 Kimi，從選單列即可存取。
negativeConstraints_zh: 若使用者僅專心使用單一 AI 程式設計 Agent，且僅在其供應商原生方案上使用，則此工具並非必要。
需在本機安裝或設定閘道實例；純雲端託管且不支援自訂基礎 URL 或本機設定注入的 Agent 無法直接管理。

tools.name: qingjian
tools.description: 青簡 Qingjian：用 Rust 寫的拼音輸入法，候選詞旁多一條正在學的語言的譯詞
tools.useCase: A language learner uses Qingjian as their daily Pinyin input method on macOS or Windows to automatically display translations of their typing in a target language (e.g., English, Japanese, or Spanish) next to candidate words.
advantages: Displays one target language translation per candidate word without obscuring the primary input text, integrating language learning naturally into daily typing.
Processes Pinyin conversion, dictionary lookups, local models, and habit learning entirely on-device without requiring a user account.
Stores input volume and vocabulary statistics locally only, with no data uploaded unless the optional, user-configured cloud completion feature is explicitly enabled.
Supports a variety of input modes including full-sentence input, abbreviations, spelling correction, Shuangpin, and Wubi.
negativeConstraints: Linux support is limited to Fcitx5 and requires manual startup of background services, unlike the standalone desktop apps available for macOS and Windows.
tools.useCase_zh: 語言學習者日常在 macOS 或 Windows 上使用「青簡」作為拼音輸入法，在打字時自動在候選詞旁顯示目標語言（如英語、日語或西班牙語）的譯文，藉此在無縫輸入中學習新單詞。
advantages_zh: 候選詞旁顯示的單一目標語言譯文不會遮擋主要的輸入文字，能將語言學習自然融入日常打字。
拼音轉換、詞庫查詢、本地模型與輸入習慣學習全在設備端完成，無需註冊帳號。
輸入量與詞彙統計僅儲存在本機，不會上傳；選用功能未開啟時不會發送資料。
支援多種輸入方式，包含整句輸入、簡拼、拼字糾錯、雙拼與五筆等。
tools.description_zh: 青簡 Qingjian：用 Rust 寫的拼音輸入法，候選詞旁多一條正在學的語言的譯詞
negativeConstraints_zh: Linux 支援僅限 Fcitx5，且需手動啟動背景服務，不像 macOS 與 Windows 可取得獨立桌面應用程式。

tools.name: Rea
tools.description: Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.
tools.useCase: A developer seeing a feature in a native or Electron app asks their AI agent to inspect the binary without source code, trace the logic, and build a similar implementation for their own project.
advantages: Supports multiple agent platforms including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Gemini CLI via a unified MCP interface
Capable of analyzing both native binaries and JavaScript/Electron applications with evidence-based results
Can optionally install Hopper during setup to enable native analysis capabilities
negativeConstraints: Native binary analysis requires an external engine installation (Hopper, Ghidra, or IDA) or approval to install Hopper
Static JavaScript analysis does not support native analysis engines, limiting its scope to JS/Electron contexts
Frequent updates are required due to the rapid development pace, necessitating regular execution of update commands
tools.useCase_zh: 開發人員看到原生或 Electron 應用程式中的某個功能時，詢問其 AI 代理在沒有原始碼的情況下檢查二進位檔、追蹤邏輯，並為自己的專案建構類似功能。
advantages_zh: 透過統一的 MCP 介面支援多個代理平台，包括 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 和 Gemini CLI
能夠分析原生二進位檔和 JavaScript/Electron 應用程式，並提供基於證據的結果
可選地在安裝過程中安裝 Hopper，以啟用原生分析功能
tools.description_zh: 用 agent 逆向工程任何事物，從應用程式行為到原生二進位檔案。
negativeConstraints_zh: 原生二進位分析需安裝外部引擎（Hopper、Ghidra 或 IDA），或需經批准安裝 Hopper。
靜態 JavaScript 分析不支援原生分析引擎，限制其範圍於 JS/Electron 情境。
因開發節奏快速需頻繁更新，必須定期執行更新指令。

tools.name: Photocraft
tools.description: PhotoCraft: An open-source, photo editor written by scratch in pure Rust
tools.useCase: Photoshop users needing to open, edit, and save layered PSD files offline without relying on Adobe's subscription-based desktop application can use PhotoCraft.
advantages: Achieves 100% render compatibility with 307 out of 309 psd-tools test files when saving PSD documents.
Provides native performance without web views through a wgpu GPU compositor and multithreaded copy-on-write tiles.
Implements agent-readiness by exposing every engine action as a command accessible via CLI, JSON, or MCP server interfaces.
negativeConstraints: The tool is currently in early alpha status, implying it lacks the maturity and stability of a production-grade alternative.
It functions strictly as a clean-room reimplementation of a subset of Photoshop, meaning it is not a substitute for full Adobe Creative Cloud ecosystem features.
tools.useCase_zh: 不需要依賴 Adobe 訂閱制桌面應用程式的 Photoshop 使用者，可以利用 PhotoCraft 進行離線作業，來開啟、編輯並儲存具圖層的 PSD 檔案。
advantages_zh: 在儲存 PSD 文件時，能對 309 個 psd-tools 測試檔案中的 307 個實現 100% 渲染相容性。
透過 wgpu GPU 合成器與執行緒化的 copy-on-write 磁磚技術，提供原生效能且無需網頁檢視視窗。
具備智能代理準備功能，允許透過 CLI、JSON 或 MCP 伺服器介面存取引擎的每個操作指令。
tools.description_zh: PhotoCraft：以純 Rust 從頭開始編寫的開源照片編輯器
negativeConstraints_zh: 工具目前處於早期 alpha 狀態，缺乏成熟度與生產級替代方案的穩定性。
它嚴格作為 Photoshop 子集的空教室重新實作，不具備 Adobe Creative Cloud 完整生態系功能。

tools.name: DroidDeck
tools.description: DroidDeck brings the SteamOS experience to Android
tools.useCase: Gamers on Android handhelds with Adreno 730+ GPUs use it to play Windows games via Steam and Proton, along with installing Linux apps and browsing other game stores like GOG.
advantages: Supports Windows games on Android via ARM64 Proton
Integrates multiple game stores (GOG, Epic Games, Amazon) directly into the Steam client
Requires no root access and supports Adreno 730/8xx series out of the box
Includes experimental support for LSFG frame generation
negativeConstraints: Incompatible with Mali, Xclipse, PowerVR, and Adreno 710 GPUs
Requires Android 9+ and specific Adreno GPU versions (730+ or 8xx); Adreno 6xx is experimental and unstable for DirectX 12
Software rendering used for desktop compositing limits performance in non-game environments
tools.useCase_zh: 在 Adreno 730 以上 GPU 的 Android 行動裝置上，遊戲玩家使用它透過 Steam 與 Proton 玩 Windows 遊戲，並安裝 Linux 應用與瀏覽 GOG 等其他遊戲商店。
advantages_zh: 支援在 Android 上透過 ARM64 Proton 執行 Windows 遊戲
將多個遊戲商店（GOG、Epic Games、Amazon）直接整合至 Steam 客戶端
不需 root 權限，並原生支援 Adreno 730/8xx 系列
包含實驗性的 LSFG 幀生成支援
tools.description_zh: DroidDeck 將 SteamOS 體驗帶入 Android
negativeConstraints_zh: 不兼容 Mali、Xclipse、PowerVR 與 Adreno 710 GPU。
需要 Android 9+ 與特定 Adreno GPU 版本（730+ 或 8xx）；Adreno 6xx 為實驗性且於 DirectX 12 不穩定。
用於桌面合成之軟體渲染限制非遊戲環境的效能。

tools.name: Wordcraft
tools.description: An open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Microsoft Word in pure Rust
tools.useCase: Developers and automation agents use WordCraft to programmatically generate, edit, and review .docx documents in headless environments or web browsers via its Rust-based CLI and MCP interface.
advantages: Runs natively on macOS, Windows, Linux, BSD, and in the browser via WebAssembly
Agent-drivable via MCP (Model Context Protocol) and CLI interfaces
Clean-room reimplementation in Rust ensures high performance and stability without proprietary dependencies
negativeConstraints: Not a direct replacement for complex legacy .doc (Word 97-2003) file formats, as it primarily handles .docx
Limited to the specific Word workflow features implemented; advanced VBA macro execution or complex OLE object embedding may not be supported as in Microsoft Word
Being a clean-room reimplementation, it may lack compatibility with highly specific or proprietary MS Word extensions
tools.useCase_zh: 開發人員與自動化代理使用 WordCraft 在無頭環境或瀏覽器中，透過其基於 Rust 的 CLI 和 MCP 介面，程式化地建立、編輯及檢視 .docx 文件。
advantages_zh: 原生支援 macOS、Windows、Linux、BSD 以及透過 WebAssembly 在瀏覽器中執行
可透過 MCP（模型上下文協議）和 CLI 介面驅動代理操作
以 Rust 進行乾淨室重新實作，確保高效能與穩定性，且無專有依賴
tools.description_zh: 以純 Rust 對 Microsoft Word 進行的開源空教室重新實作
negativeConstraints_zh: 並非複雜歷史 .doc（Word 97-2003）檔案格式的直接替代方案，主要處理 .docx。
限於已實作之特定 Word 工作流程功能；進階 VBA 巨集執行或複雜 OLE 物件嵌入可能不如 Microsoft Word 受支援。
作為空教室重新實作，可能缺乏與高度特定或專有 MS Word 擴充功能的相容性。

tools.name: Filmcraft
tools.description: FilmCraft: An open-source, nonlinear video editor written by scratch in pure Rust
tools.useCase: A video editor with Premiere Pro experience switches to a cost-effective, cross-platform workflow to cut and grade an Apache 11 documentary using NASA public-domain footage without relying on proprietary software.
advantages: Runs natively on macOS, Windows, Linux, and in the browser via WebAssembly
Implements H.264, HEVC, ProRes, and AAC codecs in pure Rust from public specifications
Uses exact integer time frame math to ensure edits never drift across common frame rates
Designed to be driven precisely by AI agents as every action is a command
negativeConstraints: Project status is young and moving fast, so it may lack the stability of mature commercial editors
Primary target users are those familiar with the Adobe Premiere Pro workflow and interface
tools.useCase_zh: 一位具有 Premiere Pro 經驗的影片編輯者，切換至一個跨平台且無授權成本的Workflow，使用 NASA 公開領域素材剪輯並調色阿波羅 11 號記錄片，無需依賴專有軟體。
advantages_zh: 原生支援 macOS、Windows、Linux，並可透過 WebAssembly 在瀏覽器中執行
以純 Rust 根據公開規範實作 H.264、HEVC、ProRes 及 AAC 編解碼器
採用精確的整數時間幀運算，確保在常見幀率下剪輯絕不漂移
設計上允許 AI 代理精準驅動應用內的每一個動作指令
tools.description_zh: FilmCraft：一款以純 Rust 從頭撰寫的開源非線性影片編輯器
negativeConstraints_zh: 專案開發處於早期階段且快速迭代，穩定性可能不如成熟的商業編輯器
主要目標用戶為熟悉 Adobe Premiere Pro 工作流與介面的使用者

tools.name: Dsh Our Free Model
tools.description: 在 dsh 裡裝上這個插件即可，無需登錄、註冊或填 API Key，就能使用包括 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、Kimi K3 在內的前沿模型——完全免費，不限量。 All you do is install this plugin in dsh: no login, no sign-up, no API key — the frontier models are just there, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Kimi K3 among them. Completely free, with no usage cap.
tools.useCase: 在 dsh 裡裝上這個插件即可，無需登錄、註冊或填 API Key，就能使用包括 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、Kimi K3 在內的前沿模型——完全免費，不限量。 All you do is install this plugin in dsh: no login, no sign-up, no API key — the frontier models are just…
advantages: Zero dependencies and no build steps required, ensuring a lightweight and frictionless installation process.
Aggregates over 76 third-party providers and 13 free-tier channels into a single registry, allowing users to switch sources and models easily.
Includes a built-in OpenAI and Anthropic-compatible local gateway that lets other local tools access the models via standard base URLs.
Implements token savings features like tool output compression (RTK) that removes up to 90% of bytes from large contexts like git diffs.
negativeConstraints: Requires running the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) kernel version 0.1.5 through 0.1.7-rc.2 as the host environment.
The free Kilo channel explicitly warns that prompts may be recorded for service improvement, making it unsuitable for processing sensitive data.
tools.useCase_zh: 希望在 DeepSeek Harness 中免費使用前沿 AI 模型，且不希望手動管理 API 金鑰或設定服務的開發者，可以透過此插件事件接入多個模型來源並轉發給本機其他工具。
advantages_zh: 零依賴且無需構建步驟，安裝過程輕量且無障礙。
聚合超過 76 家第三方供應商與 13 個免費通道，讓使用者可輕鬆切換模型來源。
內建 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 相容的本機閘道，讓其他本機工具能透過標準 URL 存取模型。
具備 Token 節省功能，例如工具輸出壓縮，可移除大型語境（如 git diff）最多 90% 的位元組。
tools.description_zh: 在 dsh 裡裝上這個插件即可，無需登錄、註冊或填 API Key，就能使用包括 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、Kimi K3 在內的前沿模型——完全免費，不限量。All you do is install this plugin in dsh: no login, no sign-up, no API key — the frontier models are just there, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Kimi K3 among them. Completely free, with no usage cap.
negativeConstraints_zh: 需要運行 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 核心版本 0.1.5 至 0.1.7-rc.2 作為主機環境
免費的 Kilo 頻道明確警示提示內容可能被記錄用於服務改進，因此不適合處理敏感資料

tools.name: Anatomy
tools.description: An agent skill for creating detailed, interactive isometric illustrations of real-world machines and complex systems. Generates polished SVGs with optional WebGL shaders and 3D effects.
tools.useCase: A developer uses Claude Code to visualize how a rate limiter works by generating an interactive isometric illustration of the concept as a physical object.
advantages: Zero dependencies using only Node built-in modules
Generates self-verifying interactive figures with live readouts and animations
Supports multiple rendering modes including SVG, WebGL shaders, and 3D
negativeConstraints: Requires Node.js version 20.10 or later
Primarily designed for Claude Code, OpenCode, and Codex environments
Not intended for non-technical audiences or static-only infographic needs
tools.useCase_zh: 開發者在使用 Claude Code 時，透過該工具將技術概念（如速率限制器）轉換為互動式等距圖示，以視覺化方式呈現其運作機制。
advantages_zh: 零依賴，僅使用 Node.js 內建模組
能產出自我驗證的互動圖示，具備即時數據顯示與動畫效果
支援 SVG、WebGL 著色器與 3D 等多種渲染模式
tools.description_zh: 用於建立真實機械與複雜系統的精緻互動等距插圖的 agent 技能，可生成帶有可選 WebGL 著色器與 3D 效果的精美 SVG。
negativeConstraints_zh: 需要 Node.js 版本 20.10 或更高
主要設計給 Claude Code、OpenCode 與 Codex 環境使用
不適合非技術用戶或僅需靜態資訊圖表的需求

tools.name: Lightcraft
tools.description: LightCraft: An open-source non-destructive photo editor written by scratch in pure Rust
tools.useCase: Photographers process RAW files locally on their desktop or run automated batch edits via an AI agent without uploading data to the cloud.
advantages: Runs natively on macOS, Windows, and Linux, and in the browser via WebAssembly.
Includes an MCP server, allowing end-to-end control by AI agents.
Uses a pure Rust implementation for performance and stability.
Adopts a scene-referred, wide-gamut, 32-bit float pipeline for high-quality image processing.
negativeConstraints: It is currently a young project and moving fast, so features may be unstable or incomplete.
Not suitable for server-side continuous processing without a UI, as it is designed primarily as an application.
Does not support proprietary AI model integration outside of the provided MCP agent interface.
tools.useCase_zh: 攝影師在地端工作站處理 RAW 檔案，或透過 AI 代理執行自動批量修圖，無需將資料上傳至雲端。
advantages_zh: 支援 macOS、Windows、Linux 原生執行，並透過 WebAssembly 在瀏覽器中運行。
內建 MCP 伺服器，可讓 AI 代理從頭到尾控制編輯流程。
使用純 Rust 實作，具有高性能與穩定性。
採用場景參考、寬色域、32 位元浮點數管線，提供高品質影像處理。
tools.description_zh: LightCraft：一款以純 Rust 從頭撰寫的開源非破壞性圖片編輯器
negativeConstraints_zh: 該專案目前開發階段尚早且快速迭代，功能可能不夠穩定或完整
不適合無 UI 的伺服器端持續處理，因主要設計為應用程式
除提供的 MCP agent 介面外，不支援專有 AI 模型整合

tools.name: math
tools.description: A collection of 719 mathematical manuscripts and supporting Lean formalization artifacts produced by an internal OpenAI model, organized into 372 discipline-classified families with verification status annotated.
tools.useCase: Consult or cite OpenAI model-produced mathematical research: 719 manuscripts across 372 families, with ~42% carrying Lean formalizations for machine verification, plus reasoning-trace summaries and BibTeX citations.
advantages: 719 manuscripts in 372 research families, far broader than any single paper collection
~42% of results carry Lean formalizations that can be machine-verified rather than only read
Includes reasoning-trace summaries, per-manuscript BibTeX, and a preserved versioned release history
negativeConstraints: A static collection, not executable software: cannot be installed, imported as a library, or called as a service
Unformalized results may contain errors (stated explicitly upstream); verify before citing
Checking the Lean formalizations requires a Lean toolchain and substantial compute
tools.description_zh: 未提供說明。
tools.useCase_zh: 查閱或引用 OpenAI 模型產生的數學研究：涵蓋 372 個研究家族共 719 篇手稿，其中約 42% 附有 Lean 形式化以供機器驗證，並提供推理軌跡摘要與 BibTeX 引用。
tools.advantages_zh: 372 個研究家族共 719 篇手稿，規模遠超單一論文彙集；約 42% 成果附有 Lean 形式化，可供機器驗證而不僅僅是閱讀；內含推理軌跡摘要、各手稿的 BibTeX 引用，以及版本化釋出歷程。
negativeConstraints_zh: 為靜態彙集而非可執行軟體：無法安裝、匯入為程式庫或作為服務呼叫
未形式化的成果可能含有錯誤（上游已明確標示）；引用前請先行驗證
檢視 Lean 形式化需要 Lean 工具鏈與大量運算資源

tools.name: pdfcraft
tools.description: PdfCraft: An open-source PDF reader and editor written by scratch in pure Rust
tools.useCase: Developers and power users organize, split, merge, and secure local PDF documents offline on macOS, Windows, Linux, FreeBSD, or the web without uploading data to a cloud service.
advantages: Clean-room reimplementation in pure Rust that runs natively on macOS, Windows, Linux, FreeBSD, and the web.
Operates completely offline with no account, no telemetry, and no cloud dependency.
High fault tolerance: processes damaged documents with 0 crashes across the 983-file pdf.js test corpus.
Atomic writes and deep undo functionality ensure the original file bytes remain untouched during edits.
negativeConstraints: Cannot replace professional design software for creating complex vector layouts or modifying underlying PDF content structure beyond standard page management.
Requires local installation or WebAssembly execution; not a server-side API for high-throughput batch processing pipelines.
tools.useCase_zh: 開發人員與進階使用者在 macOS、Windows、Linux、FreeBSD 或網頁上離線整理、分割、合併及保護本地 PDF 文件，無需提供帳戶或上傳資料至雲端。
advantages_zh: 以純 Rust 重新實現，原生支援 macOS、Windows、Linux、FreeBSD 與網頁環境。
完全離線運作，無帳戶、無遙測、無雲端依賴。
高容錯性：在 983 個 pdf.js 測試語料庫中處理損毀文件時 0 崩潰。
原子寫入與深度還原功能，確保編輯時原始檔案位元組不被修改。
tools.description_zh: PdfCraft：以純 Rust 從頭編寫的開源 PDF 閱讀器與編輯器
negativeConstraints_zh: 無法取代專業設計軟體，用於建立複雜的向量版面或修改超出標準頁面管理範圍的 PDF 內容結構。
需在本機安裝或透過 WebAssembly 執行，非伺服器端 API，不適合高吞吐量批次處理流程。

tools.name: Strata
tools.description: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on any consumer hardware: one-click install for Windows / Linux. Strata inference engine, OpenAI/Anthropic API on localhost, optional image input.
tools.useCase: An individual developer with a gaming PC equipped with a 12 GB+ NVIDIA or AMD GPU runs a 125-billion parameter Qwen model locally via Strata to process code or chat prompts without sending data to external servers.
advantages: Runs a 125B parameter model on consumer hardware (12 GB+ VRAM) rather than requiring enterprise servers
Exposes OpenAI/Anthropic compatible APIs on localhost for direct app integration
Supports multi-GPU setups and allows AI coding agents to manage installation and runtime via an MCP server
Achieves specific inference benchmarks (e.g., up to 94 tokens/s on RTX 5070 for Q2_0) for readable speed on local machines
negativeConstraints: Requires a minimum of 12 GB VRAM and 32 GB system RAM, making it unusable on older or low-end hardware
Experiencing 1-3 minutes of system sluggishness or freezing during model initialization due to high RAM locking
Only explicitly supports NVIDIA RTX 20-50 series and specific AMD Radeon cards; other architectures are experimental or unsupported
tools.useCase_zh: 擁有配置了 12GB 以上 NVIDIA 或 AMD 顯卡的個人開發者，使用 Strata 在本機執行 1250 億參數的 Qwen 模型，以處理程式碼或對話提示，且無需將資料傳送至外部伺服器。
advantages_zh: 可在消費級硬體（12GB+ VRAM）上運行 125B 參數模型，無需企業伺服器
在本地主機上開放相容於 OpenAI/Anthropic 的 API，方便直接整合應用程式
支援多 GPU 設定，並允許 AI 編碼工具透過 MCP 伺服器管理安裝與執行
提供具體的推論基準測試數字（例如 RTX 5070 在 Q2_0 模式下可達 94 tokens/s），確保本機執行速度可讀
tools.description_zh: 在任何消費型硬體上執行 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next：一鍵安裝（Windows / Linux）。Strata 推理引擎，在 localhost 上提供 OpenAI/Anthropic API，支援可選圖片輸入。
negativeConstraints_zh: 需要至少 12 GB VRAM 與 32 GB 系統記憶體，在較舊或低階硬體上無法使用。
模型初始化期間會經歷 1–3 分鐘的系統遲滯或凍結，起因於大量鎖定記憶體。
僅明確支援 NVIDIA RTX 20–50 系列與特定 AMD Radeon 顯示卡；其他架構僅為實驗性或不支援。

tools.name: vectorcraft
tools.description: VectorCraft: An open-source, vector art tool written by scratch in pure Rust
tools.useCase: A graphic designer or developer needs to create complex vector illustrations with features like live blends and perspective grids without relying on proprietary Adobe software.
advantages: Open-source clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Illustrator workflow
Runs natively on macOS, Windows, Linux, FreeBSD, and in the browser via WebAssembly
Written in pure Rust
Includes an MCP server for agent integration
negativeConstraints: Currently in active development and may lack stability or full feature parity compared to established commercial tools
Requires Rust environment or pre-compiled binaries for local use, which may add setup overhead for non-Rust users
tools.useCase_zh: 當圖形設計師或開發人員需要進行複雜的向量插圖，例如使用即時混合和透視格線等功能，且不想依賴專有的 Adobe 軟體時。
advantages_zh: 開源的 Adobe Illustrator 工作流程乾淨室重實作
可原生運行於 macOS、Windows、Linux、FreeBSD 以及透過 WebAssembly 在瀏覽器中運行
純 Rust 撰寫
包含用於 Agent 整合的 MCP 伺服器
tools.description_zh: VectorCraft：一款以純 Rust 編寫的開源向量藝術工具。
negativeConstraints_zh: 目前處於積極開發階段，可能缺乏穩定性，或功能完整性無法與成熟的商業工具相比。
需要在本地使用 Rust 環境或預編譯二進位檔，這可能為非 Rust 用戶增加設定負擔。

tools.name: effectcraft
tools.description: EffectCraft: An open-source motion graphics and compositing tool written by scratch in pure Rust
tools.useCase: A motion graphics designer uses EffectCraft to create After Effects-style animations and export them directly to Lottie format for web and mobile applications.
advantages: Built-in Lottie import and export eliminates the need for third-party plugins for web animation delivery.
Projects are stored as versioned JSON (.ecproj), allowing clean diffs in version control systems.
Every action is scriptable via a unified command registry, supporting CLI, JSON channels, and MCP agents.
Uses pure Rust codecs (VP9, AV1, HEVC, Opus) for video and audio encoding without relying on FFmpeg.
negativeConstraints: Currently young and moving fast, implying less stability and a less mature feature set than established commercial software.
Clean-room reimplementation means it may not be 100% compatible with all existing After Effects project files or plugins.
Browser version may have performance limitations compared to native builds for heavy 3D or complex composites.
tools.useCase_zh: 動態圖形設計師使用 EffectCraft 建立類似 After Effects 的動畫，並直接匯出 Lottie 格式以供 Web 與行動應用使用。
advantages_zh: 內建 Lottie 匯入與匯出功能，無需第三方外掛即可將動畫交付給 Web。
專案檔案為版本化 JSON (.ecproj)，可在版本控制系統中進行清晰的 diff。
所有操作皆可透過統一的指令註冊表進行腳本化，支援 CLI、JSON 通道與 MCP agent。
使用純 Rust 編解碼器 (VP9, AV1, HEVC, Opus) 處理影音編碼，不依賴 FFmpeg。
tools.description_zh: EffectCraft：一款以純 Rust 編寫的開源動態圖像與合成工具。
negativeConstraints_zh: 目前尚屬新興且發展迅速，穩定性較低，功能成熟度不如已建立的商業軟體。
採用淨室重新實現，可能無法 100% 相容所有現有的 After Effects 專案檔案或外掛。
瀏覽器版本在處理厚重 3D 或複雜合成時，效能可能不如原生版本。

tools.name: DiPlay
tools.description: Independent CarPlay receiver for compatible Android head units. Wired and wireless public preview.
tools.useCase: BYD vehicle owners install the APK on their Android head unit to stream iPhone CarPlay over USB or Wi-Fi without jailbreaking the car or needing a Mac.
advantages: Installs as an independent APK on the head unit, requiring no jailbreak, dongle, Mac, or external authentication server.
Specifically supports BYD HUD navigation, drawing arrows, distance, and street names directly on the windshield via verified firmware.
Compatible with both wired USB and wireless Wi-Fi Direct/hotspot connections on Android 7.1+ head units.
negativeConstraints: Explicitly supports only BYD cars; other brands are unsupported and the developer has no plans to add brand-specific fixes.
The bundled private key is extractable and the accessory identity is experimental, making reliability and compatibility across all head units and future iOS updates unguaranteed.
Dashboard, battery, wheel-speed, and parked-video features require ADB access, whereas core CarPlay functionality does not.
tools.useCase_zh: 比亞迪車主將此 APK 安裝在車載主機上，即可透過 USB 或 Wi-Fi 串流 iPhone CarPlay，無須越獄、轉接器、Mac 或外部認證伺服器。
advantages_zh: 作為獨立 APK 安裝於車載主機，不需越獄、轉接器、Mac 或外部認證伺服器。
專屬支援比亞迪 HUD 導航，可在經確認的韌體上，將箭頭、距離與路徑名稱直接繪製於擋風玻璃上。
相容於 Android 7.1 以上車主的有線 USB 與無線 Wi-Fi 直接/熱點連線。
tools.description_zh: 相容 Android 車載主機的獨立 CarPlay 接收器。有線與無線公開測試版。
negativeConstraints_zh: 明確僅支援 BYD 車輛；其他品牌不支援，開發者亦無計畫新增品牌專用修復。
內附私密金鑰可被提取，且配件身分處於實驗階段，無法保證在所有車載主機及未來 iOS 更新中的可靠性與相容性。
儀表板、電池、輪速與停車影片等功能需要 ADB 存取權限，而核心 CarPlay 功能則不需要。

tools.name: shaders
tools.description: WebGPU components for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, JS & Framer
tools.useCase: A frontend developer implements GPU-accelerated visual effects (like gradients and cursor trails) in a React application by dropping in declarative components instead of writing raw WebGL/WebGPU code.
advantages: Provides a visual design editor at shaders.com that allows non-coders to design effects on an infinite canvas and export the exact component tree for specific frameworks.
Supports React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, and plain JavaScript through a single package with consistent props, ensuring cross-framework compatibility.
Offers an MCP server and agent skill integration, enabling AI coding assistants (like Claude or Cursor) to directly find, install, and edit shader components.
Includes a CLI tool that detects the project's framework, writes component files directly to the codebase, and maintains synchronization via a lock file.
negativeConstraints: Requires WebGPU support in the target browser/environment, as it explicitly uses WebGPU rather than legacy WebGL.
Advanced design workflows and visual editing require a Shaders account, even though the core export features are free.
tools.useCase_zh: 前端開發人員在 React 應用程式中，透過匯入聲明式元件來實作 GPU 加速的視覺效果（如漸層與游標軌跡），而非手動撰寫原始的 WebGL/WebGPU 程式碼。
advantages_zh: 提供 shaders.com 視覺化設計編輯器，讓非程式設計師可無限量畫布設計效果，並匯出特定框架的精確元件樹。
單一套件支援 React、Vue、Svelte、Solid 與原生 JavaScript，且屬性保持一致，確保跨框架相容性。
整合 MCP 伺服器與 Agent 技能，讓 AI 編碼助手（如 Claude 或 Cursor）能直接搜尋、安裝並編輯 Shader 元件。
內建 CLI 工具可偵測專案框架，直接將元件檔案寫入程式庫，並透過鎖檔（lock file）維持同步。
tools.description_zh: 適用於 React、Vue、Svelte、Solid、JS 與 Framer 的 WebGPU 元件。
negativeConstraints_zh: 需要目標瀏覽器／環境支援 WebGPU，因其明確使用 WebGPU 而非舊式 WebGL。
進階設計工作流程與視覺編輯需要 Shaders 帳號，即使核心匯出功能免費。

tools.name: RemoveMacAI
tools.description: Debloat macOS: turn off Apple Intelligence, analytics, ads and pop-ups. A native app and CLI, and every change can be undone.
tools.useCase: Mac users want to reclaim disk space and improve privacy by disabling Apple Intelligence features, stopping background analytics, and removing unused macOS clutter in a single, reversible operation.
advantages: Frees up approximately 12 GB of storage by deleting Apple Intelligence models and optional apps like GarageBand and iMovie
Native Swift app and CLI that share the same undo history, ensuring every configuration change can be reversed
Provides specific granularity to disable individual Apple Intelligence components (e.g., Genmoji, Writing Tools) without affecting others
Automatically identifies and disables third-party background updaters and helpers, such as Google's updater
negativeConstraints: Notarization warning: The app is not notarized, so users must manually override security prompts in System Settings on first launch
macOS-specific: Only works on macOS (specifically referenced in context of macOS 27) and cannot be used for other operating systems
Limited to Apple Ecosystem: Does not manage Windows or Linux software, nor does it provide system-level antivirus or firewall capabilities
tools.useCase_zh: 當 Mac 使用者想要釋放磁碟空間並增強隱私時，可以透過此工具一鍵停用 Apple Intelligence 功能、關閉背景分析追蹤，並移除未使用的 macOS 預設應用程式與設定。
advantages_zh: 透過刪除 Apple Intelligence 模型及 GarageBand 等選配應用程式，可釋放約 12 GB 的磁碟空間
原生 Swift 開發的應用程式與 CLI 共用相同的復原歷史紀錄，確保所有設定變更皆可完整還原
提供極高的細粒度控制，可單獨停用特定 Apple Intelligence 功能（如 Genmoji、寫作工具）而不影響其他功能
自動識別並停用第三方背景更新程式與輔助工具，例如 Google 的更新程式
tools.description_zh: 為 macOS 去背：關閉 Apple Intelligence、分析、廣告與彈出視窗。提供原生應用程式與 CLI，所有變更皆可撤銷。
negativeConstraints_zh: 驗證警告：該應用程式未經驗證，使用者首次啟動時必須在系統設定中手動覆蓋安全提示。
僅限 macOS：僅在 macOS 上運作（上下文中特別提及 macOS 27），無法用於其他作業系統。
限於 Apple 生態系：不管理 Windows 或 Linux 軟體，也不提供系統層級的防毒或防火牆功能。

tools.name: gridcraft
tools.description: GridCraft: an open-source, clean-room spreadsheet (Microsoft Excel-style) in pure Rust. By ArtCraft.
tools.useCase: A developer or agent uses GridCraft via MCP to automate the generation of formatted XLSX reports with charts and pivot tables without needing a Microsoft license.
advantages: Runs natively on macOS, Windows, Linux, BSD, and in the browser via WebAssembly.
Agent-drivable over MCP (Model Context Protocol) for automated spreadsheet tasks.
Clean-room reimplementation in pure Rust, ensuring it is not just a wrapper around proprietary Excel binaries.
Supports 500+ functions, dynamic arrays, LET, LAMBDA, and 17 chart types.
negativeConstraints: Does not support proprietary Microsoft Office formats like DOCX, PPTX, or native XLS (pre-2007).
Lacks native cloud synchronization features found in Microsoft 365 ecosystem.
Requires Rust toolchain or specific build configurations for native development use cases.
tools.useCase_zh: 開發者或 AI 代理透過 MCP 協議使用 GridCraft，在不依賴 Microsoft 授權的情況下，自動化產生包含圖表與樞透表的格式化 XLSX 報告。
advantages_zh: 原生支援 macOS、Windows、Linux、BSD 以及透過 WebAssembly 在瀏覽器中執行。
支援 MCP 協議，可讓 AI 代理自動化操作試算表。
以純 Rust 書寫的清潔室重新實現，非依賴專有 Excel 二進位檔。
支援超過 500 個函數、動態陣列、LET、LAMBDA 以及 17 種圖表類型。
tools.description_zh: GridCraft：一款純 Rust 實作的開源乾淨室試算表（Microsoft Excel 風格），由 ArtCraft 開發。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不支援 Microsoft Office 專有格式，例如 DOCX、PPTX 或原生 XLS（2007 年以前版本）。
缺乏 Microsoft 365 生態系中內建的雲端同步功能。
原生開發使用情境需安裝 Rust 工具鏈或特定編譯設定。

tools.name: Ultramotion
tools.description: Open-source motion templates as agent skills · 動效模板庫
tools.useCase: A content creator uses Claude Code or ChatGPT Codex to instantly generate a vertical motion-graphics video with synchronized music from a single text prompt by installing a specific style like 'Liquid Glass' as an agent skill.
advantages: Generates finished videos with music from a single prompt using agent-based workflows
Offers specialized styles like 'Light Particles' capable of rendering up to 1.6M glowing particles via WebGL2
Includes a 'Hand-drawn Explainer' style that supports real stroke order for Chinese character writing
Enables 'Event Replay' by replaying moments in history from real data with specific temporal visualization techniques
negativeConstraints: Requires a headless Chromium-based browser with WebGL support, ffmpeg, and Python with numpy and scipy
The 'Variety Captions' style requires Playwright, Pillow, and soundfile, and depends on Apple Vision (macOS) or MediaPipe for face detection
The 'Flat Explainer' style requires 'edge-tts' or Whisper for voice synthesis and alignment
tools.useCase_zh: 內容創作者使用 Claude Code 或 ChatGPT Codex，透過安裝如「Liquid Glass」等特定風格的技能，僅需輸入一段文字提示詞，即可立即生成帶有同步音樂的垂直動態圖影片。
advantages_zh: 透過代理式工作流，從單一提示詞生成帶有音樂的完成影片
提供如「Light Particles」等專業風格，可透過 WebGL2 渲染高達 160 萬個發光粒子
「Hand-drawn Explainer」風格支援中文字體書寫的實際筆順
「Event Replay」可從真實數據重現歷史時刻，並採用特定的時間視覺化技術
tools.description_zh: 開放原始碼動態模板即代理技能 · 動效模板庫
negativeConstraints_zh: 需搭配支援 WebGL 的無頭 Chromium 瀏覽器，以及 ffmpeg、Python（內含 numpy 與 scipy）
'Variety Captions' 樣式需要 Playwright、Pillow 與 soundfile，並依賴 Apple Vision（macOS）或 MediaPipe 進行臉部偵測
'Flat Explainer' 樣式需要 'edge-tts' 或 Whisper 進行語音合成與對齊

tools.name: Answer Me With Html
tools.description: Answer me with HTML — an agent skill that answers hard questions with a one-page HTML you can actually read. 讓 AI Agent 用一頁 HTML 回答複雜問題。
tools.useCase: A developer wants to understand a complex system architecture or technical concept without reading a wall of text, so they ask their AI agent a question like "Map out how the modules in this repo fit together" and receive a single-file HTML page with diagrams.
advantages: Reduces model output tokens by approximately 8x (from 4,893 to 612 on average) by having the model write only a Markdown draft while the CLI generates the HTML/CSS/SVG structure.
Generates explainer pages in about 12 seconds, which is 2.6x faster than having the model hand-write the full HTML.
Produces a single self-contained HTML file that works offline without external dependencies or network requests.
Significantly reduces token usage for explainer videos, saving about 18x fewer output tokens and running 12x faster compared to standard generation.
negativeConstraints: Requires Node.js 20 or newer to run the CLI component of the skill.
Only supported by specific AI agent frameworks such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Pi, and DeepSeek Harness.
tools.useCase_zh: 開發者需要快速理解複雜的系統架構或技術概念，因此透過 AI Agent 詢問如「梳理此專案模組間的關係」等問題，並獲得一個包含圖表的單檔 HTML 頁面，而非漫長的純文字。
advantages_zh: 模型只需撰寫 Markdown 草稿，由 CLI 產生 HTML/CSS/SVG 結構，平均減少約 8 倍的輸出 token 數（從 4,893 降至 612）。
產生說明頁面僅需約 12 秒，比讓模型直接手寫 HTML 快 2.6 倍。
產出單一自包含的 HTML 檔案，可離線閱讀，無需外部資源或網路連線。
在製作說明影片時效能提升更顯著，輸出 token 減少約 18 倍，速度提升 12 倍。
tools.description_zh: Answer me with HTML — 一個讓 AI 代理用單頁 HTML 回答艱難問題的代理技能，內容可直接閱讀。讓 AI Agent 用一頁 HTML 回答複雜問題。
negativeConstraints_zh: 需要 Node.js 20 或更新版本才能執行技能的 CLI 組件。
僅支援特定 AI 代理框架，例如 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、OpenCode、Pi 與 DeepSeek Harness。

tools.name: Vibe Coding Cn
tools.description: Vibe Coding 從入門到精通教程｜AI 結對編程工作流｜Prompt、Skill、Workflow、上下文管理、codex實戰指南
tools.useCase: A Chinese-speaking developer or team wants to learn the full vibe-coding workflow end to end: prompt engineering, skills, context management and quality gates, taught as a structured, actively maintained tutorial with research evidence rather than scattered blog posts.
advantages: Structured Chinese curriculum covering the whole workflow: prompts, skills, context management and quality gates
Pairs the tutorials with research evidence and a methodology registry so claims can be traced
Ships ready-to-use assets: one-click Codex configs, a skills catalogue and an online prompt library
negativeConstraints: Not a code library or executable tool
tools.description_zh: Vibe Coding 從入門到精通教程｜AI 結對程式設計工作流｜Prompt、Skill、Workflow、上下文管理、codex實戰指南
tools.useCase_zh: 語系為中文的開發者或團隊希望完整學習 vibe-coding 工作流，包含提示工程、技能、上下文管理與品質關卡，以結構化且持續維護的教程形式呈現，並附研究實證，而非零散的部落格文章。
tools.advantages_zh: 涵蓋完整工作流的結構化中文課程：提示、技能、上下文管理與品質關卡；教程搭配研究實證與方法學登錄檔，使各項主張皆可追溯；提供即用資源：一鍵式 Codex 設定、技能目錄與線上提示庫
negativeConstraints_zh: 非程式庫或可執行工具

tools.name: huashu-art-motion
tools.description: 藝術動畫skill：35種藝術風格、9種解說語法，用代碼讓畫動起來。
tools.useCase: A content creator instructs a coding agent to generate a seamless animation of a character moving across 35 different art historical styles, using code-based rendering to animate static images and synthesize accompanying music.
advantages: Provides 35 parameterized art style recipes and 9 narrative syntax templates that can be combined to create dynamic animations from static imagery.
Includes a built-in quality assurance pipeline (qa.py and deliver.py) that automatically validates motion stability, flow, and visual quality before final delivery.
Supports pure code-based audio synthesis, allowing users to generate background music and sound effects without external audio assets.
negativeConstraints: Requires specific external dependencies including uv, ffmpeg, and Playwright Chromium for rendering and execution.
Not suitable for complex 3D modeling or real-time interactive game engines, as it focuses on 2D code-rendered frames and synthesized composites.
tools.useCase_zh: 創作者指示 AI 編碼代理，利用程式碼渲染技術，將靜態圖像轉換為跨越 35 種藝術風格的動態動畫，並同步合成背景音樂與音效。
advantages_zh: 提供 35 張參數化藝術風格配方卡與 9 種敘事語法模板，可組合生成從靜態圖像到動態動畫的內容。
內建自動化品質驗證流程（qa.py 與 deliver.py），在交付前自動檢查運動穩定性、流暢度與視覺質量。
支援純程式碼音訊合成，無需外部音訊素材即可生成配樂與音效。
negativeConstraints_zh: 需要特定的外部相依套件，包括 uv、ffmpeg 與 Playwright Chromium，用於渲染及執行。
不適合用於複雜的 3D 建模或即時互動式遊戲引擎，因其專注於 2D 程式碼渲染之影格與合成影像。

tools.name: DigUp
tools.description: Search your computer by what's in your files: photos, PDFs, documents, recordings, videos and code. On-device on Mac, Windows and Linux, built on Google DeepMind's EmbeddingGemma 2.
tools.useCase: A knowledge worker needing to locate specific content within their local file system describes a scene in a video or a clause in a PDF to retrieve the exact moment or page without opening multiple files.
advantages: Supports multimodal semantic search across text, images, audio, and video using a shared embedding space.
Operates entirely on-device with no data leaving the computer, ensuring privacy for sensitive files.
Handles content in over 100 languages simultaneously, allowing cross-lingual retrieval (e.g., searching in English to find notes in Arabic).
Utilizes the compact 740M parameter EmbeddingGemma 2 model, enabling high-quality local inference on standard laptop hardware.
negativeConstraints: Requires Apple Silicon hardware with macOS 14 or later for the stable macOS build.
Windows and Linux builds are currently in beta stage and may lack the stability of the Mac release.
Windows installer is unsigned, requiring users to manually override security warnings during installation.
tools.useCase_zh: 需要在本機檔案系統中定位特定內容的知識工作者，可透過描述影片場景或 PDF 條款來擷取精確的時刻或頁面，無須逐一開啟檔案。
advantages_zh: 支援多模態語意搜尋，涵蓋文字、圖片、音訊與影片，並使用共享嵌入空間。
完全在本機執行，資料不出離電腦，確保敏感檔案的隱私安全。
同時處理超過 100 種語言的內容，允許跨語言檢索（例如用英文搜尋找到阿拉伯語筆記）。
使用輕量級 7 億參數的 EmbeddingGemma 2 模型，可在標準筆記型電腦硬體上進行高品質的本地推理。
tools.description_zh: 根據檔案內容搜尋你的電腦：照片、PDF、文件、錄音、影片與程式碼。在 Mac、Windows 和 Linux 上本機執行，基於 Google DeepMind 的 EmbeddingGemma 2 建構。
negativeConstraints_zh: 需要具備 Apple Silicon 硬體且為 macOS 14 或更新版本，才能使用穩定的 macOS 版本。
Windows 和 Linux 版本目前處於測試階段，可能不如 Mac 發布版穩定。
Windows 安裝程式未簽署，安裝時需手動略過安全警告。

tools.name: CCBaga
tools.description: No description provided.
tools.useCase: A developer residing abroad manages their local Claude CLI identities, rotates their browser fingerprint to match a specific region, and verifies that system settings align with their network exit.
advantages: Uses a dual-application architecture where a host app manages native system settings while an isolated Chromium instance verifies the environment.
Provides a verification workflow that compares real browser readings with machine and network exit to confirm configuration success.
Integrates AI-guided network setup that generates copyable Skill installation prompts for automated configuration.
negativeConstraints: Restricted to macOS 12+ on Apple Silicon, Linux x86_64 (GTK3/WebKitGTK), and Windows 10/11 x86_64; Intel macOS and Linux ARM64 are unsupported.
Windows installers are not Authenticode signed, which may trigger SmartScreen warnings or be blocked by managed security policies.
Intended solely for users residing or traveling abroad to manage their own identities; use violating Anthropic's terms of service is prohibited.
tools.useCase_zh: 旅居海外的開發人員管理本機 Claude CLI 身份，旋轉瀏覽器指紋以符合特定區域設定，並驗證系統設定是否與其網路出口一致。
advantages_zh: 採用雙應用程式架構，主機應用程式管理原生系統設定，隔離的 Chromium 實例驗證環境狀態。
提供驗證工作流程，比對實際瀏覽器讀數與機器及網路出口，確認設定是否成功。
整合 AI 引導的網路設定，產生可複製的 Skill 安裝提示詞以實現自動化配置。
tools.description_zh: 無說明。
negativeConstraints_zh: 限用於 macOS 12+ 的 Apple Silicon、Linux x86_64 (GTK3/WebKitGTK) 以及 Windows 10/11 x86_64；Intel macOS 與 Linux ARM64 不支援。
Windows 安裝程式未經 Authenticode 簽署，可能會觸發 SmartScreen 警告或被企業安全政策封鎖。
僅供居住或旅外國外的使用者管理自身身分；禁止任何違反 Anthropic 服務條款的使用行為。

tools.name: DeepSeek-Bot
tools.description: A team of long-lived bots for DeepSeek Harness, with main bots, bot-to-bot messages and group chats.
tools.useCase: A developer creates a team of long-lived AI agents for a desktop or server environment to collaborate on complex software tasks via group chats and direct messaging.
advantages: Provides a standalone desktop app that bundles DeepSeek Harness, removing the need to install DSH separately.
Features a 'Main Bot' (Chief) that automates the setup and management of other bots and group chats.
Supports private bot isolation where folders, memory, and chat history are protected from other agents and require explicit approval for external actions.
negativeConstraints: Private bots cannot function as main bots or join group chats.
DSH Web installation requires Node.js version 22.19 or later and pnpm.
Users must manually bypass security warnings on Windows and macOS if the desktop app installer is unsigned.
tools.useCase_zh: 開發者為桌面或伺服器環境建立一組長期存續的 AI 代理團隊，透過群組聊天與直接訊息協作完成複雜軟體任務。
advantages_zh: 提供獨立桌面應用程式，內建 DeepSeek Harness，無需單獨安裝 DSH。
具備「主管機器」（Chief）功能，可自動化管理其他機器與群組聊天的建立與維護。
支援隱私機器隔離，其資料夾、記憶與聊天記錄與其他代理隔離，且對外動作需明確批准。
tools.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的長期運作機器人團隊，包含主機器人、機器人之間訊息與群組聊天功能。
negativeConstraints_zh: 私人機器人無法擔任主機器人或加入群組聊天。
DSH Web 安裝需要 Node.js 22.19 或以上版本以及 pnpm。
若桌面應用程式安裝程式未簽署，Windows 和 macOS 使用者需手動略過安全警告。

tools.name: plexo
tools.description: No description provided.
tools.useCase: A user downloads a large software update or a high-resolution video file by combining their home Wi-Fi and a mobile data hotspot to maximize throughput.
advantages: Combines multiple internet connections (Wi-Fi, Ethernet, mobile) to boost download speeds
Supports downloading direct links, magnet links, .torrent files, and Usenet NZBs
Features per-network speed limits, data allowances, and scheduled downloads
Integrates with browsers to capture downloads using authenticated sessions
negativeConstraints: Does not increase speed if multiple adapters are connected to the same router or share one upstream connection
Windows installer is not code-signed, requiring users to manually bypass security warnings
Requires distinct physical or logical network paths to achieve the claimed speed benefits
tools.useCase_zh: 使用者在下載大型軟體更新或高畫質影片時，結合家用 Wi-Fi 與行動數據熱點來最大化傳輸速度。
advantages_zh: 結合多個網路連線（Wi-Fi、乙太網、行動網路）以提升下載速度
支援下載直接連結、Magnet 連結、.torrent 檔案及 Usenet NZB
提供各網路的限速、資料量配額及排程下載功能
整合瀏覽器功能，可利用已驗證的會話捕獲下載
tools.description_zh: 無說明。
negativeConstraints_zh: 若多個網卡連接至同一路由器或共用單一上游連線，不會提升速度。
Windows 安裝程式未進行程式碼簽署，需手動略過安全警告。
需要不同的實體或邏輯網路路徑，才能達到宣稱的速度效益。

tools.name: playgta5
tools.description: A source code for playgta5.com.
tools.useCase: A gaming enthusiast or tech-savvy user wanting to locally host and archive the V1 port of the Grand V browser game by placing their own 19.7 GB .mirror folder into the directory and running the provided local launcher script.
advantages: Serves as a complete source code archival for the V1 port of the Grand V browser game before it was taken down.
Includes a portable runtime\python.exe and double-click launcher (Launch-Local.cmd) that automatically opens http://localhost:8000/ without requiring separate global Python installations.
Provides a download resumption system with progress tracking (inventory sizes, hash samples, and HTTP isolation checks) for handling the large 19.7 GB .mirror folder.
negativeConstraints: Cannot be run out-of-the-box without sourcing a separate 19.7 GB .mirror folder containing copyrighted Rockstar Games assets, which is explicitly excluded from the repository.
The codebase is an archived snapshot of a public client, not the original development repository, so it lacks official development tools or CI/CD pipelines.
Requires Python 3.11 or newer for script execution; older versions will not support the bundled runtime or download resumption logic.
tools.useCase_zh: 一位玩家或技術使用者希望本地主機並保存已下架的 Grand V 瀏覽器遊戲 V1 版本，透過將自行準備的 19.7 GB .mirror 資料夾放入指定路徑，並執行提供的本地啟動腳本即可啟動遊戲。
advantages_zh: 作為 Grand V 瀏覽器遊戲 V1 版本的完整原始碼存檔，保留其被下架前的狀態。
內建可攜式 runtime\python.exe 與雙擊啟動器 Launch-Local.cmd，可自動開啟 http://localhost:8000/，無需額外安裝全域 Python。
提供大型檔案下載續傳機制，包含進度追蹤（如清單大小、雜湊樣本、HTTP 隔離檢查），方便處理 19.7 GB 的 .mirror 資料夾。
tools.description_zh: playgta5.com 的原始碼。
negativeConstraints_zh: 若未準備單獨的 19.7 GB .mirror 資料夾（包含受版權保護的 Rockstar Games 素材），則無法直接使用；該資料夾已明確排除於存放區之外。
此程式碼庫為公開客戶端的封存快照，而非原始開發存放區，因此缺乏官方開發工具或 CI/CD 管道。
執行腳本需要 Python 3.11 或更新版本；較舊版本無法支援內建執行時間或下載復原機制。

tools.name: cadcraft
tools.description: CADCraft: computer-aided design and drafting — an open-source, clean-room AutoCAD-style app in pure Rust
tools.useCase: Creating and editing precision 2D drawings and 3D models in a clean-room AutoCAD-style environment — object snaps, layers, dimensions, hatches, blocks and DXF interchange — running natively or in the browser, and drivable by AI coding agents over MCP.
advantages: Pure-Rust implementation with no legacy dependencies, running on macOS, Windows, Linux, FreeBSD and in the browser via WebAssembly
Clean-room recreation of AutoCAD-style workflows (snaps, layers, dimensions, hatches, blocks) without licensing constraints
Agent-drivable over MCP, letting AI coding assistants operate the CAD editor directly
negativeConstraints: Status is early development — file formats and commands may change between versions
Not yet mature for production drafting pipelines as a full AutoCAD replacement
tools.useCase_zh: 在 clean-room AutoCAD 風格環境中建立與編輯精密 2D 圖面與 3D 模型：物件鎖點、圖層、標註、剖面線、圖塊與 DXF 交換；可原生或於瀏覽器執行，並可透過 MCP 由 AI 編碼代理驅動。
advantages_zh: 純 Rust 實作、無舊式相依，可在 macOS、Windows、Linux、FreeBSD 原生執行，亦可透過 WebAssembly 於瀏覽器執行
以 clean-room 方式重現 AutoCAD 風格工作流程（鎖點、圖層、標註、剖面線、圖塊），無授權限制
可透過 MCP 由 AI 編碼代理直接操作 CAD 編輯器
negativeConstraints_zh: 專案仍處 early development 狀態，檔案格式與指令可能隨版本變動
尚未能用於正式出圖管線，未達完整取代 AutoCAD 工作流程的成熟度
tools.description_zh: CADCraft：電腦輔助設計與製圖 — 以純 Rust 撰寫的開源 clean-room AutoCAD 風格應用程式。

tools.name: Ingetrazo
tools.description: Free 3D modeler for architecture, engineering and 3D design - hand-sketch-style freeform push/pull modeling, opens .skp files (2013-2026), optional BIM tagging (IfcWall/IfcSlab/IfcColumn) with IFC export and quantity takeoff.
tools.useCase: Use when you need freeform 3D modeling for architecture or engineering on Linux/Windows/macOS, SketchUp .skp round-trips, or BIM tagging with IFC quantity takeoff instead of hand-tracing drawings.
advantages: Freeform push/pull modeling that runs natively on Linux, where native CAD for civil engineers and architects is scarce.
Hermeticity guard: the geometry engine refuses to commit broken solids, keeping quantity takeoffs honest (~2,000 automated tests backing it).
Close the loop model → tag → quantity takeoff → budget with IFC export and its sister project IngePresupuestos.
negativeConstraints: 仍在 0.x 生命週期：檔案格式與外掛 API 在 minor 版間可能變動。
BIM 標註是選用層，不取代 Revit 等完整 BIM 製圖環境，不適合需要全 BIM 流程的團隊。
tools.description_zh: 開源 3D 造型器，供建築、工程與 3D 設計——手繪式自由 push/pull 建模，可開啟 .skp 檔（2013–2026），選配 BIM 標註（IfcWall／IfcSlab／IfcColumn）並匯出 IFC 數量計算。
tools.useCase_zh: 需要在 Linux／Windows／macOS 上做建築或工程的自由 3D 建模、往返 SketchUp .skp 檔、或做 BIM 標註與 IFC 數量結算時。
advantages_zh: Linux 原生執行，補足土木與建築原生平 CAD 幾乎空白的平台缺口（push/pull 自由建模）。
幾何引擎內建密閉實體檢查（hermeticity guard），壞實體直接拒收，數量結算不失真（約 2,000 支自動化測試支撐）。
模型 → 標註 → 數量結算 → 預算閉環：IFC 匯出串接姊妹專案 IngePresupuestos。
negativeConstraints_zh: 仍在 0.x 生命週期：檔案格式與外掛 API 在 minor 版間可能變動。
BIM 標註是選用層，不取代 Revit 等完整 BIM 製圖環境。

tools.name: Harness2
tools.description: Plug-and-play framework for recursive agent harnessing: optimizes the system around a fixed-weight model (prompts, tools, memory, skills, orchestration) via Propose-Probe-Compose task recursion plus a persistent improvement harness.
tools.useCase: Use when building agents that must improve their own harness (prompts, tools, memory, orchestration) for unseen tasks, e.g. running JobBench / LAB / WorkBuddy-Bench with OpenCode or Codex executors.
advantages: Improves GLM-5 and Gemini 3.5 Flash over base harnesses: up to +11.5 pts on WorkBuddy-Bench, +4.5 on JobBench, +11.8 pp LAB partial pass - with model weights frozen.
Plug-and-play: supports OpenCode and Codex executors, plus parallel and sequential recursion.
Harnessing-level recursion accumulates adopted harnesses and evidence-backed lessons into a persistent improvement harness for future tasks.
negativeConstraints: Research framework: harness refinement is tied to its benchmark suites (JobBench / LAB / WorkBuddy-Bench), not a turnkey production agent runtime.
Model weights stay fixed - it tunes the harness only, so it cannot be used for fine-tuning the underlying model.
tools.description_zh: 遞迴代理駕馭的即插即用框架：在模型權重固定的前提下，透過 Propose–Probe–Compose 任務遞迴與持續式改進 harness，自動最佳化模型周邊系統（提示詞、工具、記憶、技能、編排）。
tools.useCase_zh: 建立的代理需要對未見任務自我改良 harness（提示詞、工具、記憶、編排）時，例如以 OpenCode 或 Codex executor 跑 JobBench／LAB／WorkBuddy-Bench 基準。
advantages_zh: 在模型權重凍結下改良 GLM-5／Gemini 3.5 Flash 的 harness：WorkBuddy-Bench 最高 +11.5 分、JobBench +4.5 分、LAB partial pass +11.8 個百分點。
即插即用：支援 OpenCode 與 Codex executor，平行與循序遞迴皆可。
harnessing 層遞迴會累積已採用的 harness 與有證據的教訓，形成持續改進改寫下一輪任務的改進 harness。
negativeConstraints_zh: 研究原型：harness 改良綁定其基準套件（JobBench／LAB／WorkBuddy-Bench），非一鍵上線的代理執行環境。
模型權重固定——只調 harness，不可用來微調底層模型。

tools.name: Plugins
tools.description: Cursor's plugin specification plus official plugins: each plugin is a standalone directory with a .cursor-plugin manifest, covering coding-agent skills (PR review, orchestration, teaching), SDK patterns, and SaaS integrations (GitHub, Playwright, Google Workspace and more).
tools.useCase: Use when you want a ready-made Cursor plugin for a scenario (CI checks, PR review, voice apps, orchestrating parallel cloud agents, Gmail/Docs/Sheets integrations) or need a valid scaffold and marketplace checklist for your own plugin.
advantages: Monorepo with one manifest per plugin (169 indexed skills) - subtools support monorepo deep retrieval.
Maintained by Cursor: coding-workflow plugins plus first-party integrations in the same browsable catalog.
create-plugin and review-plugin skills enforce the spec, so new plugins are scaffolded and validated against marketplace expectations.
negativeConstraints: Plugins target the Cursor coding agent (.cursor-plugin manifests) - not standalone CLIs executables.
Third-party integration plugins require each SaaS credentials and OAuth grants; most are unusable offline.

subTools.name: Advisor
subTools.description: Advisor mode. Consult a stronger (or different) model at key checkpoints: before major decisions, when stuck on an error, and before declaring a task done. Use when the user types /advisor, asks to tu
subTools.description_zh: 顧問模式。在關鍵節點諮詢更強（或不同）的模型：重大決策前、遇到錯誤卡住時，以及宣告任務完成前。當使用者輸入 /advisor 時使用。

subTools.name: Check Agent Compatibility
subTools.description: Run the full repository compatibility pass: scanner score, startup path, validation loop, and docs reliability.
subTools.description_zh: 執行完整倉庫相容性檢查：掃描分數、啟動路徑、驗證循環及文件可靠性。

subTools.name: Cli For Agents
subTools.description: Designs or reviews CLIs so coding agents can run them reliably: non-interactive flags, layered --help with examples, stdin/pipelines, fast actionable errors, idempotency, dry-run, and predictable stru
subTools.description_zh: 設計或審查 CLI，讓編碼代理能可靠執行：非互動式旗標、含範例的分層 --help、stdin/管線支援、快速可操作的錯誤訊息、冪等性、dry-run 模式與可預測結構。

subTools.name: Continual Learning
subTools.description: Orchestrate continual learning by delegating transcript mining and AGENTS.md updates to `agents-memory-updater`.
subTools.description_zh: 透過委派轉錄檔挖掘與 AGENTS.md 更新給 `agents-memory-updater` 來協調持續學習流程。

subTools.name: Create Plugin Scaffold
subTools.description: Create a new Cursor plugin scaffold with a valid manifest, component directories, and marketplace wiring. Use when starting a new plugin or adding a plugin to a multi-plugin repository.
subTools.description_zh: 為新的 Cursor 插件建立具有有效 manifest、組件資料夾與市場連接的骨架結構。適用於啟動新插件或向多插件倉庫新增插件時。

subTools.name: Review Plugin Submission
subTools.description: Audit a Cursor plugin for marketplace readiness. Use when validating manifests, component metadata, discovery paths, and submission quality before publishing.
subTools.description_zh: 審查 Cursor 插件的市場發布準備狀態。適用於在發布前驗證 manifest、組件資訊、發現路徑與提交品質。

subTools.name: Cursor Sdk
subTools.description: Guide users building apps, scripts, CI pipelines, or automations on top of the Cursor TypeScript SDK (`@cursor/sdk`). Use this skill whenever the user mentions integrating, installing, or writing code
subTools.description_zh: 指引開發者使用 Cursor TypeScript SDK（@cursor/sdk）建構應用程式、腳本、CI 流程或自動化。當使用者提到整合、安裝或編寫程式碼時使用此技能。

subTools.name: Check Compiler Errors
subTools.description: Run compile and type-check commands and report failures
subTools.description_zh: 執行編譯與型別檢查命令，並回報失敗訊息。

subTools.name: Control Cli
subTools.description: Build or adapt a local harness to drive, inspect, and profile an interactive CLI or TUI without external services. Use for CLI UX checks, startup regressions, memory leaks, hangs, prompt flows, or ter
subTools.description_zh: 建置或調整本地工具，驅動、檢查並分析互動式 CLI 或 TUI，無需外部服務。用於 CLI UX 檢查、啟動 regression、記憶體洩漏、當機、提示流程等測試。

subTools.name: Control Ui
subTools.description: Build or adapt a local browser/CDP harness to drive and inspect a web, IDE, or Electron UI. Use for local UI verification, screenshots, accessibility snapshots, perf profiles, visual diffs, or reprodu
subTools.description_zh: 建置或調整本地瀏覽器/CDP 工具，驅動並檢查網頁、IDE 或 Electron UI。用於本地 UI 驗證、截圖、無障礙快照、效能分析、視覺差異或復現問題。

subTools.name: Deslop
subTools.description: Remove AI-generated code slop and clean up code style
subTools.description_zh: 移除 AI 產生的程式碼雜訊，並清理程式碼風格。

subTools.name: Fix Ci
subTools.description: Find failing PR checks, inspect logs or external check links, and apply focused fixes
subTools.description_zh: 找出失敗的 PR 檢查，檢視日誌或外部檢查連結，並套用集中修復。

subTools.name: Fix Merge Conflicts
subTools.description: Resolve merge conflicts non-interactively, validate build and tests, and finalize conflict resolution
subTools.description_zh: 非互動式解決合併衝突，驗證建置和測試，完成衝突解決。

subTools.name: Get Pr Comments
subTools.description: Fetch and summarize review comments from the active pull request
subTools.description_zh: 從活躍拉取請求中擷取並摘要審查評論。

subTools.name: Loop On Ci
subTools.description: Monitor PR checks and fix failures until green. Uses gh pr checks as the source of truth for PR-attached checks.
subTools.description_zh: 監控 PR 檢查並修復失敗直到通過，以 gh pr checks 作為 PR 附加檢查的權威來源。

subTools.name: Make Pr Easy To Review
subTools.description: Prepare PRs for review by cleaning noisy history, improving PR descriptions, and adding reviewer guidance without changing code behavior. Use for "make this easy to review", "tidy this PR", "clean up
subTools.description_zh: 清理干擾歷史、改善 PR 說明並加入審查指引，不改變程式行為，用於讓 PR 更易於審查。

subTools.name: New Branch And Pr
subTools.description: Create a fresh branch, complete work, and open a pull request
subTools.description_zh: 建立新分支、完成工作後，開啟 Pull Request

subTools.name: Pr Review Canvas
subTools.description: Generate an interactive PR review walkthrough as an HTML page. Fetches PR data via gh API, categorizes files into core vs mechanical changes, adds reviewer annotations, and renders diffs with moved-co
subTools.description_zh: 以 HTML 頁面生成互動式 PR 檢視流程。透過 gh API 取得 PR 資料，將檔案分類為核心與機械變更，加入檢視者註解，並呈現差異對比

subTools.name: Review And Ship
subTools.description: Review the current branch for bugs, intent fit, and test coverage; run or write tests; commit focused work; open or update a PR.
subTools.description_zh: 檢視當前分支的錯誤、意圖契合度與測試覆蓋率；執行或撰寫測試；提交專注工作；開啟或更新 PR。

subTools.name: Run Smoke Tests
subTools.description: Run Playwright smoke tests, debug failures, and verify fixes
subTools.description_zh: 執行 Playwright 冒煙測試，除錯失敗，並驗證修復。

subTools.name: Thermo Nuclear Code Quality Review
subTools.description: Run an extremely strict maintainability review for abstraction quality, giant files, and spaghetti-condition growth. Use for a thermo-nuclear code quality review, thermonuclear review, deep code quali
subTools.name_zh: 熱核能程式碼品質審查
subTools.description_zh: 執行極嚴格的維護性審查，針對抽象品質、巨型檔案與條件邏輯混亂問題。適用於熱核能等級的程式碼品質審查與深度程式碼檢視。

subTools.name: Verify This
subTools.description: Verify a claim with fresh local evidence: restate it falsifiably, capture baseline and treatment, compare artifacts, and return VERIFIED, NOT VERIFIED, or INCONCLUSIVE.
subTools.description_zh: 以最新本地證據驗證一項主張：可證偽地重述，記錄基準與處理組，比較產出物，並回傳已驗證、未驗證或結果不明。

subTools.name: Weekly Review
subTools.description: Produce a weekly synthesis of authored commits with highlights by bugfix, tech debt, and net-new work
subTools.description_zh: 針對作者 commits 產生每週摘要，並依 bug 修復、技術債與新增工作分類標示重點

subTools.name: What Did I Get Done
subTools.description: Summarize authored commits over a user-specified time period into a concise update
subTools.description_zh: 將指定時間區間內的 authored commits 濃縮為簡潔的進度更新

subTools.name: Workflow From Chats
subTools.description: Extract durable working preferences from recent Cursor chats and convert them into skills, rules, or workflow docs. Use when asked to learn preferences, mine feedback, personalize workflows, or genera
subTools.description_zh: 從最近的 Cursor 對話中提煉持久的工作偏好，並轉換為技能、規則或工作流文件。用於要求學習偏好、挖掘回饋、個人化工作流，或生成內容時。

subTools.name: Docs Canvas
subTools.description: Render a documentation-style Cursor Canvas that organizes architecture notes, API references, walkthroughs, and how-tos into a navigable layout with sections, tables of contents, and cross-references.
subTools.description_zh: 將架構筆記、API 參考、操作指南與教程組織成可導航的文件式佈局，包含章節、目錄與交叉參考。

subTools.name: Build Figma
subTools.description: Use for \"/build-figma\", a figma.com/design URL with node-id, or \"implement this Figma\" into a web, desktop, or shared UI. Orchestrates Figma MCP intake, maps nodes to the repo's own design system,
subTools.description_zh: 處理 Figma 設計連結（含 node-id），將節點對應到專案的設計系統，並輸出為網頁、桌面或共享介面的實作。用於 /build-figma、'實現這個 Figma' 等指令。

subTools.name: Dyl Mode
subTools.description: Dylan's agent style on top of pstack: concise verified delivery, root causes over symptom patches, The Algorithm before design, plain /bro replies, live UI proof, reuse/simplify, and hard merge gates.
subTools.description_zh: Dylan 的代理人格：簡潔驗證交付、追根究底勝於症狀修補、先使用演算法再設計、直接回覆、即時 UI 證明、重複利用、簡化，以及嚴格的合併門檻。

subTools.name: Dyl Ready Pr
subTools.description: Get a PR merge-ready for Dylan: deep /dyl-review till 🟢, mark it ready, resolve conflicts, then babysit CI and comments. Use for /dyl-ready-pr, "get PR green", "make the PR mergeable", "/dyl-review t
subTools.description_zh: 讓 PR 準備好由 Dylan 合併：進行深度 /dyl-review 直到 🟢、標記為可合併、解決衝突，並協助 CI 與回應評論。用於 /dyl-ready-pr、'讓 PR 通過'、'使 PR 可合併' 等指令。

subTools.name: Dyl Review
subTools.description: Review one or more PRs in Dylan's style: up to 7 copy-pasteable asks and one 🟢/🟡/🔴 call. Quick by default; "deep" adds thermos and Bugbot. Use for /dyl-review, "review this PR like me", or terse de
subTools.description_zh: 以 Dylan 風格審查一個或多個 PR：最多 7 個可複製的建議與 🟢/🟡/🔴 評級。預設快速；'deep' 會加入熱水瓶與 Bugbot。用於 /dyl-review、'像我一樣審查這個 PR' 等簡短指令。

subTools.name: Principle The Algorithm
subTools.description: Apply to any non-trivial change before designing it. Make the requirement less dumb, delete, optimize, accelerate, automate, in that order, then run it again on the result. The reply names the require
subTools.description_zh: 在設計任何重大變更前先套用此原則。依序降低需求複雜度、刪除、最佳化、加速、自動化，然後再次執行。回覆將指出需求的核心問題。

subTools.name: Add Dictation
subTools.description: Use when the user runs /add-dictation or wants speech turned into text with Grok speech-to-text: a mic button that dictates into the composer, live captions, or transcribing recorded audio (files, upl
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者執行 /add-dictation 或希望透過 Grok 語音轉文字時使用：包含麥克風按鈕、即時字幕，或轉錄錄音檔（檔案、上傳等）。

subTools.name: Add Read Aloud
subTools.description: Use when the user runs /add-read-aloud or wants the app to speak text with Grok text-to-speech: read-aloud button on assistant replies, auto-speak, TTS, voice output, narration, IVR prompts, speech ta
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者執行 /add-read-aloud，或希望應用程式使用 Grok 文字轉語音朗讀文字時使用，例如：助理回覆中的朗讀按鈕、自動朗讀、TTS、語音輸出、旁白、IVR 提示、語音互動...

subTools.name: Add Voice
subTools.description: Use when the user runs /add-voice, types Voice Mode, or asks to add Grok realtime voice to an app, including replacing an STT-LLM-TTS cascade or OpenAI Realtime.   Wire speech-to-speech, safe auth, an
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者執行 /add-voice、輸入 Voice Mode，或要求為應用程式新增 Grok 即時語音時使用，包括取代 STT-LLM-TTS 串接或 OpenAI Realtime。串接語音對語音、安全認證、安...

subTools.name: Debug Voice
subTools.description: Use when the user runs /debug-voice, says voice mode has flaws, asks to see or capture what happened in a Grok realtime voice session, or a voice integration has no debug logging yet. Proposes a plan,
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者執行 /debug-voice、表示語音模式有問題、要求查看或錄製 Grok 即時語音會話內容，或語音整合尚未提供偵錯日誌時使用。

subTools.name: Architect
subTools.description: Sketch types, signatures, and module structure before code, then stay in the loop while implementation fills in. Use for /architect, 'architect this', 'design this', or non-trivial work where jumping
subTools.description_zh: 在撰寫程式前先規劃型別、簽名與模組結構，並在實作過程中持續維持對話。適用於 /architect、'architect this'、'design this' 等需求，或較複雜的工作。

subTools.name: Arena
subTools.description: Spawn N parallel candidates at the same task, pick a base, graft the strongest parts of the losers into it. Use for /arena, 'arena this', 'throw it in the arena', or when one attempt at a non-trivial
subTools.description_zh: 在同一任務中啟動 N 個並行候選人，選取基準版本，將失敗者的最強部分合併進去。用於 /arena、'arena this'、'throw it in the arena'，或當單一嘗試非平凡任務時。

subTools.name: Automate Me
subTools.description: Use for \"automate me\", \"create/update/refresh my -mode skill\", \"turn/capture my preferences or working style into a skill\", or wanting agents to follow how the user works. Drafts or revises a pe
subTools.description_zh: 用於「automate me」、「create/update/refresh my -mode skill」、將偏好或工作風格轉為 skill，或希望 agents 遵循使用者工作方式時。起草或修訂個人 skill。

subTools.name: Benchmark Checklist
subTools.description: Vet a perf measurement (limiter, tuning, limits, errors, repeatability, relevance, and whether the work happened) before you report or act on it. Use when you run a benchmark or report a speedup or re
subTools.description_zh: 在報告或基於效能測量行動前，驗證限制器、調校、限制、錯誤、可重複性、相關性，以及工作是否確實發生。用於執行 benchmark 或報告加速時。

subTools.name: Blast Radius
subTools.description: Find what a change could break somewhere else before it ships, beyond the diff, and prove the one fact it's safe because of by running real code instead of writing it up. Use for 'blast radius of X',
subTools.description_zh: 在釋出前找出變更可能造成的影響，超越 diff 範圍，並透過執行實際程式碼來證明安全。用於「blast radius of X」、分析變更影響時。

subTools.name: Bro
subTools.description: Restate the last message in plain human language, with no jargon.
subTools.description_zh: 用白話重新表述最後一條訊息，不使用專業術語。

subTools.name: Correct
subTools.description: Find the mistakes agents keep repeating in this repo and make each one impossible. Try architecture first, then types, then a lint whose error names the fix, then a test, and write docs last. Prove ea
subTools.description_zh: 找出此專案中代理程式反覆出現的錯誤並設法根除。優先從架構著手，其次型別檢查，接著是錯誤名稱即含修復方式的 lint，再來是測試，最後才撰寫文件。證明其有

subTools.name: Create Formal Verification Skill
subTools.description: Generate a project-local skill that formally verifies the code where a bug costs the most and tests reach the least, in any language, with whichever verification tool fits. Use for /create-formal-veri
subTools.description_zh: 產生專案專屬技能，針對錯誤代價最高且測試覆蓋最低的程式碼進行形式化驗證，支援任意語言與適當的驗證工具。用於 /create-formal-verification

subTools.name: Create Verification Skill
subTools.description: Generate a project-local verification skill that drives your app the way a user does — any language, framework, or platform. Use for /create-verification-skill, \"make a control skill for this repo\",
subTools.description_zh: 產生專案專屬驗證技能，模擬使用者操作應用程式 — 支援任意語言、框架或平台。用於 /create-verification-skill、「為本倉庫建立控制技能」。

subTools.name: Figure It Out
subTools.description: Design an auditable playbook when no narrower one fits: a large migration, an ambitious multi-part change, or work a human reviews after stepping away. Scales rigor to the task, runs a hypothesis loop
subTools.description_zh: 設計可追溯的執行計畫：適用於大型遷移、複雜的多步驟變更，或人類離開後再檢視的工作。能依照任務規模調整嚴謹度，並執行假設驗證循環。

subTools.name: How
subTools.description: Use for \"how does X work\", code walkthroughs before changing something, and placement / ownership / layering questions (\"where should this live\", \"which package owns this\", \"is this the right l
subTools.description_zh: 用於「X 如何運作」、修改前的程式碼解說，以及歸屬／分層問題（如「這應該放在哪裡」、「哪個套件負責」、「這樣設計是否合適」）。

subTools.name: In Your Own Words
subTools.description: Restate in your own words what you think the user's goals are and what problem they're trying to solve. Use for /in-your-own-words.
subTools.description_zh: 用自己的話重新陳述您認為使用者的目標與欲解決的問題。用於 /in-your-own-words 指令。

subTools.name: Interrogate
subTools.description: Use for \"interrogate\", \"adversarial review\", \"multi-model review\", \"challenge this\", \"stress test this code\", \"find blind spots\", or \"tear this apart\". Multiple LLM reviewers challenge c
subTools.description_zh: 用於「挑戰」、對抗式檢視、多模型審查、「質疑這個」、「壓力測試程式碼」、「找出盲點」或「徹底檢視」。由多個 LLM 審查者互相挑戰。

subTools.name: Ketchup
subTools.description: Catch the user up on what changed in this chat since their last message, in plain words and small visuals. List every item waiting on them with what they need to decide it from the reply alone. Use fo
subTools.description_zh: 用白話文和小圖表讓使用者了解這次對話中，從上次訊息以來的所有變更。列出所有等待使用者決定的事項，並說明只需回覆即可決定。

subTools.name: Maintain Formal Verification Skill
subTools.description: Bring a project's formal verification back in line with the code after the code changes: find the commits that touched verified code, update the model, harness, or properties to describe the code as i
subTools.description_zh: 程式碼變更後，讓專案的形式化驗證與程式碼保持一致：找出涉及已驗證程式碼的提交，更新模型、harness 或屬性以描述程式碼。

subTools.name: Maintain Verification Skill
subTools.description: Periodic pass that keeps a project's verification skill and feature map honest: parallel source readers per feature, one live session driving every feature, at most one PR of proven corrections. Use f
subTools.description_zh: 定期檢核，確保專案的驗證技能和功能地圖保持準確：每個功能使用平行原始碼讀取器，一個即時會話驅動所有功能，最多一個經過證實的修正 PR。

subTools.name: Make Bot Ui
subTools.description: Use when building a custom UI (page, dashboard, buttons) that should wake a Grok Bot over a webhook, when the user must provide a webhook sender key, or when exposing that UI on Tailscale.
subTools.description_zh: 建置可透過 webhook 喚醒 Grok Bot 的客製化介面（頁面、儀表板、按鈕）時使用，當使用者需要提供 webhook 發送金鑰，或要在 Tailscale 上 exposing 該介面時。

subTools.name: No Comments
subTools.description: Spawn Comment Sicko, fix accepted findings, and offer encodings for claimed constraints.
subTools.description_zh: 啟動 Comment Sicko，修正已接受的發現，並提供被聲稱約束的編碼。

subTools.name: Poteto Help
subTools.description: Guides users through pstack setup, /poteto-mode, and picking the skill, playbook, or principle for a task. Type /poteto-help with a question.
subTools.description_zh: 引導使用者完成 pstack 設定、/poteto-mode，以及為任務挑選技能、playbook 或原則。輸入 /poteto-help 加上問題。

subTools.name: Poteto Mode
subTools.description: poteto's agent style for concise, detailed responses, deliberate subagents, unslopped prose, simple code, and verified work. Use for poteto, /poteto-mode, or requests to work in this style.
subTools.description_zh: poteto 的 agent 風格：簡潔且詳細的回覆、刻意設計的 subagents、不囉嗦的文字、簡單的程式碼，以及經過驗證的工作成果。用於 poteto、/poteto-mode 或要求以此風格工作。

subTools.name: Principle Attack The Premise
subTools.description: Apply when two or more fixes that share one premise have failed the same gate. Write the premise down and test it directly before you write another fix that assumes it.
subTools.description_zh: 當兩個或更多共享同一前提的修正方案都在同一關卡失敗時使用。在撰寫另一個假設該前提的修正前，先把前提寫下來並直接測試。

subTools.name: Principle Boundary Discipline
subTools.description: Apply when wiring validation, error handling, or framework adapters. Concentrate guards at system boundaries (CLI, config, network, external APIs); trust internal types and keep business logic in pure
subTools.description_zh: 適用於串接驗證、錯誤處理或框架適配器時。將防護集中在系統邊界（CLI、配置、網路、外部 API）；信任內部類型，並保持業務邏輯純淨。

subTools.name: Principle Build The Lever
subTools.description: Apply to any non-trivial work, not just bulk work: edits, migrations, analyses, checks. Build the tool that does it or proves it (codemod, script, generator, or a skill your subagents follow) instead
subTools.description_zh: 適用於任何非平凡的工作，不僅限大規模任務：編輯、遷移、分析、檢查。請構建執行或驗證的工具（如 codemod、腳本、生成器，或讓子代理遵循的技能），而非採用其他方式。

subTools.name: Principle Encode Lessons In Structure
subTools.description: Apply when you catch yourself writing the same instruction a second time, or notice a recurring correction. Encode the rule as a lint, metadata flag, runtime check, or script instead of more text.
subTools.name_zh: 原則：將經驗編碼為結構
subTools.description_zh: 當你重複寫同一條指令或發現反覆出現的修正時，把規則編碼為 lint、metadata flag、runtime check 或腳本，而非新增更多文字。

subTools.name: Principle Exhaust The Design Space
subTools.description: Apply when facing a novel UI interaction or architectural decision with no precedent in the codebase. Build 2-3 competing prototypes and compare side by side before committing.
subTools.description_zh: 面對程式碼庫中無先例的全新 UI 互動或架構決策時，建立 2-3 個互相競爭的原型並並排比較，再做出決定。

subTools.name: Principle Experience First
subTools.description: Apply when product, UX, or feature-scope tradeoffs come up. Choose user delight over implementation convenience; ship fewer polished features over more rough ones.
subTools.description_zh: 當產品、使用者體驗或功能範圍需要權衡時適用。選擇使用者愉悅而非實作便利；寧可推出較少但更完善的功能，也不要推出較多但不完善的版本。

subTools.name: Principle Explain The Number
subTools.description: Apply before you trust, report, or act on a number you measured: a speedup, a regression, a throughput, a latency, or an eval result. Find what limits it, and rule out that it measured something other
subTools.description_zh: 在信任、報告或根據測量值採取行動前，先套用此原則：無論是加速比、效能衰退、吞吐量、延遲或評估結果。找出限制因素，並排除該數值實測到其他事物的可能。

subTools.name: Principle Fix Root Causes
subTools.description: Apply when debugging. Trace each symptom back to the first place the system went wrong and fix it there. A guard is a fix only when the state it handles is legitimate.
subTools.description_zh: 除錯時，將每個症狀追蹤到系統出錯的第一個位置並加以修復。只有當其處理的狀態是合法的，防護機制才算有效修復。

subTools.name: Principle Foundational Thinking
subTools.description: Apply before writing logic: choosing core types and data structures, sequencing scaffold-vs-feature work, asking what concurrent actors share. Get the data structures right so downstream code becomes
subTools.description_zh: 編寫邏輯前，先選擇核心型別與資料結構、安排支架與功能的次序，並考量並發執行的執行者共享哪些資源。正確設計資料結構，讓下游程式碼更易撰寫。

subTools.name: Principle Guard The Context Window
subTools.description: Apply when context is filling up: large outputs, long files, repeated reads, fan-out planning. Route bulk to subagents; keep summaries in the main thread, not raw payloads.
subTools.description_zh: 當上下文接近上限時適用：大量輸出、長檔案、重複讀取、分支規劃。將大量工作分流至子代理；主線程保留摘要，而非原始資料。

subTools.name: Principle Laziness Protocol
subTools.description: Apply when refactoring, evaluating diff size, or tempted to add abstractions, layers, or signal threading. Bias toward deletion and the smallest change that solves the problem.
subTools.description_zh: 重構、評估差異範圍，或打算加入抽象層、額外層級或訊號線時適用。偏向刪除，選擇能解決問題的最小變更。

subTools.name: Principle Make Operations Idempotent
subTools.description: Apply when designing commands, lifecycle steps, or processing loops that run amid crashes, restarts, and retries. Converge to the same end state regardless of partial prior runs.
subTools.name_zh: 原則：讓操作具備冪等性
subTools.description_zh: 設計命令、生命周期步驟或處理迴圈時使用，這些操作可能遭遇崩潰、重啟與重試。無論先前執行是否不完整，最終狀態都應一致。

subTools.name: Principle Migrate Callers Then Delete Legacy Apis
subTools.description: Apply when introducing a new internal API while old callers still exist. Migrate callers and delete the old API in the same wave instead of preserving compatibility layers.
subTools.name_zh: 原則：先遷移呼叫端再刪除舊 API
subTools.description_zh: 引入新的內部 API 而舊的呼叫端仍存在時使用。在一次變更中同時遷移呼叫端並刪除舊 API，而非保留相容性層。

subTools.name: Principle Minimize Reader Load
subTools.description: Apply when reviewing or shaping code that's hard to trace. Count layers between question and answer, and hidden state in the reader's head; collapse one-caller wrappers and shrink mutable scope.
subTools.description_zh: 當檢視或調整難以追蹤的程式時使用。計算問題與答案之間的層數，以及讀者腦中的隱藏狀態；合併單呼叫包裝函式並收縮可變範圍。

subTools.name: Principle Model The Domain
subTools.description: Apply when writing stateful logic, or when code branches a lot or repeats a shape assumption across files.
subTools.description_zh: 撰寫狀態邏輯，或程式分支繁多、跨檔案重複形狀假設時使用。

subTools.name: Principle Never Block On The Human
subTools.description: Apply when tempted to ask 'should I do X?' on reversible work.
subTools.description_zh: 當想問「我該做 X 嗎？」但工作可逆時使用。

subTools.name: Principle Outcome Oriented Execution
subTools.description: Apply during planned rewrites and migrations with explicit phase boundaries. Converge on the target architecture; don't preserve smooth intermediate states with throwaway compatibility code.
subTools.description_zh: 進行有明確階段的計畫性重構與遷移時使用。朝目標架構收斂，不用一次性相容程式保留過渡狀態。

subTools.name: Principle Prove It Works
subTools.description: Apply after completing a task, before declaring done. Verify against the real artifact (run the feature, read the actual value, inspect the diff), not a proxy, self-report, or 'it compiles.'
subTools.description_zh: 完成任務後、宣告完成前應用。針對真實產出驗證（執行功能、查看實際值、檢查 diff），而非依賴代理指標、自我報告或「編譯通過」。

subTools.name: Principle Redesign From First Principles
subTools.description: Apply when integrating a new requirement into an existing design.
subTools.description_zh: 將新需求整合到現有設計時應用。

subTools.name: Principle Separate Before Serializing Shared State
subTools.description: Apply when concurrent actors might write to the same file, branch, key, or state object. Eliminate the sharing first; serialize structurally only when one shared writer is a real invariant.
subTools.name_zh: 序列化共用狀態前先分離原則
subTools.description_zh: 當多個執行緒可能寫入同一個檔案、分支、鍵或狀態物件時使用。優先消除共用；只有一個共用寫入者為必要不變數時，才進行結構化序列化。

subTools.name: Principle Sequence Verifiable Units
subTools.description: Apply to multi-step work (sweeps, migrations, runs of similar edits) and to how you stack commits and PRs. Break work into small units that each end in a verifiable state, check each before the next,
subTools.description_zh: 適用於多步驟工作（掃描、遷移、批次編輯）以及 commit 與 PR 的堆疊方式。將工作拆成小單位，每個單位結束後可驗證，完成後再進行下一步。

subTools.name: Principle Subtract Before You Add
subTools.description: Apply when sequencing an addition, refactor, or rewrite. Remove dead code, redundant validators, and stub references first, then build on the simpler base.
subTools.description_zh: 執行新增、重構或改寫時套用。先移除失效程式、重複驗證與暫存引用，再於更簡潔的基礎上進行開發。

subTools.name: Principle Test Behavior Not Implementation
subTools.description: Apply when you write, change, or keep a test. Assert what the code's users can observe, so that the test fails when that behavior breaks and keeps passing when only the internals change.
subTools.name_zh: 原則：測試行為而非實現
subTools.description_zh: 編寫、修改或保留測試時套用。斷言使用者能觀察到的行為，讓測試在行為破壞時失敗，僅內部改變時仍通過。

subTools.name: Principle Type System Discipline
subTools.description: Apply when designing types, reviewing a function signature, or writing code in any statically-typed language. Make illegal states unrepresentable, brand semantic primitives, parse external data at bou
subTools.description_zh: 設計類型、審查函式簽名或在靜態類型語言編寫程式時套用。使非法狀態無法表示，為語義原語命名，於邊界處剖析外部資料…

subTools.name: Recall
subTools.description: Reconstruct your recent working context from your own chat history, live state, and the shared record (user reports, prior fixes, incidents), then hand back a tight current-state brief. Use for 'recal
subTools.description_zh: 從聊天歷史、即時狀態與共享記錄（使用者報告、先前修復、事件）重建近期工作上下文，回傳簡明扼要的當前狀態摘要。用於「recall…

subTools.name: Reflect
subTools.description: Spawn three parallel review subagents over the active transcript, surface learnings, and route each to a concrete edit on an existing skill. Use when the user says reflect.
subTools.description_zh: 當使用者輸入 reflect 時，啟動三個並行的審查子代理，從當前對話記錄中提煉學習要點，並將每個要點路由至對現有技能的具體編輯。

subTools.name: Setup Pstack
subTools.description: Configure which models pstack uses per role and at what reasoning budget. Detects your available models and writes an always-applied rule that overrides the skill defaults. Use for /setup-pstack, "con
subTools.description_zh: 設定 pstack 各角色使用的模型與推理預算。偵測可用模型後，寫入始終生效的規則以覆蓋技能預設。用於 /setup-pstack 指令，或 「con」開頭的字串。

subTools.name: Sharpen
subTools.description: Make a task deeper, not bigger, then rewrite the prompt. Use for /sharpen.
subTools.description_zh: 使任務更深入而非擴大，接著重寫提示。適用於 /sharpen 指令。

subTools.name: Show Me Your Work
subTools.description: Keep a reviewable decision trail for long-running or unattended work: a TSV log with one row per decision (what, why, evidence, result). Local by default; commit it when a reviewer needs the trail to
subTools.description_zh: 為長時或無人值守工作保留可審查的決策軌跡：每項決策一行，包含內容、原因、證據與結果。預設存於本地；需審核時提交。

subTools.name: Swarm
subTools.description: Fan out N parallel workers, drain them, and return one report. Use for /swarm, 'swarm this', or parallel coverage, races, gauntlets, and exploration.
subTools.description_zh: 派出 N 個平行 Worker，回收後回傳一份報告。用於 /swarm、'swarm this'，或平行覆蓋、競態、挑戰測試與探索。

subTools.name: Tdd
subTools.description: Use only when the user explicitly asks for TDD, a failing test, or a regression test, OR when the bug has an obvious cheap local test target. Skip when the test path is unclear, expensive, integration
subTools.description_zh: 僅在使用者明確要求 TDD、有失敗測試或回歸測試時使用，或當錯誤有明顯且廉價的本地測試目標時使用。測試路徑不明確、成本高或為整合測試時跳過。

subTools.name: Teach
subTools.description: Explain a body of work plainly so a person actually understands it. Runs the `how` and `why` skills and weaves what they find into one clear explanation. Use for 'teach me this', 'help me really under
subTools.description_zh: 用平實的語言解釋內容，讓人真正理解。執行 `how` 和 `why` 技能，將所得整合為清晰說明。用於「教我這個」、「幫我真正理解」。

subTools.name: Technical Writing
subTools.description: Layered technical-writing standard: Diátaxis structure, Google developer style sentences, STE instruction rules, Global English syntax. Use for /technical-writing or when writing or reviewing docs, RF
subTools.description_zh: 分層技術寫作標準：Diátaxis 結構、Google 開發者風格句型、STE 指令規則、Global English 語法。用於 /technical-writing，或撰寫與審查文件、RF。

subTools.name: Typescript Best Practices
subTools.description: TypeScript best practices. Use when reading or editing any .ts or .tsx file.
subTools.description_zh: TypeScript 最佳實踐。用於閱讀或編輯任何 .ts 或 .tsx 檔案時。

subTools.name: Unslop
subTools.description: Cut AI tells from any writing.
subTools.description_zh: 去除任何寫作內容中的 AI 痕跡。

subTools.name: Why
