subTools.description: Use for 'why does X work this way', 'why we picked Y', design rationale, regressions, postmortems, or data-backed thresholds. Discovers available MCPs and queries each evidence category (source contro
subTools.description_zh: 用於回答「為什麼 X 這樣運作」、「為什麼選擇 Y」等設計原理、衰退、事後分析或資料門檻問題。會自動發現可用的 MCP 並查詢每類證據。

subTools.name: Orchestrate
subTools.description: Use only when the user explicitly types `/orchestrate <goal>` to decompose a large task, spawn a tree of parallel cloud-agent workers/subplanners/verifiers via the Cursor SDK, and collect structured h
subTools.description_zh: 僅當使用者明確輸入 `/orchestrate <目標>` 時使用，用於分解大型任務、透過 Cursor SDK 啟動平行雲端代理程式樹狀結構，並收集結構化結果。

subTools.name: Origin Api
subTools.description: Routes questions about the Cursor Origin API to the right section of the Origin docs and names the few rules to check first. Use when a task mentions Origin, the Origin API, Origin Apps, or Origin web
subTools.description_zh: 將關於 Cursor Origin API 的問題導向 Origin 說明文件的正確章節，並列出應先檢查的幾項規則。當任務中提到 Origin、Origin API、Origin Apps 或 Origin 網頁時使用。

subTools.name: Port Github App To Origin
subTools.description: Plans the port of an existing GitHub App to a Cursor Origin App. Use when the task is to bring a GitHub App to Origin or compare what it uses against the Origin API. Reads the app's needs out of its c
subTools.name_zh: 將 GitHub App 遷移至 Origin
subTools.description_zh: 規劃將現有 GitHub App 遷移至 Cursor Origin App。當任務是要將 GitHub App 帶到 Origin，或比較其使用的功能與 Origin API 時使用。會從其設定檔讀取應用程式需求。

subTools.name: Pr Review Canvas
subTools.description: Render a PR diff review as a Cursor Canvas that groups changes by reviewer importance, separates boilerplate from core logic, and highlights tricky or unexpected code. Use when reviewing a pull reques
subTools.description_zh: 將 PR 差異審查呈現為 Cursor Canvas，依審查者重要性分組變更、區隔樣板程式碼與核心邏輯，並標示棘手或意外程式碼。在審查拉取請求時使用。

subTools.name: Reproduce And Fix Issues
subTools.description: Reproduce triaged Slack bugs through a configured app-control adapter, verify existing fixes, and open a bounded draft pull request only after before-and-after proof. Use only from the configured Benn
subTools.description_zh: 透過已設定的應用程式控制配接器重現已分級的 Slack 錯誤，驗證現有修復方案，並在前後證明後才開啟受限的草案拉取請求。僅從已設定的 Benny 環境中使用。

subTools.name: Setup Benny
subTools.description: Configure Benny and prepare its triage and repro automations. Use when installing Benny or changing its Slack, tracker, repository, routing, control, model, or budget settings.
subTools.description_zh: 設定 Benny 並準備其分診與復現自動化。安裝 Benny 或變更其 Slack、tracker、倉庫、路由、控制、模型或預算設定時使用。

subTools.name: Triage Issue Reports
subTools.description: Triage Slack issue reports with one thread-only verdict, evidence review, cause-aware routing, tracker dedupe, and fail-closed ticket creation. Use only from the configured Benny triage automation.
subTools.description_zh: 對 Slack 問題報告進行分流，提供單一討論串判決、證據審查、原因感知路由、追蹤器去重與 fail-closed 票單建立。僅從已配置的 Benny 分流自動化中使用。

subTools.name: Architect
subTools.description: Sketch types, signatures, and module structure before code, then stay in the loop while implementation fills in. Use for /architect, 'architect this', 'design this', or non-trivial work where jumping
subTools.description_zh: 在撰寫程式前，先勾勒型別、簽名與模組結構，並在實作階段持續追蹤。適用於 /architect、'architect this'、'design this' 或難度較高的工作。

subTools.name: Arena
subTools.description: Spawn N parallel candidates at the same task, pick a base, graft the strongest parts of the losers into it. Use for /arena, 'arena this', 'throw it in the arena', or when one attempt at a non-trivial
subTools.description_zh: 針對同一任務產生 N 個平行候選方案，選定基礎後，將失敗者中最強的部份整合進去。適用於 /arena、'arena this'、'throw it in the arena' 或非平凡工作。

subTools.name: Automate Me
subTools.description: Use for \"automate me\", \"create/update/refresh my -mode skill\", \"turn/capture my preferences or working style into a skill\", or wanting agents to follow how the user works. Drafts or revises a pe
subTools.description_zh: 用於「自動化作業」、「建立/更新/刷新我的模式技能」、「將我的偏好或工作風格轉化為技能」，或希望智能體遵循使用者工作方式。草擬或修訂技能。

subTools.name: Benchmark Checklist
subTools.description: Vet a perf measurement (limiter, tuning, limits, errors, repeatability, relevance, and whether the work happened) before you report or act on it. Use when you run a benchmark or report a speedup or re
subTools.description_zh: 在報告或採取行動前，檢視效能測量（限制器、調優、限制、錯誤、可重複性、相關性及工作是否確實執行）。用於執行基準測試或報告加速時。

subTools.name: Blast Radius
subTools.description: Find what a change could break somewhere else before it ships, beyond the diff, and prove the one fact it's safe because of by running real code instead of writing it up. Use for 'blast radius of X',
subTools.description_zh: 在發布前，找出變更可能影響的範圍，並透過執行實際程式碼來驗證安全性。

subTools.name: Bro
subTools.description: Restate the last message in plain human language, with no jargon.
subTools.description_zh: 用日常語言重述上一則訊息，避免使用技術術語。

subTools.name: Correct
subTools.description: Find the mistakes agents keep repeating in this repo and make each one impossible. Try architecture first, then types, then a lint whose error names the fix, then a test, and write docs last. Prove ea
subTools.description_zh: 找出該專案中 agent 常犯的錯誤並設法杜絕。依序從架構、型別、直指修正的 lint 到測試逐步強化，最後再補文件。

subTools.name: Create Formal Verification Skill
subTools.description: Generate a project-local skill that formally verifies the code where a bug costs the most and tests reach the least, in any language, with whichever verification tool fits. Use for /create-formal-veri
subTools.description_zh: 產生專案技能，對錯誤影響最大且測試最難觸及的程式碼進行形式驗證。適用任何語言與合適工具，輸入 /create-formal-veri 即可。

subTools.name: Create Verification Skill
subTools.description: Generate a project-local verification skill that drives your app the way a user does — any language, framework, or platform. Use for /create-verification-skill, \"make a control skill for this repo\",
subTools.description_zh: 生成專案本地的驗證技能，以使用者方式驅動您的應用——支援任何語言、框架或平台。用於 /create-verification-skill、'為這個儲存庫建立控制技能'。

subTools.name: Figure It Out
subTools.description: Design an auditable playbook when no narrower one fits: a large migration, an ambitious multi-part change, or work a human reviews after stepping away. Scales rigor to the task, runs a hypothesis loop
subTools.description_zh: 當缺乏更精確的執行計畫時，設計可審計的執行計畫：適用於大型遷移、雄心勃勃的多部分變更，或人類暫停後重新檢視的工作。根據任務規模調整嚴謹程度，並執行假設循環。

subTools.name: How
subTools.description: Use for \"how does X work\", code walkthroughs before changing something, and placement / ownership / layering questions (\"where should this live\", \"which package owns this\", \"is this the right l
subTools.description_zh: 用於理解「X 如何運作」、改動前的程式碼導覽，以及歸屬與分層問題（例如「這該放在哪裡」「哪個套件擁有這部分」）時使用。

subTools.name: In Your Own Words
subTools.description: Restate in your own words what you think the user's goals are and what problem they're trying to solve. Use for /in-your-own-words.
subTools.description_zh: 用自己的話重述您認為使用者的目標與試圖解決的問題。用於 /in-your-own-words 指令。

subTools.name: Interrogate
subTools.description: Use for \"interrogate\", \"adversarial review\", \"multi-model review\", \"challenge this\", \"stress test this code\", \"find blind spots\", or \"tear this apart\". Multiple LLM reviewers challenge c
subTools.description_zh: 用於「質問」、「對抗性審查」、「多模型審查」、「挑戰這個」或「壓力測試這支程式」。由多位 LLM 檢視者進行挑戰與挑毛病。

subTools.name: Ketchup
subTools.description: Catch the user up on what changed in this chat since their last message, in plain words and small visuals. List every item waiting on them with what they need to decide it from the reply alone. Use fo
subTools.description_zh: 用白話文和小圖示幫您回顧本次對話中自上次訊息以來的更動。列出所有等您決定的事項，並從回覆內容本身就能了解該怎麼決定。用於 /ketchup 指令。

subTools.name: Maintain Formal Verification Skill
subTools.description: Bring a project's formal verification back in line with the code after the code changes: find the commits that touched verified code, update the model, harness, or properties to describe the code as i
subTools.description_zh: 程式變更後，找出觸及已驗證程式碼的提交，更新模型、測試環境或屬性，使其與程式保持一致。

subTools.name: Maintain Verification Skill
subTools.description: Periodic pass that keeps a project's verification skill and feature map honest: parallel source readers per feature, one live session driving every feature, at most one PR of proven corrections. Use f
subTools.description_zh: 定期執行以維持專案驗證技能與功能映射準確：每個功能並行讀取來源、一次會話驅動該功能、最多一個經驗證的修正 PR。

subTools.name: Make Bot Ui
subTools.description: Use when building a custom UI (page, dashboard, buttons) that should wake a Grok Bot over a webhook, when the user must provide a webhook sender key, or when exposing that UI on Tailscale.
subTools.description_zh: 建構可透過 webhook 喚醒 Grok 機器人的自訂介面（頁面、儀表板、按鈕），當使用者需提供 webhook 發件金鑰，或在 Tailscale 上揭露該介面時使用。

subTools.name: No Comments
subTools.description: Spawn Comment Sicko, fix accepted findings, and offer encodings for claimed constraints.
subTools.description_zh: 啟動 Comment Sicko、修正已接受的發現，並對聲稱的約束提供編碼建議。

subTools.name: Poteto Help
subTools.description: Guides users through pstack setup, /poteto-mode, and picking the skill, playbook, or principle for a task. Type /poteto-help with a question.
subTools.description_zh: 引導使用者完成 pstack 設定、/poteto-mode 及為任務選擇技能、劇本或原則。輸入 /poteto-help 並附上問題。

subTools.name: Poteto Mode
subTools.description: poteto's agent style for concise, detailed responses, deliberate subagents, unslopped prose, simple code, and verified work. Use for poteto, /poteto-mode, or requests to work in this style.
subTools.description_zh: poteto 的代理風格，提供簡潔且詳細的回應、刻意啟動子代理、精煉的文字、簡單的程式碼與經過驗證的工作成果。用於 poteto、/poteto-mode 或此風格的工作請求。

subTools.name: Principle Attack The Premise
subTools.description: Apply when two or more fixes that share one premise have failed the same gate. Write the premise down and test it directly before you write another fix that assumes it.
subTools.description_zh: 當兩個或以上共享同一前提的修正都未通過同一關卡時套用。先寫下前提並直接測試它，再撰寫其他假設其成立的新修正。

subTools.name: Principle Boundary Discipline
subTools.description: Apply when wiring validation, error handling, or framework adapters. Concentrate guards at system boundaries (CLI, config, network, external APIs); trust internal types and keep business logic in pure
subTools.description_zh: 連接驗證、錯誤處理或框架擴充功能時套用。將防護集中於系統邊界（CLI、組態、網路、外部 API）；信任內部類型，並將商業邏輯保持在純淨狀態。

subTools.name: Principle Build The Lever
subTools.description: Apply to any non-trivial work, not just bulk work: edits, migrations, analyses, checks. Build the tool that does it or proves it (codemod, script, generator, or a skill your subagents follow) instead
subTools.description_zh: 應用於任何非平凡的工作（編輯、遷移、分析、檢查）。建立能執行或證明該工作的工具（如 codemod、腳本、生成器或讓子代理遵循的 skill），而非手動處理。

subTools.name: Principle Encode Lessons In Structure
subTools.description: Apply when you catch yourself writing the same instruction a second time, or notice a recurring correction. Encode the rule as a lint, metadata flag, runtime check, or script instead of more text.
subTools.name_zh: 原則：將經驗編碼於結構
subTools.description_zh: 當發現自己重複撰寫相同指示或修正時，將規則編碼為 lint、metadata flag、執行階段檢查或腳本，而非僅新增文字。

subTools.name: Principle Exhaust The Design Space
subTools.description: Apply when facing a novel UI interaction or architectural decision with no precedent in the codebase. Build 2-3 competing prototypes and compare side by side before committing.
subTools.description_zh: 面對程式碼庫中無先例的新穎 UI 互動或架構決策時，建立 2-3 個競爭原型並並排比較後再做出決定。

subTools.name: Principle Experience First
subTools.description: Apply when product, UX, or feature-scope tradeoffs come up. Choose user delight over implementation convenience; ship fewer polished features over more rough ones.
subTools.description_zh: 產品、UX 或功能範圍權衡時，優先選擇使用者滿意度而非實現便利性；交付較少但精緻的功能，而非較多粗糙的功能。

subTools.name: Principle Explain The Number
subTools.description: Apply before you trust, report, or act on a number you measured: a speedup, a regression, a throughput, a latency, or an eval result. Find what limits it, and rule out that it measured something other
subTools.description_zh: 在信任、報告或根據測量的數字（如速度提升、衰退、吞吐量、延遲或評估結果）行動前，找出限制因素並排除測量到無關事物的可能性。

subTools.name: Principle Fix Root Causes
subTools.description: Apply when debugging. Trace each symptom back to the first place the system went wrong and fix it there. A guard is a fix only when the state it handles is legitimate.
subTools.description_zh: 除錯時，追溯每個症狀至系統首次出錯的位置並修復。僅當保護機制處理的狀態是合法時，才算真正修復。

subTools.name: Principle Foundational Thinking
subTools.description: Apply before writing logic: choosing core types and data structures, sequencing scaffold-vs-feature work, asking what concurrent actors share. Get the data structures right so downstream code becomes
subTools.description_zh: 撰寫邏輯前，先選擇核心類型與資料結構、排序腳手架與功能工作、確認並發角色共享的內容。讓資料結構正確，使下游程式更簡單。

subTools.name: Principle Guard The Context Window
subTools.description: Apply when context is filling up: large outputs, long files, repeated reads, fan-out planning. Route bulk to subagents; keep summaries in the main thread, not raw payloads.
subTools.description_zh: 當上下文即將填滿時（大型輸出、長檔案、重複讀取、扇出規劃），將批量任務路由給子代理；在主執行緒中保留摘要，而非原始載荷。

subTools.name: Principle Laziness Protocol
subTools.description: Apply when refactoring, evaluating diff size, or tempted to add abstractions, layers, or signal threading. Bias toward deletion and the smallest change that solves the problem.
subTools.description_zh: 適用時在重構、評估差異大小，或想新增抽象層、封裝層時。偏好刪除，以最小更動解決問題。

subTools.name: Principle Make Operations Idempotent
subTools.description: Apply when designing commands, lifecycle steps, or processing loops that run amid crashes, restarts, and retries. Converge to the same end state regardless of partial prior runs.
subTools.description_zh: 適用在設計命令、生命週期步驟或處理迴圈時，可能遭遇 crashes、restarts 與 retries。無論先前是否部分執行過，都收斂至相同最終狀態。

subTools.name: Principle Migrate Callers Then Delete Legacy Apis
subTools.description: Apply when introducing a new internal API while old callers still exist. Migrate callers and delete the old API in the same wave instead of preserving compatibility layers.
subTools.name_zh: 先遷移呼叫者再刪除舊 API
subTools.description_zh: 適用在新建內部 API 但舊呼叫者尚存的時機。在同一波次遷移呼叫者並刪除舊 API，而非保留相容性層。

subTools.name: Principle Minimize Reader Load
subTools.description: Apply when reviewing or shaping code that's hard to trace. Count layers between question and answer, and hidden state in the reader's head; collapse one-caller wrappers and shrink mutable scope.
subTools.description_zh: 適用在審查或設計難以追蹤的程式碼時。計算問題到答案之間的層數，以及閱讀者腦中的隱藏狀態；合併單呼叫者封裝，縮小可變範圍。

subTools.name: Principle Model The Domain
subTools.description: Apply when writing stateful logic, or when code branches a lot or repeats a shape assumption across files.
subTools.description_zh: 適用在撰寫狀態式邏輯，或程式碼分支繁多、在多個檔案重複相同結構假設時。

subTools.name: Principle Never Block On The Human
subTools.description: Apply when tempted to ask 'should I do X?' on reversible work.
subTools.description_zh: 適用在想對可逆工作詢問「我該做 X 嗎？」的時機，直接做就好。

subTools.name: Principle Outcome Oriented Execution
subTools.description: Apply during planned rewrites and migrations with explicit phase boundaries. Converge on the target architecture; don't preserve smooth intermediate states with throwaway compatibility code.
subTools.description_zh: 適用在有明確階段邊界的計劃性重寫與遷移。朝向目標架構收斂，不要用拋棄式相容程式碼保留中間平滑狀態。

subTools.name: Principle Prove It Works
subTools.description: Apply after completing a task, before declaring done. Verify against the real artifact (run the feature, read the actual value, inspect the diff), not a proxy, self-report, or 'it compiles.'
subTools.description_zh: 適用在完成任務後、宣告完成前。針對真實產物驗證（執行功能、讀取實際值、檢查 diff），而非依賴代理指標、自我報告或「編譯通過」。

subTools.name: Principle Redesign From First Principles
subTools.description: Apply when integrating a new requirement into an existing design.
subTools.name_zh: 基於第一性原理重設計
subTools.description_zh: 當將新需求整合至現有設計時使用。

subTools.name: Principle Separate Before Serializing Shared State
subTools.description: Apply when concurrent actors might write to the same file, branch, key, or state object. Eliminate the sharing first; serialize structurally only when one shared writer is a real invariant.
subTools.name_zh: 序列化共享狀態前先行分離
subTools.description_zh: 當多個執行緒可能寫入同一個檔案、分支、金鑰或狀態物件時使用。先消除共享；只有在單一共享寫入者是真正不變條件時，才進行結構性序列化。

subTools.name: Principle Sequence Verifiable Units
subTools.description: Apply to multi-step work (sweeps, migrations, runs of similar edits) and to how you stack commits and PRs. Break work into small units that each end in a verifiable state, check each before the next,
subTools.description_zh: 適用於多步驟工作與 commit、PR 堆疊方式。將工作拆解為小單元，每個單元都以可驗證狀態結束，逐一檢查後再進行下一步。

subTools.name: Principle Subtract Before You Add
subTools.description: Apply when sequencing an addition, refactor, or rewrite. Remove dead code, redundant validators, and stub references first, then build on the simpler base.
subTools.description_zh: 當安排新增、重構或改寫時使用。先移除廢棄程式碼、冗餘驗證器與標記參考，再以更簡潔的基礎進行建構。

subTools.name: Principle Test Behavior Not Implementation
subTools.description: Apply when you write, change, or keep a test. Assert what the code's users can observe, so that the test fails when that behavior breaks and keeps passing when only the internals change.
subTools.description_zh: 撰寫、修改或保留測試時使用。斷言使用者能觀察到的行為，讓測試在行為破壞時失敗，僅內部改變時保持通過。

subTools.name: Principle Type System Discipline
subTools.description: Apply when designing types, reviewing a function signature, or writing code in any statically-typed language. Make illegal states unrepresentable, brand semantic primitives, parse external data at bou
subTools.description_zh: 設計型別、審查函式簽名或使用任何靜態型別語言撰寫程式碼時使用。使非法狀態無法表示，標示語意基底，在邊界處解析外部資料。

subTools.name: Recall
subTools.description: Reconstruct your recent working context from your own chat history, live state, and the shared record (user reports, prior fixes, incidents), then hand back a tight current-state brief. Use for 'recal
subTools.description_zh: 從聊天紀錄、即時狀態與共享記錄重建近期工作脈絡，回傳精簡的當前狀態摘要。當使用者輸入 recall 時使用。

subTools.name: Reflect
subTools.description: Spawn three parallel review subagents over the active transcript, surface learnings, and route each to a concrete edit on an existing skill. Use when the user says reflect.
subTools.description_zh: 針對當前對話 Spawn 三個平行檢視子代理，浮現學習心得，並將各項導向對現有技能的具體編輯。當使用者輸入 reflect 時使用。

subTools.name: Setup Pstack
subTools.description: Configure which models pstack uses per role and at what reasoning budget. Detects your available models and writes an always-applied rule that overrides the skill defaults. Use for /setup-pstack, "con
subTools.description_zh: 設定 pstack 各角色使用的模型與推理預算。偵測可用模型後，寫入始終生效的規則以覆蓋技能預設值。用於 /setup-pstack。

subTools.name: Sharpen
subTools.description: Make a task deeper, not bigger, then rewrite the prompt. Use for /sharpen.
subTools.description_zh: 讓任務更深入而非更大，然後重新撰寫提示詞。用於 /sharpen。

subTools.name: Show Me Your Work
subTools.description: Keep a reviewable decision trail for long-running or unattended work: a TSV log with one row per decision (what, why, evidence, result). Local by default; commit it when a reviewer needs the trail to
subTools.description_zh: 為長時間或無人監控的作業保留可審查的決策軌跡：以 TSV 日誌記錄每項決策（內容、原因、證據、結果）。預設儲存於本地；若審查者需要軌跡，則將其提交。

subTools.name: Swarm
subTools.description: Fan out N parallel workers, drain them, and return one report. Use for /swarm, 'swarm this', or parallel coverage, races, gauntlets, and exploration.
subTools.description_zh: 展開 N 個平行工作節點，待它們完成後回收，並回傳一份綜合報告。可用於 /swarm、「swarm this」或平行覆蓋、競爭、挑戰與探索情境。

subTools.name: Tdd
subTools.description: Use only when the user explicitly asks for TDD, a failing test, or a regression test, OR when the bug has an obvious cheap local test target. Skip when the test path is unclear, expensive, integration
subTools.description_zh: 僅在使用者明確要求測試驅動開發、失敗測試或回歸測試，或當 Bug 有明顯的簡易本地測試目標時使用。若測試路徑不明確、成本高昂或涉及整合測試則跳過。

subTools.name: Teach
subTools.description: Explain a body of work plainly so a person actually understands it. Runs the `how` and `why` skills and weaves what they find into one clear explanation. Use for 'teach me this', 'help me really under
subTools.description_zh: 以淺顯方式說明工作內容，讓使用者真正理解。執行 `how` 與 `why` 技能，並整合兩者發現成一清晰解說。用於「教我這個」「幫我徹底了解」等需求。

subTools.name: Technical Writing
subTools.description: Layered technical-writing standard: Diátaxis structure, Google developer style sentences, STE instruction rules, Global English syntax. Use for /technical-writing or when writing or reviewing docs, RF
subTools.description_zh: 採用分層技術寫作標準：Diátaxis 結構、Google 開發者風格句子、STE 指導規則、全球英文句法。用於 `/technical-writing` 指令，或撰寫與檢視文件時。

subTools.name: Typescript Best Practices
subTools.description: TypeScript best practices. Use when reading or editing any .ts or .tsx file.
subTools.description_zh: TypeScript 最佳實踐指南。適用於讀取或編輯任何 `.ts` 或 `.tsx` 檔案時。

subTools.name: Unslop
subTools.description: Cut AI tells from any writing.
subTools.description_zh: 去除任何寫作中的 AI 痕跡。

subTools.name: Why
subTools.description: Use for 'why does X work this way', 'why we picked Y', design rationale, regressions, postmortems, or data-backed thresholds. Discovers available MCPs and queries each evidence category (source contro
subTools.description_zh: 用於「為什麼 X 會這樣運作」「為什麼選擇 Y」、設計理由、回歸分析、事後報告或資料支援的閾值。探索可用的 MCPs 並查詢每個證據類別。

subTools.name: Cancel Ralph
subTools.description: Cancel an active Ralph Loop. Use when the user wants to stop, cancel, or abort a running ralph loop.
subTools.description_zh: 停止正在執行的 Ralph Loop。當使用者想要停止、取消或中止執行的 ralph loop 時使用。

subTools.name: Ralph Loop
subTools.description: Start a Ralph Loop for iterative self-referential development. Use when the user asks to run a ralph loop, start an iterative loop, or wants repeated autonomous iteration on a task until completion.
subTools.description_zh: 啟動 Ralph Loop 進行迭代式自我參考開發。當使用者要求執行 ralph loop、開始迭代迴圈，或希望在任務中進行重複的自主迭代直到完成時使用。

subTools.name: Ralph Loop Help
subTools.description: Explain the Ralph Loop plugin, how it works, and available skills. Use when the user asks for help with ralph loop, wants to understand the technique, or needs usage examples.
subTools.description_zh: 說明 Ralph Loop 外掛的運作方式與可用技能。當使用者詢問 ralph loop 的幫助、想了解這項技術或需要使用範例時使用。

subTools.name: Create Learning Path
subTools.description: Build a personalized learning roadmap with milestones and practice checkpoints
subTools.description_zh: 建立個人化學習藍圖，包含里程碑與練習檢查點。

subTools.name: Run Learning Retrospective
subTools.description: Evaluate learning progress, identify blockers, and adjust the learning plan
subTools.description_zh: 評估學習進度、找出阻礙，並調整學習計畫。

subTools.name: Thermo Nuclear Code Quality Review
subTools.description: Run an extremely strict maintainability review for abstraction quality, giant files, and spaghetti-condition growth. Use for a thermo-nuclear code quality review, thermonuclear review, deep code quali
subTools.name_zh: 熱核武程式碼品質審查
subTools.description_zh: 執行極度嚴格的維護性審查，包含抽象品質、巨型檔案與義大利麵式條件判斷的成長。用於熱核武級程式碼品質審查、深層程式碼檢查。

subTools.name: Thermo Nuclear Review
subTools.description: Comprehensive security and correctness audit of a branch's changes. Use for thermo nuclear, thermonuclear, or deep review requests, or branch/PR diff audits focused on bugs, breaking changes, security
subTools.description_zh: 對分支變更進行全面的安全性和正確性稽核。用於深度審查要求，或針對錯誤、破壞性變更、安全性的分支／PR 差異稽核。

subTools.name: Thermos
subTools.description: Launch both thermo-nuclear review subagents in parallel, then synthesize their findings. Use for thermos, double thermo review, or combined bug/security and code-quality branch audits.
subTools.description_zh: 並行啟動兩個 Thermo 核戰級審查子代理，再綜合其結果。用於要求 Thermos 綜合審查、雙重 Thermo 審查，或結合錯誤／安全性與程式碼品質的分支稽核。

subTools.name: Google Docs
subTools.description: Author and edit Google Docs with the google-docs tools - structured writing, character and paragraph styling, lists, tables, images, headers/footers. Use when creating a formatted document, editing do
subTools.description_zh: 使用 google-docs 工具撰寫與編輯 Google Docs，支援結構化寫作、字元與段落樣式、清單、表格、圖片及頁首頁尾。適合建立格式化文件或編輯文件時使用。

subTools.name: Google Drive
subTools.description: Work with Google Drive through its MCP tools - search, read, create, organize, share, comment, and export files. Use when creating files in specific folders, moving or renaming, converting Markdown/CS
subTools.description_zh: 透過 MCP 工具操作 Google Drive，支援搜尋、讀取、建立、組織、分享、留言及匯出檔案。適合在特定資料夾建立檔案、移動或重新命名，以及轉換 Markdown/CS 格式時使用。

subTools.name: Google Sheets
subTools.description: Build and edit Google Sheets with the google-sheets tools - values, formatting, charts, conditional formatting, structure, validation, named and protected ranges. Use when creating a spreadsheet or da
subTools.description_zh: 使用 google-sheets 工具建立與編輯 Google 試算表，支援數值、格式、圖表、條件式格式、結構、驗證、命名範圍與受保護範圍等設定。當您需要建立或編輯試算表時可使用此工具。

subTools.name: Google Slides
subTools.description: Build and edit Google Slides through the google-slides MCP tools - slides, grids of cards and columns, text boxes, shapes, images, tables, styling, layout inspection, and per-slide PNG rendering. Use
subTools.description_zh: 使用 google-slides MCP 工具建立與編輯 Google 簡報，支援投影片、卡片與欄位列排版、文字方塊、圖形、圖片、表格、樣式、版面配置檢查，以及每張投影片的 PNG 渲染輸出。

subTools.name: Tailscale Setup
subTools.description: Walk a user through connecting Grok Bot to their Tailscale tailnet - define tag:grokbot in the tailnet policy file, grant it only the MCP hosts and ports it should reach, sign in from the Tailscale pl
subTools.description_zh: 引導使用者將 Grok Bot 連線至其 Tailscale tailnet：在 tailnet 政策檔中定義 tag:grokbot，僅授予其應可連線的 MCP 主機與通訊埠，並從 Tailscale 登入。

subTools.name: X Api Mcp Guide
subTools.description: ALWAYS read this when a user connects the X plugin or any X MCP, before using any X tool, including Grok Bot's built-in public reads (no X connection or credits needed), and again on any X error. Do n
subTools.description_zh: 請務必於連接 X plugin 或使用任何 X MCP 前閱讀本指南，包括 Grok Bot 內建的公開讀取功能（無需 X 連線或信用額度），並於任何 X 錯誤時再次參閱。

subTools.name: X Money Guide
subTools.description: Read this before the first X Money action in a session and again on any X Money error, refusal, or missing capability. Covers the approval rule for every action that moves money (always ask, every tim
subTools.description_zh: 每次會話中首次執行 X Money 操作前，以及遇到任何 X Money 錯誤、拒絕或缺失功能時，請先閱讀本指南。涵蓋每項涉及資金移動之操作的核准規則（每次務必詢問）。

tools.description_zh: Cursor 官方插件規範與官方插件集：每支插件是帶 .cursor-plugin 清單的獨立目錄，涵蓋編碼代理技能（PR 審查、任務編排、教學）、SDK 模式與大量 SaaS 整合（GitHub、Playwright、Google Workspace 等）。
tools.useCase_zh: 想直接取用現成 Cursor 插件（CI 檢查、PR 審查、語音應用、雲端代理編排、Gmail／文件／試算表整合），或需要為自家插件產生合規腳手架與上架檢查清單時。
advantages_zh: Monorepo + 每插件一份清單（已索引 169 個 skill 子工具），支援 monorepo 深層檢索。
Cursor 官方維護：開發流程插件與第一方 SaaS 整合收在同一份可瀏覽目錄。
create-plugin 與 review-plugin 兩支 skill 鎖定規範，新插件從腳手架到上架檢都有標準流程。
negativeConstraints_zh: 插件綁定 Cursor 編碼代理（.cursor-plugin 清單），不可當成獨立 CLI 直接執行。
第三方整合插件需要各服務的憑證與 OAuth 授權，離線環境多數不可用。

tools.name: Artcraft
tools.description: ArtCraft is an intentional crafting engine for artists, designers, and filmmakers
tools.useCase: Iteratively composing AI image and video creations — artists layer, mask, edit and regenerate results on a 2D canvas and inside 3D scenes (image-to-3D mesh, character posing, kitbashing) while switching between model providers.
advantages: 2D/3D creative IDE built for artistic control — compositing, masking, character posing and kitbashing instead of one-shot prompt boxes
Pluggable model providers (Grok, Midjourney, Sora, World Labs and more) so creators keep their favorite image/video models in one workspace
Open-source desktop app designed for AI media creation workflows
negativeConstraints: Generation quality depends on external model providers and their API access
Not a general-purpose 3D modeling suite — mesh features serve art compositing rather than engineering precision
tools.useCase_zh: 迭代式地進行 AI 圖像與影片創作——藝術家在 2D 畫布與 3D 場景中分層、遮罩、編輯並重新生成結果（圖像轉 3D 網格、角色姿勢調整、套件拼裝），並可在多個模型提供商之間切換。
advantages_zh: 為藝術控制而生的 2D／3D 創作 IDE——提供合成、遮罩、角色姿勢與套件拼裝，而非一次性提示框
可插拔的模型提供商整合（Grok、Midjourney、Sora、World Labs 等），多種圖像／影片模型集中在同一工作環境
開源桌面應用程式，專為 AI 媒體創作流程設計
negativeConstraints_zh: 生成品質取決於外部模型提供商及其 API 存取能力
並非通用 3D 建模套裝軟體——網格功能服務於藝術合成而非工程精度
tools.description_zh: ArtCraft — 藝術家的 IDE：用於 AI 圖像與影片創作的互動式桌面應用程式，具備 2D／3D 合成、圖像轉 3D 網格與可插拔模型提供商整合。

tools.name: VoxCPM
tools.description: VoxCPM2: Tokenizer-Free TTS for Multilingual Speech Generation, Creative Voice Design, and True-to-Life Cloning
tools.useCase: A developer integrates an Apache-2.0 licensed TTS API into a multilingual content platform to generate studio-quality speech and design synthetic voices from text descriptions without requiring reference audio for every new character.
advantages: Supports 30 languages including specific Chinese dialects without requiring language tags in the input.
Enables 'Voice Design' to create new voices from natural language descriptions alone, eliminating the need for reference audio.
Provides a tokenizer-free diffusion autoregressive architecture that outputs 48kHz studio-quality audio directly from 16kHz inputs.
Open-sourced under Apache-2.0 license with commercial-ready weights and code.
negativeConstraints: Requires significant GPU resources for inference, with real-time performance benchmarked on high-end hardware like NVIDIA RTX 4090.
Does not support languages outside the specific list of 30 primary languages and 9 Chinese dialects.
On-device inference is limited to specific quantization formats via llama.cpp-omni and may not support all advanced features like controllable style guidance at the same quality level.
tools.useCase_zh: 開發者將一個採用 Apache-2.0 授權的 TTS API 整合到多語言內容平台中，無需為每個新角色提供參考音訊即可從文字描述生成演播室級別的語音並設計合成音聲。
advantages_zh: 支援 30 種語言（包含特定中國方言），且輸入文字時無需指定語言標籤。
透過「語音設計」功能，僅憑自然語言描述即可建立新聲音，無需參考音訊。
採用免分詞器的擴散自回歸架構，可直接將 16kHz 輸入轉為 48kHz 演播室級別音訊。
以 Apache-2.0 授權公開原始碼與權重，可自由用於商業目的。
tools.description_zh: VoxCPM2：無需 Tokenizer 的多語言語音生成、創意語音設計與高度逼真變聲技術
negativeConstraints_zh: 推論過程需要大量 GPU 資源，即時效能僅在 NVIDIA RTX 4090 等高階硬體上測試過。
不支援特定 30 種主要語言與 9 種中方言以外的其他語言。
裝置端推論僅限透過 llama.cpp-omni 進行特定量化格式，可能無法以同等品質支援所有進階功能（例如可控語音風格引導）。

tools.name: Omnibox
tools.description: Cross-platform all-in-one AI knowledge hub (OmniBox / 小黑): collect web pages, PDFs, Word/PPT/MP3 files via browser extension, iOS Flash capture or WeChat bot, then parse, index and query them with RAG plus rich Markdown editing.
tools.useCase: A team captures diverse content like web pages, PDFs, and voice notes into a unified hub to perform cross-source Q&A and document generation.
advantages: End-to-end parsing and indexing for heterogeneous file formats including PDF, Word, PPT, and MP3.
Integrated advanced Markdown rendering for complex visual elements such as formulas, mind maps, flowcharts, and Gantt charts.
Cross-platform capture via dedicated browser extension, iOS app, and WeChat bot.
negativeConstraints: Deployment requires cloning the repository with submodules and configuring environment variables for local development.
RSS subscription features are not yet implemented according to the current roadmap.
tools.useCase_zh: 團隊將網頁、PDF 和語音筆記等多種內容收錄到統一中心，執行跨來源問答與文件生成。
advantages_zh: 支援 PDF、Word、PPT 和 MP3 等異質檔案格式之端對端解析與索引。
整合進階 Markdown 渲染，可處理公式、心智圖、流程圖和甘特圖等複雜視覺元素。
透過瀏覽器擴充功能、iOS 應用程式和 WeChat 機器人實現跨平台內容擷取。
tools.description_zh: 跨平台全方位 AI 知識中樞（OmniBox／小黑）：透過瀏覽器擴充功能、iOS Flash 擷取或微信機器人收集網頁、PDF、Word/PPT/MP3 等檔案，再結合 RAG 與豐富的 Markdown 編輯功能進行解析、索引與查詢。
negativeConstraints_zh: 部署需克隆包含子模組的 Git 儲存庫，並設定環境變數以進行本地開發。
RSS 訂閱功能尚未實作，目前規劃路徑中仍無此功能。

tools.name: Machine Skill
tools.description: Describe any machine in one line. Claude builds a photoreal, physics based, interactive simulation of it in one HTML file, plus the film to post it. An open source Claude Code skill.
tools.useCase: An engineer or educator in Claude Code generates a photoreal, physics-based 3D simulation of a specific machine (like a turbofan or pump) from a single line of description and exports a video film of it.
advantages: Uses Claude Code and three.js to generate interactive 3D simulations from natural language without requiring a traditional build step or compiler.
Integrs computed physics (e.g., Brayton cycle, affinity laws) and material properties directly into the visual simulation, rather than using static tables or pre-baked assets.
Includes a built-in recording script that allows the user to automatically generate shareable video films from the interactive HTML simulation.
negativeConstraints: Requires the Claude Code environment and specific dependencies (three.js 0.170) to generate and record the simulations.
Limited to generating machines and mechanical systems; not applicable for biological, abstract, or non-physical entities.
Relies on LLM research for machine specifications, meaning the accuracy of the physics depends on Claude's training data and retrieval capabilities.
tools.useCase_zh: 工程師或教育者在使用 Claude Code 時，透過一行文字生成特定機器（如渦扇發動機或泵浦）的光學逼真、物理驅動 3D 模擬，並可直接匯出影片。
advantages_zh: 利用 Claude Code 和 three.js，透過自然語言生成互動式 3D 模擬，無需傳統建置步驟或編譯器。
將計算出的物理法則（如布雷頓循環、相似定律）與材料特性直接整合至視覺模擬中，而非使用靜態表格或預製資產。
內建錄製腳本，可自動將互動式 HTML 模擬轉換為可分享的影片。
tools.description_zh: 只需一行描述任何機器，Claude 就能在單一 HTML 檔案中建立具物理效果的照片級真實感互動模擬，並產出影片供發布。這是一個開源的 Claude Code 技能。
negativeConstraints_zh: 需具備 Claude Code 環境與特定相依套件（three.js 0.170）才能產生與錄製模擬內容。
僅限生成機器與機械系統；不適用於生物、抽象或非實體物件。
依賴 LLM 研究來取得機器規格，因此物理模擬的準確度取決於 Claude 的訓練資料與檢索能力。

tools.name: dsh-Go
tools.description: dsh-go — DeepSeek Harness 裝進口袋：手機本機運行，也能遙控你的電腦。
tools.useCase: Mobile users who need to interact with the DeepSeek coding agent locally or remotely to execute tasks on their phone without a root environment.
advantages: Runs a built-in Linux environment on the phone without requiring Root or Termux.
Supports one-click remote control and seamless switching to a DSH instance running on a computer.
Allows interrupting or queuing messages during AI response generation with automatic process folding.
negativeConstraints: Requires Android 8.0 or higher; does not support iOS or HarmonyOS.
Cannot overlay-install if the device has a previous version signed with a different certificate; requires uninstalling old versions which clears local data.
Tied specifically to the DeepSeek Harness ecosystem.
tools.useCase_zh: 需要在手機上本地運行或遠端操控 DeepSeek 編碼代理，且不想依賴 Root 環境的行動裝置使用者。
advantages_zh: 手機內建 Linux 環境，免 Root、免 Termux 即可運行。
支援一鍵遠端操控電腦上的 DSH，並無縫切換對話。
允許在 AI 回應過程中插話或排隊訊息，完成後自動折疊過程。
tools.description_zh: dsh-go — DeepSeek Harness 裝進口袋：手機本機運行，也能遙控你的電腦。
negativeConstraints_zh: 需要 Android 8.0 以上；不支援 iOS 或 HarmonyOS。
若裝置已安裝以不同憑證簽署的舊版，無法覆蓋安裝；需先解除安裝舊版，這會清除本地端資料。
僅適用於 DeepSeek Harness 生態系統。

tools.name: dsh-superagent-prototype
tools.description: Towards a More Autonomous Agent System
tools.useCase: A development team operates a proactive coding agent that listens to GitHub and Feishu, allowing authorized users to request work which results in automated pull requests managed through a web panel that highlights items requiring human attention.
advantages: Proactively monitors GitHub and Feishu to initiate work items and generate pull requests when requested by authorized users.
Implements a 'minimal attention' philosophy where the agent acts only when explicitly asked or permitted by team-defined rules, reducing unnecessary interruptions.
Includes a dedicated web panel to visually track tasks that require human intervention or result review.
negativeConstraints: Intended as a research prototype and not production-ready; may contain bugs and inconsistent engineering practices, requiring review and adaptation before use.
The published code differs from the internal version described in the related paper, as some future design directions are not implemented.
tools.useCase_zh: 開發團隊操作一個主動型編碼代理，該代理監控 GitHub 與飛書，允許授權使用者請求任務並自動生成 Pull Request，同時透過網頁面板標識需要人工關注的事項。
advantages_zh: 主動監控 GitHub 和飛書，在獲授權使用者請求時自動建立工作項目並生成 Pull Request。
採用「最小注意力」原則，代理僅在明確請求或符合團隊預設規則時行動，減少不必要的干擾。
內建網頁面板，便於追蹤需要人工介入或結果審查的任務。
tools.description_zh: 朝向更自主的 Agent 系統邁進
negativeConstraints_zh: 作為研究原型，尚未達產品級強度；可能含有 bug 與不一致的工程實踐，使用前需經檢視與調整。
公布的程式碼與相關論文所描述的內部版本不同，部分未來設計方向尚未實作。

tools.name: unslop
tools.description: A Claude skill that turns vibecoded, AI-looking UI into a designed interface
tools.useCase: A developer or designer uses this skill in Claude Code, Codex, or Google Antigravity to audit and refactor 'vibecoded' AI-generated UIs into polished, character-driven interfaces across various frontend stacks.
advantages: Framework-agnostic support for Next.js, React, Vue, Svelte, Tailwind, and plain HTML/CSS
Automated generation of square 'story videos' (under 10s) using Playwright and ffmpeg to showcase the transformation
Ability to snapshot and fix live websites when only a URL is available
CC BY 4.0 license allowing commercial use and modification with attribution
negativeConstraints: Requires Playwright and Chromium installed locally for snapshotting live sites or generating story videos
Requires ffmpeg installed and available on PATH for story video creation
Paid image generation services (fal, Replicate, OpenAI, Higgsfield) require separate API connections and incur costs for visual assets
tools.useCase_zh: 開發者或設計師在 Claude Code、Codex 或 Google Antigravity 中，使用此技能審計並重構「vibecoded」的 AI 生成 UI，將其轉換為具備風格與設計感的介面，支援多種前端技術棧。
advantages_zh: 跨框架支援 Next.js、React、Vue、Svelte、Tailwind 及純 HTML/CSS
可自動生成低於 10 秒的方形「故事影片」，使用 Playwright 與 ffmpeg 展示轉化過程
當僅有網址時，可快照並修復線上網站
採用 CC BY 4.0 授權，允許商業使用與修改（需標註來源）
tools.description_zh: Claude 技能：將隨手寫出、帶有 AI 感的 UI 轉換為經過設計的介面
negativeConstraints_zh: 需要本機安裝 Playwright 與 Chromium，以便對線上網站進行截圖或產生故事影片。
需要 ffmpeg 已安裝且可於 PATH 中存取，用於故事影片產生。
付費圖像生成服務（fal、Replicate、OpenAI、Higgsfield）需另行串接 API，產生視覺素材會產生費用。

tools.name: misterdownloadmanager
tools.description: misterdownloadmanager: The ultimate open-source, clean-room download manager written from scratch in pure Rust for Windows, Mac, and Linux
tools.useCase: A user on Windows, macOS, or Linux wants to download large files or manage torrent/magnet links using a browser-integrated, free download manager that is significantly faster than IDM.
advantages: 5x faster than IDM, completing a 1GB download in 1 second versus 5.5 seconds
Full support for BitTorrent features including magnet links, .torrent files, and seeding
Supports 86 languages, significantly more than IDM's 40, with no ads, trials, or sign-ups required
Open-source (GPL-3.0) and clean-room implementation written from scratch in pure Rust
negativeConstraints: macOS support is experimental for both Apple Silicon and Intel
Written in Rust with GPL-3.0 license, which may conflict with proprietary software integration requirements
tools.useCase_zh: 使用 Windows、macOS 或 Linux 的使用者，想要透過瀏覽器整合、免費的下載管理員來下載大檔案或管理 BitTorrent/磁鐵鏈接，且速度遠超 IDM。
advantages_zh: 速度比 IDM 快 5 倍，下載 1GB 檔案僅需 1 秒（IDM 需 5.5 秒）
完整支援 BitTorrent 功能，包括磁鐵鏈接、.torrent 檔案與種子傳播
支援 86 種語言（IDM 僅 40 種），無廣告、無試用期、無需註冊
採用 GPL-3.0 授權的開源軟體，以純 Rust 從零編寫（清潔室實現）
tools.description_zh: misterdownloadmanager：一款完全重新撰寫、乾淨實作的開放原始碼下載管理工具，以純 Rust 打造，支援 Windows、Mac 與 Linux
negativeConstraints_zh: macOS 支援為實驗性質，無論 Apple Silicon 與 Intel 皆然。
以 Rust 與 GPL-3.0 授權撰寫，可能與 proprietary 軟體整合需求衝突。

tools.name: Lichii
tools.description: VERY experimental Nintendo Switch 2 emulator
tools.useCase: 適用於在桌面環境中測試、研究或遊玩實驗性 Nintendo Switch／Switch 2 相容遊戲與渲染管線（HDR 輸出、區域網路連線、畫面升頻）的開發與模擬場景。
advantages: 基於 yuzu／Sudachi／Eden 等專案累積進行相容性與渲染器修復
支援原生 HDR10／scRGB 輸出與 XeSS／DLSS 等畫質升頻路徑
內建 LAN Play 區域無線網路連線模擬功能
negativeConstraints: 處於高度實驗階段，不適用於追求穩定商業級遊玩體驗的生產環境
不適用於缺乏合法遊戲備份與系統金鑰的一般終端使用者
tools.description_zh: 高度實驗性的 Nintendo Switch 2 模擬器
negativeConstraints_zh: 處於高度實驗階段，不適用於追求穩定商業級遊玩體驗的生產環境
不適用於缺乏合法遊戲備份與系統金鑰的一般終端使用者

tools.name: HGhub
tools.description: YellowFruit third-party client
tools.useCase: 適用於在 Windows、macOS 或 Android 裝置上透過 Rust 與 Tauri 2 輕量化桌面／行動客戶端瀏覽與播放 YellowFruit 相關短劇及影視串流內容的場景。
advantages: 採用 Rust 與 Tauri 2 框架打造，具備輕量體積與較低記憶體佔用
提供跨平台原生支援（涵蓋 Windows、macOS 與 Android）
negativeConstraints: 屬於第三方非官方串流客戶端，不適用於企業級合規媒體託管或正式商業影音發行系統
依賴外部 YellowFruit 來源服務可用性，無法作為離線本地影片轉檔或剪輯工具
tools.description_zh: YellowFruit 第三方客戶端
negativeConstraints_zh: 屬於第三方非官方串流客戶端，不適用於企業級合規媒體託管或正式商業影音發行系統
依賴外部 YellowFruit 來源服務可用性，無法作為離線本地影片轉檔或剪輯工具

tools.name: agent_skills
tools.description: Official AI agent skills collection by Jane Street featuring socratic-tutor, a structured SKILL.md skill that turns coding agents into strict, anti-sycophancy Socratic tutors with diagnostic placement and spaced review.
tools.useCase: 適用於希望讓 AI 程式代理（如 Claude Code、Cursor 等支援 SKILL.md 的環境）進入嚴謹蘇格拉底式教學模式，透過診斷測驗、反迎合提問與間隔複習深度學習技術概念的場景。
advantages: 內建意圖護欄，僅在明確要求學習或測驗時啟動教學迴圈，不干擾日常問答
具備 4–10 項子技能診斷定位與 Level 0–5 ASCII 技能樹進度追蹤
嚴格禁止直接洩漏答案或迎合錯誤回答，搭配間隔複習強化長期記憶
negativeConstraints: 雖然由 Jane Street 發布，但本專案並非量化交易演算法或金融交易機器人
不適用於只需快速取得現成程式碼或直接代寫任務的日常開發工作流
tools.description_zh: Jane Street 開源的 AI 代理技能集合，內含 socratic-tutor 結構化 SKILL.md 技能，可將程式開發代理轉換為具備診斷評量、技能樹追蹤與間隔複習機制的嚴謹蘇格拉底式導師。
negativeConstraints_zh: 雖然由 Jane Street 發布，但本專案並非量化交易演算法或金融交易機器人
不適用於只需快速取得現成程式碼或直接代寫任務的日常開發工作流

tools.name: rea-video
tools.description: Reverse-engineer any video, shot by shot: filmed, AI-generated or coded, and how to remake it. Breakdowns in the open VIDEO.md format. 逆向一切視頻，逐個鏡頭看是拍的、AI 生成的還是代碼做的，再告訴你怎麼復刻；拆解結果按 VIDEO.md 格式輸出。
tools.useCase: 適用於需要將既有影片逐鏡頭逆向拆解，辨識實拍、AI 生成或程式碼動畫來源，並產出結構化 VIDEO.md 報告與復刻藍圖（含分鏡、提示詞、字幕時間軸與音訊節奏）的場景。
advantages: 支援離線確定性拆解與多模態視覺模型輔助，可區分實拍、AIGC 與動畫鏡頭
自動輸出開放式 VIDEO.md 藍圖與互動式 report.html，並支援匯出 .SRT／.ASS 字幕軸
整合 Claude Code 與 Codex 等 AI 代理技能，將復刻步驟分為拍攝、生成與程式實作三類
negativeConstraints: 必須本機具備 Python 3.10+ 與 FFmpeg 環境，不適用於純瀏覽器無後端或無法安裝系統二進位檔的環境
不適用於僅需單純影片格式轉檔、基礎裁切或即時直播串流處理的任務
tools.description_zh: 逆向解構任何影片，逐鏡頭分析是拍攝、AI 生成還是程式碼製作，以及重製方法；拆解結果以開放式 VIDEO.md 格式輸出。
negativeConstraints_zh: 必須本機具備 Python 3.10+ 與 FFmpeg 環境，不適用於純瀏覽器無後端或無法安裝系統二進位檔的環境
不適用於僅需單純影片格式轉檔、基礎裁切或即時直播串流處理的任務

tools.name: cleanyourtv
tools.description: Debloat any Android or Google TV over Wi-Fi and get an Apple TV-style home.
tools.useCase: A user wants to remove ads and bloatware from a specific Android TV or Google TV device by connecting via Wi-Fi to enable USB debugging, running a script to disable manufacturer services, and installing a custom launcher.
advantages: Operates over Wi-Fi without requiring physical USB cable connection or root access.
Uses 'pm disable-user' instead of uninstalling, allowing complete restoration with a one-line command if the user changes their mind.
Features a native, lightweight launcher (572 KB) that replaces the stock ad-filled home screen with an Apple TV-like interface.
Automatically discovers brand-specific bloatware differences and prompts for confirmation before disabling potentially needed services.
negativeConstraints: Cannot be used on Samsung, LG, Roku, Vizio, or Hisense VIDAA TVs; it supports only Android TV and Google TV.
Requires the TV to have developer options enabled with USB debugging (Adb) active and network accessibility from the host computer.
Host environment requires Python 3, JDK 17-22, and Android SDK platform 34 with build-tools 34 to build and install the launcher.
tools.useCase_zh: 使用者希望透過 Wi-Fi 連接 Android TV 或 Google TV，啟用 USB 偵錯後執行腳本停用製造商服務並安裝自訂啟動器，以去除廣告與冗餘軟體。
advantages_zh: 透過 Wi-Fi 操作，無需實體 USB 線材或 Root 權限。
使用「pm disable-user」而非直接 uninstall，可透過單行指令完整還原，降低風險。
提供輕量級原生啟動器（572 KB），將充滿廣告的主畫面替換為類似 Apple TV 的介面。
能自動偵測不同品牌的冗餘軟體差異，並在停用可能需要的服務前請求確認。
tools.description_zh: 透過 Wi-Fi 對 Android 或 Google TV 進行 debloat，獲得類 Apple TV 的主畫面體驗。
negativeConstraints_zh: 不適用於 Samsung、LG、Roku、Vizio 或 Hisense VIDAA 電視；僅支援 Android TV 與 Google TV。
必須在電視上啟用開發者選項並開啟 USB 除錯（Adb），且主機電腦需能存取該電視。
主機環境需具備 Python 3、JDK 17–22，以及含 build-tools 34 的 Android SDK platform 34，用於建置與安裝啟動器。

tools.name: GestaltX
tools.description: An MobileGestalt editor for iOS 27.x, featuring region-code tweaks, device presets, backups.
tools.useCase: iOS developers or advanced users on iOS 27.x modify their device's MobileGestalt to enable Apple Intelligence features, change region codes, or adjust hardware flags using a native SwiftUI app.
advantages: Native SwiftUI interface optimized for iOS 27.x with automatic backup creation and restoration for device safety.
Includes a dedicated recovery workflow to fix hardware identity spoofing issues that might have broken Face ID or dictation in previous tools.
Supports local plist import/export allowing for safe offline inspection and modification of system configuration files.
Uses a safer activation approach that avoids permanent hardware identity spoofing, unlike older tools like YumEdit.
negativeConstraints: Requires iOS 27.x or later; on-device MobileGestalt access is explicitly not supported on iOS 26.x.
Mandatory ad-hoc signing with a specific certificate and App Group entitlements, which is not suitable for standard App Store distribution.
Apple Intelligence feature activation is experimental and depends on specific device models, OS versions, and Apple service availability.
tools.useCase_zh: iOS 開發人員或進階使用者在 iOS 27.x 裝置上，透過原生 SwiftUI 應用修改 MobileGestalt 以啟用 Apple Intelligence 功能、調整區域代碼或硬體標誌。
advantages_zh: 優化於 iOS 27.x 的原生 SwiftUI 介面，具備自動備份與還原機制以確保裝置安全。
包含專門的恢復流程，可修復先前工具造成的硬體身份偽裝問題（如 Face ID 或語音聽寫失效）。
支援本地 plist 匯入與匯出，允許安全地離線檢查與修改系統設定檔。
採用較安全的啟用方式，避免像 YumEdit 這類舊工具常見的永久硬體身份偽裝風險。
tools.description_zh: 一款用於 iOS 27.x 的 MobileGestalt 編輯器，支援地區碼微調、裝置預設檔與備份功能。
negativeConstraints_zh: 需 iOS 27.x 或以上版本；iOS 26.x 明確不支援裝置上的 MobileGestalt 存取。
強制要求以特定憑證進行 ad-hoc 簽名及 App Group 權限，不適合標準 App Store 發行。
Apple Intelligence 功能啟用屬實驗性質，取決於特定裝置型號、OS 版本及 Apple 服務可用性。

tools.name: rune
tools.description: Rune: Native UI framework
tools.useCase: Developers building native desktop or web applications in Rust use Rune to create GPU-accelerated user interfaces, and automation scripts use its headless mode to render PNG screenshots and inspect element trees for testing agents.
advantages: Native GPU-rendering engine with custom text, layout, and spring physics.
Supports headless execution to render PNGs and dump element trees for agent-driven automation.
Cross-platform compatibility for macOS, Windows, Linux, and web environments.
negativeConstraints: Pre-release status requires pinning specific git revisions, leading to potential instability compared to stable libraries.
Does not accept pull requests; contributors must use issues and agents for submissions.
tools.useCase_zh: 使用 Rust 開發原生桌面或 Web 應用程式的開發者，利用 Rune 建構 GPU 加速的使用者介面；自動化腳本則可利用其離頭模式渲染 PNG 截圖並檢查元素樹，以支援智能體的測試與驗證。
advantages_zh: 具備原生 GPU 繪製引擎，內含自有的文字、排版與彈簧物理效果。
支援離頭（headless）執行，可將介面渲染為 PNG 並傾印元素樹，方便智能體驅動自動化。
跨平台相容性，涵蓋 macOS、Windows、Linux 及 Web 環境。
tools.description_zh: Rune：原生 UI 框架
negativeConstraints_zh: 原始版本狀態需鎖定特定 Git 修訂版，導致相較穩定函式庫可能有較不穩定的風險。
不接收程式碼合併請求；貢獻者需透過問題與代理人進行提交。

tools.name: Kiri
tools.description: A small, fast container runtime for macOS, Windows and Linux
tools.useCase: A developer on macOS or Windows needs to run Docker images quickly without the resource overhead of Docker Desktop, using the standard docker CLI and Kiri's native UI for local domains and one-command Kubernetes.
advantages: Starts and exits containers in ~2.5ms, which is approximately 80 times faster than Docker Desktop.
Low memory footprint with the daemon staying at ~15MB and the VM sleeping after 60s of idle time, waking in ~0.15s.
Includes a one-command Kubernetes cluster launcher and local domain support (http://<name>.kiri.local) with HTTPS certificates.
Written in Rust with a custom 10MB kernel and ~900KB agent, avoiding runc, shim, and dockerd for improved efficiency.
negativeConstraints: Requires macOS 14 or later for the native macOS version.
Windows support depends on WSL 2 for execution.
Currently lacks a built-in builder, relying on external buildx or upcoming roadmap features for complex builds.
tools.useCase_zh: 在 macOS 或 Windows 上，開發者需要快速執行 Docker 映像檔，且希望避免 Docker Desktop 的高資源佔用，可使用標準 docker CLI 搭配 Kiri 的原生介面來管理本地域名與一鍵啟動的 Kubernetes 叢集。
advantages_zh: 容器啟動與結束約需 2.5 毫秒，比 Docker Desktop 快約 80 倍。
記憶體佔用低，守護程序僅約 15 MB，閒置 60 秒後虛擬機休眠，醒來僅需約 0.15 秒。
支援一鍵啟動 Kubernetes 叢集，並提供本地域名（http://<name>.kiri.local）及 HTTPS 憑證。
使用 Rust 撰寫，配備自訂 10 MB 核心與約 900 KB 代理程式，無需 runc、shim 或 dockerd，效率更高。
tools.description_zh: 一套輕量快速的容器執行階段，支援 macOS、Windows 與 Linux
negativeConstraints_zh: 原生 macOS 版本需 macOS 14 或以上版本。
Windows 支援需依賴 WSL 2 才能執行。
目前缺乏內建組建工具，複雜組建需依賴外部 buildx 或未來規劃的功能。

tools.name: Craft Anything
tools.description: Craft Anything: understand how any software works, and craft your own.
tools.useCase: A developer points Craft Anything at a target website or game, instructs a coding agent to recreate it in a specific stack, and reviews the automated comparison before running the new build.
advantages: Uses 320 dedicated inspection tools to study targets without requiring an LLM for the analysis phase
Operates as a clean-room engine in pure Rust with dual MIT/Apache-2.0 licensing
Automatically compares generated builds against originals using multi-width checks and self-tests to refine results
Exposes all functionality as both CLI commands and MCP tools for seamless integration with external agents
negativeConstraints: Currently in early alpha status, making it unsuitable for production-critical workflows
Requires a specific target artifact (website, app, or game) to initiate the study phase
Not a general-purpose IDE; functionality is strictly bound to the 'craft' (replicate) workflow
tools.useCase_zh: 開發者將 Craft Anything 指向目標網站或遊戲，指示 AI 代理人以特定技術棧重構專案，並在執行新構建前審查自動比對結果。
advantages_zh: 使用 320 個專用檢測工具分析目標，無需依賴大型語言模型即可進行結構分析
以純 Rust 撰寫的清潔室引擎，採 MIT/Apache-2.0 雙授權模式
自動將生成結果與原始目標進行多寬度畫面與自我測試比對，持續優化差異
所有功能均暴露為 CLI 指令與 MCP 工具，便於與外部 AI 代理人整合
tools.description_zh: Craft Anything：理解任何軟體的運作方式，並自行打造。
negativeConstraints_zh: 目前處於早期 Alpha 階段，不適合用於產線關鍵型工作流程。
需指定特定目標成果（網站、應用程式或遊戲）以啟動學習階段。
並非通用型 IDE；功能嚴格限制在「打造」（複製）工作流程中。

tools.name: Apkstart
tools.description: Windows 上的安卓應用運行器：雙擊 APK 即裝，應用以獨立窗口與桌面圖標運行，自持 QEMU 運行時
tools.useCase: A Windows user wants to run specific Android APK files locally without using a mobile device or complex cloud services, installing them by double-clicking the APK file to generate native desktop shortcuts.
advantages: Allows running Android apps as native Windows desktop windows with independent icons and start menu entries.
Uses host network NAT via QEMU user-mode instead of creating virtual network adapters, avoiding driver installation and network configuration changes.
Self-contained runtime management that automatically downloads and verifies ADB, Emulator, and Android images from official sources without relying on third-party emulators.
negativeConstraints: Requires Windows 10/11 x64 architecture; incompatible with macOS or Linux systems.
Heavy resource consumption due to bundled QEMU emulator and Android system image, requiring significant RAM and storage for performance.
tools.useCase_zh: Windows 使用者希望在本地執行特定的 Android APK 檔案，無需使用手機或複雜的雲端服務，透過雙擊 APK 檔案即可安裝並生成原生桌面捷徑。
advantages_zh: 允許將 Android 應用程式作為原生 Windows 桌面視窗執行，並具備獨立的桌面圖示與開始選單項目。
使用 QEMU 使用者態 NAT 橋接主機網路，而非建立虛擬網卡，避免安裝驅動程式或更改網路設定。
自帶的時區管理系統可自動下載並驗證 ADB、模擬器與 Android 映像，無需依賴第三方模擬器。
tools.description_zh: Windows 上的安卓應用程式執行器：雙擊 APK 即可安裝，應用程式以獨立視窗與桌面圖示執行，內建 QEMU 執行階段
negativeConstraints_zh: 僅支援 Windows 10/11 x64 架構；不兼容 macOS 或 Linux 系統。
因內建 QEMU 模擬器與 Android 系統映像檔，資源消耗較重，需大量 RAM 與儲存空間以維持效能。

tools.name: SheeridVerify
tools.description: sheeridVerify 是一個基於 Node.js 的驗證流程學習項目，提供本地 Web 工作台、任務隊列、瀏覽器表單交互及 HTTP 狀態查詢，供學校教學、學術研究和獲得授權的流程測試使用。
tools.useCase: Researchers use the local web dashboard to queue and monitor automated SheerID verification tasks while manually completing interactive real-person checks.
advantages: Local-first architecture keeps personal data and configuration on the user's machine by default
Built-in retry and backoff logic distinguishes network failures from verification rejections
Supports concurrent task management with configurable limits and automatic state polling
negativeConstraints: Intended only for educational or research purposes; unauthorized use or identity fraud is prohibited
Requires Node.js >= 22.15 and manual installation of Camoufox for browser-based workflows
Does not generate, modify, or fake verification documents or materials
tools.useCase_zh: 研究人員使用本機 Web 工作台排程並監控 SheerID 驗證任務，同時手動完成需要真人互動的驗證步驟。
advantages_zh: 本機優先架構，預設將個人資料與設定檔保留在用戶裝置上
內建重試與退避邏輯，能區分網路故障與驗證被拒的狀態
支援並行任務管理，可設定並發上限並自動輪詢查詢狀態
tools.description_zh: sheeridVerify 是一個基於 Node.js 的驗證流程學習專案，提供本機 Web 工作台、任務佇列、瀏覽器表單互動及 HTTP 狀態查詢功能，供學校教學、學術研究與合法授權的流程測試使用。
negativeConstraints_zh: 僅限教育或研究用途；禁止未經授權的使用或身分詐欺行為。
需 Node.js >= 22.15 版，並需手動安裝 Camoufox 以支援基於瀏覽器的流程。
不得產生、修改或偽造驗證文件或相關材料。
